Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do.

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, security and aerospace company headquartered in Arlington, VA, with locations across the country. BAE Systems employees’ dedication and commitment show in everything they create and deliver, including advanced electronic systems, cyber operations and intelligence analysis, combat vehicles, naval weapons, ship maintenance and modernization, and vehicle upgrades and services.

How we work is rooted in purpose – a purpose to protect those who protect us, to unite our community of colleagues and customers, and to drive forward the growth and development of our exceptional team members. Connect your passion for making a difference to career full of purpose by visiting jobs.baesystems.com.

BAE Systems, Inc. believes in the free exchange of ideas and encourages all visitors to its social media properties to engage in spirited conversation. We expect and encourage differences in opinions and perspectives, but we require a civil discourse. To that end, all posts and comments must:

- Refrain from promoting partisan political causes.
- Protect confidential, proprietary, embargoed or otherwise protected information. 
- Respect and protect intellectual property rights and permissions for artistic content.

Further, BAE Systems will remove comments that do not contribute to a civil discourse.  The following are examples of comments that will be removed:  
- Profanity, or any speech that is potentially denigrating or demeaning.
- Violence, threats of violence, or implied violence.
- Descriptions of illegal activity, or implied illegal activity.
- Ad hominem attacks or personal insults.
- Off-topic or demonstrably false information

Job Description


BAE Systems, a top-ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of Defense, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence & Security provides services and products to the Department of Defense, the government, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world.

At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie and a shared ambition to lead the world in defense technologies and national security services. We offer flexible work environment to support the balance in your life and keep you performing at your best. Be a part of a company that is part of the community; driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.

We are looking for experienced System Engineers to join our technology-based program supporting a key government customer. This program will deliver engineering services for network infrastructure as well as sophisticated enterprise computing infrastructure including end-point devices, data center hosted servers, multi-Cloud services as well as virtualized applications, and storage systems. Enterprise Computing Engineering services include modern application technology including containerized solutions with orchestrated workflow that function both on customer premise, and via remote Cloud services. Network infrastructure engineering services are comprised of core infrastructure, voice and video engineering, field engineering, application management and development for networks, network analytics, firewalls, network access controls and bandwidth service delivery. This is a fast paced, challenging, and career rewarding experience to recruit and develop provide top talent and solutions on one of the most complex and high-profile programs within the government.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer with a Bachelors degree, 6 years of experience and a background utilizing the following:

  • AWS Services
    • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch and CloudTrail
    • Ability to manage and maintain AWS Cloud infrastructure, including resource provisioning, monitoring and cost optimization
  • Python Programming
    • Proficient in Python programming language (version 3.9 or later)
    • Ability to write Python scripts to automate tasks, such as data processing, file management and system administration
    • Familiarity with popular Python libraries, such as Boto3 (AWS SDK for Python), requests and Django
  • Automation
    • Experience with automation tools, such as Ansible, Terraform and/or CloudFormation
    • Ability to translate deployment practices into automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash scripts and/or other automation tools
  • Other
    • Familiarity with Version Control systems such as Git and specifically, GitHub
    • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools, such as Prometheus and CloudWatch
    • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Development, Operations and Security teams
    • Knowledge of Agency governance and compliance practices as they relate to AWS and other Cloud environments to include Government best practices and Government Enterprise services, processes and procedures
    • Architect background; ability to advise customer management on technical conversations within the team to support customer tools and operations; be the team technical rep. at technical meetings


Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • AWS Cloud Certification(s)


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $132962 - $226035

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

descriptionHtml:
Altamira Technologies has a long and successful history providing innovative solutions throughout the U.S. National Security community. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Altamira serves the defense, intelligence and homeland security communities worldwide by focusing on creating innovative solutions leveraging common standards in architecture, data and security. Altamira believes that our people and the culture of our company differentiate us from other companies.

Position: Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Specialist (Senior)

Position Location: Remote /Joint Base Andrews

Position Description:

Altamira is seeking an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Specialist key role in designing, provisioning, securing, and maintaining the AWS-based infrastructure supporting the DME MVP solution. This role combines cloud architecture, DevSecOps engineering, automation, and security expertise ensuring that all deployed environments meet strict DoD standards and operate efficiently within a SIPR environment. The specialist also contributes to a self-service data infrastructure platform that accelerates development and operational agility across the mission.

This position is remote, must be able to attend occasional meetings at Joint Base Andrews.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, harden, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure supporting the DME MVP solution.
  • Build a self-service data infrastructure platform to accelerate engineering and data workflows.
  • Engineer cross cloud data interoperability across AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud.
  • Develop secure, fully automated Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling automated testing, security scanning, and continuous delivery.
  • Lead creation of MVP service catalog and API gateway with integrated access controls.
  • Manage cloud networking, IAM, encryption, identity federation, and segmentation aligned to DoD requirements.
  • Optimize cloud performance, reliability, and cost across multiple platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD STIGs, Zero Trust principles, CSF, and related cybersecurity frameworks.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and knowledge sharing materials.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Must possess and maintain required DoD 8140 certifications.
  • Understanding of cross cloud data patterns and architectures (AWS/Azure/OCI/GCP).
  • Deep hands-on AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM, KMS, VPC, and monitoring services.
  • Strong command of AWS IAM roles, policies, and security best practices.
  • Expert level proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline).
  • Strong DevSecOps background and familiarity with modern Git/GitOps workflows.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, Linux/Unix administration, and security fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of Zero Trust architectures, DoD STIGs, secure API patterns, and boundary protections.
  • Excellent problem solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast paced, evolving environment.
  • Active Secret clearance required; TS/SCI preferred.

Education:

  • 10 years of experience with MA/MA degree or equivalent experience
  • Security Clearance: SECRET - With ability to acquire TS/SCI

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000 to $175,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, the scope of the position, relevant experience, education, certifications, internal equity, customer contractual requirements, security clearance requirements, and other legitimate business considerations.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support a company focused on federal modernization, cloud transformation, and mission-critical technology initiatives. This position is on-site in Huntsville, AL. The Senior Cloud Engineer will design, deploy, optimize, and sustain secure cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, data platforms, and DevSecOps operations. This is an opportunity to play a key role in modernizing critical government systems while ensuring scalable, resilient, and secure cloud environments supporting high-impact national missions.

Responsibilities for the Senior Cloud Engineer include:

  • Design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, data workloads, and modernization initiatives
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar automation tools
  • Support CI/CD pipeline integration, cloud automation, monitoring, logging, and observability initiatives
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls including IAM, encryption, network segmentation, compliance, and vulnerability remediation
  • Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues while collaborating with engineering, migration, testing, and operations teams

Required Qualifications for the Senior Cloud Engineer include:

  • 8+ years of experience with cloud engineering, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, and automation
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud networking, troubleshooting, and technical documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
  • Active Top Secret Security Clearance

Compensation for the Senior Cloud Engineer include:

Salary Range: $185,000-200,000 depending on experience

Full Benefits Package: PTO, Paid Holidays, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Tuition Reimbursement, Sick Leave as Required by Law

Department: Information Technology

Job Number: 100666

Offices: Boston; Chicago; Los Angeles; Washington, D.C.; Tampa

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

EEO/AA EMPLOYER/Veterans/Disabled

Manatt is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, physical or mental disability, religion, creed, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex or gender (including gender identity, gender expression, status as a transgender or transsexual individual, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), age (over 40), genetic information, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, sexual orientation, political activity or affiliation, genetic or and any other protected classes or characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the American Disabilities Act, applicants may request accommodations needed to participate in the application process.

This employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

IMPORTANT: If the Government cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to provide you written instructions and an opportunity to contact SSA and/or DHS before taking adverse action against you, including terminating your employment.

Employers may not use E-Verify to pre-screen job applicants or to re-verify current employees and may not limit or influence the choice of documents presented for use on the Form I-9. In order to determine whether Form I-9 documentation is valid, this employer uses E-Verify’s photo screening tool to match the photograph appearing on some permanent resident and employment authorization cards with the official U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services’ (USCIS) photograph. If you believe that your employer has violated its responsibilities under this program or has discriminated against you during the verification process based upon your national origin or citizenship status, please call the Office of Special Counsel at 1-800-255-7688 (TDD: 1-800-237-2515).

- Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations.

descriptionHtml:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Project Software Engineer II on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure.
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO).
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment.

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $88,600 to $147,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
About Fervo Energy

Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America’s most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.

Position Description

The Senior Cloud Engineer builds, automates, and operates Fervo’s Azure-native cloud platform, turning architectural designs into repeatable, well-governed infrastructure. The role centers on infrastructure as code, GitHub-based delivery, self-service platform capabilities, and automated configuration of Linux and Windows systems. Success requires hands-on engineering, demonstrated coding ability, and the discipline to manage infrastructure through version-controlled, peer-reviewed practices rather than manual change.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure as Code & Delivery

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep) and reusable modules to provision Azure resources consistently across environments and sites.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and enforce GitOps workflows where changes flow through version control, pull requests, and peer review.

Platform Engineering & Self-Service

  • Build and iterate golden paths and self-service capabilities, with guardrails codified as policy to keep provisioning within security, cost, and tagging standards.
  • Document platform capabilities so internal teams can consume them without one-to-one engineering support.

Systems Configuration & Fleet Management

  • Manage Linux and Windows configuration through automation—Ansible and SUSE Manager (or equivalent) for Linux; Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy for Windows—rather than manual, host-by-host changes.
  • Maintain baseline images and standards so new hosts, including field and edge compute, are provisioned in a known, compliant state.

Operations, Security & Compliance

  • Operate Azure landing zones and platform services within an Entra ID / Zero Trust model, with observability across monitoring, logging, alerting, and cost.
  • Ensure changes flow through auditable pipelines supporting SOX ITGC, and apply NERC CIP-aligned controls where platform components support in-scope systems.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8 years in infrastructure support or engineering with demonstrated progression.
  • 6+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, or platform engineering.
  • Production experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or Bicep), including reusable modules and state management.
  • Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD or similar product.
  • Demonstrated coding ability in Python and/or PowerShell, evidenced by repositories or work samples.
  • Experience managing both Linux and Windows systems through automation (e.g., Ansible, Microsoft Intune and/or Group Policy).

Preferred

  • Platform engineering experience: internal developer platforms, golden paths, and self-service provisioning.
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience; Azure remains the primary platform.
  • SUSE Manager (or equivalent, such as Red Hat Satellite) and Microsoft Intune at scale.
  • Policy-as-code (Azure Policy, Open Policy Agent) and secrets management (Azure Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
  • Regulated-sector experience and familiarity with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or NERC CIP.
  • Certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

Location

Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position will be eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in-office presence at our Houston office will be required.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer-paid basic life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match
  • Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave
  • Family-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot
  • A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses
  • An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care
  • Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo’s Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as LTI and bonus opportunities for eligible roles

Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change.

Our Workplace

Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule.

Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

Description

SAIC is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer to provide provision of Global Enterprise IT services, specifically focusing the design and management of the core cloud infrastructure. With a deep understanding of AWS & Azure service such as EC2/Azure Virtual Machines, VPC/Virtual Networks and S3/Storage accounts. In addition to these responsibilities, the Cloud Engineer create and maintain the foundational elements that support cloud applications and services. The Engineer is expected to deliver Tier 3 level support to SITEC 3 EOM mission partners. This critical support role involves the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of system outages, all while guaranteeing optimal service uptime and mission operational capabilities.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is a pivotal role within our IT infrastructure team, providing tier three systems support in line with the SIE OPORD. This position demands a comprehensive understanding of government PAAS, SAAS coupled with advanced skills in analysis, troubleshooting, and system design. Effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders is a critical component of this role. The engineer will be integral to the systems engineering process, leveraging data for performance enhancement, and participating actively in working groups, design reviews, and system testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and administer the AWS & Microsoft Azure cloud environment, including provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, policy governance and security.
  • Design, develop, and implement highly available, multi-region solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Analyze existing operational standards, processes, and/or governance to identify and implement improvements.
  • Migrate existing infrastructure services to cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage security and access controls of cloud-based solutions.
  • Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) leveraging cloud native tooling to ensure automated and consistent platform deployments.
  • Develop and implement policy driven data protection best practices to ensure cloud solutions are protected from data loss.
  • Support cloud adoption of applications as they are being transformed and/or modernized.
  • Ensure all resources components meet proper performance and capacity standards.
  • Provide training and mentorship to Cloud Administrators, enhancing their understanding of Cloud capabilities and standard configurations.
  • Innovate and implement new technologies to advance mission readiness.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance

  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of 3+ years of AWS/Microsoft Azure experience involving design, deployment, configuration, and optimization.
  • Proven track record in managing production Windows Servers and implementing top-tier security practices within an enterprise environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft operating platforms and office applications.
  • At least 3 years of relevant IT experience.
  • Demonstrated ability in performance optimization and system engineering processes.

Required Certifications

  • DoW 8570 IAT II Certification.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Intermediate level or higher.

Desired Skills

  • Microsoft Certified Expert in the Azure product line OR.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Target salary range $80,001 - $120,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

With a deep understanding of AWS & Azure service such as EC2/Azure Virtual Machines, VPC/Virtual Networks and S3/Storage accounts. In addition to these responsibilities, the Cloud Engineer create and maintain the foundational elements that support cloud applications and services. The Engineer is expected to deliver Tier 3 level support to SITEC 3 EOM mission partners. This critical support role involves the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of system outages, all while guaranteeing optimal service uptime and mission operational capabilities.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is a pivotal role within our IT infrastructure team, providing tier three systems support in line with the SIE OPORD. This position demands a comprehensive understanding of government PAAS, SAAS coupled with advanced skills in analysis, troubleshooting, and system design. Effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders is a critical component of this role. The engineer will be integral to the systems engineering process, leveraging data for performance enhancement, and participating actively in working groups, design reviews, and system testing.

Key Responsibilities



- Manage and administer the AWS & Microsoft Azure cloud environment, including provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, policy governance and security.
- Design, develop, and implement highly available, multi-region solutions within Microsoft Azure.
- Analyze existing operational standards, processes, and/or governance to identify and implement improvements.
- Migrate existing infrastructure services to cloud-based solutions.
- Manage security and access controls of cloud-based solutions.
- Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) leveraging cloud native tooling to ensure automated and consistent platform deployments.
- Develop and implement policy driven data protection best practices to ensure cloud solutions are protected from data loss.
- Support cloud adoption of applications as they are being transformed and/or modernized.
- Ensure all resources components meet proper performance and capacity standards.
- Provide training and mentorship to Cloud Administrators, enhancing their understanding of Cloud capabilities and standard configurations.
- Innovate and implement new technologies to advance mission readiness.

Qualifications

Required Education



- Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance



- Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills



- Minimum of 3+ years of AWS/Microsoft Azure experience involving design, deployment, configuration, and optimization.
- Proven track record in managing production Windows Servers and implementing top-tier security practices within an enterprise environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft operating platforms and office applications.
- At least 3 years of relevant IT experience.
- Demonstrated ability in performance optimization and system engineering processes. 

Required Certifications



- DoW 8570 IAT II Certification. 
- Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Intermediate level or higher. 

Desired Skills



- Microsoft Certified Expert in the Azure product line OR.
- AWS Solutions Architect Professional OR.
- Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert OR.
- Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Target salary range $80,001 - $120,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Summary:
The Azure Cloud Engineer works as part of a cross-functional infrastructure and cloud engineering team to design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve secure, scalable Microsoft Azure environments. This role emphasizes Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, cloud networking, identity integration, and platform reliability, partnering closely with security, application, and data teams to deliver resilient, well-architected cloud platforms using DevOps best practices.

Qualifications:

  • Four-year college degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform or Bicep)

  • CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Container experience (Docker required; AKS preferred)
  • Cloud security controls implementation experience
  • Automation and scripting using PowerShell, Bash, or Python

  • Hybrid connectivity (VPN, ExpressRoute)
  • Azure landing zones and CAF alignment
  • FinOps and cost governance familiarity

Skills and Competencies

  • Independent judgment and initiative
  • Self-motivated with minimal supervision
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Work Conditions


  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to sit for extended periods
  • Occasional travel for data center maintenance and training



Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Bicep)
  • Build, operate, and enhance CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application delivery
  • Architect and manage Azure networking, including Virtual WAN, VNets, peering, Route Server, private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and gateways
  • Implement identity, access control, and privilege management using Microsoft Entra ID (RBAC, PIM, managed identities)
  • Design and operate secure storage solutions (Azure Storage, managed disks, Azure Files)
  • Implement secrets, key, and certificate management using Azure Key Vault
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS)
  • Operate and support Azure compute and platform services (VMs, App Service, Functions, AKS, Front Door, Load Balancers, Gateways, WAF)
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and observability using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
  • Apply cloud security best practices, governance standards, and compliance controls
  • Support cost optimization, capacity planning, and resource lifecycle management

Competitive salary plus excellent benefits and perks including, but not limited to:


  • Medical, Dental and Vision

Description

Company Description

Citizant is a leading provider of professional IT services to the U.S. government. We seek to address some of our country’s most pressing challenges in Agile application development, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, and Program Management support services. We strive to hire only ethical, talented, passionate and committed “A Players” who already align with the company’s core values: Drive, Delivering Excellence, Reputation, Responsibility, and a Better Future. No matter how large we grow, Citizant will retain its collaborative, supportive, small-company culture, where successful team effort to address external and internal customer challenges is valued above all else.

This position is for a near-term opportunity

Position Summary

The Field Maintenance Command and Control (FMxC2) Cloud Engineer designs, implements, secures, automates, and supports cloud infrastructure and platform services supporting the FMxC2 application. This role enables application modernization, scalability, resiliency, security, and DevSecOps delivery. The Cloud Engineer plays a key role in cloud adoption, Infrastructure-as-Code implementation, CI/CD pipeline development, deployment automation, and secure application delivery.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of infrastructure, platform, systems, or cloud engineering experience.
  • Experience deploying, managing, and supporting solutions within enterprise cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Cloud One, or similar platforms).
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code and automation solutions.
  • Experience supporting containerized applications and orchestration platforms.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevSecOps processes within enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts, secure system design, and cloud security principles.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Local to Montgomery, AL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Experience supporting FMxC2.
  • Experience supporting Air Force logistics, maintenance, readiness, sustainment, or operational systems.
  • Experience supporting DoD or Air Force programs.
  • Experience supporting cloud migration and application modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies.
  • Cloud-related certifications.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based AI/ML services, automation frameworks, or infrastructure supporting AI-enabled solutions.
  • SAFe Agile experience or certification.

Clearance Requirement

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.

Citizant Offers a Competitive Benefits Package, Including

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition Assistance & Professional Development Program

Join our team and be part of a forward-thinking organization committed to innovation, professional growth, and supporting national defense initiatives. We offer a collaborative culture that values your expertise and encourages continuous learning and development.

Additional Information

Citizant strives to be an employer of choice in the Washington metropolitan area. Citizant associates accept challenging and rewarding work and, in return, receive excellent compensation and benefits, as well as the opportunity for personal and professional development.

Citizant is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

$113,000 - $117,000/yearly

Department: Information Technology

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

descriptionHtml:
What We Need

Brady Corporation is seeking an exceptional Cloud Engineer to design, build, administer, maintain, and optimize our growing multi-cloud infrastructure and Google Workspace ecosystem. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional software and security teams to deploy highly available, cost-effective cloud solutions while driving collaboration and productivity through Workspace optimizations. You will play a vital part in modernizing our technological footprint and establishing best practices for cloud adoption across our global operations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Implement and maintain secure cloud infrastructure (primarily GCP and Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Administer, maintain, and optimize the Google Workspace environment (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Chat, etc.) to ensure a seamless and productive experience for end-users.
  • Manage unified user provisioning, Cloud Identity, and role-based access control (RBAC) linking GCP and Google Workspace.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage containerized applications utilizing Docker and Kubernetes (GKE/AKS).
  • Monitor cloud performance, troubleshoot complex system issues, and optimize resource utilization for FinOps cost efficiency.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to streamline automated deployment processes.
  • Collaborate on the migration of legacy on-premise systems and applications to modern, scalable cloud architectures.
  • Ensure all cloud deployments meet strict internal security standards and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis to ensure high availability of critical services.

What You Will Need To Be Successful

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, IT infrastructure, or software development.
  • Exceptional working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Microsoft Azure services.
  • Proven experience administering Google Workspace, Cloud Identity, and associated enterprise collaboration tools.
  • Experience with container orchestration tools and methodologies.

descriptionHtml:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

The Cloud Engineer will design, operate, and continuously improve Rivian’s multi-cloud infrastructure with a strategic focus on our expansion into Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AI/LLM enabled workloads, and our already mature AWS environment. This is a hands-on, operations-focused role that drives infrastructure automation, security, observability, and cost optimization for mission-critical cloud workloads.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to deliver cloud solutions that enable teams to operate cloud workloads that are performance and cost optimized.
  • Operate and secure core networking, accounts, and workload identities (IAM/SSO) in GCP .
  • Enable and operationalize cloud services to support AI/ML and LLM workloads, including AWS Bedrock and GCP AI platforms.
  • Automate infrastructure end-to-end using Terraform (IaC), AWX/Ansible, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot critical workloads, including EKS/Kubernetes environments, HPC clusters, and large-scale storage.
  • Implement and improve observability best practices (e.g. AWS CloudWatch, GCP Monitoring) and participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
  • Drive cost eﬃciency (FinOps mindset) by supporting ongoing cost reviews and optimization efforts.

Qualifications

  • Growth mindset with the ability to evaluate/learn new technologies quickly and apply them to deliver solutions that meet Business needs.
  • Hands-on experience operating production workloads on GCP (AWS is a plus).
  • Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code (Cloud Formation, CDK, Terraform) and configuration management (Ansible/AWX).
  • Strong knowledge of coreGCP services (GKE, networking, Vertex AI/Gemini).
  • Practical experience with observability tools (e.g., Datadog) and strong debugging skills across distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming or scripting language for tooling and automation (e.g., Python, Go).
  • Proficiency in generating software using coding agents; productionizing vibe-coded applications.

Pay Disclosure

Salary Range for this role is $97,700 - $122,100 for Georgia based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.

Interview Integrity & AI Policy

Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore, the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted. We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.

Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy 11 paid holidays, up to 34 days of PTO
  • Robust 401(k) Plan: Benefit from up to a 12% company contribution, including a 3% safe harbor, 6% match, and up to 3% additional as a form of profit sharing.

  • Inspiring Work Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, creative, and supportive culture where you are encouraged to push boundaries, take risks, and enjoy the rewards.

Archer is collaborating with MANTECH to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior AWS Cloud Engineer to join our team in Virginia Beach, VA. This is a hybrid position.

The Senior AWS Cloud Engineer will be supporting an ambitious endeavor to reimagine how our customer, Naval Sea Systems, provides AWS cloud services to its customers. This includes deploying AWS services in a modern, fully automated manner.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Interact with stakeholders for status meetings, requirements gathering, and similar meetings
  • Compose new Terraform code and/or edit existing code for the deployment of AWS resources
  • Take an automation-first approach to the administration and configuration management of resources deployed in AWS GovCloud
  • Administer Red Hat Enterprise Linux and/or Windows Server instances and their AMI lifecycle
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies as a member of a highly functioning Agile engineering team
  • Create, maintain, and update relevant system documentation as required

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other related STEM discipline and 9+ years of relevant experience OR a High School Diploma and 13+ years of relevant experience completing tasking relevant to cloud engineering
  • Must have an associate-level AWS certification (ex. AWS CSAA) or higher
  • Must possess a DoD 8570 Computing Environment certification (ex. Sec+)
  • Experience in RHEL OS and/or Windows Server with knowledge in maintaining them
  • Experience automating production cloud deployments/administration with tools like Terraform and/or Ansible

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles
  • 3+ years of production Terraform experience
  • Experience working with GitHub or similar system and Git

Clearance Requirements

  • Must possess an active Secret security clearance

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations.
  • Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations

descriptionHtml:
Altamira Technologies has a long and successful history providing innovative solutions throughout the U.S. National Security community. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, Altamira serves the defense, intelligence and homeland security communities worldwide by focusing on creating innovative solutions leveraging common standards in architecture, data and security. Altamira believes that our people and the culture of our company differentiate us from other companies.

Position: Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Specialist (Senior)

Position Location: Remote /Joint Base Andrews

Position Description

Altamira is seeking an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Specialist key role in designing, provisioning, securing, and maintaining the AWS-based infrastructure supporting the DME MVP solution. This role combines cloud architecture, DevSecOps engineering, automation, and security expertise ensuring that all deployed environments meet strict DoD standards and operate efficiently within a SIPR environment. The specialist also contributes to a self-service data infrastructure platform that accelerates development and operational agility across the mission.

This position is remote, must be able to attend occasional meetings at Joint Base Andrews.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, harden, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure supporting the DME MVP solution.
  • Build a self-service data infrastructure platform to accelerate engineering and data workflows.
  • Engineer cross cloud data interoperability across AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and Google Cloud.
  • Develop secure, fully automated Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling automated testing, security scanning, and continuous delivery.
  • Lead creation of MVP service catalog and API gateway with integrated access controls.
  • Manage cloud networking, IAM, encryption, identity federation, and segmentation aligned to DoD requirements.
  • Optimize cloud performance, reliability, and cost across multiple platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD STIGs, Zero Trust principles, CSF, and related cybersecurity frameworks.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and knowledge sharing materials.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Must possess and maintain required DoD 8140 certifications.
  • Understanding of cross cloud data patterns and architectures (AWS/Azure/OCI/GCP).
  • Deep hands-on AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM, KMS, VPC, and monitoring services.
  • Strong command of AWS IAM roles, policies, and security best practices.
  • Expert level proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline).
  • Strong DevSecOps background and familiarity with modern Git/GitOps workflows.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, Linux/Unix administration, and security fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of Zero Trust architectures, DoD STIGs, secure API patterns, and boundary protections.
  • Excellent problem solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast paced, evolving environment.
  • Active Secret clearance required; TS/SCI preferred.

Education

  • 10 years of experience with MA/MA degree or equivalent experience
  • Security Clearance: SECRET - With ability to acquire TS/SCI

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000 to $175,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, the scope of the position, relevant experience, education, certifications, internal equity, customer contractual requirements, security clearance requirements, and other legitimate business considerations.
