descriptionHtml:
Platform Engineer (Azure), Boulder, CO (Hybrid or Remote)

Ascend's Azure platform runs the hosted environments behind Market Intelligence (MI), PowerVAL (PV), PowerSIMM (PS), SmartBidder (SB), Ascend Power Procurement (APP), and Ascend Energy Exchange (AEX). As Platform Engineer, you'll design, build, and operate that platform alongside our Senior Platform Engineer, working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and identity and security administration. You'll partner with Development, Model Support, and client-facing teams to deliver reliable environments, move clients from on-premises hosting into Azure, and help maintain our security and compliance posture.

You'll do well here if you have strong hands-on Azure skills, automate and document what you build, and can explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Our Mission @ Ascend

At Ascend Analytics, our mission centers on creating sustainable economic value for energy buyers and producers to transform the power industry. Our team combines advanced analytics, cloud-based technology, and deep market expertise to help our clients solve complex challenges across grid reliability, power market volatility, renewable integration, infrastructure development, and energy investment strategy. As a high-growth, private equity–backed company, Ascend continues to expand its market leadership while investing in innovation, talent, and scalable solutions for an increasingly dynamic energy market.

Your Impact @ Ascend

Real influence. Real outcomes. At every level.

  • High-impact work. Shape the tools and decisions that drive the clean energy transition.
  • Direct exposure. Work alongside executive leadership and key utility and corporate clients.
  • Room to grow. A rapidly scaling SaaS business with real advancement opportunities.
  • Collaborative culture. A team that values creative thought, inclusion, and work-life balance.

Key Responsibilities

Azure infrastructure and networking

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Azure resources, including virtual machines, App Services, container apps, batch accounts, storage accounts, file shares, and key vaults.
  • Build and maintain Azure networking: VNets and subnets, site-to-site and point-to-site VPN, private endpoints, NAT gateways for static IP requirements, and Front Door routing.
  • Configure and manage Azure Virtual Desktop host pools, images, scale plans, and published applications for analyst and developer workstations.
  • Maintain backup, monitoring, and alerting coverage across development and production environments.

Automation and DevOps

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform, delivered through Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for application build, versioned deployment, and environment promotion, including service connections, self-hosted agents, and federated identity credentials.
  • Help development teams move build and test workloads from legacy on-premises environments into Azure.

Identity, security, and compliance

  • Administer Entra ID: user and group provisioning, conditional access, MFA, SSO integrations, and app registrations, with automated monitoring of expiring secrets and certificates.
  • Manage Privileged Identity Management role eligibility, access reviews, and approval of elevation requests.
  • Administer role-based access for client-facing platforms and resolve customer authentication and MFA issues escalated through the IT case queue.
  • Deploy and maintain endpoint security tooling, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Provide evidence, control descriptions, and technical input for SOC 2 Type II audits and customer security assessments, and advise on audit scope for newly production-hosted systems.

Client support and documentation

  • Support client onboarding and migrations, including storage access, VPN connectivity, and third-party integrations.
  • Serve as an escalation point for platform incidents affecting internal users and hosted clients.
  • Maintain network diagrams and hosting documentation as environments change, and lead internal cross-training sessions on Azure architecture.
  • Provide weekly status updates on priorities, progress, and blockers.

Required

Key Qualifications

  • 4+ years in cloud platform, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • AZ-104 or a similar intermediate-level Azure certification.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS and PaaS: VMs, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Container Apps, and Azure Batch.
  • Strong working knowledge of Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Azure networking experience: VNet design, VPN gateways, private endpoints, NAT, DNS, and firewall rules.
  • Hands-on Entra ID administration: conditional access, MFA, SSO, app registrations, and PIM.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell and KQL for automation and reporting.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
  • Clear technical writing and the ability to communicate with non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a SOC 2 Type II audit cycle.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop administration at scale.
  • Bicep infrastructure-as-code experience.
  • Power BI Embedded capacity management.
  • Oracle Database or Autonomous Database on Azure.
  • Background supporting SaaS products in energy, utilities, or another regulated industry.
  • Advanced certifications: AZ-305, AZ-400, or SC-300.

If you don't meet every qualification but this role excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Our Values @ Ascend

Ascend promotes a culture of teamwork, inclusion, and work-life balance. We operate by five core pillars:

  • Integrity: We act with honesty and uphold the highest ethical standards, doing the right thing even when it's difficult.
  • Purpose Driven: We are united by a shared purpose — to deliver meaningful impact for our customers, our industry, and the energy transition to a low-carbon future.
  • Belonging: We foster a respectful, inclusive environment where everyone is valued, diverse perspectives are embraced, and equitable opportunities are provided for all.
  • Innovation: We anticipate and address new challenges, embracing change and continuous improvement.
  • One Team Mindset: We collaborate across teams and functions, supporting one another and prioritizing shared success over individual wins.

Your Value @ Ascend

Join a team that values your work, supports your growth, and invests in your future.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • FSA, HSA, and dependent care accounts
  • 401(k) with 3% non-elective contribution
  • Flexible PTO and work hours

Salary range: $85,000-$115,000 USD annually, calibrated to your experience and structured to grow with you.

Compensation is flexible and tailored to your qualifications, relevant experience, and location of hire.

We thrive on collaboration, whether in our Boulder office or across a screen.

That's why our Boulder, CO office runs on a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 days remote). We prefer candidates who can work from Boulder HQ, but it isn't a requirement: we're open to strong remote candidates, and we make it easy to collaborate across both.

Need accommodations? Contact us at recruiting@ascendanalytics.com.

Ascend Analytics is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or genetic information.

Note: We regret that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

descriptionHtml:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Staff Cloud Infrastructure / Scientific Computer Engineer to help build, operate, and improve the infrastructure foundations that support computational science, data engineering, analytics, and enterprise business operations across RevMed. This role will emphasize site reliability engineering, Kubernetes operations, observability, Databricks infrastructure, and cloud financial management (FinOps).

This role will partner with scientific, G&A, data, security, and IT stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable compute and platform services. The ideal candidate brings deep infrastructure experience, strong operational judgment, and the ability to translate scientific and business computing needs into practical, reusable platform patterns. They will balance reliability, performance, security, and cost, using operational data to guide improvements.

  • Design, operate, and improve secure cloud infrastructure for R&D and scientific computing workloads.
  • Build reusable infrastructure patterns for compute, storage, networking, identity, secrets management, and observability.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform, to standardize provisioning and change management.
  • Apply SRE practices to critical platform services, including service-level indicators and objectives, actionable alerting, incident response, post-incident reviews, and automation that reduces operational toil.
  • Operate and improve Kubernetes environments, including cluster upgrades, workload deployment, resource allocation, autoscaling, networking, access controls, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop observability across cloud, Kubernetes, and data platforms using metrics, logs, and traces to identify failures, diagnose performance issues, and understand capacity needs.
  • Support high-throughput and scientific compute environments, including HPC and scheduler-based workloads.
  • Enable reproducible compute patterns using Linux, containers, registries, and automated deployment workflows.
  • Partner with data and ML teams on infrastructure for dataset staging, training workflows, batch inference, and platform reliability.
  • Own the operational foundations of Databricks environments, including workspace provisioning, compute policies, networking, identity, secrets, governance integrations, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.
  • Partner with data teams to improve Databricks workload reliability, compute utilization, performance, and cost through appropriate compute sizing, autoscaling, workload isolation, and lifecycle controls.
  • Support data platform infrastructure for scientific, analytics, and G&A use cases, including secure access patterns, governance integrations, and scalable storage.
  • Drive FinOps practices across cloud and Databricks services, including cost allocation and tagging, usage visibility, budgets, forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization recommendations.
  • Identify and implement cost improvements through rightsizing, idle-resource cleanup, storage lifecycle management, and appropriate purchasing commitments, while preserving workload reliability and performance.
  • Improve operational practices such as monitoring, incident response, runbooks, capacity planning, recovery readiness, and service ownership.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with scientists, data engineers, security, and IT to deliver practical platform solutions.
  • Mentor others and contribute to standards, documentation, and reusable patterns for cloud operations, reliability engineering, and scientific infrastructure.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, DevOps/SRE, scientific computing, or related technical roles.
  • Strong experience operating production infrastructure in AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.
  • Strong experience with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Practical experience with Linux, networking fundamentals, system troubleshooting, and operational support.
  • Experience with CI/CD, version control, peer review, testing, and change management practices.
  • Experience supporting containerized workloads using Docker or similar technologies, including hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production.
  • Experience implementing observability and reliability practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident management, and systematic troubleshooting of distributed services.
  • Experience operating Databricks or comparable managed data platforms, with an understanding of compute, networking, identity, governance, and operational support.
  • Experience analyzing cloud usage and expenditure and implementing cost optimization measures with measurable results.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex technical problems and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar agents for cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, systems configuration, operational tooling, AI-native application development, and agentic engineering.
  • Experience with managed Kubernetes services such as Amazon EKS or Azure AKS, and deployment approaches using Helm or GitOps.
  • Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable cloud-native or commercial tools.
  • Experience with Databricks infrastructure automation, Unity Catalog integrations, compute policies, and workload usage and cost reporting.
  • Experience with FinOps processes and tooling, including cost attribution, showback, forecasting, commitment planning, and collaboration with Finance and workload owners.
  • Experience supporting HPC or high-throughput compute environments, including Slurm or similar schedulers.
  • Experience supporting scientific computing, computational chemistry, computational biology, or data-intensive R&D workflows.
  • Experience with cloud security, identity, least privilege access, auditability, and regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with workflow tools such as Nextflow, Snakemake, Airflow, or cloud batch services.
  • Experience building reusable platform patterns, documentation, and self-service infrastructure capabilities.

HJF is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Systems Engineer II - Cloud Engineer to develop, implement, and maintain systems in the cloud supporting large-scale biological data analysis for research. The Systems Engineer works independently; establishes internal priorities, work schedules and goals and uses their own initiative and sound judgment. Work is evaluated based on results achieved towards established goals and requirements, timeliness, application of sound business practice and efficient use of resources.

Physical Capabilities

  • Ability to stand or sit at a computer for prolonged periods.

Work Environment

  • This position will take place primarily in an office setting.

Compensation

  • The annual salary range for this position is $77,600-$115,000. Actual salary will be determined based on experience, education, etc.

descriptionHtml:
Are you a multitalented software engineer who is at home in the Cloud?

Expedition Technology, (EXP), in Herndon, VA is seeking an experienced Cloud Development Software Engineer to join our collaborative team. We support the Department of Defense and Intelligence Communities by developing ground-breaking applications that combine signal processing and image processing with artificial intelligence/machine learning capabilities.

If you join us, you’ll combine Cloud engineering and software engineering skills to work with a team tasked to design, develop and deploy cloud-native applications using Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will focus on building scalable, resilient and containerized applications within the AWS ecosystem that support high-side and low-side development.

Does this sound like a challenge you’d like to explore? Here’s what you’ll need to know for the role.

Responsibilities

  • Manage cleared Cloud deployments using C2S
  • Work with a team to manage existing AWS infrastructure in GovCloud
  • Utilize your DevOps skills to maintain and support software engineering efforts
  • Employ your software engineering skills to design and develop CloudFormation templates for reusability, and use Lambda or ECS Fargate code for logic implementation

The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing cloud infrastructure and services to ensure high availability, reliability, and scalability as well as automating deployment of infrastructure through infrastructure as code. This role involves working closely with other IT professionals to develop and maintain cloud-based solutions that meet the company’s objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain cloud-based infrastructure, applications, and services. This includes selecting appropriate cloud services, creating architecture diagrams, and developing automation scripts.
  • Deploy new applications to the cloud and migrate existing applications to modern cloud services.
  • Monitor the performance of cloud-based systems and optimize resources to ensure cost-effectiveness and high availability.
  • Design, implement and support monitoring and observability solutions for cloud-based resources
  • Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise and be part of responding to any outages.
  • Support in the design and architecture of new solutions such as new applications, networking and systems or re-design to enhance current applications, networking and systems.
  • Develop and enforce cloud security policies and procedures to protect data and applications from unauthorized access and potential security threats.
  • Document the architecture of the environment, train other team members and create standard operating procedures for team members as well as other IT Teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, relative field or an equivalent combination of education and experience required
  • Minimum four (4) years of experience working in Cloud Engineering, Software/Network Engineering, Computer and Information Science, and/or related field.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience documenting infrastructure and setting standards and procedures
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, OCI), Cloud Strategy, Design, Architecture, and Migration
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with troubleshooting Line-of-Business applications, Incident, Problem and Change Management
  • Exhibits excellent verbal, written, and executive presentation skills;collaborates effectively to facilitate progressive change;maintains a strong quality and results orientation;and implements process improvement changes with leadership direction.

Compensation

The anticipated pay range/scale for this position is $105,322.00 to $131,652.00 Annually. Actual starting base pay within this range will depend on factors including geographic location, education, training, skills, and relevant experience.

Additional Compensation

This position is eligible to receive a discretionary annual bonus.

Perks and Benefits

Employees have the opportunity to participate in medical, dental and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts and/or health savings accounts; dependent savings accounts; 401(k) with company matching contributions; employee stock purchase plan; and a tuition reimbursement program. The Company provides 9 paid holidays per year, and, upon hire, new employees will accrue paid time off (PTO) at a rate of 0.0577 hours of PTO per hour worked, up to a maximum of 120 hours per year.

Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.

Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Engineer to design, build, automate, and support secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure. This role will primarily focus on Microsoft Azure and work closely with Infrastructure, Security, Network, Application, and DevOps teams to support enterprise cloud services.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services.
  • Build and manage compute, storage, networking, DNS, load balancing, and private connectivity.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and cloud security controls.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity and integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, identity, performance, and availability issues.
  • Participate in production incident response, root cause analysis, change management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Support backup, disaster recovery, resiliency, and business continuity requirements.
  • Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud costs.
  • Maintain cloud standards, documentation, and operational procedures.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure, systems, or cloud engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  • Strong PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar automation experience.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones and enterprise cloud governance.
  • Experience with AKS, containers, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Backup, or Azure Site Recovery.
  • Experience supporting hybrid and regulated enterprise environments.
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-700, or AZ-400.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $160,000.00/Yr. - USD $200,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Job Description

Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union

This position requires working onsite in San Francisco, 2 days per week, and is not negotiable. We are unable to offer employment sponsorship for this position - now or in the future. An in-person interview will be part of the recruitment process.

The Senior Cloud Engineer will be accountable for driving the configuration and operation of University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) cloud infrastructure services. The Senior Cloud Engineer will coordinate the partnership with a broad range of developers, engineers, business partners, and key University stakeholders to provide best-in-class cloud services. This role configures and facilitates workloads in the cloud, automates cloud infrastructure maintenance, and builds new operational monitoring capabilities.

The Senior Cloud Engineer will positively impact UCSF’s operations and culture by ensuring UCSF’s Information Technology (IT) infrastructure is operable, secure, efficient, and effective in service of the University’s mission. The Senior Cloud Engineer will advance the University’s mission by delivering exceptional information technology services comprehensively and consistently across customers and stakeholders. This role will execute UCSF’s vision while modeling UCSF’s culture and values.

Department Overview

University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is distinguished as a leading academic healthcare organization, home to groundbreaking discoveries, world-class education, and exceptional healthcare services. Infrastructure Services (IS) is the backbone of the technological infrastructure, assuring the technical services that enable the academic, medical, and research missions of the organization. Beyond a focus on maintaining systems and resolving issues, we are committed to nurturing the potential of our team members and empowering them to excel. UCSF Infrastructure Services provides 24x7 support to the University community, always upholding the highest level of responsiveness and reliability for our customers. IS values innovation and excellence in ensuring secure and efficient Information Technology (IT) services, regardless of the hour or complexity of the issue.

The Platform Services team within Infrastructure Services is committed to empowering the academic, medical, and research mission of UCSF by ensuring that all customers have seamless, secure, and accessible technological support. The team oversees the management and maintenance of various technology platforms, including system and cloud services, to guarantee they are secure, readily available, and performing optimally. Platform Services handles the management of critical software, such as Epic, ensuring it supports the highest level of medical service delivery by operating at peak performance. The team also oversees data center operations, including server management, storage, and networking equipment, to ensure the reliable delivery of health services. Additionally, it manages databases with a focus on data security, availability, and top-tier performance. All these tasks are critical not only for the smooth operation of the University’s technological infrastructure, but also for enhancing productivity, enabling the provision of high-quality health services and learning, and ultimately, improving patient and student outcomes.

Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of experience/training, in one or more of the following fields: computer science, computer information systems, etc.
  • 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following fields: information technology, computer science, engineering, etc.
  • Associate-level cloud certification in AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platform, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in information technology with a focus on platform engineering and cloud services.
  • Advanced knowledge of the design, development and application of technology and systems to meet business needs.
  • Advanced experience migrating on-premises workloads to cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including support for hybrid and virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications, including GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Experience applying DevOps practices, including infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, and collaboration across development and operations teams.
  • Extensive knowledge of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and integration with cloud data providers. Experience with Linux, Windows, containerization, and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud-based automation tools and processes. Proven experience provisioning and maintaining cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Strong ability to adapt technology solutions to meet user needs. Demonstrated understanding of system dependencies and how changes impact interconnected systems and users.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in production cloud environments, including incident response, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
  • Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Ansible, including development of reusable modules, templated configurations, and automated infrastructure workflows.
  • Strong customer focus with the ability to triage issues, manage escalations, and deliver solutions that meet service-level agreements, institutional policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate technical information and ideas to diverse colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships with team members, stakeholders, and customers.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to scope solutions based on available resources and timelines. Ability to gather information, evaluate options, and make sound decisions.
  • Experience participating in activities to advance an inclusive environment that values equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging.
  • Ability to think creatively and propose innovative ideas, including the incorporation of new technologies or processes. Ability to work with agility in a fast-paced environment.

Required Certifications

  • Associate-level cloud certification in AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent cloud platform, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing cloud governance and security controls in regulated environments (e.g. AWS Service Control Policies (SCPs), Azure Policy)
  • Advanced cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent.

About Us

About UCSF

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

Pride Values

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.

Salary Information

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.

Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement.

To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation-and-benefits/index.html

Movement Search and Delivery is working with a leading hybrid cloud and managed services consulting firm in Beavercreek, OH to identify and evaluate Cleared Azure Cloud Engineers (O&M and DevOps, L3/L4).

About the Role:

Support a classified Azure Government environment by administering, operating, and automating Azure infrastructure and Azure Virtual Desktop. You’ll be responsible for system health, patching, and troubleshooting. You’ll also build infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines in a secure, air-gapped setting. Candidates should already be comfortable operating in a DoD classified environment from day one.

What You Will Do:

  • Administer and maintain a classified Azure environment, including subscriptions, marketplace, monitoring, and patching
  • Support a Linux and Windows air-gapped environment, including Active Directory
  • Deploy and manage Azure resources via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep primary; JSON, YAML, PowerShell supporting)
  • Provision and maintain storage accounts, Key Vault, VMs, VNets, subnets, and NSGs aligned with DoD security baselines
  • Deploy and maintain Azure Virtual Desktop (host pools, application groups, workspaces)
  • Build golden images with Packer and rotate AVD session host images via pipeline
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS) for infrastructure and application delivery
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and application issues, and document resolutions
  • Develop automation to reduce manual effort and improve deployment reliability
  • Scale infrastructure to meet evolving workload and performance needs
  • Implement security best practices and verify security controls
  • Coordinate with onsite and remote teams to validate configurations and ensure operational handoff readiness


Hard Requirements:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance or above
  • U.S. citizenship (required by government contract)
  • Willing to work fully onsite and live within driving distance of Beavercreek, OH or relocate (relocation packages available)
  • Active Security+ certification (required for DevOps level)

Qualifications:

  • 5-8+ years of demonstrated performance in related technology (level dependent)
  • Experience in a classified Azure region or delivering software into an air-gapped network
  • Hands-on experience deploying Azure infrastructure via Bicep or Terraform
  • Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and Packer golden image pipelines
  • Advanced experience in one or more of: Active Directory (Domain, Federated, Certificate Services), WSUS, YUM, ACAS automation, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Kubernetes
  • Ability to manage an air-gapped Linux update infrastructure and submit change/configuration management documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field AND 3+ years of leadership experience, OR equivalent experience
  • Preferred: Microsoft AZ-140, on-prem to Azure or cloud-to-cloud migration experience, Ansible or PowerShell automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication, independent problem-solving, and a team-first mindset

MOVEMENT is a national executive search firm that connects companies with exceptional talent across engineering, manufacturing, finance, supply chain, information technology, sales, legal, and human resources.

How to Apply

Apply through this posting and a member of the Movement Search and Delivery team will review your application. For more information on open jobs, visit www.movementsearch.com.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

UJET leads the way in AI-powered contact center innovation, delivering a future-proof, cloud platform that redefines the customer experience with cutting-edge AI, true multimodality, and a mobile-first approach. We infuse AI across every aspect of your customer journey and contact center operations, to drive automation and efficiency. UJET's AI solutions empower agents, optimize customer journeys, and transform contact center operations for elevated experiences and actionable insights. Built on a cloud-native architecture with a unique CRM-first approach, UJET ensures unmatched security, scalability, and prioritized data insights (without storing PII). Designed for effortless use, UJET partners with businesses to deliver exceptional interactions, smarter decision-making, and accelerated growth in the AI-driven world.

Learn more at www.ujet.cx.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer in Austin, TX, Los Angeles, CA, or Portland, ME to design, build, and evolve the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure that powers our cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role requiring strong production experience with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform, and cloud networking, preferably on GCP.

You will be responsible for the foundational infrastructure that supports our engineering organization, including Kubernetes clusters, GCP networking, infrastructure automation, identity and access management, and shared infrastructure services.

We are looking for engineers who have directly designed, built, operated, and troubleshot complex Kubernetes environments running on cloud providers—not simply deployed applications into existing clusters.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, operate, and maintain production infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including GKE, VPC networking, load balancers, Cloud DNS, IAM, and related cloud services.
  • Own the architecture and lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters, including provisioning, upgrades, node pool management, autoscaling, networking, capacity planning, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules, infrastructure-as-code frameworks, and automated provisioning workflows that enable consistent, reliable infrastructure management.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across Kubernetes, Linux, networking, DNS, cloud services, and distributed systems.
  • Design and maintain GCP networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnetworks, firewall rules, routing, NAT, load balancing, and connectivity between services and environments.
  • Build and improve infrastructure observability using Prometheus, logging systems, metrics, alerting, and related monitoring tools.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls, including IAM policies, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege access patterns.
  • Drive infrastructure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization across our GCP environment.
  • Plan and execute major infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and architectural improvements while minimizing production risk.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Security teams to establish scalable infrastructure patterns and clear technical ownership.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and mentorship of other engineers.

Required Qualifications

Cloud Native Infrastructure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred

  • 3+ years of hands-on production experience, including designing, provisioning, operating, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure.
  • Deep practical knowledge of GCP networking, including VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, routing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS, and Cloud Load Balancing.
  • Experience managing GCP projects, IAM policies, service accounts, and infrastructure security configurations.
  • Demonstrated experience debugging production infrastructure problems involving multiple GCP services.
  • Requires periodic in-person collaboration at a UJET office or designated location.

Kubernetes / GKE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
  • Direct experience provisioning, administering, upgrading, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and internals, including the control plane, worker nodes, scheduling, networking, services, ingress, storage, and resource management.
  • Experience managing node pools, autoscaling, resource requests and limits, cluster capacity, and Kubernetes version upgrades.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex Kubernetes infrastructure issues involving networking, DNS, node health, scheduling, resource pressure, and cluster-level failures.
  • Experience using tools such as kubectl, Helm, and Kubernetes monitoring and diagnostic utilities.

Title

Cloud Engineer

At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 85 countries and operations in over 28 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results.

Trinzic is the future independent company to be created through the planned spin-off of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, expected in January 2027. Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions. 

Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Join us at a defining moment and help shape the future of a company built to tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact. 

Candidates who join KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business before the spin-off will transition to Trinzic when the separation is complete and will not need to reapply for employment. 

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities.

Our KBR team in Colorado Springs, CO, is seeking a Cloud Engineer. This role is pivotal in integrating cloud technologies with Cloud Infrastructure practices, requiring a blend of technical skills and operational acumen. As a Cloud Engineer, your contributions will have direct impact on the success of our projects and the overall business outcomes we aim to achieve.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: At KBR, you'll be working on prototype projects that support the U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory’s missions. The AFRL is the primary scientific research and development center for the Air Force. AFRL leads the discovery, development, and integration of affordable warfighting technologies for our air, space, and cyberspace force.
  • Collaborative Environment: Our rapid prototyping environment requires that we empower and entrust our engineers to make high level decisions. We live the Agile values, prioritizing development team autonomy, face-to-face communication, and working code over processes and documentation.
  • Impactful Work: Your work will directly support the Air Force in expanding national capabilities. As the Air Force's leader for National-to-Tactical capability development, AFRL collaborates with leading experts across the Intelligence Community, Department of Defense, National Laboratories, industry, inter-agency, academia, and partner nations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, manage, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud resources in multiple environments.
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform, etc.) repositories to easily recreate and redeploy resources as needed.
  • Troubleshoot failed deployments, integrations between Azure resources, and user access issues through Azure Entra ID service.
  • Troubleshoot Azure Kubernetes Service and Virtual Machines with deployed applications running.
  • Design and maintain networks and systems interconnectivity protected with Azure Firewall Policies, User-Defined Routes, Application Gateway, etc.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support DevOps Engineers, Software Engineers, and Systems Engineers.

Work Environment

  • Location: Colorado Springs, CO – Onsite
  • Travel Requirements: Minimal
  • Working Hours: Flexible

Qualifications

Required:

  • Security Clearance: Must have an active U.S. government SECRET security clearance, with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI Clearance; which is something only a U.S. citizen can obtain.
  • Education: B.S. in Computer Science. Other degrees/educational courses will be considered with relevant work experience or certification.
  • 2+ years of experience with knowledge in one or more of the following fields:
    • Cloud Engineering
    • Network Engineering
  • Comfortable with Bicep, Terraform, or similar Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • 1+ years of experience with Azure or AWS cloud services through AZ/AWS Command Line Interface tools and Azure/AWS Portal usage.
  • 2+ years of experience with GNU/Linux commands, shell navigation, and standard code repository usage (GitLab, GitHub, etc.)
  • Ability to research and solve complex technical problems independently.
Desired

  • AWS or Azure cloud services certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals or similar) is preferred.
  • DoD 8140 Cyber Workforce qualification (Security+ or equivalent)
  • Experience creating cloud infrastructure with standard resources.
  • Familiarity with Azure Entra ID, Azure Kubernetes Service, Virtual Machines, Azure Firewall, Azure networking resources.
  • Experience operating/deploying/managing air-gapped cloud networks.

Basic Compensation: $93,700 - $140,600 (For Colorado Springs, CO Only)

The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.

Additional Compensation

KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of a sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Who We Are

The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge

The Systems Engineering team crafts, builds, deploys and maintains a wide variety of IT infrastructure using the latest standards and technologies.

We are actively looking for a Cloud Systems Engineer with a broad range of systems infrastructure related and general purpose programming skills. Our ideal candidate has a rich and diverse technical background, is creative and passionate about IT systems, as well as standardization, optimization, and automation. Furthermore, this candidate will have experience architecting, engineering, implementing, and supporting large scale enterprise networks, storage, and system infrastructures in public and private cloud, and on-prem solutions to accommodate end-users, developers, and internal/external customers.

Candidates are expected to stay aware of industry changes and plan to keep ahead of industry advancements to help guide the use and implementation of technology at Take-Two.

What You’ll Take On

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure across AWS and GCP, following cloud-native best practices.
  • Manage all infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, writing, reviewing, and enforcing IaC standards across the team.
  • Develop and maintain automation tooling and internal platforms using Python, reducing manual toil.
  • Lead the design and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub workflows..
  • Proactively monitor system performance and availability, participate in an on-call rotation and drive post incident reviews to improve reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with development, security, and networking teams to evaluate and adopt new cloud services and technologies.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, establishing standards for code quality.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture decision records.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on cloud engineering experience, with significant depth in AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, EBS, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, and more) and working knowledge of GCP.
  • Write terraform modules, manage state, enforce policy, and review IaC PRs.
  • Use GitHub for pull requests, branch strategy, actions workflows, and repository management..
  • Python is your primary scripting and automation language. You write clean, tested, maintainable code.
  • Proficiency with Linux system administration, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls), and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS).
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles and experience building or maintaining delivery pipelines.
  • Experience architecting for high availability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization in a cloud-native environment.
  • Communicate clearly to explain complex infrastructure topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Great to Have

  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Familiarity with observability stacks like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CheckMK, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of service mesh or advanced networking patterns (e.g., AWS Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, GCP VPC peering).
  • Background in gaming, media, or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive industries.
  • Experience with cost management tooling and FinOps practices in large AWS environments.

What We Offer You

  • Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
  • Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
  • Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
  • Benefits. Medical (HSA & FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!
  • Perks. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events and stocked pantries.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). If you need to report an issue or otherwise have questions, please contact Careers@take2games.com

As an equal opportunity employer, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Who We Are

Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge

The Systems Engineering team crafts, builds, deploys and maintains a wide variety of IT infrastructure using the latest standards and technologies.

We are actively looking for a Cloud Systems Engineer with a broad range of systems infrastructure related and general purpose programming skills. Our ideal candidate has a rich and diverse technical background, is creative and passionate about IT systems, as well as standardization, optimization, and automation. Furthermore, this candidate will have experience architecting, engineering, implementing, and supporting large scale enterprise networks, storage, and system infrastructures in public and private cloud, and on-prem solutions to accommodate end-users, developers, and internal/external customers.

Candidates are expected to stay aware of industry changes and plan to keep ahead of industry advancements to help guide the use and implementation of technology at Take-Two.

What You’ll Take On



- Architect, deploy, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure across AWS and GCP, following cloud-native best practices.
- Manage all infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, writing, reviewing, and enforcing IaC standards across the team.
- Develop and maintain automation tooling and internal platforms using Python, reducing manual toil.
- Lead the design and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitHub workflows..
- Proactively monitor system performance and availability, participate in an on-call rotation and drive post incident reviews to improve reliability.
- Collaborate closely with development, security, and networking teams to evaluate and adopt new cloud services and technologies.
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, establishing standards for code quality.
- Create and maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and architecture decision records.

What You Bring



- Hands-on cloud engineering experience, with significant depth in AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, EBS, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, and more) and working knowledge of GCP.
- Write terraform modules, manage state, enforce policy, and review IaC PRs.
- Use GitHub for pull requests, branch strategy, actions workflows, and repository management..
- Python is your primary scripting and automation language. You write clean, tested, maintainable code. 
- Proficiency with Linux system administration, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls), and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS).
- Strong understanding of CI/CD principles and experience building or maintaining delivery pipelines.
- Experience architecting for high availability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization in a cloud-native environment.
- Communicate clearly to explain complex infrastructure topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Great to Have



- Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
- Familiarity with observability stacks like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CheckMK, or equivalent.
- Knowledge of service mesh or advanced networking patterns (e.g., AWS Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, GCP VPC peering).
- Background in gaming, media, or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive industries.
- Experience with cost management tooling and FinOps practices in large AWS environments.

What We Offer You



- Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
- Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.

descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

The Cloud Engineering team at Euna is building the secure, reliable cloud infrastructure that powers our public applications. As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will own the design, automation, monitoring, and disaster recovery of that infrastructure while guiding junior engineers. If you want to own the cloud foundation behind critical public-facing products, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and manage cloud infrastructure that meets Euna's requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and performance for public applications.
  • Own cloud infrastructure projects from start to finish, partnering with development, SRE, and security teams to align with business objectives.
  • Implement automation tools and frameworks for efficient deployment and management of cloud resources.
  • Implement monitoring and alert strategies for cloud infrastructure, and take part in on-call rotations to respond to incidents.
  • Ensure cloud resources comply with industry standards and company policies for security and data protection, and manage access controls.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and control cloud costs without compromising performance or security.
  • Guide and develop junior cloud engineers, and write clear documentation and diagrams that explain complex systems.

What You Bring

  • You have 8+ years in cloud computing, with deep AWS expertise across services such as EC2, S3, RDS, EKS, ECS, and Lambda.
  • You bring extensive experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native tools like CloudFormation, ARM, and Terraform.
  • You are proficient in at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and in Git version control with GitHub, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps.
  • You have a SaaS background across multiple product lines, with proficiency in CDN technologies and a solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols.
  • You solve problems analytically and communicate well, working across departments and with external parties.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Expertise in Azure, and expertise in GCP as an additional plus
  • Experience in cloud security and StateRAMP certification
  • Previous experience with Jira
  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer certification, or equivalent

Location

This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our Atlanta, GA office.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's What That Actually Looks Like

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

🧘 Eunafier Days

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

🤝 Philanthropy Time

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

🎉 Real connection at scale

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

📈 Room to grow

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

About Euna Solutions

Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit www.eunasolutions.com. Euna's privacy policy is available here.

Please visit our website: https://eunasolutions.com/careers/ and check out our LinkedIn Pages https://www.linkedin.com/company/eunasolutions/

We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

For any inquiries or requests regarding accessibility at Euna Solutions, please email recruiting@eunasolutions.com or call our office at 1.877.707.7755. Upon request, appropriate accessible formats or arrangements will be provided as soon as practicable.

descriptionHtml:
Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us!

At Atlas Air Worldwide, we’re not just an airline, we’re a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we’re built on a foundation of safety, service excellence, integrity, innovation, teamwork, and responsibility. With over 30 years of history, a modern all-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we’re driven by purpose.

If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.

The Senior Cloud Systems Engineer designs, engineers, automates, and continuously improves the enterprise cloud platforms and services that support Atlas Air’s business-critical airline operations, digital transformation initiatives, and data and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for a technologist with a proven track record of building resilient, secure, and cost-optimized cloud environments at enterprise scale.

Operating primarily in AWS, the Senior Cloud Systems Engineer owns Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering outcomes—not day-to-day manual provisioning. The role partners with cloud architects, security, DevOps, and application teams to modernize workloads, accelerate delivery, and raise engineering standards across the organization. The engineer serves as a subject matter expert and technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges.

Values And Behavioral Standards

To ensure the effective communication and application of company values and behavioral standards, as stated in our company “Code of Conduct” policy, and to respond appropriately in the event of any known departure.

Major Job Accountabilities (in Priority Order)

Platform Engineering & Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, including reusable modules, service templates, and enterprise guardrails.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD deployment pipelines using Git-based workflows (GitHub) to accelerate and standardize infrastructure and application delivery.
  • Enable self-service infrastructure capabilities and automate operational processes to reduce toil and improve consistency and governance.
  • Develop automation and tooling using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

Cloud Architecture & Engineering

  • Engineer AWS-based infrastructure supporting production, disaster recovery, and non-production environments.
  • Translate business and application requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
  • Design and implement disaster recovery and resiliency solutions across multiple Availability Zones and AWS Regions.
  • Support enterprise data and AI platforms (e.g., Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) through robust cloud infrastructure engineering.
  • Participate in solution architecture and design reviews; recommend improvements and evaluate emerging cloud services and technologies.

Security & Compliance

  • Engineer solutions aligned with enterprise security standards and implement cloud-native security controls.
  • Maintain least-privilege access principles across IAM and enforce network and data protection controls.
  • Support audit, compliance, and vulnerability remediation initiatives.

Cost Optimization (FinOps)

  • Analyze cloud consumption trends and identify optimization and rightsizing opportunities.
  • Implement FinOps best practices and automation to reduce waste and support budgeting and forecasting.

Operational Excellence & Support

  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure incidents and problems.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, and alerting to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Keep IT management apprised of critical issues, systemic problems, and risks in a timely manner.

Collaboration, Documentation & Delivery

  • Partner with application teams to modernize workloads and improve deployment velocity.
  • Champion high-quality documentation of technical processes, architectures, and runbooks that yield reproducible results.
  • Lead knowledge-transfer activities and mentor junior engineers to raise overall team capability.
  • Deliver assigned projects on time, within scope, and within budget, adhering to change control standards and coordinating internal and vendor resources.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in cloud, systems, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years designing and supporting enterprise cloud environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS delivering highly available, secure, and reliable services (e.g., IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, ECS/EKS).
  • Proven experience implementing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub or equivalent Git-based workflows.
  • Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar).
  • Solid foundation in Linux and Windows administration, cloud networking, and IAM/security controls.
  • Experience supporting production environments with high-availability and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills; demonstrated results orientation, initiative, and ownership.
  • Minimum 5+ years of Microsoft Windows Server environments
  • Minimum 5+ Citrix Cloud Enterprise experience

Desired Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional (or equivalent).
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification.
  • Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, serverless, and multi-account AWS environments.
  • Experience supporting data/AI platforms (Databricks, Amazon Bedrock) or large-scale cloud migrations.
  • Experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and comfort presenting to technical and non-technical audiences.

Special Demands

This position may require travel on an as-needed basis to domestic and international company locations, data centers, and training events. The role participates in an on-call rotation and may be required to respond to major incidents outside of standard business hours.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship or employer immigration support either now or in the future.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to afford equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, place of birth, age, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable in accordance with federal, state and local laws.

If you'd like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please download the available EEO is the Law document by clicking "EEO Is The Law" .

To view our Pay Transparency Statement, please click here: Pay Transparency Statement

Competitive compensation will be offered based on a variety of factors, including a candidate's experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity and other factors. In addition, a range of benefits to include medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, as well as generous paid time off, and 401K contributions are offered as a part of the total compensation package.

Pay Range

$136,500—$185,000 USD

  • Experience with Git-based version control using GitHub, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps, and a demonstrated ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate delivery

  • Hands-on experience with Azure and/or GCP in a production environment
  • Experience in cloud security practices and tooling
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert certification, or equivalent
  • Previous experience working with Jira

Location

This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our Atlanta, GA office.

AI Mindset at Euna Solutions

We believe the future of work is human + AI. At Euna Solutions, we encourage our team members to leverage AI tools to enhance creativity, efficiency, and decision-making. We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.

If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Life at Euna Solutions

We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and public sector champions. We've built a workplace around a straightforward idea: people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and not running on empty.

Here's What That Actually Looks Like

🏢 How we work

We're hybrid — three days a week in our Oakville or Atlanta offices, with standard hours on those days. What the remaining days look like depends on your role and your manager. We talk about it early in the process so there are no surprises on either side.

🧘 Eunafier Days

Twice a year, you get an extra day tacked onto a long weekend. We think recharging is part of doing good work — not a reward for it. Use it however you need.

🙌 Community is part of who we are

Our Engagement Committee finds meaningful ways to give back through time, donations, and shared expertise. We're invested in the places where our people actually live and work.

🤝 Philanthropy Time

We give every employee up to eight hours a year to spend on causes that matter to them. We want you to show up for your community — and we make time for it.

🎉 Real connection at scale

You won't know all 600+ people — and that's okay. What matters is building real relationships with the people you work with every day. Our culture team creates consistent opportunities for that, so work doesn't feel isolating.

📈 Room to grow

Whether you're going deep on AI, building expertise in government tech, or stepping into a bigger role, we invest in your development — through budget, mentorship, and real opportunity to move when you're ready.

About Euna Solutions

Euna Solutions® is the leading provider of purpose-built, cloud-based software designed to streamline procurement, budgeting, payments, and grants management for public sector and government organizations. Euna's AI-powered features and intelligent automation help organizations make better-informed decisions, ensure compliance, empower collaboration, and reduce administrative burden. Euna's full-cycle financial suite supports more than 3,600 organizations across North America in building trust, enabling transparency, and driving positive community impact. Recognized on Government Technology's GovTech 100 list, Euna Solutions is committed to advancing public sector innovation. To learn more, visit www.eunasolutions.com. Euna's privacy policy is available here.

Please visit our website: https://eunasolutions.com/careers/ and check out our LinkedIn Pages https://www.linkedin.com/company/eunasolutions/

We believe in embracing new perspectives and optimizing impact. If you have relatable experience and relevant transferable skills but feel you may be missing a few of the requirements, we encourage you to apply! We recognize that people have unique career journeys and if you're excited about this role and know you can bring something great to the team, then we want to hear from you. Please know Euna Solutions is committed to providing a comfortable and accessible interview process for every candidate. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process (big or small), please let us know.

For any inquiries or requests regarding accessibility at Euna Solutions, please email recruiting@eunasolutions.com or call our office at 1.877.707.7755. Upon request, appropriate accessible formats or arrangements will be provided as soon as practicable.
