descriptionHtml:
Schrödinger seeks a Cloud Engineer to join us in our mission to transform the discovery of therapeutics and materials.

Schrödinger has pioneered a physics-based software platform that enables discovery of high-quality, novel molecules for drug development and materials applications more rapidly and at lower cost compared to traditional methods. The software platform is used by biopharmaceutical and industrial companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories around the world. Our multidisciplinary drug discovery team also leverages the software platform to advance collaborative programs and its own pipeline of novel therapeutics to address unmet medical needs.

As a member of our Information Technology team, you’ll play a crucial role in facilitating the partnership between our development and operations teams. By building solutions in a highly collaborative environment, you’ll help scientists accelerate their R&D activities, reduce costs, and make discoveries that wouldn’t otherwise be possible.

Who Will Love This Job

  • An experienced cloud engineer who focuses on designing, implementing, and rectifying scalable cloud solutions and has an in-depth knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and other platforms like AWS or Azure
  • An excellent problem-solver who enjoys collaborating in an Agile environment
  • A proficient user of Infrastructure as Code tools (such as Github/GitLab, Terraform, Ansible) and automating change management via CI/CD
  • A networking, security, and data storage expert
  • A skilled scripter and programmer (Python, Bash, etc.)
  • An advanced Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL) administrator (and we’d like to hire someone with some macOS and Windows administration background as well)
  • Experience in a compliance-heavy environment will be helpful (ISO, SOX, GxP, etc.)

What You’ll Do

  • Participate in the design and architecture of cloud solutions that strategically meet the company's scalability, performance, and security requirements
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including technical and non-technical colleagues, to understand their business needs and requirements and align efforts and strategies across teams
  • Empower Schrödinger staff to make effective use of cloud resources holistically, including scalability, performance, cost optimization, security, and compliance as components of solutions
  • Leverage industry best practices in areas such as automation, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, logging, diagnosis, and troubleshooting
  • Leverage industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices while introducing and advocating for new technologies that can enhance the company's cloud capabilities

What You Should Have

  • At least five years of real-world, hands-on experience with cloud engineering in an enterprise environment
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or comparable experience in a professional setting
  • A proven track record of creating and improving internal standards, processes, and policies

Pay And Perks

Schrödinger understands it’s people that make a company great. Because of this, we’re prepared to offer a competitive salary, equity-based compensation, and a wide range of benefits that include healthcare (with dental and vision), a 401k, pre-tax commuter benefits, a flexible work schedule, and a parental leave program. We have catered meals in the office, a company culture that is relaxed but engaged, and over a month of paid vacation time. Our Administrative and Human Resources departments also plan a myriad of fun company-wide events. New York is home to our largest office, but we have teams all over the world. Schrödinger is honored to have been included in Crain's New York Best Places to Work, BuiltIn's NYC Best Place to Work, and Newsweek's list of America's 100 Most Loved Workplaces.

Estimated base salary range: $135,000 - $170,000. Actual compensation package is dependent on a number of factors, including, for example, experience, education, degrees held, market data, and business needs. If you have any questions regarding the compensation for this role, do not hesitate to reach out to a member of our Strategic Growth team.

Sound exciting? Apply today and join us!

As an equal opportunity employer, Schrödinger hires outstanding individuals into every position in the company. People who work with us have a high degree of engagement, a commitment to working effectively in teams, and a passion for the company's mission. We place the highest value on creating a safe environment where our employees can grow and contribute, and refuse to discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious belief, sex, age, disability, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, marital status, partnership status, caregiver status, sexual and reproductive health decisions, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To us, "diversity" isn't just a buzzword, but an important element of our core principles and key business practices. We believe that diverse companies innovate better and think more creatively than homogenous ones because they take into account a wide range of viewpoints. For us, greater diversity doesn't mean better headlines or public images - it means increased adaptability and profitability.

descriptionHtml:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.com to learn more about us.

As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.

H1's Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps team is responsible for building, automating, and optimizing the AWS infrastructure that powers our healthcare data platforms and applications. As H1 continues to scale globally, our team plays a critical role in enabling engineering teams to deploy and operate secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud environments.

What You'll Do At H1

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for designing, building, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure at scale. This role is primarily focused on cloud infrastructure engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and cost optimization, rather than traditional Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).

You'll partner closely with Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and other technical teams to provision new infrastructure, improve existing environments, automate manual processes, and support the evolving needs of H1's applications and data platforms.

You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to database infrastructure and operational support, helping improve our ability to troubleshoot and resolve database-related challenges across US-based projects.

You will:

  • Design, build, and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
  • Own infrastructure projects end-to-end, from technical design and provisioning through deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Build and maintain AWS environments leveraging IAM, S3, EKS, EMR, and supporting cloud services.
  • Develop automation and self-service capabilities using Python and scripting to streamline infrastructure provisioning and reduce manual effort.
  • Optimize AWS infrastructure costs through resource utilization analysis, cost dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI, partnering with engineering teams to support application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Support infrastructure and database-related troubleshooting, collaborating with engineering and database teams to resolve issues and improve operational efficiency.

About You

You're a hands-on AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys building systems, solving complex technical challenges, and automating repetitive work. You have deep experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure through Terraform and are comfortable owning projects independently, from initial design through production deployment.

You understand how cloud infrastructure supports modern SaaS applications and large-scale data platforms, and you're motivated by finding ways to make environments more scalable, secure, efficient, and cost-effective.

You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where priorities evolve, take ownership of technical challenges, and bring a practical, solutions-oriented approach to your work.

You Bring:

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting production AWS infrastructure, rather than primarily focusing on monitoring or SRE functions.
  • The ability to independently scope, design, and execute complex cloud infrastructure projects while balancing operational priorities.
  • A strong automation mindset, with experience replacing manual infrastructure processes with repeatable, scalable solutions.
  • Experience supporting containerized applications and cloud-native data platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across AWS infrastructure, networking, permissions, and deployment environments.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, data engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • A team-first mindset and commitment to contributing to an inclusive, supportive engineering culture.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or DevOps, including 5+ years working extensively with AWS.
  • Strong expertise designing, building, and managing AWS infrastructure, including IAM, S3, EKS (Kubernetes), and EMR.
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), infrastructure provisioning, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration in AWS environments.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using CircleCI.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Bash scripting to automate infrastructure workflows and reduce manual processes.
  • Experience with AWS cost optimization, resource utilization, and cloud infrastructure security and networking.
  • Experience supporting or troubleshooting production databases, ideally within AWS environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently own complex infrastructure projects and collaborate across engineering teams.

Compensation

This rolepays $120,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of RSUs.

Anticipated role close date: 12/15/2026

H1 OFFERS

  • Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
  • Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
  • Retirement options
  • Health & charitable donation stipends
  • Impactful Business Resource Groups
  • The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

H1 is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter once you've begun the interview process. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0249718

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a cloud engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a Cloud Engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process. You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience architecting and deploying applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure
  • 2+ years of experience building, operating, and maintaining compliant computing environments in AWS or Azure
  • Experience with Terraform
  • Experience managing Git-based version control systems and CI/CD pipelines
  • Top Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 Security+ or CISSP Certification within 30 days of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code environments, including activities around the automated server or network configurations, large-scale software deployments, or monitoring and testing such as continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)
  • Experience with provisioning and managing infrastructure and applications in Cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby
  • Experience leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Agile Certification
  • DevOps Certification
  • Cloud Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

Kforce has a client that is seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer in Memphis, TN. Summary: We are seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer to design, implement, optimize, and support enterprise cloud infrastructure within Microsoft Azure. This individual will play a key role in building secure, scalable, resilient cloud environments and partnering across infrastructure, security, application development, and technology teams. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on Azure engineering experience with the ability to operate at a senior level, troubleshoot complex cloud environments, automate infrastructure, and contribute to cloud architecture and technical direction. What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Build secure, scalable, highly available, and resilient Azure environments
  • Deploy and manage Azure resources including virtual machines, storage, networking, databases, identity, and related infrastructure services
  • Design and support Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, subnets, routing, load balancing, private connectivity, and network security
  • Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, and/or ARM templates
  • Develop automation using tools such as PowerShell, Azure CLI, and Python to improve cloud provisioning and operational efficiency
  • Partner with application development, security, networking, and infrastructure teams to support cloud-based applications and services
  • Monitor and optimize Azure environments for performance, availability, security, scalability, and reliability
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure, connectivity, performance, and deployment issues
  • Support cloud security and identity practices using technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and managed identities
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions, engineering standards, best practices, and technical documentation

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred; Equivalent professional experience will also be considered
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role
  • Significant hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting solutions within Microsoft Azure
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale, production Azure environments
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, Bicep, and/or ARM templates
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, or similar technologies
  • Experience designing solutions with scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery in mind
  • Strong understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and cloud architecture
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity, access management, and networking concepts
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex cloud infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Experience operating at a Senior Azure Engineer, Azure Infrastructure Engineer, Cloud Platform Engineer, or Azure Architect level
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Experience supporting cloud migrations or modernization initiatives
  • Experience working within hybrid cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments
  • Familiarity with cloud governance, monitoring, automation, and cost-optimization practices

The pay range is the lowest to highest compensation we reasonably in good faith believe we would pay at posting for this role. We may ultimately pay more or less than this range. Employee pay is based on factors like relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, location, performance, union contract and business needs. This range may be modified in the future.

We offer comprehensive benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k), and life, disability & ADD insurance to eligible employees. Salaried personnel receive paid time off. descriptionHtml:
Cloud Engineer – Senior position

HOW A CLOUD ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

In this role, you'll join our team, providing high-quality, cost-effective cloud solutions to our clients. Be part of a dynamic environment where your expertise in cloud operations will drive significant enhancements in the efficiency and effectiveness of our customers’ operations. As a Cloud Engineer on our team, you will be responsible for distributed and managed services automating the installation, configuration and maintenance of platform services.


Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
  • Migrate existing CloudFormation code to Terraform
  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and maintain version-controlled infrastructure
  • Work with DevOps, Security, and Engineering teams to implement CI/CD and deployment strategies

What you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, technical training, or work/military experience
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering or DevOps
  • Strong proficiency with Terraform (writing modules, managing state, workspaces, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud provider
  • Experience with DevOps tools and utilities to include Github, Ansible & CDK
  • Ability to work effectively in a Linux-based development environment
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong knowledge of networking, security, and IAM in the cloud
  • Proficient in at least one scripting language

Nice to haves:

  • Terraform SME
  • Hands-on experience with multiple cloud providers such as [AWS, Azure, OCI, or GCP]
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools
  • Hands on experience with python
  • Knowledge of containerization

CLEARANCE:

Active TS/SCI with a Polygraph level clearance.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law.

companySlogan: Where success meets success.
descriptionHtml:
Why Stifel

Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

What You'll Be Doing

The Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and services. They collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure cloud-based applications and systems' availability, scalability, and security. This role involves troubleshooting and optimizing cloud environments while staying updated on emerging technologies and best practices in cloud computing.

What We're Looking For

  • Deploy and manage cloud resources (e.g., virtual machines, storage, databases) using cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Monitor and maintain the performance, security, and availability of cloud services.
  • Collaborate with software developers and system administrators to ensure seamless integration with cloud-based applications.
  • Implement automation and orchestration to streamline cloud provisioning and management processes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud-related issues and incidents.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and certifications in cloud technologies.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts, architectures, and services.
  • Proficiency in at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (IAC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 0-2 years of experience in IT or cloud-related roles.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services and deployments.

Licenses & Credentials

  • Minimum Required: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or equivalent (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer).

Systems & Technology

  • Proficiency in at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (IAC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell).

About Stifel

Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start-up. We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas. Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success.

While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations. Stifel is home to approximately 9,000 individuals who are currently building their careers as financial advisors, research analysts, project managers, marketing specialists, developers, bankers, operations associates, among hundreds more. Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

At Stifel we offer an entrepreneurial environment, comprehensive benefits package to include health, dental and vision care, 401k, wellness initiatives, life insurance, and paid time off.

Stifel is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionHtml:
At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on-the-job training program, and tuition reimbursement--available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week.

We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees.

Senior Cloud Engineer

Accountability Statement

The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback.

This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on-call support rotation.

Essential Job Functions

  • Responsible for day-to-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud-based systems.
  • Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on-call rotation with other cloud engineers.
  • Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates.
  • Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers.
  • Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on-premises operations.
  • Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor
  • All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job:

  • Focus - Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member.
  • Connect - Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care.
  • Understand - Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule).
  • Counsel - Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives.
  • Advance - Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded.
  • Verify necessary follow-up actions.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • This position requires a 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education.

Experience

  • 5 - 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry).
  • 3+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment
  • Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices
  • Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025).
  • Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus.
  • Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus.
  • Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps
  • Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages.
  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN.
  • Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud.
  • A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus.
  • A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams.

DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management.

The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.

No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.

Thank you again for your interest in this position!

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0249718

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a cloud engineer, you’re eager to develop, manage, and secure a container platform that meets your client’s needs and takes advantage of cloud capabilities. We need you to develop container management software to solve some of our clients’ toughest challenges.

As a Cloud Engineer at Booz Allen, you can use your technical skills to affect mission-forward change. On our team, you’ll hone your skills using the latest cloud technologies as you look for ways to improve your client’s environment with current container software to ensure seamless orchestration. Using your platform experience, you’ll support your team as you inform strategy and design while ensuring standards are met throughout the containerization process. You’ll recommend resources that will help your client manage and securely adopt containers. Additionally, you’ll continue to strengthen your skills while supporting the development of critical cloud platforms.

Work with us to use cloud platform technology for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience architecting and deploying applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure
  • 2+ years of experience building, operating, and maintaining compliant computing environments in AWS or Azure
  • Experience with Terraform
  • Experience managing Git-based version control systems and CI/CD pipelines
  • Top Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 Security+ or CISSP Certification within 30 days of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code environments, including activities around the automated server or network configurations, large-scale software deployments, or monitoring and testing such as continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD)
  • Experience with provisioning and managing infrastructure and applications in Cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Experience with system integration using a variety of protocols, including JSON, REST, and XML
  • Experience with scripting in Bash, PowerShell, Python, Groovy, or Ruby
  • Experience leveraging JSON, YAML, or XML for configuration
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Agile Certification
  • DevOps Certification
  • Cloud Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title

Langan provides expert land development engineering and environmental consulting services for major developers, renewable energy producers, energy companies, corporations, healthcare systems, colleges/universities, and large infrastructure programs throughout the U.S. and around the world. Our employees collaborate seamlessly among 50+ offices and gain valuable hands-on experience that fosters career growth. Langan culture is entrepreneurial from advancing innovative technical solutions, to participating in robust training and knowledge sharing, to making progressive change within the communities we live and work.

Consistently ranked among the top ten “Best Firms to Work For” and Engineering News-Record’s top 50 firms worldwide, Langan attracts and retains the best talent in the industry. Employees thrive at Langan, a firm that fosters an inclusive and supportive work environment for all; prioritizes wellbeing, health, and safety; encourages volunteerism and philanthropy; offers workplace flexibility, along with carbon-neutral office spaces; and empowers individuals to contribute their skills and knowledge to make impactful contributions.

Job Summary

Langan is seeking an Staff Azure Cloud Engineer to join its national Digital Solutions Team.  This individual will play a crucial role in provisioning, configuring, and maintaining Azure resources that support both current and future Enterprise GIS environments. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a growing and fast-paced technology team that works on Esri ArcGIS Enterprise deployments across on-premises, Azure, and AWS cloud environments for both internal and customer projects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Langan’s geospatial, network and development teams to build and configure Azure resources to support ArcGIS Enterprise environments that serve both internal and external clients;
  • Apply concepts of computing, networking, security, and the cloud to system design;
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues in existing server environments;
  • Deploy and maintain hosted applications and databases;
  • Configure logging, monitoring, and appropriate alerting thresholds for infrastructure and services that support ArcGIS Enterprise environments and its dependencies;
  • Plan, develop, test, and document disaster recovery, redundancy, and backup activities for managed cloud infrastructure;
  • Develop and maintain scripts to automate resource provisioning, configuration, and administration;
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) to deploy infrastructure and application changes;
  • Write comprehensive documentation on system implementations and changes;
  • Manage and apply updates to services and systems;
  • Manage identity and access for cloud resources, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), conditional access policies, and integration with on-premises Active Directory where required;
  • Stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies, cloud & systems engineering; and
  • Respond to incidents by helping with recovery, mitigation, and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or other related discipline is required (Master’s degree a plus);
  • Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-104 Administrator Associate, AZ-305 Solutions Architect Expert) are a plus.
  • 2+ years of professional experience designing, executing, and supporting Esri ArcGIS Enterprise;
  • Experience identifying and resolving complex technical issues;
  • Self-motivated learner who continually keeps up to date with new technology;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills;
  • High caliber of self-motivation with the ability to work well within groups;

UNCOMN is seeking a Cloud Engineer 3-4 (Mid/Senior-Level) to:

  • Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure cloud infrastructure to support enterprise applications.

  • Support and maintain AWS and/or Azure GovCloud environments in compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization to balance performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate with development and security teams to support application infrastructure and cloud operations.
  • Document cloud architecture, configurations, and processes to ensure consistency and operational continuity.
  • Stay current with evolving cloud technologies and best practices to support continuous improvement.
  • Design, deploy, and manage application programming interfaces (APIs) using languages like Java, Python, and Ruby.


This position description outlines the core duties for this role, but it is not all-inclusive. Responsibilities may shift based on contract requirements, mission needs, or organizational objectives.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of related professional experience, preferably within AWS environments.
  • Must currently meet Department Cyber Workforce Framework (DCWF)/8140 requirements for Work Role 641 Intermediate (or Advanced). Please see the 8140 Dashboard (Qualifications Matrix) for more information; a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, CMIS, or a related field from an accredited college or university satisfies this requirement.
  • Must be comfortable obtaining CompTIA Security+ certification within 30 days of employment. Active Security+ highly preferred.
  • Must be comfortable obtaining a Cloud-based certification or certificate within 30 days of employment. Active Cloud-based certification highly preferred.
  • Must be eligible to obtain a Secret clearance, granted by the US Government, which requires US citizenship. The government also uses 13 adjudicative guidelines to determine an individual's eligibility.
  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates) to automate provisioning and management of cloud resources.
  • Hands-on experience administering Linux systems in cloud environments, including configuration, performance optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to partner closely with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be willing to obtain relevant certifications as required by future client or contract needs.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active DoD Security clearance or higher.
  • Knowledge of hardware or software load balancers, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Experience installing, configuring, and managing various network devices and services.


Why UNCOMN?

  • Instant Flexible PTO: Enjoy flexible paid time off starting your very first day with us!
  • Generous Holidays: Benefit from 7 paid holidays and up to 3 floating holidays annually.
  • Immediate Health Coverage: Get access to comprehensive health benefits from day one.
  • 401K Safe Harbor Match: Secure your future with our top-tier 401K matching program.
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career with our training and education assistance programs.
  • Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access complimentary support services for you and your family.


Note: Benefits apply to full-time employees only.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We’re dedicated to building an uncommon, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, or national origin.

Job Type

Description

Are you ready to put your AWS expertise to work on cloud challenges that few engineers get the chance to tackle?

Virtual Service Operations (VSO) is seeking an experienced AWS Platform / Infrastructure Automation Engineer to join a highly skilled team delivering advanced cloud engineering capabilities for a mission-critical, security-sensitive initiative. Build cloud platforms that have to work reliably even when conventional internet-connected tooling is unavailable. This is a hands-on opportunity to make sophisticated AWS infrastructure repeatable, secure, and easier to operate. You will work with experienced technical partners in a collaborative environment where careful engineering and measurable results matter.

The program you will be supporting is a highly classified, mission-critical modernization initiative. Your roles will be to help build next-generation cloud infrastructure and integration platforms that connect fragmented intelligence, operational data, and mission systems through APIs, MCP servers, and cloud-native technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform.
  • Develop CI/CD workflows and repeatable deployment patterns suitable for restricted environments.
  • Automate configuration management, patching, and operational maintenance.
  • Support AWS WorkSpaces, Amazon EKS, Systems Manager, and related platform services


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of DevOps or cloud platform engineering experience.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly AWS CDK with Python or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing CI/CD pipelines and Git-based engineering workflows.
  • Hands-on AWS cloud experience and ability to work effectively in highly controlled environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS WorkSpaces, EKS, and Systems Manager.
  • Experience deploying automation into isolated or tightly controlled environments.
  • Relevant AWS professional or specialty certifications; Security+ or CISSP where applicable.


Requirements

  • Active TS/SCI clearance; must be eligible for applicable SCI read-on/indoctrination and additional program-specific access approvals.
  • Must reside within commuting distance of one of the following 4 approved secure work locations: Herndon, VA; Washington, DC; Seattle, WA; or Denver, CO.
  • Regular on-site work in an approved secure facility and occasional work at authorized customer facilities may be required. This is not a remote position.
  • Full-time position, on-site
  • Please note that pursuant to a government contract, this specific position requires U.S. citizenship status


What is Important to Us:

  • You are an excellent communicator in writing and speaking.
  • You have the ability to work independently but also value teamwork.
  • Your problem-solving skills are excellent.
  • You are looking for a job where performance appraisals occur regularly, and you look forward to advancing your career.
  • You seek a community of virtue-centered co-workers and clients.


What we offer you: As part of the VSO company, you will be part of a virtue-centered team who value their work and teammates. This is a no-jerk zone. We provide ongoing learning and development opportunities to foster continuous growth. We offer competitive salaries, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

More About VSO: VSO is a hybrid cloud and managed services consulting firm. Much of VSO’s success can be attributed to our deep partnerships with IT services industry leaders such as AWS, IBM, Microsoft and others. VSO leverages numerous other partner relationships so as to provide our customers with optimal support. Additionally, we take pride in taking care of our employees. We offer a wide variety of benefits for eligible employees related to health, retirement, professional development, and more! For more information, please visit our website at https://vso-inc.com/careers

$175,000.00 - $230,000.00 per year

Purpose and Impact:

This team is focused on providing cloud-based geolocation solutions in near-real-time directly to decision makers and warfighters around the world. The ideal candidate has recent experience working with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, including microservices and containers. Candidates will have experience migrating applications to cloud environments; configuring and maintaining cloud infrastructures using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation; troubleshooting issues and identifying root cause analysis; generating after action reports to include new requirements and improved Tier 1 SOPs; experience with ActiveMQ and/or Kafka, as well as deployment strategies for high-availability systems.

Work Schedule: M-F, 8 hours/5 days per week; after-hours call-in may be required

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure (e.g., modernization, migration, roadmaps, etc.), ensuring that systems are designed and maintained following best practices and governance requirements.
  • Build reusable modules (e.g., Helm Charts, Terraform, etc.) and enforce development standards for creation and maintenance of Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Continuously monitor the health and performance of the infrastructure and systems using logging and alerting, identify issues and implement solutions for improved efficiency.
  • Provide strategies for failure/recovery (e.g., backup, high availability, etc.), cost optimization (e.g., tagging, budgets, rightsizing, autoscaling, etc.) and benefit analysis of cloud services.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system capabilities and efficiency.
  • Contribute to deliverables (e.g., architectures, runbooks, and operational procedures) and performance metrics, where applicable, and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and recommend enhancements to current systems.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Proven progressive responsibility and experience, collectively, with the following:

  • Experience provisioning, configuring, and managing cloud infrastructure and services (e.g., compute, storage, networking, IAM)
  • Experience designing and implementing secure, scalable cloud architectures
  • Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (laC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, etc.
  • Knowledge of containers and platform workloads (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes/EKS/AKS/GKE).
  • Development experience with Java and React.
  • Experience configuring monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, etc. and responding to incidents.
  • Experience implementing and testing backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability strategies.
  • Experience managing secrets and key management with tools such as KMS/KeyVault/Secret Manager, certificates, and rotation policies.
  • Experience optimizing cloud cost and performance (e.g., tagging, budgets, rightsizing, autoscaling) and producing usage/cost reports.
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud infrastructure issues across networking (DNS, routing, VPN), security, and service limits.
  • Experience documenting architectures, runbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Experience with Linux OS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required.
  • Four (4) years of additional experience software development/engineering on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.

Minimum Years of Experience:

  • Six (6) years’ experience in software development/engineering in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity, including at least four (4) years of experience in software development on systems utilizing cloud-related technologies is required.

Purpose and Impact:

This team is focused on providing cloud-based geolocation solutions in near-real-time directly to decision makers and warfighters around the world. The ideal candidate has recent experience working with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, including microservices and containers. Candidates will have experience migrating applications to cloud environments; configuring and maintaining cloud infrastructures using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation; troubleshooting issues and identifying root cause analysis; generating after action reports to include new requirements and improved Tier 1 SOPs; experience with ActiveMQ and/or Kafka, as well as deployment strategies for high-availability systems.

Work Schedule: M-F, 8 hours/5 days per week; after-hours call-in may be required

Essential Responsibilities: 



- Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure (e.g., modernization, migration, roadmaps, etc.), ensuring that systems are designed and maintained following best practices and governance requirements. 
- Build reusable modules (e.g., Helm Charts, Terraform, etc.) and enforce development standards for creation and maintenance of Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
- Continuously monitor the health and performance of the infrastructure and systems using logging and alerting, identify issues and implement solutions for improved efficiency. 
- Provide strategies for failure/recovery (e.g., backup, high availability, etc.), cost optimization (e.g., tagging, budgets, rightsizing, autoscaling, etc.) and benefit analysis of cloud services. 
- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system capabilities and efficiency. 
- Contribute to deliverables (e.g., architectures, runbooks, and operational procedures) and performance metrics, where applicable, and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams. 
- Stay abreast of emerging technologies and recommend enhancements to current systems. 

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Proven progressive responsibility and experience, collectively, with the following:



- Experience provisioning, configuring, and managing cloud infrastructure and services (e.g., compute, storage, networking, IAM)
- Experience designing and implementing secure, scalable cloud architectures
- Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (laC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, etc. 
- Knowledge of containers and platform workloads (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes/EKS/AKS/GKE). 
- Development experience with Java and React. 
- Experience configuring monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, etc. and responding to incidents. 
- Experience implementing and testing backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability strategies. 
- Experience managing secrets and key management with tools such as KMS/KeyVault/Secret Manager, certificates, and rotation policies. 
- Experience optimizing cloud cost and performance (e.g., tagging, budgets, rightsizing, autoscaling) and producing usage/cost reports. 
- Experience troubleshooting cloud infrastructure issues across networking (DNS, routing, VPN), security, and service limits. 
- Experience documenting architectures, runbooks, and operational procedures. 
- Experience with Linux OS

Clearance Required: 



- TS/SCI w Poly

Minimum Education: 



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited college or university is required. 
- Four (4) years of additional experience software development/engineering on projects with similar software processes may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree. 

Minimum Years of Experience: 



- Six (6) years’ experience in software development/engineering in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity, including at least four (4) years of experience in software development on systems utilizing cloud-related technologies is required.

Req ID: 385095

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a AWS Infrastructure Developer III (Senior) to join our team in Fort Meade, Maryland (US-MD), United States (US).

Job Summary:

The AWS Infrastructure Engineer supports our client by designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable AWS cloud environments that host operational capabilities and mission data workflows. The role encompasses architecting AWS infrastructure, deploying and managing compute resources such as EC2, ECS, Fargate, and Lambda, and implementing robust networking constructs including VPC segmentation, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Route 53, NACLs, and security groups. The engineer leverages orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or Nomad for containerized workload management and applies IAM best practices to enforce least privilege access across multi account environments. The position is responsible for troubleshooting performance, connectivity, and security issues, optimizing cloud operations, supporting hybrid cloud integrations, and ensuring compliance with AWS security frameworks and GovCloud/DoD requirements. The role requires regular collaboration with teammates, leadership, and customers—often including presentations—and may involve limited TDY travel in support of mission objectives.

Job Duties:

  • Design and implement AWS infrastructure architectures supporting operational capability hosting and data processing
  • Deploy and manage AWS compute resources (EC2, ECS, Lambda) hosting operational capabilities and services
  • Implement network segmentation, security groups, NACLs, and routing policies enforcing operational security requirements
  • Leverage orchestration systems (Kubernetes, Nomad, or similar) for container and workload management
  • Manage IAM policies, roles, and service control policies enforcing least-privilege access
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure performance, connectivity, and security issues impacting operations
  • Conduct limited TDY travel as mission requires
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field (or equivalent experience)
    • Education Equivalency:
      • High School Diploma/GED with 13 years of IT experience
      • Associate’s degree with 11 years of IT experience
      • Master’s Degree with 7 years of IT experience
      • PhD with 5 years of IT experience
  • Minimum 9 years of general Information Technology experience
  • Minimum 4 years of AWS infrastructure engineering experience
  • Minimum 4 years of experience with AWS networking services including VPC, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Route 53
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code implementation
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with AWS compute services (EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda)
  • Minimum 1 year of experience with orchestration systems outside AWS (Kubernetes, Nomad, Docker Swarm, or similar)
  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience implementing AWS security best practices and compliance frameworks
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Security Specialty)
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or DoD cloud environments
  • Advanced Kubernetes experience (CKA/CKAD certification)
  • Experience with hybrid cloud architectures connecting on-premises and cloud environments
  • Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and multi-account strategies

NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this role is $117,600 - $196,000. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. If the position offered in temporary, the position will not be eligible for incentive compensation. This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.

Job Title: Senior AWS Engineer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]

Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually

Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Senior AWS Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms. The work focuses on availability, scalability, security, observability, automation, and dependable service operations. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in AWS IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, managed services, CloudWatch, automation, and cloud security, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, provision, configure, and operate cloud or infrastructure components using approved architecture patterns
  • Automate repeatable provisioning, deployment, configuration, and operational tasks
  • Implement security, identity, networking, backup, monitoring, and availability controls
  • Investigate incidents, capacity issues, vulnerabilities, and performance problems
  • Maintain runbooks, diagrams, standards, and change records; collaborate across engineering and operations

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Required: typically 6+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition
  • Practical experience with the role-specific technology stack: AWS IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, managed services, CloudWatch, automation, and cloud security
  • Professional experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or systems operations relevant to the role
  • Hands-on knowledge of the named cloud, operating-system, container, or automation technologies
  • Understanding of networking, identity, security, monitoring, and availability fundamentals
  • Experience with scripting, automation, source control, or infrastructure as code
  • Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues methodically
  • Strong documentation and cross-team collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional hands-on depth in AWS IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, managed services, CloudWatch, automation, and cloud security
  • Experience mentoring peers, reviewing technical work, and guiding delivery decisions
  • Familiarity with secure development, accessibility, governance, or regulatory requirements where applicable

Job Description:

Advance how our customers operate while you advance your career. Join GDIT as a Cloud DevOps Engineer supporting the Fences platform. Fences is a secure, multi-classification enterprise platform that delivers cloud computing services to the DoW, integrating engineering, cybersecurity, and management capabilities to enable the rapid delivery of secure, cloud-based digital solutions.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, The Work You’ll Do At GDIT Will Be Impactful To The Mission Of Department Of War (DoW), Chief Information Officer (CIO) For Special Access Program(s) (SAPs) (DoW SAP CIO). You Will Play a Crucial Role In Providing Support In The Following Areas:

  • Provision, configure, and maintain cloud service provider (CSP) accounts, subscriptions, and services.
  • Design, deploy, and support cloud infrastructure including compute, storage, networking, and virtual desktop solutions.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and automated deployment processes.
  • Implement and support API Gateway, cloud-native, and shared platform services.
  • Optimize cloud performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilization based on workload requirements.
  • Support onboarding and integration of customer workloads into cloud environments.
  • Engineer and maintain secure connectivity between cloud, customer, and DoW network environments.
  • Monitor cloud infrastructure, system health, and network interfaces to ensure service continuity.
  • Maintain configuration management, change control, and CMDB processes in support of operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with CSPs, mission owners, DISA, and cybersecurity teams to support cloud operations and service enhancements.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, RMF, JSIG, and cloud governance requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • BS degree; may be substituted for additional years of experience
  • 10+ years of IT/DoW Infrastructure and Cloud experience
  • Security Clearance Level: Top Secret with SCI eligibility
  • Required Certifications: Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, CISSP, CCSP, Security+)
  • Cloud infrastructure engineering and administration (AWS, Azure, or equivalent CSPs)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Ansible)
  • Cloud compute, storage, networking, and virtualization technologies
  • CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
  • Cloud networking, VPNs, routing, load balancing, and hybrid cloud architectures
  • API Gateway and cloud service integration
  • Scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Monitoring, logging, and performance management tools
  • Configuration management and ITSM/CMDB practices
  • Cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (RMF, JSIG, NIST 800-53)
  • Strong troubleshooting, systems integration, and stakeholder coordination skills

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

  • Excellent customizable health benefits (Medical, Dental and Vision)
  • 401K with company match
  • Educational Assistance and eLearning
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to employee advancement
  • Rewards and Recognition programs

descriptionHtml:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

  • Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

Cloud Foundations manages the account, access, and network foundation that Lambda's cloud infrastructure runs on, implementing governance and access controls in line with company policies. In practice that means AWS accounts and IAM, the VPC and transit network structure, DNS, and the Terraform execution platform that every change flows through.

This is a new team, and this role helps define it. Working closely with Security, GRC, IT, and the engineering teams that consume the foundation, this position turns policy into working controls and paved paths, so that hundreds of engineers can safely self-serve instead of filing requests.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve the IaC execution platform (Terraform, Atlantis): how infrastructure changes are proposed, reviewed, and applied across the company
  • Design and operate Lambda's cloud account, access, and IAM structure: organizational hierarchy, provisioning, and permission models
  • Own the cloud network foundation: VPCs, Transit Gateway, and DNS, including the patterns other teams build on
  • Drive AWS cloud governance: tagging standards, compliance guardrails, and cost visibility and accountability
  • Implement least-privilege access and compliance automation in line with company requirements and policies, replacing manual access and provisioning work with self-service
  • Help shape how this new team operates: its scope, priorities, and service boundaries
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and keep the systems you own well-documented, reliable, and observable

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, cloud platform, or cloud security engineering, or a closely related discipline
  • Deep experience managing AWS at scale: multi-account organizations, IAM and permission boundaries, SCPs, and resource organization
  • Strong foundation in infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and the tooling around it: modules, state management, and automated plan/apply workflows
  • Solid cloud networking fundamentals: VPC design, transit and hybrid connectivity, DNS, and edge/CDN configuration
  • Comfortable writing the automation and tooling that runs the foundation (Go and/or Python), and treating it as a product: real users, real quality standards, and things that actually get adopted
  • Use AI tools as a natural part of how you work, and hold their output to the same bar as your own: you review it, verify it, and own what ships
  • Build for the many, not for one team or one use case
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and clarifying ownership
  • Distill the right problem out of the noise: ask the why behind the why
  • Own what you build past the point it ships: monitor it, measure whether it actually helped, and act on what you learn
  • Sweat the details and aren't satisfied until things run smoothly

Nice to Have

  • Experience building agentic workflows that automate meaningful parts of infrastructure operations or governance
  • Experience implementing controls for a compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001) without turning it into manual toil
  • Cloud cost management and FinOps experience
  • Hands-on experience with Azure, GCP, or OCI alongside AWS

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation
  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.
