descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Hybrid Cloud / Kubernetes Engineer to design, build, operate, and sustain the cloud and on-premises infrastructure supporting platform services and mission-critical workloads in highly secure environments.

This role offers the opportunity to work across AWS classified environments, Kubernetes platforms, on-premises infrastructure, networking, storage, security controls, and tenant services. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on infrastructure expertise and understands how to engineer reliable, scalable, and consistent solutions across cloud, on-premises, and restricted deployment environments.

As part of a highly technical engineering team, you will help build and operate hybrid infrastructure, support growing tenant environments, troubleshoot complex platform issues, and contribute to the reliability, resiliency, and performance of mission-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Design, deploy, configure, and operate AWS infrastructure supporting shared services, mission hosting, and tenant environments.
  • Deploy, configure, and operate Kubernetes and container platforms, including EKS or comparable technologies.
  • Engineer and support compute, storage, load balancing, DNS, ingress, egress, and supporting platform services.
  • Evaluate and support workload placement decisions based on mission, security, performance, connectivity, and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain scalable, repeatable infrastructure patterns across diverse deployment environments.

Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Integrate cloud environments with on-premises and restricted-network infrastructure.
  • Maintain common platform patterns where practical while accounting for the unique requirements and constraints of different deployment environments.
  • Support backup, recovery, resiliency, capacity, patching, and platform lifecycle activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues spanning cloud, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and operating systems.
  • Support the reliability, scalability, and operational performance of production infrastructure across hybrid environments.

Tenant & Shared-Service Support

  • Support standardized tenant infrastructure and reusable environment patterns.
  • Partner with Infrastructure-as-Code engineers to ensure infrastructure can be provisioned and maintained through controlled, repeatable automation.
  • Support platform services including identity, CI/CD, observability, repositories, and mission-hosting dependencies.
  • Participate in Tier 3/4 troubleshooting and escalation for complex infrastructure and application-platform issues.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, and ongoing platform lifecycle activities.
  • Support on-call responsibilities for production infrastructure and platform services.

Location: This position is fully onsite in Chantilly, VA.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph.
  • 8 years' minimum with a BS/BA, 10 years' with an AS/AA, 12 years' may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, platform, or systems engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS.
  • Strong Kubernetes and container-platform experience.
  • Experience with Linux, networking, storage, load balancing, and production infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure and application-platform dependencies.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines and environments.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial:

  • AWS GovCloud, C2S, SC2S, Secret/Top Secret cloud, or comparable classified cloud environments.
  • EKS, OpenShift, or comparable Kubernetes platforms.
  • Istio or a comparable service mesh technology.
  • Terraform, CloudFormation, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Disconnected or restricted-network environments.
  • Large-scale, multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
  • AWS cost and capacity optimization experience.
  • Experience supporting standardized infrastructure patterns across multiple deployment environments.

Details

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $216,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

Koniag Technology Solutions, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Senior AWS Engineer to join a focused, small team supporting AWS Cloud service offerings for a government agency undergoing cloud modernization and migration efforts. The ideal candidate is a motivated team-player with deep knowledge of AWS services and cloud computing, passionate about automation, collaboration, and driving technical solutions in a fast-paced environment. This position requires an active Secret clearance at minimum, with Top Secret preferred.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Responsibilities

The Senior AWS Engineer will serve on a focused, small team to support AWS Cloud service offerings used by a government agency to modernize and migrate systems to the cloud. The Engineer will work closely with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, fellow engineers, and security engineers to define and build the initial service offering as well as the roadmap for future releases. This multi-functional role will participate in and support a team charged with coordinating and implementing various solutions required to support the AWS Cloud. Description

Are you ready to put your AWS expertise to work on cloud challenges that few engineers get the chance to tackle?

Virtual Service Operations (VSO) is seeking an experienced AWS Platform / Infrastructure Automation Engineer to join a highly skilled team delivering advanced cloud engineering capabilities for a mission-critical, security-sensitive initiative. Build cloud platforms that have to work reliably even when conventional internet-connected tooling is unavailable. This is a hands-on opportunity to make sophisticated AWS infrastructure repeatable, secure, and easier to operate. You will work with experienced technical partners in a collaborative environment where careful engineering and measurable results matter.

The program you will be supporting is a highly classified, mission-critical modernization initiative. Your roles will be to help build next-generation cloud infrastructure and integration platforms that connect fragmented intelligence, operational data, and mission systems through APIs, MCP servers, and cloud-native technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform.
  • Develop CI/CD workflows and repeatable deployment patterns suitable for restricted environments.
  • Automate configuration management, patching, and operational maintenance.
  • Support AWS WorkSpaces, Amazon EKS, Systems Manager, and related platform services


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of DevOps or cloud platform engineering experience.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly AWS CDK with Python or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing CI/CD pipelines and Git-based engineering workflows.
  • Hands-on AWS cloud experience and ability to work effectively in highly controlled environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS WorkSpaces, EKS, and Systems Manager.
  • Experience deploying automation into isolated or tightly controlled environments.
  • Relevant AWS professional or specialty certifications; Security+ or CISSP where applicable.


Requirements

  • Active TS/SCI clearance; must be eligible for applicable SCI read-on/indoctrination and additional program-specific access approvals.
  • Must reside within commuting distance of one of the following 4 approved secure work locations: Herndon, VA; Washington, DC; Seattle, WA; or Denver, CO.
  • Regular on-site work in an approved secure facility and occasional work at authorized customer facilities may be required. This is not a remote position.
  • Full-time position, on-site
  • Please note that pursuant to a government contract, this specific position requires U.S. citizenship status


What is Important to Us:

  • You are an excellent communicator in writing and speaking.
  • You have the ability to work independently but also value teamwork.
  • Your problem-solving skills are excellent.
  • You are looking for a job where performance appraisals occur regularly, and you look forward to advancing your career.
  • You seek a community of virtue-centered co-workers and clients.


What we offer you: As part of the VSO company, you will be part of a virtue-centered team who value their work and teammates. This is a no-jerk zone. We provide ongoing learning and development opportunities to foster continuous growth. We offer competitive salaries, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

More About VSO: VSO is a hybrid cloud and managed services consulting firm. Much of VSO’s success can be attributed to our deep partnerships with IT services industry leaders such as AWS, IBM, Microsoft and others. VSO leverages numerous other partner relationships so as to provide our customers with optimal support. Additionally, we take pride in taking care of our employees. We offer a wide variety of benefits for eligible employees related to health, retirement, professional development, and more! For more information, please visit our website at https://vso-inc.com/careers

$175,000.00 - $230,000.00 per year

Description

SAIC is seeking a Cloud Systems Engineer to provide provision of Global Enterprise IT services, specifically focusing the design and management of the core cloud infrastructure. With a deep understanding of AWS & Azure service such as EC2/Azure Virtual Machines, VPC/Virtual Networks and S3/Storage accounts. In addition to these responsibilities, the Cloud Engineer create and maintain the foundational elements that support cloud applications and services. The Engineer is expected to deliver Tier 3 level support to SITEC 3 EOM mission partners. This critical support role involves the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of system outages, all while guaranteeing optimal service uptime and mission operational capabilities.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is a pivotal role within our IT infrastructure team, providing tier three systems support in line with the SIE OPORD. This position demands a comprehensive understanding of government PAAS, SAAS coupled with advanced skills in analysis, troubleshooting, and system design. Effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders is a critical component of this role. The engineer will be integral to the systems engineering process, leveraging data for performance enhancement, and participating actively in working groups, design reviews, and system testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and administer the AWS & Microsoft Azure cloud environment, including provisioning, configuration, performance monitoring, policy governance and security.
  • Design, develop, and implement highly available, multi-region solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Analyze existing operational standards, processes, and/or governance to identify and implement improvements.
  • Migrate existing infrastructure services to cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage security and access controls of cloud-based solutions.
  • Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) leveraging cloud native tooling to ensure automated and consistent platform deployments.
  • Develop and implement policy driven data protection best practices to ensure cloud solutions are protected from data loss.
  • Support cloud adoption of applications as they are being transformed and/or modernized.
  • Ensure all resources components meet proper performance and capacity standards.
  • Provide training and mentorship to Cloud Administrators, enhancing their understanding of Cloud capabilities and standard configurations.
  • Innovate and implement new technologies to advance mission readiness.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

Required Clearance

  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of 3+ years of AWS/Microsoft Azure experience involving design, deployment, configuration, and optimization.
  • Proven track record in managing production Windows Servers and implementing top-tier security practices within an enterprise environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft operating platforms and office applications.
  • At least 3 years of relevant IT experience.
  • Demonstrated ability in performance optimization and system engineering processes.

Required Certifications

  • DoW 8570 IAT II Certification.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 451 – System Administrator - Intermediate level or higher.

Desired Skills

  • Microsoft Certified Expert in the Azure product line OR.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert OR.
  • Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Target salary range $80,001 - $120,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Overview

It's an exciting time to be a member of the Fisher Investments Technology Department. We're investing in the future of our firm's technology and are building our team to achieve global growth. We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to support our Cloud Platform team. If you are looking for an opportunity to make an impact as we develop scalable and strategic solutions to support our global growth, we want to hear from you!

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will report to the Cloud Platform Team Lead and will be responsible for supporting, implementing, and managing our Azure-based cloud infrastructure. The Azure Cloud Engineer will maintain the operational Azure cloud environment, perform infrastructure deployments and ensure the production environment is operating securely and efficiently using automation tools. You will work with Infrastructure Engineering to make sure all deployments follow standards, are compliant and secure. You will also be partnered with other cloud team members, application owners and business owners for faster delivery of resources.

The Day-to-Day:

  • Design and manage scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure and automation tooling for routine operation tasks
  • Deploy enterprise scaled cloud resources that can be used across technology organizations using code
  • Be the contact to business application owners and build bridge between them and cloud team
  • Develop, implement and maintain scalable, AI infrastructure on Cloud Platform
  • Follow security audit requirements and controls in every action
  • Implement and suggest strategies in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, develop tooling and associated processes for applying automated, faster, efficient, and consistent error-free deployments
  • Enhance existing deployment processes and Infrastructure as Code scripts to improve automation, efficiency, and consistency
  • Participate in team activities such as peer code reviews, design collaboration efforts and rotating on-call process
  • Use configuration management and automated deployment tools to provide cloud-based solutions and services ensuring best practices
  • Work with solution architects, tech leads and partners to confirm developed solutions align with existing standards, meet security controls and meet cloud computing best practices
  • Investigate and monitor current-state cloud usage, solutions in use, risks, gaps, limitations and recommend solutions, optimizations and remediation
  • Provide international and 24/7 support at on-call duties and working a flexible off-hours schedule for planned and unplanned maintenance

Your Qualifications:

Position Description

Join CGI Federal in supporting a federal law enforcement client's classified digital asset modernization initiative. This position requires an active Top Secret clearance and involves engineering work within secure cloud environments that enable the deployment of a next generation Digital Asset Management platform. We are seeking a technically strong, adaptable Cloud Engineer who can design, configure, and support cloud infrastructure components, quickly learn new technologies, and collaborate effectively with technical, security, and functional teams. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in secure, mission focused environments and enjoys solving complex challenges across cloud, data, integration, and operational layers.

This position is located in Washington, DC or Fairfax, VA.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Support the deployment and configuration of cloud infrastructure for a Digital Asset Management solution across classified and unclassified cloud environments, following secure engineering standards.

Build and maintain ingestion pipelines using structured file exchange workflows, automation, and monitoring, ensuring compliance with secure data transfer models and boundary controls.

Implement and configure cloud resources such as VPCs, IAM roles, networking boundaries, logging, monitoring, encryption, and container services consistent with acceptable patterns and high side security requirements.

Collaborate with functional, engineering, and security stakeholders to ensure cloud architecture aligns with mission, performance, and compliance needs.

Assist with environment provisioning, multi account setups, secure network configurations, and adherence to enclave access rules.

Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud deployments, container execution, secure data transfers, and platform integrations across low side and high side environments.

Participate in technical testing, including end to end validation, regression testing, and classified environment readiness checks.

Create and maintain operational documentation, deployment procedures, cross domain workflow notes, and security driven configuration records.

Support sustainment activities such as configuration updates, ingestion pipeline tuning, cloud optimization, and environment monitoring.

Provide technical input during stakeholder workshops, engineering reviews, and classified planning sessions.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Minimum 3 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure support, or related technical roles, preferably with hands‑on work in AWS environments.

Active Top Secret clearance (required).

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

Hands on experience deploying or supporting solutions in AWS, including networking, IAM, monitoring, and automation.

Understanding of cloud architecture principles including VPC design, access control, encryption, multi account structures, and secure cloud patterns.

Experience supporting containerized workloads (ECS, EKS, Docker, etc.).

Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, data pipelines, and application environments.

Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively in evolving mission and technology landscapes.

Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, functional, and security teams.

Ability to operate in structured environments with formal documentation, configuration management, and governance expectations.

Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:

Experience working in GovCloud, high side cloud environments, or secure enclaves.

Familiarity with file based ingestion workflows, ETL/ELT pipelines, or structured data integration methods.

Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Understanding of security frameworks, boundary protection, and compliance considerations in classified environments.

Exposure to financial systems, digital assets, or accounting workflows (not required).

Experience supporting multi tenant or multi agency deployments.

Familiarity with CI/CD, AWS CodeCommit, secure container deployment pipelines, or DevSecOps models.

Experience collaborating with cybersecurity, ISSO/ISSM teams, or supporting ATO processes.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Our Public Cloud engineering teams are responsible for innovating and maintaining a large scale distributed systems engineering platform that ships hundreds of features to production for tens of millions of users across all industries every day. Our users count on our platform to be highly reliable, lightning fast, supremely secure, and to preserve all of their customizations and integrations every time we ship. You will need deep experience with concurrency, large scale systems, proficiency with solving real-world data management challenges, a strong understanding of how to craft solutions that are highly available, and a proven ability to design, develop, and optimize the core back-end systems.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Deliver cloud infrastructure automation tools, frameworks, workflows, and validation platforms on our public cloud platforms
  • Designing, developing, debugging, and operating resilient distributed systems that run across thousands of compute nodes in multiple data centers
  • Using and contributing to open source technology
  • Developing Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Writing microservices on containerization frameworks such as Kubernetes, Docker, Mesos
  • Resolving complex technical issues and drive innovations that improve system availability, resilience, and performance
  • Balancing live-site management, feature delivery, and retirement of technical debt
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation to address complex problems in real-time and keep services operational and highly available

You're Our Person If You Have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of backend software development experience (Python) working with Cloud Architecture
  • In-depth, hands-on experience with Linux Systems Administration and Troubleshooting, servers, and Cloud architecture. Good knowledge of Linux internals.
  • Proven professional work experience with Python. In-depth understanding of OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and concurrency.
  • Public cloud engineering on GCP, AWS, and or Azure platforms. Cloud provisioning, infrastructure, and migration at cloud scale.
  • Use of AI assisted development tools to automate DNS and infrastructure management.
  • Solid understanding of configuring, deploying, managing, and maintaining large cloud-hosted systems.
  • Experience with container and orchestration systems like Kubernetes, Docker, etc.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Splunk, Puppet, Spinnaker, Terraform, git, etc.
  • Strong understanding of fundamental network technologies like DNS, Load Balancing, SSL, TCP/IP, SQL, HTTP, Switches, Routers.
  • CI/CD experience with tools like Jenkins, and Travis CI.
  • Implementation experience of large infrastructure projects.
  • A continuous learner, a critical thinker, and a team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Embrace a culture and work environment that promotes diversity and inclusion.
  • Configuration management with open-source tools, ideally Puppet, Chef, Salt, or Ansible.
  • Experience maintaining monitoring platforms like Grafana.
  • Experience with Agile development methodology and Test Driven Development

Even Better If You Have

  • Experience using AWS Route 53.
  • Working in high-availability, 24x7x365 large-scale multi-datacenter environment
  • Highly skilled in packet analysis, network analysis tools, troubleshooting, and analytical fault diagnosis.
  • Security hardening of network infrastructure, such as DNSSEC

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer

Location: Irving, Tx


Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Lead or Senior Engineer with strong experience in enterprise infrastructure, hybrid cloud, Kubernetes and OpenShift. The engineer will design, build and support scalable infrastructure and container platforms across on-premises and public cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and support hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions.
  • Work with VMware, physical servers, storage, network switches and data-center infrastructure.
  • Design and manage Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, including EKS, GKE and AKS.
  • Support microservices, serverless and stateful workloads on container platforms.
  • Implement container security, image registry and cluster lifecycle standards.
  • Support service mesh technologies such as Istio and Envoy.
  • Standardize CI/CD and GitOps processes using Argo CD or Flux.
  • Support canary and blue-green deployment strategies.
  • Improve platform availability, performance, monitoring and cost efficiency.
  • Lead technical design reviews and coordinate with cloud, DevOps, network, security and application teams.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform, systems or network engineering.
  • Hands-on experience at Senior Engineer, Lead Engineer or Technical Lead level.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise environments and modernization programs.
  • Strong communication, documentation and technical design skills.
  • Ability to create technical diagrams using Visio, Draw.io or PowerPoint.
  • Experience with monitoring and IT operations tools such as Grafana, Orion, ServiceNow or BMC.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift and at least one public cloud platform: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, container security and platform automation.
  • Good understanding of high availability, capacity planning, FinOps and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Preferred Certifications

  • Red Hat certification.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).
  • TOGAF or Zachman certification is an advantage.

Key Skills

Hybrid Cloud, VMware, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, Platform Engineering, Container Security, Istio, Envoy, Argo CD, Flux, CI/CD, GitOps, FinOps, Grafana, ServiceNow.

  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong presentation skills with deep experience in data usage in dash-boarding platforms.
  • Advanced understanding and experience with monitoring tools.
  • Advanced experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Ability to quickly grasp technical issues and offer solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Outgoing and enthusiastic personality.

  • Customer-focused attitude and desire to interface directly with end-user clients.

Job Description

The University of Nevada, Las Vegas invites applications for Senior Cloud Engineer, Information Technology [R0150849].

ROLE OF THE POSITION

descriptionHtml:
Referment is working with a top global hedge fund to appoint a Senior Cloud Engineer for its New York infrastructure team.

This is a rare opportunity to join one of the most ambitious and technologically sophisticated firms in global investment management. Technology is fundamental to how the firm operates, competes and scales, with its infrastructure supporting a complex, performance-critical investment environment across multiple international locations.

You will help design and build the cloud platform underpinning the firm’s continued growth. Working across AWS and Azure, you will develop automated, secure and highly resilient infrastructure while helping establish the engineering standards used across the organisation.

This is not a narrowly defined cloud administration position. You will work across architecture, automation, networking, security, observability and reliability, with the opportunity to influence important technical decisions and see your work adopted throughout the business.

If you want meaningful ownership, substantial technical variety and the opportunity to engineer infrastructure within a top hedge fund, this is an exceptional opportunity.

What You’ll Own

  • Design, deploy and maintain highly available cloud infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Help shape the cloud architecture and engineering standards supporting a global investment business.
  • Build cloud-native platforms using containers, microservices, serverless technologies and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Develop infrastructure as code using Terraform, Ansible and other automation technologies.
  • Build and improve automated deployment pipelines that make infrastructure changes faster, safer and more repeatable.
  • Monitor, optimise and troubleshoot infrastructure performance, availability, security and cost.
  • Implement effective observability using technologies such as CloudWatch, Grafana and Datadog.
  • Strengthen identity and access management, encryption, network security and wider cloud controls.
  • Design disaster recovery and business continuity solutions, including backup, failover and multi-region architecture.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and determine where they can provide meaningful technical or commercial value.
  • Work closely with infrastructure and engineering colleagues across the US, Europe and APAC, as well as the firm’s managed service providers.
  • Document technical architectures, engineering standards and cloud best practices as the environment continues to develop.

The Environment

You will work across a broad and modern cloud technology landscape that includes:

  • AWS and Microsoft Azure
  • Terraform and Ansible
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • Python, PowerShell and Bash
  • CI/CD and automated deployment pipelines
  • CloudWatch, Grafana and Datadog
  • Cloud networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing and load balancing
  • Identity and access management
  • Encryption and cloud security controls
  • Multi-region architecture, disaster recovery and business continuity

You could be designing a new cloud architecture one day, troubleshooting a production issue the next and then working with global colleagues to automate or secure the underlying environment.

You will need to understand the individual technologies, but also how they come together to support a highly demanding and business-critical investment platform.

What We’re Looking For

You will bring approximately 5 to 10 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, solutions architecture or a similarly hands-on technical position.

You Are Likely To Have

  • Strong practical experience designing, deploying and managing infrastructure across AWS and Azure.
  • A thorough understanding of cloud architecture and the appropriate use of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS services.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, particularly Terraform and Ansible.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell or Bash.
  • Experience building and operating containerised environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure delivery.
  • A strong understanding of cloud networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing and connectivity.
  • Practical knowledge of IAM, encryption, network security and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience designing resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, failover mechanisms and multi-region deployments.
  • The ability to diagnose complex infrastructure problems calmly and methodically.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple regions.
  • A proactive, adaptable mindset and the willingness to take ownership outside a narrowly defined remit.

Experience within a hedge fund, investment firm, financial institution or another highly regulated and performance-sensitive environment would be advantageous, particularly where you have worked with SEC, GDPR or comparable regulatory requirements.

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline is preferred.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This role offers the technical ambition and resources of a top global hedge fund, combined with the opportunity to influence an infrastructure environment that continues to evolve rapidly.

You will join an organisation where engineering quality matters, infrastructure is treated as a strategic capability and strong technical decisions have a direct impact on performance, resilience and the firm’s ability to compete.

The Opportunity Includes

  • A senior position within one of the world’s leading hedge funds.
  • Genuine influence over the design of a global cloud environment.
  • Significant technical ownership rather than responsibility for one narrow component.
  • Exposure to complex, performance-sensitive and business-critical infrastructure.
  • The opportunity to work across AWS, Azure, automation, security, networking and reliability.
  • Collaboration with experienced engineers and stakeholders across multiple international locations.
  • The resources and support required to build infrastructure properly.
  • The compensation and benefits associated with a top global investment firm.

This could be an excellent next step for a Senior Cloud Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer or Cloud Solutions Architect who wants broader ownership within an elite financial environment.

If you want to help build the cloud platform supporting one of the world’s leading hedge funds, we would like to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate DRW's cloud and hybrid infrastructure across a diverse multi-cloud environment, taking ownership and accountability for the reliability, security, and performance of what you deliver. This role helps ensure our cloud infrastructure is secure, highly available, and optimized to support our continued success and growth.

You will partner closely with engineering, security, networking, operations, and business teams to enable appropriate use of public cloud, private infrastructure, and hybrid architectures.

What You'll Do

  • Platform Management: Manage and evolve cloud platforms, including but not limited to AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud), and Snowflake, along with the associated hybrid and on-premises dependencies required to operate them reliably.
  • Cloud Foundations: Design and maintain cloud foundations, including account/subscription/project organization, identity integration (federation, workload identity), policy guardrails, logging, tagging, and shared services.
  • Operational Excellence: Serve as the escalation point for complex production and cloud/hybrid-infrastructure issues, owning root cause analysis and holding yourself accountable for durable fixes, engaging cloud provider and partner support teams as needed.
  • Automation & Standards: Build and maintain automation, standards, reference architectures, and documentation that strengthen deployment consistency and enable teams to consume cloud services safely and consistently.
  • Integration & Collaboration: Engineer and support resilient cloud connectivity, including transit architectures and connectivity between cloud providers and on-premises environments.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Implement and improve observability across cloud services, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and capacity dashboards.
  • Stakeholder Support: Advise application and infrastructure teams on cloud, hybrid, and on-premises architecture choices based on reliability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Cost Management: Partner with Finance and Purchasing on cloud cost visibility, forecasting, and commitments, holding yourself accountable for the team's FinOps and efficiency goals.
  • Continuous Improvement: Research, evaluate, and implement new cloud services and capabilities that improve reliability, developer experience, security, or efficiency.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience engineering and administering production cloud environments in multi-cloud and hybrid settings, with strong AWS experience, exposure to one or more of Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud), and Snowflake; and integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation, including Terraform, Python, APIs/SDKs, CI/CD, and Git.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including VPCs, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, and interconnect providers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, including IAM, encryption/key management, secrets management, and least-privilege design.
  • Experience with cloud observability, monitoring, and alerting, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex production problems while making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Understanding of cloud cost models and practical approaches to cost allocation, optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and adapt to changing technologies and business needs while working effectively across technical teams and cloud providers.
  • A proven track record of delivering secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions, with strong ownership and accountability for production outcomes.
  • Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation supporting production cloud environments.
  • Previous experience in financial services or trading environments is a plus.

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

 California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

- Cost Management: Partner with Finance and Purchasing on cloud cost visibility, forecasting, and commitments, holding yourself accountable for the team's FinOps and efficiency goals.

What We're Looking For



- 5+ years of experience engineering and administering production cloud environments in multi-cloud and hybrid settings, with strong AWS experience, exposure to one or more of Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud), and Snowflake; and integration with on-premises infrastructure. 
- Experience with infrastructure as code and automation, including Terraform, Python, APIs/SDKs, CI/CD, and Git. 
- Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including VPCs, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, and interconnect providers. 
- Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, including IAM, encryption/key management, secrets management, and least-privilege design. 
- Experience with cloud observability, monitoring, and alerting, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex production problems while making sound decisions under pressure. 
- Understanding of cloud cost models and practical approaches to cost allocation, optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps. 
- Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and adapt to changing technologies and business needs while working effectively across technical teams and cloud providers. 
- A proven track record of delivering secure, scalable, and reliable cloud solutions, with strong ownership and accountability for production outcomes. 
- Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation supporting production cloud environments. 
- Previous experience in financial services or trading environments is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
This exciting hands-on role within our Infrastructure team will provide you with the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the firm’s cloud implementation, strategy, and architecture design. At BAM, you will have the chance to work with some of the smartest and most driven individuals in the industry.


As a Senior Cloud Engineer at BAM, you will:

• Serve as a mentor and guide to Cloud Engineering team members.

• Run internal projects efficiently with self-managing autonomy.

• Play a key role in architecting and managing BAM’s public cloud environments (AWS, GCP).

• Help to design and automate BAM's Kubernetes offerings, especially managed cloud offerings.

• Partner with developers and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and provide recommendations for cloud solutions and strategies to address those needs.

• Work with Infrastructure & Platform teams to provide a consistent end user experience across BAM’s on-premise and cloud environments.

• Write code to automate and optimize deployment of infrastructure and applications (whether it’s Python, Terraform, Go, or something else).

• Develop self-service capabilities that allow stakeholders to access cloud services quickly and efficiently.

• Implement and support applications running on BAM’s cloud and Kubernetes systems, especially as they support our user-facing platforms.

• Integrate our platforms with open-source observability tools like Grafana and Prometheus.

• Use LLMs and autonomous agents as force multipliers for our offerings.

• Stay up to date with the latest trends and offerings within the cloud and Kubernetes computing space, and act as a champion of their adoption across the organization.

• Participate in out-of-hours on-call rotation and maintenance.


To be considered a good fit, you should have:

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting and implementing large-scale, highly available, services on public cloud.

• Practical skills with Kubernetes as a platform, including cluster creation from scratch, cluster management, security, deployment of applications, and experience with managed Kubernetes platforms.

• A familiarity with and commitment to DevOps and Platform Engineering best practices.

• Expert knowledge of immutable infrastructure, infrastructure automation and provisioning tools, such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

• Experience with cloud-native security practices and tools.

• Basic to intermediate programming capability particularly as it relates to infrastructure.

• Strong knowledge of Linux administration particularly RPM-based operating systems.

• Strong operational understanding of networking concepts, architecture, and best practices, especially as it relates to hybrid cloud integration..

• Systems architecting and design skills, Cloud, Kubernetes, serverless, etc.

• An ability to develop quick and sound solutions to complex problems.

• An orientation toward working in an agile-based team, prioritizing quick frequent deliverables guided by high-level roadmaps rather than large and infrequent waterfall releases.

• A commitment to improving team practices and systems.

• A goal of being supportive of team members in meetings, change reviews, and design discussions.

• A strength in communication/presentation, written and in meetings (leveraging AI is fine but not being dependent on it).


Bonus points for:

• Familiarity with Hashicorp Vault.

• Experience with Kubernetes service meshes.

• Contributions to open-source libraries, projects, or communities.

• Experience working with Kubernetes on-prem.

• AWS Certified Developer/DevOps or Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional).

• Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization.

• Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.

• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure management.

The Cloud Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining cloud-based solutions and work proactively to diagnose problems and provide recommendations for new and existing cloud-based systems.

Accountabilities:

Responsibilities/Duties/Function/Tasks:


  • Administer, configure, and maintain the Bank’s Microsoft cloud services and other cloud-based solutions used by the Bank.
  • Ensure system backups and recovery using cloud-based solutions.
  • Manage and plan project work related to platform upgrades, patches, and modifications to services as needed.
  • Evaluate the Bank’s cloud services utilized by the Bank, to understand how they integrate with infrastructure services.
  • Design integration of cloud application and infrastructure services into existing IT systems.
  • Implement and manage cloud security controls, identity and access management policies.
  • Secure systems to meet corporate standards and best practices.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of disaster recovery processes and procedures.
  • Develop scripts for configuration management automation and process improvements.
  • Support existing applications and projects by responding to incidents, problems, and service requests.
  • Participate in research and recommend new cloud technologies to meet the Bank’s business objectives.
  • Operate in accordance with the Bank’s control processes and comply with the Bank’s policies and procedures.
  • Manage administrative tasks.
  • Crosstrain others on the team as requested.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve cloud-based system issues, involving third-party vendor support as needed for quick resolution of problems.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-based procedures related to Microsoft cloud services and other cloud-based solutions used by the Bank.
  • Consulted in the development of IT roadmaps around infrastructure and cloud services; understand and convey potential impact to Bank services and architecture.
  • Develop and implement performance metrics and monitoring to report on cloud configurations, performance, and security baselines.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 5-7 years’ experience in cloud engineering or a related role.
  • Experience engineering and administrating enterprise backup/restore solutions, web servers, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Exchange, and/or other enterprise cloud services.
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud providers (ex. AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with scripting languages and automation tools is desired.
  • Knowledge of networking, databases, and storage solutions in cloud environments.
  • Ability to make effective and informed decisions using own initiative and based upon a sound understanding of the issues and challenges of the organization.

  • Understanding of EntraID.
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) as well as interpersonal skills.
  • Effective in a culture of teamwork, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Highly organized with the ability to plan and prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Ability to positively engage with others and possess a strong desire to learn.
  • Results-oriented and self-motivated

descriptionHtml:
MORSE Corp is an employee owned, small business based in Cambridge, MA, Arlington, VA, and Seattle, WA with a history of fielding cutting-edge technology. MORSE boasts a specially selected team of scientists, engineers, and software developers to deliver best-in-class technical solutions that solve difficult multidisciplinary problems faced by the US National Security Ecosystem.  

MORSE is seeking highly motivated and talented Software Engineers with cloud expertise to join our innovative team. You will support projects that provide critical AI, machine learning, simulation, situational awareness, and mission planning capabilities to a diverse range of Department of Defense (DoD) customers.

As a Cloud Software Engineer at MORSE, you will work on cutting-edge technology and directly contribute to the success of our applications and our customers’ missions. You will collaborate with teams of engineers and data scientists to design, develop, and deliver software products that meet high standards of scalability, reliability, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable, efficient, and reliable software applications using Python.

  • Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Oversee the deployment of cloud services and ensure compliance with security guidelines and best practices.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration with your team to ensure high-quality code and knowledge sharing.

  • Stay up to date with the latest software engineering trends, tools, and technologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products, ensuring seamless integration and deployment.

  • Contribute to new codebases that emphasize object orientation, modularity, and maintainability.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance (TS/SCI).

  • Strong proficiency in Python.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm charts.

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and microservice architectures.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, and deployment in cloud environments. 

  • Strong communication skills and self-motivation.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, and 1+ years of software engineering experience.

 

Nice to Have

  • AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification.

  • Security+ or equivalent security certification.

MORSE Corp’s salary range for this role carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to, prior experience, education, skills and expertise, location, internal equity, and other factors that are job related and consistent with business need. Therefore, final offer amounts may vary from the amount stated. Depending on role eligibility, total compensation may also include bonus, stock, 401(k) match, paid time off, medical, dental, vision and life insurance.Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year. Summary

The Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer plays an integral role in defining and assessing the firm’s infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture and practices. This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.

  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

descriptionHtml:
Steptoe, a Washington, DC-based Am Law 100 law firm, is seeking an Enterprise Cloud & Systems Engineer responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise cloud and hybrid infrastructure with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. This position plays a hands‑on engineering role in implementing cloud foundations, managing hybrid connectivity, automating infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of core IT platforms.

The Enterprise Cloud and Systems Engineer work deeply at the technical level deploying and configuring Azure resources, managing identity services, building Infrastructure as Code, automating operational processes, and maintaining enterprise storage platforms. This role collaborates closely with architecture, security, operations, and application teams to integrate on‑premises systems with Azure and to provide stable, well‑governed platform services that support firm‑wide applications and data.

Essential Functions

  • Design, deploy, and operate Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, networking, identity services, storage, and supporting platform services (IaaS and selected PaaS)
  • Build and maintain Azure landing zones, subscription structures, resource organization, policies, and governance controls
  • Implement and manage hybrid infrastructure, including connectivity between on‑premises environments and Azure (identity synchronization, networking integration, and access controls)
  • Administer and support Active Directory and Azure AD (Entra ID), including directory synchronization, authentication flows, conditional access, and role‑based access control
  • Design and manage Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks (VNets), ExpressRoute or VPN Gateway connectivity, routing, and Network Security Groups (NSGs)
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform and/or Bicep to provision and manage Azure resources consistently across environments
  • Engineer and operate enterprise Azure storage solutions, including Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files, and Azure Blob Storage, ensuring security. performance, availability, and appropriate data protection
  • Build automation and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub to support infrastructure deployment, updates, and operational workflows
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and security controls to ensure visibility, compliance, and operational stability across cloud platforms
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud and hybrid infrastructure issues related to performance, connectivity, identity, or service availability
  • Participating in incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation activities to improve platform reliability and resilience
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks to support IT Operations and ensure repeatable processes
  • Provide advanced technical support and subject matter expertise for cloud and hybrid infrastructure services

Non-Essential Functions

  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualification

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and operational responsibilities effectively
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving skills
  • 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, platform, or infrastructure engineering roles
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure services, architecture, and operational best practices
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments integrating on‑premises and cloud systems
  • Strong Windows Server and Active Directory administration experience
  • Hands‑on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and operational tasks
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, routing, and connectivity concepts
  • Familiarity with Azure networking services such as VNets, ExpressRoute or VPN Gateways, and Network Security Groups (NSGs) Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, equivalent technical certification, or comparable professional experience Certifications (Preferred)
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate
  • Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Or equivalent certifications supporting Azure, hybrid infrastructure, or infrastructure automation

Success Factors

  • Attention to detail: Designs and implements accurate, secure, and repeatable infrastructure solutions with minimal errors
  • Critical thinking and problem solving: Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues across cloud and hybrid platforms
  • Customer service: Responsive and dependable technical partner to internal IT teams and stakeholders
  • Initiative and continuous improvement: Proactively automates manual processes and improves platform reliability and efficiency
  • Teamwork: Works effectively across architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to deliver stable platform services

Work Environment

  • Non-smoking environment
  • Ability to maintain a flexible work schedule
  • Available to work 9:00 - 5:30 pm Monday through Friday.
  • Hybrid work arrangements may be available for this position.
  • Extra weekday and weekend hours may be required for special programs or events
  • Must be available to work beyond regular hours when necessary
  • Must be able to work under tight deadlines and stressful situations
  • Must have ability to work independently

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $117,000 - $127,000. The actual base salary offered will be dependent upon the applicant’s experience and qualifications, as well as other job-related factors, including but not limited to, relevant skills, education, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, geographic location.

 Steptoe offers a full range of benefits for you and your eligible dependents. Benefits currently include: medical, dental, vision, life, disability, dependent care, health care flexible spending accounts, 401K Plan, Profit-Sharing, Paid Time-Off and a robust Wellness Program.

Steptoe, a Washington, DC-based Am Law 100 law firm, is seeking an Enterprise Cloud & Systems Engineer responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise cloud and hybrid infrastructure with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. This position plays a hands‑on engineering role in implementing cloud foundations, managing hybrid connectivity, automating infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of core IT platforms.

The Enterprise Cloud and Systems Engineer work deeply at the technical level deploying and configuring Azure resources, managing identity services, building Infrastructure as Code, automating operational processes, and maintaining enterprise storage platforms. This role collaborates closely with architecture, security, operations, and application teams to integrate on‑premises systems with Azure and to provide stable, well‑governed platform services that support firm‑wide applications and data.

Essential Functions



- Design, deploy, and operate Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, networking, identity services, storage, and supporting platform services (IaaS and selected PaaS)
- Build and maintain Azure landing zones, subscription structures, resource organization, policies, and governance controls
- Implement and manage hybrid infrastructure, including connectivity between on‑premises environments and Azure (identity synchronization, networking integration, and access controls)
- Administer and support Active Directory and Azure AD (Entra ID), including directory synchronization, authentication flows, conditional access, and role‑based access control
- Design and manage Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks (VNets), ExpressRoute or VPN Gateway connectivity, routing, and Network Security Groups (NSGs)
- Experience using Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform and/or Bicep to provision and manage Azure resources consistently across environments
- Engineer and operate enterprise Azure storage solutions, including Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files, and Azure Blob Storage, ensuring security. performance, availability, and appropriate data protection
- Build automation and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub to support infrastructure deployment, updates, and operational workflows
- Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and security controls to ensure visibility, compliance, and operational stability across cloud platforms
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud and hybrid infrastructure issues related to performance, connectivity, identity, or service availability
- Participating in incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation activities to improve platform reliability and resilience
- Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational runbooks to support IT Operations and ensure repeatable processes
- Provide advanced technical support and subject matter expertise for cloud and hybrid infrastructure services

Non-Essential Functions



- Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualification



- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and operational responsibilities effectively
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving skills
- 3–5 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, platform, or infrastructure engineering roles
- Strong experience with Microsoft Azure services, architecture, and operational best practices
- Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments integrating on‑premises and cloud systems
- Strong Windows Server and Active Directory administration experience
- Hands‑on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep
- Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and operational tasks
- Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub
- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, routing, and connectivity concepts
- Familiarity with Azure networking services such as VNets, ExpressRoute or VPN Gateways, and Network Security Groups (NSGs) Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in a related field, equivalent technical certification, or comparable professional experience Certifications (Preferred)
- Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate
- Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Or equivalent certifications supporting Azure, hybrid infrastructure, or infrastructure automation

- Attention to detail: Designs and implements accurate, secure, and repeatable infrastructure solutions with minimal errors
- Critical thinking and problem solving: Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues across cloud and hybrid platforms
- Customer service: Responsive and dependable technical partner to internal IT teams and stakeholders
- Initiative and continuous improvement: Proactively automates manual processes and improves platform reliability and efficiency
- Teamwork: Works effectively across architecture, security, operations, and engineering teams to deliver stable platform services

- Available to work 9:00 - 5:30 pm Monday through Friday.

descriptionHtml:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Every hour of every day, soldiers, acquisition professionals, and federal partners around the world count on systems that simply cannot go down. That is where PL ALTESS comes in. As the Agile Center of Excellence for the Program Executive Office Enterprise (PEO Enterprise), the U.S. Army Product Lead Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology Enterprise Systems and Services (PL ALTESS) runs enterprise-class data centers that host hundreds of programs, thousands of virtual servers, and millions of users worldwide, 24x7x365. Our team delivers the full spectrum of IT services: data center and Service Operations Center operations, network and systems administration, cybersecurity, cloud and application modernization, disaster recovery, and lifecycle testing across physical, virtual, and cloud architectures spanning multiple geographic locations. If you want your work to matter at mission scale, this is the place.

The opportunity: ALTESS is a managed service provider for Army and DoW IT systems and is expanding into managed cloud services across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and private clouds. As a Cloud Engineer, you will help build that capability from the ground up, migrating mission applications, automating everything, and shaping how Army systems run in the cloud.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate managed cloud services in Microsoft Azure, AWS, and private cloud environments.
  • Migrate on-premises applications to the cloud, from discovery and planning through cutover.
  • Build secure connectivity with IPsec/VPN and BGP between data centers and cloud environments.
  • Automate infrastructure and routine administration with Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, and Bash.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline/CodeDeploy, Azure DevOps).
  • Apply DoW STIGs and IAVM to cloud workloads and keep them compliant.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and communicate clearly with customers and teammates.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIRED)

  • Minimum of 12 years w/o a degree, Minimum of 10 years with AS/AA; Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhDDoD 8140 qualified for DCWF 451 - System Administrator at the Intermediate proficiency level
  • Cloud platform certification, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate (formerly SysOps Administrator - Associate).
  • Background in Computer Science or IT.
  • Active DoW Secret security clearance
  • US Citizenship
  • Mid- to senior-level cloud engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with IPsec/VPN and other secure transport technologies, as well as Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).
  • Proven experience migrating on-premises applications to the cloud.
  • Understanding of network, storage, server, and application technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of automation concepts, tools, and scripting languages (Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Puppet, Chef, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of code repository tools such as Git.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline experience, e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodeDeploy/CodePipeline, Azure DevOps.
  • Working knowledge of DoW STIGs and IA Vulnerability Management (IAVM).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and experience managing multiple large-scale projects.

WHAT SETS YOU APART (DESIRED)

  • Senior IT experience in networking or equivalent experience.
  • Experience automating routine administrative tasks.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud / Azure Government and DoD Cloud Computing SRG impact levels.

WORKLOCATION

  • Radford, VA or Remote

Ready to keep the mission running? Apply today and join the team that keeps Army enterprise systems up 24x7x365.

Details

Target Salary Range: $112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.
