About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Platform Infrastructure team. This team is in the Platform org and focuses on customer setup and deployment, especially in complex cloud, hosting, and security environments. You will help build the systems that bootstrap cloud accounts and projects, wire authentication, and turn deployment workflows into reliable, repeatable productized experiences for customers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys cloud infrastructure, networking, infrastructure as code, and solving real-world deployment problems with clean software abstractions.

You Will

  • Build and improve systems that automate customer setup and deployment across cloud environments.
  • Develop deployment workflows and infrastructure as code templates that mirror customer environments and reduce manual setup work.
  • Improve support for complex deployment scenarios including BYO-VPC, customer-managed keys, airgapped environments, and custom-region deployments.
  • Work on cloud account and project bootstrapping, authentication wiring, proxy and private networking, and deployment orchestration.
  • Partner closely with Platform, Security, Product, and customer-facing teams to make deployments faster, safer, and easier to operate.
  • Raise the quality, reliability, and coverage of our AWS and GCP deployment tooling over time.

About You

  • You have 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantially hands-on experience designing, building, and automating cloud infrastructure and in AWS and/or GCP environments
  • You have solid backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to work across infrastructure-heavy systems.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure provisioning system using Terraform or other infrastructure-as-Code (Iac)tools, with a focus on automation, scalability, and repeatable deployments.
  • Hands-on experience designing and configuring cloud networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, routing, proxies, and private connectivity in AWS and/or GCP environments.
  • You have built or improved deployment automation, onboarding workflows, internal cloud platforms, or customer-environment setup systems.
  • You can balance engineering rigor with pragmatism and are excited to turn complex setup problems into repeatable productized systems.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across functions, and are comfortable taking ownership in an evolving environment.

Location:

  • This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits

The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $270,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

Your Job

The Cloud Engineer at KBX is an individual contributor responsible for operating, maintaining, and improving the cloud platform that supports our application teams. Working with senior engineers and other team members, you will execute cloud infrastructure changes, fulfill platform and access requests, support shared services, troubleshoot issues, and help keep our AWS environment secure, reliable, and supportable. This role is suited to someone early in their cloud engineering career who has strong technical fundamentals, follows established designs and standards, collaborates well, and can reliably carry work through implementation and operational support.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Our Team

We partner closely with Software Engineering and DevOps, Security, and IT leadership to create secure, scalable, and reliable platform solutions, strengthen engineering practices, and accelerate the responsible adoption of cloud and AI technologies. We value technical curiosity, critical thinking, knowledge sharing, technical leadership, and a "can-do" attitude.

What You Will Do

  • Build and support AWS infrastructure using established designs, security controls, and change-management practices.
  • Work with senior engineers to clarify requirements and technical decisions.
  • Maintain, monitor, upgrade, and troubleshoot cloud platform technologies, including Amazon EKS, Istio, Solo Gloo, Kong, Amazon MSK/Kafka, and Redis/ElastiCache.
  • Use Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions to provision infrastructure and deploy platform changes.
  • Manage IAM, access, networking, encryption, and secrets requests using established standards. Identify automation opportunities and resolve security risks or unclear requirements with the team.
  • Monitor platform health, respond to alerts and incidents, troubleshoot issues with application teams, and escalate complex problems.
  • Apply tagging standards, support cost reporting, investigate waste, and implement approved cost-saving changes.
  • Investigate issues using documentation and operational data, ask for help when needed, and verify work before closing it.
  • Maintain implementation notes, runbooks, request records, and troubleshooting guides. Share lessons with the team.
  • Build AWS and cloud platform skills through hands-on work, training, certifications, and feedback.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, communicate impact, and help prevent repeat issues.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Entry-level candidates are welcome. Experience through employment, internships, labs, coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, networking, software development, or DevOps
  • Experience applying core AWS concepts and services such as compute, networking, storage, IAM, security groups, subnets, routing, and monitoring.
  • Experience deploying, managing, or supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes environments. Familiarity with Amazon EKS, ingress controllers, container networking, or service mesh technologies is a plus.
  • Experience scripting in Python, PowerShell, or shell.
  • Experience applying cloud security, identity and access management, monitoring, logging, incident response, and change-management best practices
  • An ability to use AI-assisted tools to support learning, scripting, analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows

What Will Put You Ahead

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or Information Technology field
  • Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, application teams, service requests, or operational queues in an internship, academic, lab, or professional setting
  • Experience using Terraform, source control, or CI/CD automation
  • Experience working with Amazon EKS, ingress, container networking, or service mesh technologies is valuable but not required
  • Experience using service mesh technologies (Istio or similar) and API gateway technologies such as Gloo/kgateway, Kong, or equivalent in a production setting
  • Using GitOps methodologies and tools (Argo CD) for continuous deployment on Kubernetes
  • Experience with Cloudflare or similar CDN/DNS/web security platforms for cloud networking and traffic management
  • Experience working in a hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments and integrating on-premises systems with AWS cloud resources (networking, identity federation, etc.).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate, or another relevant AWS certification.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or similar cloud/platform certification.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

KBX Logistics, a Koch company and global leader in transportation, offers world-class, technology-driven capabilities across all modes of managed freight and transportation asset management. KBX is uniquely positioned to meet the challenges shippers face, leveraging decades of firsthand experience and data-driven insights from a large, diverse, and global business network. By building mutually beneficial partnerships and innovative technology, KBX creates a competitive advantage for its customers and meets the growing need for cost effective and reliable supply chain solutions. For more information on KBX, visit www.kbx.com

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except wh ere prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. Job Responsibilities

  • Engineer, configure, test, install, integrate, operate, secure, monitor, maintain, and sustain commercial cloud environments.

  • Develop, operate, and manage network infrastructure supporting Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and/or Virtual Private Network (VPN) environments.

    • Twelve (12) years of experience with a High School Diploma or GED.

Company:  IRALOGIX, Inc.                                                                        Position:   Sr Cloud Platform Engineer


Location:    Remote                                                                                       Job Type:  Full-Time/Exempt


Industry:    Retirement Services/FinTech Software                                                                       Travel:       Infrequent, as needed






IRALOGIX is a high-growth, institutional technology platform focused on providing uniquely capable solutions to IRA providers, 401(k) recordkeepers, retirement-focused Advisors, Mutual Fund investment providers, and banks interested in growing their IRA capabilities, revenue, and market share. Through proprietary, ground-up technology, we are changing the landscape and are empowering client companies to provide broader access to the best retirement services possible while significantly lowering administration costs and increasing efficiency, profitability, and competitiveness, far beyond industry expectations.


 


Role:


As a SENIOR CLOUD PLATFORM ENGINEER, focusing on AWS technology and reporting directly to the Senior Director of Platform Architecture, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure that powers our reliable, high-performing, and scalable platforms. As a member of our Platform Architecture team, your AWS expertise will play a vital role in helping optimize our cloud environments, improve performance, and enhance security. The team is responsible for analyzing, designing, and implementing the frameworks and infrastructure to align with application, platform, and system requirements. The team collaborates closely with software, site reliability, security and other engineering teams to ensure that the finalized infrastructure and application architecture align with security, scalability, reliability, and availability standards.


 


Responsibilities:


The essential responsibilities and duties for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:



  • Designs, deploys, and manages AWS EKS clusters, ensuring high availability and scalability.

  • Works with AWS ECS (Fargate) to implement serverless container orchestration.

  • Sets up, configures, and maintains message brokers (Amazon MQ, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ) for distributed applications.

  • Manages and optimizes Amazon RDS for SQL databases, including performance tuning and high availability.

  • Implements and fine-tunes Amazon Redshift for data warehousing, providing high-performance analytics.

  • Develops and maintains infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK.

  • Designs and configures tooling like CloudWatch and Datadog to maintain the health, performance, and security of AWS environments.

  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders and platform engineering teams to understand specific business needs and recommend appropriate AWS services.

  • Leverages the AWS Well-Architected Framework to ensure operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability of AWS environments.


Education and Experience:



  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar certification is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience in designing and managing AWS cloud services with expertise in EKS, Fargate, MQ, RDS, and Redshift.

  • Proficiency in containerization technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code (IaC) and automation tools.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team and client-facing environments.

  • Must be US Citizen, Permanent Resident, or eligible to work in the US permanently.


 


 


 


 


IRALOGIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that embraces diversity, represents a variety of backgrounds, and upholds inclusiveness.  M/F/V/D

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Systems Engineer at our Dallas, TX, office .

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Sr. Systems Engineer to join our Business Technology team. In this role, you will report to the Sr. Director, Infrastructure & Operations, and will be responsible for building and maintaining application infrastructure environments primarily on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will play a critical role in enabling our development teams to deploy applications efficiently and reliably through Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) practices and cloud-native solutions.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented engineer who enjoys working with automation tools, particularly Terraform, and has a solid understanding of cloud services and architectural patterns. You'll collaborate with development teams, infrastructure engineers, and cloud architects to build scalable, reliable infrastructure solutions that support our business objectives.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable application infrastructure across Azure and AWS using Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and reusable provisioning modules and templates.
  • Deploy, configure, and manage cloud services including compute, storage, databases, networking, load balancing, auto-scaling, content delivery, and container platforms such as Kubernetes and AWS ECS.
  • Design and maintain cloud networking and security configurations, including VNets/VPCs, subnets, routing, network security groups, and supporting infrastructure controls.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and application deployment processes.
  • Apply Azure and AWS Well-Architected and cloud adoption principles to infrastructure design, cloud migrations, application modernization, and ongoing architectural improvements.
  • Implement and manage monitoring, logging, alerting, capacity management, and performance optimization to maintain infrastructure availability, reliability, and application performance.
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, adjusting infrastructure capacity based on application demand and operational requirements.
  • Implement and maintain backup, disaster recovery, security patching, and infrastructure resilience capabilities for critical application environments.
  • Partner with application development, Cloud, and architecture teams to define infrastructure requirements, integrate provisioning into deployment pipelines, and implement standardized architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Provide ongoing operational support, incident response, troubleshooting, and on-call support, while maintaining infrastructure documentation, procedures, troubleshooting guides, and driving continuous improvements in reliability, performance, security, and cost optimization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience
  • 5 years minimum of prior relevant experience
  • Skills Required: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Terraform, cloud architecture patterns, CI/CD pipelines, containerization and orchestration, networking and security, monitoring and logging, automation and scripting, version control systems, problem-solving and troubleshooting, cross-functional collaboration, technical documentation, and continuous learning mindset

Compensation & Benefits

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; based on the type of position
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

Job Description

AWS Cloud Engineer – Infrastructure & Operations

We are seeking a technically capable and motivated Cloud Engineer to support the administration, security, reliability, and ongoing improvement of cloud-based infrastructure. This position will play an important role in maintaining cloud environments, supporting server operations, managing containerized applications, and ensuring the stability and security of critical business systems.

The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in cloud computing, systems administration, networking, and infrastructure security. We are open to considering both experienced professionals and early-career candidates who demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, initiative, and the ability to learn quickly.

Position Details

  • Location: Jacksonville, FL
  • Work Arrangement: Fully onsite
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • On-call participation required for critical infrastructure support

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain, configure, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure across multiple environments.
  • Administer Linux and Windows-based systems, including configuration, updates, security controls, and performance improvements.
  • Support containerized applications and orchestration platforms.
  • Configure and troubleshoot web servers, reverse proxies, load balancing solutions, and network connectivity.
  • Monitor system availability, performance, and security using cloud-native and third-party monitoring solutions.
  • Identify and address infrastructure vulnerabilities, operating system exposures, and security-related findings.
  • Apply industry-recognized security frameworks and configuration standards to strengthen infrastructure environments.
  • Develop and maintain automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration processes.
  • Manage infrastructure code through version control and collaborative development practices.
  • Track technical issues, operational activities, maintenance requests, and remediation efforts through project management and ticketing platforms.
  • Investigate production incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement solutions to prevent recurring issues.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, disaster recovery, backup processes, and ongoing operational improvements.
  • Work alongside technical teams across multiple business functions to support infrastructure initiatives.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and change-management records.

Required Technical Qualifications

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of AWS services, including compute, networking, identity management, storage, databases, and load balancing.
  • Understanding of cloud architecture, high availability, access controls, and infrastructure security.
  • Familiarity with managing and troubleshooting cloud-hosted production environments.

Systems Administration

  • Strong understanding of Linux operating systems and command-line administration.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server environments.
  • Knowledge of system services, user permissions, log analysis, patch management, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of operating system security configuration and hardening standards.

Networking & Security

  • Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, routing, firewalls, and network security.
  • Experience or familiarity with web server and reverse proxy configuration.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability assessment, security patching, and remediation practices.

Containers & Automation

  • Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration technologies.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes and managed container environments.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code concepts and automated provisioning tools.
  • Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.

Monitoring & Operations

  • Familiarity with cloud monitoring, logging, and infrastructure performance tools.
  • Exposure to vulnerability scanning and security assessment platforms.
  • Familiarity with ticketing, incident management, and change-control systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and adapt to evolving technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in cloud engineering, systems administration, infrastructure operations, or information security.
  • Industry-recognized cloud certifications or relevant technical credentials.
  • Hands-on experience supporting production cloud environments and business-critical applications.
  • Experience with container orchestration, workload troubleshooting, and container management.
  • Practical experience developing and maintaining infrastructure automation configurations.
  • Experience with web servers, reverse proxies, load balancing, and network security controls.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms and established security configuration standards.
  • Exposure to Shell scripting, Python, automation tools, deployment pipelines, or related technologies.
  • Experience working with relational database platforms.
  • Background supporting highly available systems and responding to production incidents.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments, security audits, compliance requirements, and remediation activities.

Communication Requirements

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Additional language capabilities are a plus, particularly experience communicating technical information across international teams.
  • Ability to explain technical issues clearly and maintain accurate operational documentation.

Early-Career Candidates

Candidates with limited professional experience are encouraged to apply. Individuals demonstrating strong technical aptitude and a genuine interest in cloud infrastructure will be considered.

Relevant Experience May Include

  • Academic coursework or projects involving cloud computing, networking, operating systems, or cybersecurity.
  • Technical internships or entry-level IT experience.
  • Personal projects, home labs, or hands-on cloud environments.
  • Relevant certifications or independent technical training.
  • Strong analytical abilities, curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership of new challenges.

Work Environment & Availability

  • This is a fully onsite position based in Jacksonville, Florida. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available.
  • Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation is required to support critical infrastructure and production incidents.
  • Must be available to respond to urgent system or security issues outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when scheduled.
  • Occasional planned maintenance activities may take place outside standard business hours.
  • On-call scheduling, response expectations, and applicable compensation are governed by company policies.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $120,000.00/ Annually

You will work with Infrastructure Engineering to make sure all deployments follow standards, are compliant and secure. You will also be partnered with other cloud team members, application owners and business owners for faster delivery of resources.

  • Design and manage scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure and automation tooling for routine operation tasks
  • Deploy enterprise scaled cloud resources that can be used across technology organizations using code
  • Be the contact to business application owners and build bridge between them and cloud team
  • Develop, implement and maintain scalable, AI infrastructure on Cloud Platform
  • Follow security audit requirements and controls in every action
  • Implement and suggest strategies in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, develop tooling and associated processes for applying automated, faster, efficient, and consistent error-free deployments
  • Enhance existing deployment processes and Infrastructure as Code scripts to improve automation, efficiency, and consistency
  • Participate in team activities such as peer code reviews, design collaboration efforts and rotating on-call process

descriptionHtml:
This exciting hands-on role within our Infrastructure team will provide you with the opportunity to make a lasting impact on the firm’s cloud implementation, strategy, and architecture design. At BAM, you will have the chance to work with some of the smartest and most driven individuals in the industry.


As a Senior Cloud Engineer at BAM, you will:

• Serve as a mentor and guide to Cloud Engineering team members.

• Run internal projects efficiently with self-managing autonomy.

• Play a key role in architecting and managing BAM’s public cloud environments (AWS, GCP).

• Help to design and automate BAM's Kubernetes offerings, especially managed cloud offerings.

• Partner with developers and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and provide recommendations for cloud solutions and strategies to address those needs.

• Work with Infrastructure & Platform teams to provide a consistent end user experience across BAM’s on-premise and cloud environments.

• Write code to automate and optimize deployment of infrastructure and applications (whether it’s Python, Terraform, Go, or something else).

• Develop self-service capabilities that allow stakeholders to access cloud services quickly and efficiently.

• Implement and support applications running on BAM’s cloud and Kubernetes systems, especially as they support our user-facing platforms.

• Integrate our platforms with open-source observability tools like Grafana and Prometheus.

• Use LLMs and autonomous agents as force multipliers for our offerings.

• Stay up to date with the latest trends and offerings within the cloud and Kubernetes computing space, and act as a champion of their adoption across the organization.

• Participate in out-of-hours on-call rotation and maintenance.


To be considered a good fit, you should have:

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting and implementing large-scale, highly available, services on public cloud.

• Practical skills with Kubernetes as a platform, including cluster creation from scratch, cluster management, security, deployment of applications, and experience with managed Kubernetes platforms.

• A familiarity with and commitment to DevOps and Platform Engineering best practices.

• Expert knowledge of immutable infrastructure, infrastructure automation and provisioning tools, such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

• Experience with cloud-native security practices and tools.

• Basic to intermediate programming capability particularly as it relates to infrastructure.

• Strong knowledge of Linux administration particularly RPM-based operating systems.

• Strong operational understanding of networking concepts, architecture, and best practices, especially as it relates to hybrid cloud integration..

• Systems architecting and design skills, Cloud, Kubernetes, serverless, etc.

• An ability to develop quick and sound solutions to complex problems.

• An orientation toward working in an agile-based team, prioritizing quick frequent deliverables guided by high-level roadmaps rather than large and infrequent waterfall releases.

• A commitment to improving team practices and systems.

• A goal of being supportive of team members in meetings, change reviews, and design discussions.

• A strength in communication/presentation, written and in meetings (leveraging AI is fine but not being dependent on it).


Bonus points for:

• Familiarity with Hashicorp Vault.

• Experience with Kubernetes service meshes.

• Contributions to open-source libraries, projects, or communities.

• Experience working with Kubernetes on-prem.

• AWS Certified Developer/DevOps or Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional).

• Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization.

• Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS).

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.

• Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure management.

Job Description:

As a Cloud Engineer, you will be a key player in architecting, designing, and implementing cloud solutions that empower our clients to leverage the full potential of cloud technologies. You will be responsible for the development of a robust and scalable cloud infrastructure, serve as a technical mentor who guides, supports, and accelerates the professional growth of junior engineers, all while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery to the missions.

Work is 5 days onsite in Reston, VA.

The work you'll do:

  • Build, configure, operate, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure, including environments in AWS GovCloud, using services such as EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and AWS Organizations.
  • Proactively pick up and manage support tickets, collaborating with teammates to troubleshoot infrastructure, access, and networking issues, implement solutions, and follow through to resolution.
  • Communicate ticket status, technical issues, and resolutions clearly to teammates and stakeholders.
  • Continue deepening AWS knowledge and technical skills, and contribute to improvements in team processes and documentation.

Here's what you need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience building, supporting, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure; plus prior experience supporting infrastructure in AWS GovCloud.
  • Experience with AWS services including EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM (users, roles, policies), and AWS Organizations.
  • Experience working in a ticket-driven support environment, with a willingness to proactively pick up, troubleshoot, and resolve tickets.
  • Foundational understanding of cloud architecture principles and the AWS Well-Architected Framework, along with a conceptual understanding of cloud networking (e.g., VPCs and security groups).

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience supporting AWS environments across multiple classification domains.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or EKS.
  • Experience with microservices or serverless architecture.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • AWS cloud certification.
  • Experience providing architecture guidance or supporting large-scale cloud-modernization initiatives.
  • Willingness to learn, deepen technical skills, and collaborate with teammates to troubleshoot issues and support cloud infrastructure.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

Cloud Engineer

Location: Hill Air Force Base, Utah (Onsite)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Security Clearance: Active Secret Required

Salary: $110,000–$180,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

About The Opportunity

The JAAW Group LLC, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), is seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer to support mission-critical Department of Defense cloud infrastructure onsite at Hill Air Force Base, Utah. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with cloud technologies, solving technical challenges, and keeping critical systems running smoothly. We're looking for someone with strong, hands-on Kubernetes experience who can confidently deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized environments. While experience with additional cloud and DevOps technologies is valuable, we're most interested in candidates who have practical experience working with Kubernetes and understand how to diagnose and resolve technical issues.

What You'll Do

  • Deploy, configure, manage, and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments and containerized workloads.
  • Diagnose and resolve Kubernetes issues involving Pods, deployments, networking, storage, and configurations.
  • Support cloud infrastructure and help maintain secure, reliable systems.
  • Work with automation tools, scripting, and CI/CD pipelines to support deployments and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with engineering and cybersecurity teams to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Professional, hands-on Kubernetes experience, including deploying, managing, and troubleshooting workloads in production or other operational environments.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals, including Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and configuration management.
  • Ability to independently investigate and troubleshoot Kubernetes deployment failures, Pod issues, and related technical problems.
  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, or DevOps practices.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite at Hill Air Force Base.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • CompTIA Security+ or CISSP certification, or the ability and willingness to obtain the required certification after hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, or comparable Kubernetes platforms.
  • Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, GitLab CI, or similar automation and deployment tools.
  • Kubernetes cluster administration, security, monitoring, or lifecycle management.
  • Previous experience supporting Department of Defense or federal government environments.

  • Ample opportunity to learn, develop and grow with access to career and leadership development programs, job shadowing, a mentor program, and tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year

Location

  • Hybrid: Employees who are able to perform the essential functions of their jobs away from an Elevations location may do so with the expectation that they are onsite at least fifty percent of the time over a two-week pay period.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Cloud Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing, building, securing, automating, and supporting our enterprise cloud environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure. They help ensure our cloud platforms are secure, reliable, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective while establishing strong standards for cloud architecture, governance, automation, and operational excellence. The Senior Cloud Engineer works closely with Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Security, and Application Development to deliver and support cloud infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, identity and access management, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, disaster recovery, and DevOps capabilities. They are an experienced, proactive self-starter who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, can balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership, communicate effectively across teams, manages competing priorities, and continually look for opportunities to improve security, resiliency, efficiency, and the overall cloud environment.

Essential Functions

  • Manages the organization’s Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, backup, SFTP services, application platforms, resource governance, and integration with on-premises infrastructure.
  • Develops secure, scalable, highly available, and standardized Azure architecture; leads technical design decisions for cloud infrastructure patterns, hybrid connectivity, resource organization, and platform modernization.
  • Builds and maintains Infrastructure as Code, scripting, and automated deployment solutions using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions.
  • Supports application development and DevOps activities by engineering Azure application services, troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines, participating in architecture and code reviews, and translating application requirements into infrastructure solutions.
  • Implements cloud security, identity, compliance, and governance controls in partnership with Information Security, including least-privilege access, encryption, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, configuration reviews, and change management requirements.
  • Monitors infrastructure health, security, availability, performance, and capacity; troubleshoots complex incidents, performs root-cause analysis, maintains backup and disaster recovery capabilities, and implements sustainable corrective actions.
  • Optimizes cloud consumption and costs through resource rightsizing, capacity planning, cost reporting, tagging, reserved capacity, savings plans, and other infrastructure improvements.
  • Leads technical collaboration and knowledge sharing across Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Security, and Application Development; maintains technical documentation, mentors engineers, and coordinates with vendors and external partners.

Reports To

Manager Systems Engineering

Manages

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities

Required Skills, Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in systems, infrastructure, or cloud engineering.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, monitoring, and governance.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid cloud, and enterprise networking.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience supporting Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Experience with cloud security, IAM, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability.
  • Working knowledge of Git, REST APIs, relational databases, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and lead complex technical initiatives.

Preferred Skills, Education And Experience

  • Microsoft Azure certifications, including Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate or other relevant cloud/infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Service Bus, and Container Apps.
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, VMware, AWS, Cloudflare, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with Azure Site Recovery and enterprise backup/disaster recovery solutions.
  • Experience with DNS, network security, firewalls, VPNs, and private connectivity.
  • Experience working in a financial institution or other highly regulated environment.
  • Knowledge of NCUA, FFIEC, GLBA, or related financial-services regulatory and security requirements.
  • Experience with ITIL, incident management, change management, Agile, and enterprise technical documentation.

Work Environment

Elevations uses multi-factor authentication to keep our data safe. As such, a personal smartphone is a requirement for employment with us. This job operates in an office setting and routinely uses standard office equipment.

Physical Requirements

  • All other positions: Sitting frequently, walking occasionally, use of hands frequently, hearing constantly, talking frequently, exerting up to 10 lbs of force occasionally to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

Full time/ 40 hours a week

Compensation Information:

The person hired into this position will likely earn between $115,914.07 and $144,892.59 annual salary, plus annual bonus.

Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted hiring range based on factors such as relevant experience, time in role, base salary of internal peers, prior performance, business sector, licensure requirements and/or skill level, and will be finalized at the time of offer.

This role is anticipated to close within 25 days from the date of posting. However, if the position has not been filled, Elevations may keep the application period open longer.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Position Overview
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable, secure and highly available cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI). The role focuses on infrastructure automation, reliability, resiliency, networking, security and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments. You will collaborate with application, security and operations teams to implement best practices for deployment, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery while driving continuous improvement and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI) to meet availability, performance and security requirements.
  • Build and manage virtual networks (VCN/VNet), subnets, route tables, DNS, VPNs, FastConnect/ExpressRoute and cross-tenancy routing to support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
  • Implement and operate load balancers, storage solutions, backups, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure resiliency and data protection.
  • Manage identity and access (IAM), whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall policies to secure cloud environments and enforce least privilege.
  • Develop, maintain and run automation using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash and REST APIs to provision infrastructure, orchestration and configuration management.
  • Create and maintain monitoring, logging and dashboarding (metrics, logs, alerts) to enable rapid detection and incident response; participate in on-call rotations and incident post-mortems.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure issues across compute, networking and storage layers, drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to improve reliability.
  • Perform capacity planning, cloud optimization and cost control activities, recommending improvements and right-sizing resources.
  • Document architecture, operational runbooks, topology diagrams, network configurations and standard operating procedures for teams and audits.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, applications, networking, SRE) to deliver secure, compliant and production-ready platforms and to drive continuous improvement.
  • Implement server administration tasks, manage IP addressing, and maintain firewalls and routing for complex deployments.
  • Design and run tests for disaster recovery and failover, validate backup/restoration procedures and maintain recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years experience working with cloud platforms (must have Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud / OCI experience).
  • Strong practical knowledge of networking concepts including VCN/VNet, subnets, route tables, DNS, VPN, FastConnect/ExpressRoute, IP addressing and routing.
  • Skilled in automation and scripting using Terraform, Python, PowerShell and Bash; experience consuming REST APIs for infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with identity and access management (IAM), security controls, whitelisting, endpoint configuration and firewall management in cloud environments.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboards, incident response and troubleshooting server, storage and networking issues.
  • Preferred certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Fundamentals, Cloud Infrastructure Foundations, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate.
  • Hands-on experience with OCI-specific features (VCN, FastConnect, Load Balancer, Object/Block Storage) and cross-tenancy designs a plus.
  • Background as an Infrastructure Engineer or SRE and familiarity with disaster recovery, backups, resiliency, cloud optimization and capacity planning a plus.
  • Experience with Terraform modules, CI/CD integration, cloud cost optimization tools, dashboarding platforms and log aggregation systems a plus.
  • Strong written documentation skills, clear communication, collaborative mindset, problem-solving orientation and a focus on continuous improvement.

Benefits

PTO, Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, Vision, 401K, bonus and profit sharing

Overview

 JOB TITLE: Senior Cloud Engineer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY : FBI – Federal Bureau of Investigation

POSITION INFORMATION : Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting the FBI

LOCATION: Huntsville, AL OR Quantico, VA (Onsite)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support cloud architecture, deployment, optimization, and sustainment activities for a major FBI modernization program. This role ensures secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud environments that support application, data, migration, and DevSecOps operations. The Senior Cloud Engineer will collaborate closely with Full Stack Engineers, Data Engineers, DevSecOps teams, QA Automation, and Product teams to build and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure aligned with mission-critical requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture & Engineering
    • Design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications and data pipelines.
    • Implement cloud-native services, compute configurations, load balancing, and storage solutions.
    • Support modernization and migration of legacy workloads into cloud environments.
    • Ensure cloud deployments meet performance, scalability, and availability targets.
  • Infrastructure Automation & DevSecOps Support
    • Develop infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tooling.
    • Support CI/CD integration and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
    • Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and automated alerting.
    • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to maintain secure deployment pipelines.
  • Security & Compliance
    • Implement cloud security controls including IAM policies, encryption, network segmentation, and auditing.
    • Ensure adherence to federal security standards within cloud environments.
    • Support vulnerability mitigation, patching, hardening, and continuous compliance activities.
  • Troubleshooting & Optimization
    • Diagnose issues related to cloud resources, network configurations, deployments, and integrations.
    • Perform root-cause analysis on cloud performance degradations or service interruptions.
    • Work closely with development, testing, and migration teams to address cloud-related issues.
  • Collaboration & Agile Delivery
    • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical design discussions.
    • Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and support cloud adoption best practices.
    • Coordinate cloud activities across development, migration, testing, and operations workstreams.
  • Documentation & Reporting
    • Prepare technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration details, SOPs, and runbooks.
    • Provide updates on cloud performance, incidents, and optimization activities.
    • Maintain documentation supporting audits and operational continuity.
Qualifications

 REQUIRED:

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited University, required
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (compute, storage, networking, security, automation).
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation tools.
  • Proficiency in cloud networking, VPC design, routing, security groups, and load balancing.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting DOJ, FBI, Intelligence Community, federal modernization, or national-security programs.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Scripting experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with performance tuning and cost optimization in cloud environments.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • Must have an active Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Candidate must be able to function in general office environment.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

As a government contractor, ITC Federal's compensation for this role may be influenced by the specific contract, task order, and labor category to which an employee is assigned, in addition to factors such as geographic location, required certifications or clearance level, education, and years of relevant experience. The anticipated salary range for this position is $145,000 to $157,000, representing the range ITC Federal reasonably expects to pay depending on these factors.

Everforth ECS is seeking a Cloud Platform Engineer to join a growing Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and AI/ML team in support of a government multi-cloud environment with 50+ customer tenants and growing. The Cloud Platform Engineer will support all phases of development, design, modernization, and rapid development of cloud solutions in Azure and AWS GovCloud. Key Responsibilities Include

  • Provide subject matter expertise using best practices for designing cloud-based and hybrid solutions. Consulting, designing, and implementation of complex cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud services, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.

  • Build and improve GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate application and infrastructure deployments.

  • Support design of secure cloud architecture, ensuring system components maintain strict compliance with ATO requirements and security frameworks (NIST/FedRAMP).
  • Implement cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, network security, and data encryption
  • Conduct risk assessments and audits to identify and address vulnerabilities in the cloud environment
  • Continuously monitor and optimize the performance and cost-efficiency of cloud solutions
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts for complex issues, ensuring minimal impact to the organization and driving root cause analysis

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related cloud engineering experience.

  • Highly developed interpersonal and oral/written communication skills, with the ability to effectively and professionally interact with a diverse set of stakeholders

Description As an Infrastructure Engineer in this role, you will be responsible for architecting and maintaining scalable, resilient systems that support high-volume data alerting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Success in this position will be driven by your hands-on experience with messaging platforms like RabbitMQ and Kafka, which are essential for handling large-scale data streams and ensuring reliable communication between services. You will benefit from familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, as well as logging and alerting frameworks that enable proactive incident response. Exposure to DevOps methodologies will be crucial, as you will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and enhance operational efficiency. Your ability to troubleshoot complex issues and implement best practices in cloud security and automation will set you apart in this challenging and rewarding role.

Responsibilities:

We are seeking an AWS Cloud Systems Engineer with expertise in multiple cloud platforms. A successful individual will be responsible for developing in a scalable cloud-native solutions, and ensuring best practices across architecture, development, deployment, and security from design, test, integration, production, sustainment and maintenance.   • Perform cloud operations and engineering tasks to enhance, sustain, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure cloud solutions for AWS cloud environment
  • Perform AWS cloud operations, sustainment, and maintenance activities to maintain optimum cloud
  • Adopt and utilize DevSecOps practices, infrastructure as code, and automation frameworks

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering and Infrastructure team in one of today’s most important technology areas. This role will be responsible for designing, building, automating, and operating scalable cloud and hybrid infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, production workloads, AI/data platforms, and modern DevOps ecosystems.

This role will report to Cloud Engineering leadership and will be based in San Jose, CA.

Role And Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud and hybrid infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, production workloads, AI/data platforms, and CI/CD ecosystems.
  • Build and maintain highly available, resilient, secure, and cost-optimized solutions across cloud platforms, with deep focus on AWS.
  • Lead adoption and operationalization of Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, and related automation frameworks.

  • Implement automated remediation, rollback, guardrails, and self-healing infrastructure patterns to improve reliability and reduce operational risk.
  • Establish and enforce operational standards for monitoring, patching, change management, disaster recovery, and production support.
  • Partner closely with Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, Application, and Engineering teams to align cloud platforms with enterprise security, hardening, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, automation, AI/ML infrastructure, and platform engineering capabilities to support Bloom Energy’s modernization and scalability goals.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident escalation processes for critical production systems.


Skills And Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 6-8 years of experience in cloud, infrastructure or DevOps.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in AWS cloud services, cloud networking, security, resiliency, and production operations.
  • Experience with Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, or multi-cloud environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience designing and operating mission-critical production environments supporting enterprise applications and services.
  • Strong experience in cloud networking and network architecture, including VPC, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, firewalls, routing, and BGP.

  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps platforms such as Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and modern platform engineering patterns.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, CloudWatch, or similar technologies.

  • Experience implementing SRE practices, incident management, runbooks, operational reviews, and reliability improvement programs.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.


Nice To Have Skills

  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).

  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

  • High School or GED

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

descriptionHtml:
MORSE Corp is an employee owned, small business based in Cambridge, MA, Arlington, VA, and Seattle, WA with a history of fielding cutting-edge technology. MORSE boasts a specially selected team of scientists, engineers, and software developers to deliver best-in-class technical solutions that solve difficult multidisciplinary problems faced by the US National Security Ecosystem.  

MORSE is seeking highly motivated and talented Software Engineers with cloud expertise to join our innovative team. You will support projects that provide critical AI, machine learning, simulation, situational awareness, and mission planning capabilities to a diverse range of Department of Defense (DoD) customers.

As a Cloud Software Engineer at MORSE, you will work on cutting-edge technology and directly contribute to the success of our applications and our customers’ missions. You will collaborate with teams of engineers and data scientists to design, develop, and deliver software products that meet high standards of scalability, reliability, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable, efficient, and reliable software applications using Python.

  • Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Oversee the deployment of cloud services and ensure compliance with security guidelines and best practices.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration with your team to ensure high-quality code and knowledge sharing.

  • Stay up to date with the latest software engineering trends, tools, and technologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products, ensuring seamless integration and deployment.

  • Contribute to new codebases that emphasize object orientation, modularity, and maintainability.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance (TS/SCI).

  • Strong proficiency in Python.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm charts.

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and microservice architectures.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, and deployment in cloud environments. 

  • Strong communication skills and self-motivation.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, and 1+ years of software engineering experience.

 

Nice to Have

  • AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification.

  • Security+ or equivalent security certification.

MORSE Corp’s salary range for this role carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to, prior experience, education, skills and expertise, location, internal equity, and other factors that are job related and consistent with business need. Therefore, final offer amounts may vary from the amount stated. Depending on role eligibility, total compensation may also include bonus, stock, 401(k) match, paid time off, medical, dental, vision and life insurance.Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year. MORSE maintains an “open” leave policy that does not restrict exempt, regular full-time employees to a specific number of paid sick or vacation days.
