descriptionHtml:
About Lvt

LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it.

We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it.

  • A Top-Tier Growth Company: Named one of the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025 and #10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional list for 2025.
  • Innovative Leadership: Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame in 2024.
  • Product & Software Excellence: We were named one of The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023 and are a winner of the Security Today Govies Award for 2025.

About This Role

As a Senior Cloud Engineer at LVT, you will be a primary architect of the infrastructure that powers our global fleet of intelligent units and our sophisticated Agentic AI platform. We are looking for a high-level individual contributor who thrives on building elegant, automated systems rather than just maintaining them. You will bridge the gap between software and physical hardware, ensuring our AWS environment is scalable, secure, and resilient. If you are passionate about GitOps, complex networking, and "infrastructure as code" as a standard, you will find a home here.

This role is hybrid based out of our Seattle office.

Role Responsibilities

  • Architect and Implement scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure within AWS to support our rapidly expanding AI and IoT ecosystems.
  • Drive Automation by developing and maintaining robust Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, reducing manual overhead and ensuring environment consistency.
  • Orchestrate Containerized Workloads using Kubernetes, managing cluster health, scaling, and performance optimization.
  • Develop CI/CD Pipelines via GitHub Actions and ArgoCD to enable seamless, automated deployments across multiple environments.
  • Engineer Complex Networking Solutions to ensure secure, low-latency communication between our cloud infrastructure and physical units in the field.
  • Build Internal Tooling and custom tooling to empower the broader engineering team and streamline operational workflows.
  • Enhance Observability by implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks that provide deep visibility into system health.
  • Lead Technical Design Reviews and provide mentorship to junior team members, acting as a subject matter expert on cloud-native best practices.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Cloud Expert: You are a senior-level engineer with experience engineering complex environments within AWS and hold a deep understanding of its core services. Ideally you also have some experience in Azure and other cloud providers as well.
  • Kubernetes Veteran: You possess hands-on experience managing production Kubernetes clusters and understand the nuances of container orchestration.
  • Automation Enthusiast: You are an expert with Terraform and believe that if a task is done twice, it should be automated.
  • GitOps Practitioner: You have a proven track record of using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD to manage sophisticated deployment lifecycles.
  • Network Architect: You have a strong grasp of advanced networking concepts, including VPCs, VPNs, routing, and security protocols.
  • Tool Builder: You are proficient in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) for creating custom automation tools.
  • Problem Solver: You possess a "scrappy" innovative mindset, capable of troubleshooting complex distributed systems under pressure.
  • Collaborator: You communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a culture of transparency.

Benefits

We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.

LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Cloud Engineer

Top Secret Clearance is required.

Full time on site in Huntsville, AL

I3 is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support cloud architecture, deployment, optimization, and sustainment activities within a major federal modernization program. This role ensures secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud environments that support application, data, migration, and DevSecOps operations. The Senior Cloud Engineer collaborates with Full Stack Engineers, Data Engineers, DevSecOps teams, QA Automation, and Product teams to build and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure aligned with mission-critical requirements.

Your Future Duties And Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Engineering

  • Design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications and data pipelines
  • Implement cloud-native services, compute configurations, load balancing, and storage solutions
  • Support modernization and migration of legacy workloads into cloud environments
  • Ensure cloud deployments meet performance, scalability, and availability targets

Infrastructure Automation & DevSecOps Support

  • Develop infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tooling
  • Support CI/CD integration and automation for application and infrastructure deployments
  • Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and automated alerting
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to maintain secure deployment pipelines

Security & Compliance

  • Implement cloud security controls including IAM policies, encryption, network segmentation, and auditing
  • Ensure adherence to federal security standards within cloud environments
  • Support vulnerability mitigation, patching, hardening, and continuous compliance activities

Troubleshooting & Optimization

  • Diagnose issues related to cloud resources, network configurations, deployments, and integrations
  • Perform root-cause analysis on cloud performance degradations or service interruptions
  • Work closely with development, testing, and migration teams to address cloud-related issues

Collaboration & Agile Delivery

  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical design discussions
  • Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and support cloud adoption best practices
  • Coordinate cloud activities across development, migration, testing, and operations workstreams

Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration details, SOPs, and runbooks
  • Provide updates on cloud performance, incidents, and optimization activities
  • Maintain documentation supporting audits and operational continuity

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (compute, storage, networking, security, automation)
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation tools
  • Proficiency in cloud networking, VPC design, routing, security groups, and load balancing
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal modernization or national-security programs
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures
  • Scripting experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Experience with performance tuning and cost optimization in cloud environments

Your Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Engineer to design, operate, automate, and continuously improve our Azure Cloud Platform. This role is responsible for maintaining the enterprise Azure landing zone, shared services, cloud governance controls, and automation capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and reliable cloud services across the organization. The Senior Cloud Engineer serves as a key technical leader and Level-3 escalation point, partnering with regional teams to drive standardization, operational excellence, and cloud adoption globally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, operate, and maintain Azure landing zone infrastructure, including networking, firewalls, shared compute, backup, patching, and platform reliability.
  • Drive Azure FinOps and cloud cost optimization initiatives, including resource utilization analysis, cost allocation and showback/chargeback models, budgeting, forecasting, rightsizing recommendations, and governance controls to maximize cloud efficiency and financial accountability
  • Manage shared services including identity, connectivity, monitoring, logging, security, and automation platforms.
  • Own Azure subscription provisioning, lifecycle management, and enforcement of enterprise baseline configurations and governance controls.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and automation solutions to enable scalable cloud operations.
  • Provide cloud onboarding, DevOps enablement, and self-service capabilities for application and regional teams.
  • Serve as the Level-3 technical escalation point for Azure platform, infrastructure, and landing-zone issues.
  • Lead troubleshooting, incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement initiatives
  • Collaborate with regional cloud teams to ensure consistent implementation of standards, governance, security controls, and operational processes worldwide.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of Azure cloud engineering experience in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Landing Zones, networking, security, governance, and cloud operations.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Azure CLI, GitHub, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience supporting highly available, globally distributed cloud platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

HashiCorp Terraform Associate

What Success Looks Like

Secure, reliable, and highly available Azure platform operations.

Increased automation and reduced manual operational effort.

Consistent cloud standards and governance across all regions.

Rapid resolution of platform incidents and escalations.

Accelerated cloud adoption through self-service and enablement capabilities.

Join us in building and operating a world-class Azure cloud platform that powers secure, scalable, and innovative technology services across our organization.

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic AWS Kubernetes Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud and Systems Engineering Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Hyatt technology teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The AWS Kubernetes Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, securing, and operating the AWS-based platform that powers Hyatt’s enterprise Kubernetes, AI and ML ecosystem. This role focuses on systems reliability, cloud governance, observability, cost optimization, and integrations—enabling Hyatt’s Systems Engineering team to deploy AWS & Kubernetes Infrastructure efficiently and securely at scale. You will serve as a technical owner of AWS & Kubernetes infrastructure, ensuring that environments, pipelines, and integrations are robust, compliant, and cost-effective across the organization.

  • Design and maintain secure, scalable AWS infrastructure supporting Kubernetes workloads (EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, etc.).
  • Define and manage IAM roles, policies, access boundaries, and VPC networking to meet security and compliance requirements.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) to standardize and automate environment provisioning.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security teams to align AWS EKS environments with Hyatt’s global cloud governance standards.
  • Participate in incident response (on-call) processes for reliable production operations.
  • Optimize compute, storage, and networking costs, using AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, and tagging strategies.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and EKS platform components.
  • Automate environment provisioning, policy enforcement, and validation through infrastructure testing and continuous delivery.
  • Integrate security, compliance, and performance checks into the deployment workflow.
  • Design and manage network connectivity and data flows between internal systems and external systems or SaaS platforms.
  • Partner with enterprise architects and platform engineers to guide solution design for new initiatives, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
  • Stay current on AWS service evolution and EKS infrastructure trends to continuously improve platform capabilities.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years managing large-scale AWS environments, ideally supporting kubernetes, data or ML workloads.
  • Proven expertise in cloud administration, security, networking, and DevOps automation.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and monitoring frameworks.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • AWS Services: IAM, S3, EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Lambda, KMS, Config, VPC, PrivateLink.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • CI/CD & Automation: GitLab, AWS CodePipeline.
  • Observability: Datadog, CloudWatch for metrics, logging, and alerting.
  • Networking & Security: VPC design, role-based access control, encryption, VPN/Direct Connect, security groups, and compliance frameworks.
  • Cost & Performance: AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, and workload optimization techniques.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $117,000 - $152,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

descriptionHtml:
Company:  IRALOGIX, Inc.                                                                        Position:   Sr Cloud Platform Engineer


Location:    Remote                                                                                       Job Type:  Full-Time/Exempt


Industry:    Retirement Services/FinTech Software                                                                       Travel:       Infrequent, as needed






IRALOGIX is a high-growth, institutional technology platform focused on providing uniquely capable solutions to IRA providers, 401(k) recordkeepers, retirement-focused Advisors, Mutual Fund investment providers, and banks interested in growing their IRA capabilities, revenue, and market share. Through proprietary, ground-up technology, we are changing the landscape and are empowering client companies to provide broader access to the best retirement services possible while significantly lowering administration costs and increasing efficiency, profitability, and competitiveness, far beyond industry expectations.


 


Role:


As a SENIOR CLOUD PLATFORM ENGINEER, focusing on AWS technology and reporting directly to the Senior Director of Platform Architecture, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure that powers our reliable, high-performing, and scalable platforms. As a member of our Platform Architecture team, your AWS expertise will play a vital role in helping optimize our cloud environments, improve performance, and enhance security. The team is responsible for analyzing, designing, and implementing the frameworks and infrastructure to align with application, platform, and system requirements. The team collaborates closely with software, site reliability, security and other engineering teams to ensure that the finalized infrastructure and application architecture align with security, scalability, reliability, and availability standards.


 


Responsibilities:


The essential responsibilities and duties for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:



  • Designs, deploys, and manages AWS EKS clusters, ensuring high availability and scalability.

  • Works with AWS ECS (Fargate) to implement serverless container orchestration.

  • Sets up, configures, and maintains message brokers (Amazon MQ, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ) for distributed applications.

  • Manages and optimizes Amazon RDS for SQL databases, including performance tuning and high availability.

  • Implements and fine-tunes Amazon Redshift for data warehousing, providing high-performance analytics.

  • Develops and maintains infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK.

  • Designs and configures tooling like CloudWatch and Datadog to maintain the health, performance, and security of AWS environments.

  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders and platform engineering teams to understand specific business needs and recommend appropriate AWS services.

  • Leverages the AWS Well-Architected Framework to ensure operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability of AWS environments.


Education and Experience:



  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar certification is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience in designing and managing AWS cloud services with expertise in EKS, Fargate, MQ, RDS, and Redshift.

  • Proficiency in containerization technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Strong knowledge of infrastructure as code (IaC) and automation tools.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team and client-facing environments.

  • Must be US Citizen, Permanent Resident, or eligible to work in the US permanently.


 


 


 


 


IRALOGIX is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that embraces diversity, represents a variety of backgrounds, and upholds inclusiveness.  M/F/V/D

descriptionHtml:
Your Job

The Cloud Engineer at KBX is an individual contributor responsible for operating, maintaining, and improving the cloud platform that supports our application teams. Working with senior engineers and other team members, you will execute cloud infrastructure changes, fulfill platform and access requests, support shared services, troubleshoot issues, and help keep our AWS environment secure, reliable, and supportable. This role is suited to someone early in their cloud engineering career who has strong technical fundamentals, follows established designs and standards, collaborates well, and can reliably carry work through implementation and operational support.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Our Team

We partner closely with Software Engineering and DevOps, Security, and IT leadership to create secure, scalable, and reliable platform solutions, strengthen engineering practices, and accelerate the responsible adoption of cloud and AI technologies. We value technical curiosity, critical thinking, knowledge sharing, technical leadership, and a "can-do" attitude.

What You Will Do

  • Build and support AWS infrastructure using established designs, security controls, and change-management practices.
  • Work with senior engineers to clarify requirements and technical decisions.
  • Maintain, monitor, upgrade, and troubleshoot cloud platform technologies, including Amazon EKS, Istio, Solo Gloo, Kong, Amazon MSK/Kafka, and Redis/ElastiCache.
  • Use Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions to provision infrastructure and deploy platform changes.
  • Manage IAM, access, networking, encryption, and secrets requests using established standards. Identify automation opportunities and resolve security risks or unclear requirements with the team.
  • Monitor platform health, respond to alerts and incidents, troubleshoot issues with application teams, and escalate complex problems.
  • Apply tagging standards, support cost reporting, investigate waste, and implement approved cost-saving changes.
  • Investigate issues using documentation and operational data, ask for help when needed, and verify work before closing it.
  • Maintain implementation notes, runbooks, request records, and troubleshooting guides. Share lessons with the team.
  • Build AWS and cloud platform skills through hands-on work, training, certifications, and feedback.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, communicate impact, and help prevent repeat issues.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

  • Entry-level candidates are welcome. Experience through employment, internships, labs, coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, networking, software development, or DevOps
  • Experience applying core AWS concepts and services such as compute, networking, storage, IAM, security groups, subnets, routing, and monitoring.
  • Experience deploying, managing, or supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes environments. Familiarity with Amazon EKS, ingress controllers, container networking, or service mesh technologies is a plus.
  • Experience scripting in Python, PowerShell, or shell.
  • Experience applying cloud security, identity and access management, monitoring, logging, incident response, and change-management best practices
  • An ability to use AI-assisted tools to support learning, scripting, analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows

What Will Put You Ahead

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or Information Technology field
  • Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, application teams, service requests, or operational queues in an internship, academic, lab, or professional setting
  • Experience using Terraform, source control, or CI/CD automation
  • Experience working with Amazon EKS, ingress, container networking, or service mesh technologies is valuable but not required
  • Experience using service mesh technologies (Istio or similar) and API gateway technologies such as Gloo/kgateway, Kong, or equivalent in a production setting
  • Using GitOps methodologies and tools (Argo CD) for continuous deployment on Kubernetes
  • Experience with Cloudflare or similar CDN/DNS/web security platforms for cloud networking and traffic management
  • Experience working in a hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments and integrating on-premises systems with AWS cloud resources (networking, identity federation, etc.).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate, or another relevant AWS certification.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or similar cloud/platform certification.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

KBX Logistics, a Koch company and global leader in transportation, offers world-class, technology-driven capabilities across all modes of managed freight and transportation asset management. KBX is uniquely positioned to meet the challenges shippers face, leveraging decades of firsthand experience and data-driven insights from a large, diverse, and global business network. By building mutually beneficial partnerships and innovative technology, KBX creates a competitive advantage for its customers and meets the growing need for cost effective and reliable supply chain solutions. For more information on KBX, visit www.kbx.com

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except wh ere prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. Company Overview

By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.

Position Overview

By Light Professional IT Services LLC (By Light) is seeking qualified professionals to support the U.S. Army Product Lead Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology Enterprise Systems and Services (PL ALTESS) in support of the Program Executive Office Enterprise. PL ALTESS delivers enterprise-class data center hosting, managed services, and Service Operations Center capabilities that enable the continued operation, modernization, security, and availability of critical information technology infrastructure and applications for U.S. Army, Department of War, and Federal Government customers. Support encompasses IT service operations and delivery; data center operations; cloud management; network and systems administration; cybersecurity; application services and modernization; DevSecOps and automation; disaster recovery and business continuity; hardware and software integration and migration; service-level and process management; and customer and business services.

Positions are primarily based at the PL ALTESS site at Radford Army Ammunition Plant (RFAAP), Radford, Virginia, with potential support at other designated CONUS and OCONUS locations. Work is generally performed during a standard Monday–Friday schedule with core hours of 0900–1500 Eastern Time; however, personnel must be prepared to provide after-hours mission support, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to critical outages as required. Personnel supporting the ALTESS Operations Center may support a 24x7x365 mission across designated shifts. Telework may be authorized only when compatible with assigned duties and approved by the Government.

All personnel must be U.S. citizens, capable of satisfying applicable background-investigation, security-clearance, network-access, and annual security-training requirements. Personnel assigned cybersecurity-related duties or administrative privileges must maintain applicable Department of War cybersecurity workforce qualifications, certifications, and training throughout performance.

Responsibilities

  • Support PL ALTESS commercial cloud-services infrastructure as part of the managed-service delivery organization supporting U.S. Army and Department of War (DoW) IT systems.
  • Engineer, implement, manage, and support public-cloud and private-cloud service capabilities, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and approved private-cloud environments.
  • Design, deploy, configure, administer, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud infrastructure and associated services to meet customer operational, availability, performance, security, and scalability requirements.
  • Support the planning and execution of cloud migrations, including migration of authorized on-premises applications, infrastructure, and associated workloads to cloud environments.
  • Apply cloud-security engineering practices, including compliance with applicable DoW Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Information Assurance Vulnerability Management (IAVM) requirements, and secure-transport standards.
  • Engineer and support secure cloud connectivity, including IPsec/VPN, Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), and other approved secure transport technologies.
  • Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, orchestration, and configuration-management capabilities using approved tools and scripting languages, including Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Puppet, and Chef.
  • Develop and maintain automation for routine cloud-administration, provisioning, configuration, monitoring, remediation, and operational tasks.
  • Support Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevSecOps practices using approved tools such as Jenkins, Travis CI, AWS CodeDeploy, or equivalent technologies.
  • Use and maintain code repositories and version-control processes, including Git, to support configuration, automation, and cloud-engineering artifacts.
  • Collaborate with network, storage, systems, cybersecurity, application-development, and customer teams to integrate cloud services with enterprise infrastructure and applications.
  • Assess technical requirements and recommend cloud architectures, services, configurations, and modernization approaches that improve capability, security, resilience, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Monitor cloud service health, performance, capacity, utilization, and security posture; identify risks and issues; and implement or recommend corrective actions.
  • Prepare and communicate technical documentation, operational procedures, status, risks, technical recommendations, and solution information to customers, project teams, and Government stakeholders.

Required Experience/Qualifications

  • Certification: CompTIA Security+ certification or an equivalent Information Assurance (IA) certification.
  • Computing Environment (CE) certification: A relevant cloud Computing Environment (CE) certification, such as Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer (MCSD) Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
  • Mid- to senior-level Cloud Engineer experience.
  • Experience in Computer Science or Information Technology (IT).
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience effectively managing multiple large-scale projects.
  • Strong experience with IPsec/VPN, Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), and other secure transport technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating on-premises applications to cloud environments.
  • Understanding of network, storage, server, and application technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of automation concepts, tools, and scripting languages, including Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Puppet, and Chef.
  • Working knowledge of code repository tools, such as Git.
  • Working knowledge of DoW STIGs and Information Assurance Vulnerability Management (IAVM) requirements.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as Jenkins, Travis CI, AWS CodeDeploy, or equivalent platforms.

Preferred Experience/Qualifications

  • Senior-level IT experience in networking or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Supported the U.S. Army or another Department of Defense (DoD) agency.
  • Demonstrated communication skills to effectively interface with senior military officials, managers, and subordinates.

Special Requirements/Security Clearance

  • Security Clearance: Secret

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking an AWS Cloud Engineer to support our NIAID team in Rockville, MD.

The role spans the full delivery lifecycle: AWS infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, and administration of the Windows Server, Active Directory, and SQL Server estate. The engineer independently owns infrastructure design, sets technical direction, and mentors junior engineers.

This role is hybrid with 3 days onsite per week in Rockville, MD.

This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain highly available AWS environments for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Develop automation tooling, scripts, and lightweight internal applications (PowerShell, Python, or similar) that streamline provisioning, configuration, and operations.
  • Build developer-facing tooling, internal APIs, and self-service capabilities that improve delivery velocity.
  • Administer Windows Server, including performance tuning and root cause analysis.
  • Administer Active Directory, including AD DS, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and integration with AWS Managed Microsoft AD.
  • Administer Microsoft SQL Server on EC2 and RDS, including backup/recovery, high availability, and performance tuning.
  • Support migration of Windows and SQL Server workloads from on premises to AWS.
  • Monitor system health using Datadog and CloudWatch; drive incident response, runbooks, and reliability improvements.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex incidents and lead root cause analysis.
  • Maintain backup/DR configurations and participate in restore testing.
  • Perform capacity planning, cost optimization, and resource tagging.
  • Develop technical documentation and mentor junior engineers.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, AWS Kiro) to accelerate IaC development and troubleshooting.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors and 4+ years of relevant IT experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience independently owning cloud infrastructure design and setting technical direction on complex initiatives.
  • Experience translating customer/stakeholder requirements into implemented technical solutions.
  • Hands-on AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, database, IAM, backup, and monitoring services.
  • Experience with Terraform (or CloudFormation/CDK) for infrastructure as code.
  • Strong software development background — able to build automation tools, internal services, or lightweight applications, not just administrative scripts.
  • Strong PowerShell skills with working proficiency in Python.
  • Deep Windows Server engineering experience, including root cause analysis of complex issues.
  • Experience administering Active Directory (AD DS, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, enterprise authentication).
  • Experience administering SQL Server, including backup/recovery, HA, and RDS administration.
  • Solid understanding of AWS networking (VPC, routing, security groups, load balancing, hybrid connectivity).
  • Experience with observability and incident response practices using Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar.
  • Experience supporting production systems under formal change control.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to explain technical solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Microsoft Windows Server or Azure certification.
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (Docker, ECS, or EKS).
  • Experience building internal APIs or full stack applications (front end and back end).
  • Experience with AI/ML services (Bedrock, SageMaker) or AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Experience with AWS multi-account/landing zone patterns (Organizations, Control Tower, IAM Identity Center).
  • Familiarity with FinOps, cost optimization, and tagging strategies.
  • Experience with on-prem-to-AWS migrations.
  • Experience in federal, healthcare, or regulated environments (FISMA/FedRAMP).

Overview

Cloud Egineer - Senior

LOCATION: Eglin AFB, FL

JOB STATUS: Full-Time

CLEARANCE: Active Secret Clearance

CERTIFICATION: DOD 8140 Level 3 Certification

TRAVEL: No Travel Required

Astrion has an exciting opportunity for an SE-4 Cloud Engineer located at Eglin AFB, FL.

The Cloud Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of 48 Cyberspace Test Squadron’s cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong understanding of cloud computing concepts, technologies, and best practices. The Cloud Engineer will work closely with squadron test teams, developers, and leadership to ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of 48CTS cloud-based services and applications. This role encompasses building, automating, and optimizing cloud infrastructure to meet current and future business needs.

Required Qualifications / Skills

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be substituted for education.
  • Active Secret clearance. U.S. Citizenship.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies (e.g., IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
  • Experience with one or more major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Resource Manager).
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls).
  • Experience with security best practices and compliance standards.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
  • Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).

Desired Qualifications / Skills

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect
  • Other relevant cloud certifications.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Design and Implementation:

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable, highly available, and secure cloud infrastructure solutions.
  • Select appropriate cloud services and technologies based on business requirements and cost considerations.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager.
  • Configure and manage virtual machines, containers, networking, storage, and databases in the cloud.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based security controls, including identity and access management (IAM), network security groups, and encryption.

Cloud Infrastructure Management And Maintenance

  • Monitor cloud infrastructure performance and identify areas for optimization.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud-related issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform regular maintenance tasks, such as patching, upgrades, and backups.
  • Implement and maintain cloud monitoring and alerting systems.
  • Manage and optimize cloud costs.

Automation And Orchestration

  • Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Puppet).
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based applications.
  • Implement and manage container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

Security And Compliance

  • Implement and maintain cloud security best practices.
  • Implement and manage security incident response procedures.

Collaboration And Communication

  • Work closely with other IT teams, developers, and business stakeholders to understand their needs and provide cloud solutions.
  • Document cloud infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures.
  • Provide training and support to other IT staff on cloud technologies.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay up-to-date on the latest cloud technologies and trends.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve cloud infrastructure efficiency, security, and reliability.
  • Contribute to the development of cloud standards and best practices.
  • Research and recommend innovative cloud solutions.

Cloud Egineer - Senior

LOCATION: Eglin AFB, FL

JOB STATUS: Full-Time

CLEARANCE: Active Secret Clearance

CERTIFICATION: DOD 8140 Level 3 Certification

TRAVEL: No Travel Required

Astrion has an exciting opportunity for an SE-4 Cloud Engineer located at Eglin AFB, FL.

The Cloud Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of 48 Cyberspace Test Squadron’s cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong understanding of cloud computing concepts, technologies, and best practices. The Cloud Engineer will work closely with squadron test teams, developers, and leadership to ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of 48CTS cloud-based services and applications. This role encompasses building, automating, and optimizing cloud infrastructure to meet current and future business needs.

Required Qualifications / Skills



- Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be substituted for education. 
- Active Secret clearance. U.S. Citizenship. 
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies (e.g., IaaS, PaaS, SaaS). 
- Experience with one or more major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). 
- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell). 
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Resource Manager). 
- Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). 
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). 
- Strong understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls). 
- Experience with security best practices and compliance standards. 
- Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). 
- Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL). 

Desired Qualifications / Skills



- AWS Certified Solutions Architect
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
- Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect
- Other relevant cloud certifications. 

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Design and Implementation:



- Design, build, and deploy scalable, highly available, and secure cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Select appropriate cloud services and technologies based on business requirements and cost considerations. 
- Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager. 
- Configure and manage virtual machines, containers, networking, storage, and databases in the cloud. 
- Implement and manage cloud-based security controls, including identity and access management (IAM), network security groups, and encryption. 

Cloud Infrastructure Management And Maintenance



- Monitor cloud infrastructure performance and identify areas for optimization. 
- Troubleshoot and resolve cloud-related issues in a timely manner. 
- Perform regular maintenance tasks, such as patching, upgrades, and backups. 
- Implement and maintain cloud monitoring and alerting systems. 
- Manage and optimize cloud costs. 

Automation And Orchestration



- Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Puppet). 
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud-based applications. 
- Implement and manage container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm). 

Security And Compliance



- Implement and maintain cloud security best practices. 
- Implement and manage security incident response procedures. 

Collaboration And Communication



- Work closely with other IT teams, developers, and business stakeholders to understand their needs and provide cloud solutions. 
- Document cloud infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures. 
- Provide training and support to other IT staff on cloud technologies. 

Continuous Improvement



- Stay up-to-date on the latest cloud technologies and trends. 
- Identify and implement opportunities to improve cloud infrastructure efficiency, security, and reliability. 
- Contribute to the development of cloud standards and best practices. 
- Research and recommend innovative cloud solutions.

Location/Address: 100% On-site in San Diego, CA

Travel & Passport: 20%, CONUS and OCONUS

Position Description

We are urgently seeking an experienced Cloud Engineer III to design, build, integrate, and sustain secure cloud infrastructure and application runtime environments supporting mission-critical systems. This role will work across cloud compute, storage, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, monitoring, and security to provide reliable and scalable platforms for operational applications. The candidate will collaborate with software, platform, network, cybersecurity, and systems engineering teams to integrate commercial, government, and proprietary software into cohesive cloud-based environments. The role requires strong cloud and Linux fundamentals, hands-on troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to solve complex infrastructure challenges while contributing to the continued evolution of scalable, automated, and secure cloud architectures.

Incorporated in 2002, The Marlin Alliance is a digital transformation company dedicated to ensuring our clients compete and win in tomorrow's digital world. We specialize in creating technical solutions that allow for seamless execution of automated business processes and the generation of governed, machine-consumable data. From strategic planning to advanced analytics and cybersecurity, our team provides cutting-edge, cross-disciplinary solutions. We are seeking motivated professionals who share our agile, solution-oriented mindset and are ready to deliver the real, practical results relied upon by our clients.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, configure, and sustain production cloud infrastructure supporting compute, storage, networking, containerized applications, and mission-critical workloads.
  • Manage cloud compute and storage resources, including EC2 instances and block, file, and object storage, to maintain system availability, data persistence, performance, reliability, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and microservices across Kubernetes environments, including container runtime, workload scheduling, service discovery, networking, ingress, and application availability.
  • Implement and optimize dynamic resource management and scaling strategies across cloud and Kubernetes environments using workload demand, performance requirements, operational needs, and infrastructure cost considerations.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement application orchestration and runtime environments that integrate decoupled services, commercial products, Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) software, and proprietary applications into cohesive application workflows.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and health telemetry across cloud infrastructure, compute resources, containers, applications, and storage to support proactive system management and rapid troubleshooting.
  • Configure and maintain cloud networking infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, NACLs, load balancers, and supporting network services required for secure application connectivity.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and engineering teams to implement operating system hardening, least-privilege access, IAM controls, secure network configurations, data protection requirements, and applicable security and compliance baselines.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployment, maintenance, and operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, CI/CD, and other automation technologies where appropriate.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support across cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, application, network, storage, and security environments while documenting architectures, configurations, procedures, and recommended solutions.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education And Experience

  • Strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, systems administration, DevOps, or related technical disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, administering, troubleshooting, and sustaining cloud-based compute, storage, networking, and application infrastructure.
  • Experience administering Linux-based systems and troubleshooting operating system, application, resource utilization, connectivity, and infrastructure performance issues.
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications using Docker, containerd, Kubernetes, or similar container and orchestration technologies.
  • Understanding of Kubernetes architecture and operations, including workloads, Pods, Services, networking, ingress, resource management, scaling, and application deployment.
  • Experience with cloud networking concepts, including virtual networks, subnets, routing, security groups, access controls, load balancing, and secure connectivity.
  • Experience implementing or supporting monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and observability capabilities for infrastructure and application environments.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, least-privilege access, system hardening, data protection, network security, and secure configuration practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose complex issues spanning cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, containers, applications, storage, networking, and security.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with software, infrastructure, platform, networking, cybersecurity, program, and operational stakeholders.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including EC2, EBS, EFS, S3, VPCs, subnets, Security Groups, route tables, NACLs, IAM, Auto Scaling Groups, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, and related infrastructure services.
  • Experience administering AWS EKS or self-managed Kubernetes clusters and supporting containerized microservices in production environments.
  • Experience implementing Kubernetes scaling and resource management using Horizontal Pod Autoscalers, Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, resource requests and limits, quotas, or similar capabilities.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability technologies such as Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or similar declarative provisioning tools.
  • Experience integrating cloud and container deployments with CI/CD or GitOps technologies such as GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, Flux, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages to automate infrastructure provisioning, administration, maintenance, monitoring, and health checks.
  • Experience integrating GOTS, Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS), third-party, legacy, or proprietary software into modern cloud and containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with AMI management, CIS Benchmarks, STIGs, vulnerability remediation, encryption, secrets management, and other security practices applicable to government cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting distributed, hybrid cloud, or other complex application environments.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, classified, or other security- and compliance-driven cloud environments.

Education And Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Experience
  • Current Security+ Certificate

Citizenship And Clearance Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • No dual citizenship
  • TS/SCI Eligible, security clearance required

Work Environment / Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

  • Typical office environment with no unusual hazards.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Constant sitting while using the computer terminal.
  • Constant use of sight abilities while reviewing documents.
  • Constant use of speech/hearing abilities for communication.
  • Occasional reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching may be required.
  • Occasional lifting, up to 20 pounds.
  • A constant state of mental alertness.
  • Frequent work under deadlines.

Job Classification

  • Salary Range: $120,000–$200,000

Disclaimer

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) incumbent in this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. All duties and responsibilities are essential functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

To perform this job successfully, the incumbents will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities.

This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an "at-will" relationship.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

 JOB TITLE: Senior Cloud Engineer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY : FBI – Federal Bureau of Investigation

POSITION INFORMATION : Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting the FBI

LOCATION: Huntsville, AL OR Quantico, VA (Onsite)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support cloud architecture, deployment, optimization, and sustainment activities for a major FBI modernization program. This role ensures secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud environments that support application, data, migration, and DevSecOps operations. The Senior Cloud Engineer will collaborate closely with Full Stack Engineers, Data Engineers, DevSecOps teams, QA Automation, and Product teams to build and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure aligned with mission-critical requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Cloud Architecture & Engineering
    • Design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise applications and data pipelines.
    • Implement cloud-native services, compute configurations, load balancing, and storage solutions.
    • Support modernization and migration of legacy workloads into cloud environments.
    • Ensure cloud deployments meet performance, scalability, and availability targets.
  • Infrastructure Automation & DevSecOps Support
    • Develop infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tooling.
    • Support CI/CD integration and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
    • Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and automated alerting.
    • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to maintain secure deployment pipelines.
  • Security & Compliance
    • Implement cloud security controls including IAM policies, encryption, network segmentation, and auditing.
    • Ensure adherence to federal security standards within cloud environments.
    • Support vulnerability mitigation, patching, hardening, and continuous compliance activities.
  • Troubleshooting & Optimization
    • Diagnose issues related to cloud resources, network configurations, deployments, and integrations.
    • Perform root-cause analysis on cloud performance degradations or service interruptions.
    • Work closely with development, testing, and migration teams to address cloud-related issues.
  • Collaboration & Agile Delivery
    • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical design discussions.
    • Provide technical guidance to engineering teams and support cloud adoption best practices.
    • Coordinate cloud activities across development, migration, testing, and operations workstreams.
  • Documentation & Reporting
    • Prepare technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration details, SOPs, and runbooks.
    • Provide updates on cloud performance, incidents, and optimization activities.
    • Maintain documentation supporting audits and operational continuity.
Qualifications

 REQUIRED:

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited University, required
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (compute, storage, networking, security, automation).
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation tools.
  • Proficiency in cloud networking, VPC design, routing, security groups, and load balancing.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting DOJ, FBI, Intelligence Community, federal modernization, or national-security programs.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Scripting experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with performance tuning and cost optimization in cloud environments.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • Must have an active Top Secret (TS) security clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Candidate must be able to function in general office environment.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

As a government contractor, ITC Federal's compensation for this role may be influenced by the specific contract, task order, and labor category to which an employee is assigned, in addition to factors such as geographic location, required certifications or clearance level, education, and years of relevant experience. The anticipated salary range for this position is $145,000 to $157,000, representing the range ITC Federal reasonably expects to pay depending on these factors.

descriptionHtml:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior AWS Cloud Engineer to join our team in Virginia Beach, VA. This is a hybrid position.

The Senior AWS Cloud Engineer will be supporting an ambitious endeavor to reimagine how our customer, Naval Sea Systems, provides AWS cloud services to its customers. This includes deploying AWS services in a modern, fully automated manner.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Interact with stakeholders for status meetings, requirements gathering, and similar meetings
  • Compose new Terraform code and/or edit existing code for the deployment of AWS resources
  • Take an automation-first approach to the administration and configuration management of resources deployed in AWS GovCloud
  • Administer Red Hat Enterprise Linux and/or Windows Server instances and their AMI lifecycle
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies as a member of a highly functioning Agile engineering team
  • Create, maintain, and update relevant system documentation as required

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or other related STEM discipline and 9+ years of relevant experience OR a High School Diploma and 13+ years of relevant experience completing tasking relevant to cloud engineering
  • Must have an associate-level AWS certification (ex. AWS CSAA) or higher
  • Must possess a DoD 8570 Computing Environment certification (ex. Sec+)
  • Experience in RHEL OS and/or Windows Server with knowledge in maintaining them
  • Experience automating production cloud deployments/administration with tools like Terraform and/or Ansible

  • Experience in customer-facing roles
  • 3+ years of production Terraform experience
  • Experience working with GitHub or similar system and Git

  • Must possess an active Secret security clearance

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

descriptionHtml:
Courier Health is on a mission to solve one of the biggest and most meaningful opportunities in healthcare: reinvent how people living with chronic and rare diseases are supported.

We are building the future of patient engagement for life sciences companies. Our software is leveraged by biopharma companies to support patients in their complex journey from diagnosis to initiating and remaining on therapy to achieve optimal health outcomes.

Come Build with Us

We're a NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We’re an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. If that sounds like your kind of place, we think you'll love it here.

The Opportunity

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies, and every one of those patients depends on infrastructure that is reliable, secure, and ready to scale. The platform our engineers build on determines how quickly we can ship for our customers and how quickly patients feel it. This role owns that.

You'll design, deploy, and evolve our serverless-first AWS platform (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, AppSync, and Aurora) along with the multi-account architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and guardrails that let every engineer move fast and ship with confidence. It's a rare combination: deep technical ownership at an early-stage company, in a domain where the stakes are real. If you're motivated by the opportunity to have an outsized impact on not just your company, but the healthcare industry at large, this is the role.

What You'll Build

A serverless platform that scales with our growth. Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, AppSync, and Aurora are the core of what you'll operate and evolve. You'll keep it fast, reliable, and secure as our customer base and data volumes grow and provide the architectural guidance that helps teams build systems worthy of it.

Guardrails that make the right thing the easy thing. You'll own our AWS multi-account architecture: account hierarchy, Service Control Policies, and IAM Identity Center. You'll build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines and broader developer platform that make compliant-by-default the path of least resistance for every engineer on the team.

Observability and security we can stake the mission on. We work in healthcare so system health isn't optional. Title: Lead Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer

Location: Irving, Tx

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Lead or Senior Engineer with strong experience in enterprise infrastructure, hybrid cloud, Kubernetes and OpenShift. The engineer will design, build and support scalable infrastructure and container platforms across on-premises and public cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and support hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions.
  • Work with VMware, physical servers, storage, network switches and data-center infrastructure.
  • Design and manage Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, including EKS, GKE and AKS.

  • Standardize CI/CD and GitOps processes using Argo CD or Flux.
  • Support canary and blue-green deployment strategies.
  • Improve platform availability, performance, monitoring and cost efficiency.
  • Lead technical design reviews and coordinate with cloud, DevOps, network, security and application teams.

Required Experience And Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, platform, systems or network engineering.

  • Strong communication, documentation and technical design skills.
  • Ability to create technical diagrams using Visio, Draw.io or PowerPoint.
  • Experience with monitoring and IT operations tools such as Grafana, Orion, ServiceNow or BMC.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift and at least one public cloud platform: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux, container security and platform automation.
  • Good understanding of high availability, capacity planning, FinOps and infrastructure lifecycle management.

Hybrid Cloud, VMware, Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, Platform Engineering, Container Security, Istio, Envoy, Argo CD, Flux, CI/CD, GitOps, FinOps, Grafana, ServiceNow.

Job Description

This position is responsible for the completion of technical work on client engagements involving accounting and consulting matters while maintaining positive client relationships.

Responsibilities

Multi-cloud platform engineering and operations (design and operate foundations) (25%)

  • Design, implement, and operate scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and other providers, with hands-on depth in at least two.
  • Engineer and improve foundational services and standard patterns (identity integration, networking, logging/monitoring, compute, storage, security controls).
  • Own lifecycle management for key services (upgrades, deprecation planning, operational readiness).

IaC ownership: reusable modules, standardized patterns, environment consistency (25%)

  • Develop and maintain IaC (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep) with focus on reusable modules, standardized patterns, and consistency.
  • Establish code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation) to improve repeatability and reduce risk.

Automation-first engineering for efficiency and improve reliability (15%)

  • Build automation workflows and scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate manual operational tasks and improve reliability.

Reliability ownership and operational standards (lead, don’t just participate) (15%)

  • Own reliability outcomes for cloud services.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis; implement preventative improvements.
  • Define and improve runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, and support models.

Security, compliance, resilience, and vulnerability management as engineered guardrails (12%)

  • Ensure deployments meet security and compliance expectations through guardrails, patterns, and technical controls with Security/Risk.
  • Support audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples) with evidence support and control implementation.
  • Design and validate backup, recovery, and resilience patterns; ensure objectives are tested and reliable.
  • Lead and automate patching and vulnerability management improvements.

Technical leadership: mentoring and cross-team influence (*8%)

  • Translate requirements into designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps aligned to cloud-first.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide technical guidance across teams, influencing patterns and decisions to reduce delivery friction

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or related roles.
  • Hands-on engineering depth in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Strong IaC (Terraform preferred and/or Ansible) including module development and pattern standardization.
  • Strong scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing or significantly improving CI/CD practices for infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong operational ownership: incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventative remediation.

Certifications / licenses (2 or more preferred)

  • AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional

Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of multi-cloud design and operations, with hands-on depth in at least two: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
  • Knowledge of building and improving foundational services and standard patterns: identity integration, networking, logging and monitoring, compute, storage, security controls.
  • Knowledge of operational excellence practices: runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, operational readiness, lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance implementation patterns and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples).

Skills

  • Engineer, automate, and operate cloud services end-to-end; drive ambiguous work to clarity.
  • IaC engineering with emphasis on reusable modules, pattern standardization, and environment consistency (Terraform preferred and or Ansible).
  • Build automation workflows and enforce code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation).
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements.
  • Optimize for performance and cost-efficiency, including enforcing tagging standards and cost allocation practices.

Abilities

  • Ability to own reliability outcomes and reduce operational toil through automation.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps.
  • Ability to mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing, and influence cross-team patterns.

Languages and tools

  • Scripting and automation: Python, PowerShell, Bash (or equivalent).
  • IaC: Terraform (preferred), Ansible, Bicep.
  • Containers and orchestration (preferred): container platforms and orchestration experience.
  • Governance and guardrails (preferred): Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, GCP org policies.

Preferred

  • Containers and orchestration.
  • Cloud governance and guardrails (Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, org policies).
  • Centralized logging and security monitoring integrations (SIEM examples).
  • Regulated environments and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC).
  • Multi-region patterns, shared services networking, private connectivity.

The pay rate range for this job position is $74,200 to $148,230. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

A self-directed senior engineer comfortable owning complex cloud initiatives independently, with strong AWS expertise, a security-first mindset, and the ability to translate technical work into clear reporting for both engineering peers and agency leadership. Location: Hybrid (2 days per week or as needed in the REI Sterling Office)
