Overview

This role requires U.S. citizenship to meet federal contract requirements related to access to sensitive government data.

The DevOps Engineer III (Cloud Platform Engineer III) is a senior level technical contributor responsible for the development, automation, and maintenance of the organization’s multi-cloud ecosystem. This role focuses on refactoring legacy infrastructure into resilient, standardized Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to eliminate single points of failure and operational drag. The candidate participates in architectural and design decisions while contributing as a primary technical resource for Terraform, CloudFormation, and cloud-native services. Working closely with development, security, and networking teams, the DevOps Engineer III implements complex production environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The focus is on driving scalability through high-level automation—transitioning from manual intake to self-service orchestration—while ensuring strict adherence to global security, IAM governance, and compliance standards. This position follows agile workflows and delivery timelines. This position has no responsibility for providing care to patients.

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Development: Contributes advanced development and refactoring of Terraform and CloudFormation codebases. Develops reusable modules and standardized network patterns to ensure infrastructure parity across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • REST API Development & Integration: Designs and develops custom code to interface with REST APIs for cloud service providers and internal platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, GitHub, BeyondTrust). This includes creating automated middleware or scripts to facilitate data exchange and trigger complex orchestration workflows.
  • Cloud Orchestration & Self-Service: Contributes to the design and implementation of automated cloud provisioning workflows by integrating ServiceNow, GitHub Actions, Ansible and Terraform Cloud via IaC and pipelines to replace manual processes.
  • Multi-Cloud Platform Stewardship: Implements logging, monitoring, and observability solutions in Azure and GCP to align with established AWS enterprise standards via IaC.
  • Configuration Management: Develops and maintains "configuration as code" using Ansible to automate system roles, patching, and the onboarding of development teams into cloud-native environments.
  • Modernization & POCs: Executes proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives for modernizing legacy infrastructure with modern cloud technologies and enterprise AI infrastructure.
  • Tooling Lifecycle Management: Manages the governance, maintenance, and updates for core cloud and IaC technologies. Investigates and recommends new technologies that modernize and increase the efficiency of the organization.
  • Team Enablement & Redundancy: Provides senior-level technical oversight and redundancy for critical cloud systems. Supports and mentors DevOps I and II engineers. Leads and contributes to internal Communities of Practice.
  • Security & Compliance Implementation: Implements IAM roles, security groups, and baseline security controls, supporting CIS hardening and compliance requirements through automated configuration and policy enforcement.
  • Observability & Operational Support: Develops, configures, and supports logging and monitoring solutions across “hybrid cloud” infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and GCP to maintain visibility into platform health, automation outcomes, and system performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate and consult with cross-functional teams and external service providers (e.g., AWS, Red Hat) on cloud-related initiatives, providing technical expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and efficient solutions while supporting outage resolution and service request management.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Expert Multi-Cloud Proficiency: Expert-level skill in administering and configuring a hybrid multi-cloud enterprise environment.
  • Terraform Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing, refactoring, and managing Terraform code at scale, including experience with Terraform Cloud and GitHub integration. Follows an IaC first approach.
  • AWS CloudFormation: Deep understanding and experience with AWS CloudFormation templates for infrastructure deployment is highly desirable.
  • Software Development Skills: Proficiency in Python with working knowledge of one or more of the following: JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash, and PowerShell for building automation, integrations, and platform tooling.
  • REST API Development: Strong knowledge of RESTful API principles and experience developing scripts or applications that consume and interact with web services to automate cross-platform tasks.
  • Cloud Networking Knowledge: Strong understanding and debugging of cloud networking, including virtual networks, VPN tunnels, routing tables, direct connect tunnels, network security groups.
  • Cloud Security & IAM: Deep understanding of cloud security principles, specifically IAM policy construction, secret management, automated compliance hardening (CIS), networking controls, and security best practices.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Proficiency in building and maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and integrating them with ITSM tools like ServiceNow.
  • Configuration Management: Experience with Ansible, specifically applying a "configuration as code" philosophy.
  • Enterprise Platform Integration: Experience integrating cloud platforms with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, CMDBs, databases, and internal automation systems.
  • AI & Automation Concepts: Working knowledge of AI concepts and prompt engineering, with the ability to incorporate AI-driven capabilities into cloud and automation workflows.
  • Workload & Priority Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions.

Required

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • Three years of related experience. (Administering cloud environments or equivalent).

Qualifications (Preferred)

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

  • This is a sedentary position that may exert up to 10 pounds and may lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. This position involves sitting most of the time and is not exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

Physical Requirements

Carrying, Climbing, Color Determination, Crawling, Far Vision, Lifting, Listening, Manual Dexterity, Near Vision, Non Indicated, Pulling and/or Pushing, Reaching, Sitting, Speaking, Standing, Stooping and Crouching, Tasting or Smelling, Walking

descriptionHtml:
Infrastructure Engineer – AI / Cloud Infrastructure

Location: San Francisco, CA (Onsite)

Compensation: $150,000–$300,000 base + Equity

Employment: Full-time

I'm partnering with a well-funded AI startup building sophisticated data infrastructure for some of the world's leading investment firms. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, the company is developing an enterprise AI platform that enables financial institutions to securely leverage proprietary data and make better investment decisions.

They're looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to help architect, build and scale the underlying platform, working on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, data security and AI workloads.

What you'll be doing

  • Designing and scaling cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise AI applications and large-scale financial datasets.
  • Building secure, multi-tenant systems with strict data isolation, access controls and governance.
  • Developing infrastructure for data ingestion, processing and integration across structured and unstructured sources.
  • Supporting LLM inference, AI agents and machine learning workloads.
  • Implementing Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines across cloud environments.
  • Building monitoring, observability and reliability systems for production infrastructure.
  • Collaborating closely with engineering, AI research and product teams.


What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering or a similar role.
  • Strong experience with AWS, GCP or Azure.
  • Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, containers and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience building scalable, reliable distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, access management and data protection.
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog.
  • Experience in high-growth startups or fast-paced engineering environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure, LLMs or AI agents.
  • Exposure to regulated environments, particularly financial services.
  • Experience with private cloud deployments or bring-your-own-cloud architectures.


Why consider it?

An opportunity to join an ambitious, heavily funded AI startup at an early stage, take significant ownership of core infrastructure decisions and work on technically demanding problems at the intersection of AI, cloud engineering and financial technology.

descriptionHtml:
The American Chemical Society (ACS) is the world’s largest scientific membership association, with a mission to “advance the broader chemistry enterprise and its practitioners for the benefit of Earth and its people”.

ACS Publications is a Division of the ACS and has all the characteristics of a medium-large scientific and technical publishing organization. It is one of two Divisions charged with serving the dual function of generating a reliable annual surplus to support the Society’s programmatic activities, while also fulfilling a core goal of the Society in advancing knowledge in the field of chemistry and the chemical enterprise. The Division publishes 80+ high-quality peer-reviewed journals covering the breadth of chemistry and allied fields, as well as numerous other high-quality products and services of benefit to the global community.

The Division has US-based facilities in Washington, D.C. and Columbus OH, as well as worldwide operations in a growing number of international locations under ACS International, Ltd. (ACSI) including but not limited to the UK, Singapore, China, and India.

Required

Within the Publications Division, Global Technology Services (GTS) is tasked with providing all required technological support for the publishing activities of the ACS. The primary verticals in the GTS infrastructure include:

  • Customer Engagement
  • Innovation Enablement
  • Business Operations and Administration
  • Foundational & Technology Operations
  • Strategy & Execution
  • Publishing Operations & Business Systems
  • Data Engineering

This position will reside within the Product Development vertical and will report to the Senior Technology Manager.

Position Summary

As a Sr Cloud Engineer/ Architect at ACS, a leading source of scientific information, you will be instrumental in implementing and managing cloud solutions. This role demands a profound understanding of cloud services, especially in Amazon Web Services (AWS). Your expertise will be critical in the development and management of our cloud-based infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and efficient operation across our extensive range of scientific and scholarly publications, national conferences, and other services. The Position will involve design and hands-on implementation with a small team.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in AWS Cloud Platforms: expertise in major cloud platforms like AWS. Understanding their core services such as computing, storage, and databases is crucial
  • Linux Fundamentals: Many cloud environments run on Linux, so having a solid understanding of Linux basics is essential
  • Networking and Virtualization: Knowledge of networking concepts and virtualization technologies is important for managing cloud infrastructure
  • Security and Compliance: Understanding cloud security best practices and compliance requirements is vital to protect data and applications
  • Automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Skills in tools like Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Azure Resource Manager help automate the provisioning and management of cloud resources
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes for container management and orchestration is highly valuable
  • Programming and Scripting: Proficiency in languages like Python, Java, or Bash for scripting and automation tasks
  • Database Management: Understanding different database services and management techniques is important for handling data in the cloud
  • Monitoring, Logging, and Cost Optimization: Skills in monitoring and logging tools, as well as strategies for cost optimization, ensure efficient cloud operations
  • Ability to rationalize the cost of cloud resource usage: Skills in reviewing infrastructure and services used by applications or platforms to resize and upgrade to reduce cost of cloud footprint.

Soft Skills

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly and efficiently.
  • Communication: Strong communication skills to collaborate with teams and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Learning: The cloud landscape is constantly evolving, so a commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technologies is crucial.
  • Project Management: Skills in managing projects, timelines, and resources effectively.

Position Accountabilities [ Sr Cloud Architect/ Engineer]

  • Minimum 10+ years of cloud engineering/development experience required for this position
  • Ability to plan, design, explain and anticipate impact of services used in the cloud.
  • Implement, and manage cloud solutions in AWS, using cloud native solutions and optimizations.
  • Take ownership of the provision of Cloud services and products. Develop and manage infrastructure automation focusing on scalability and security.
  • Work closely with software and AI engineer teams to meet project acceptance criteria, document requirements, support continuous integration and delivery, and mentor junior staff members in cloud technologies and best practices.
  • Experience with Design, develop, and manage dev, test, and production environments, ensuring robust software configuration management throughout the application development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile setting, to provide architecture support on AWS
  • Infrastructure
  • Utilize Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code to automate and manage cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure CI/CD pipeline via tools such as Brainboard, ensuring smooth IAC deployments and integrations using GitHub
  • Work with serverless computing frameworks on AWS to enhance application scalability and efficiency.
  • Kubernetes & Container Platform Operations
  • Implement, scale, and upgrade AWS EKS clusters
  • Manage workloads, node groups, network flows, and cluster security
  • Containerization strategies: Docker, EKS, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD
  • Extensive experience in implementing AWS EKS clusters, management and scaling of the clusters with a good knowledge of traffic in/ouflows via subnet configurations and gateways. Linux experience is a plus.
  • Security, IAM & Compliance
  • Build IAM role models, SSO, SCPs, permission boundaries
  • Implement security guardrails: cross strike, sonarcube, etc
  • Secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, SSM)
  • Ensure compliance alignment
  • Data, Storage & Backup Strategy
  • S3 lifecycle & replication design
  • EBS, EFS, RDS/Aurora usage patterns
  • Backups, snapshots, restore testing, DR runbook

For this role, we are preferring candidates in US office, will need to work extensively with UK and India time zone teams. Travel as required.

This role can be based in our Washington, D.C. or Colombus, OH offices. A reasonable rate of compensation for this position is

  • For DC, between $144,000-195,000 per year.
  • For OH, between $130,000-176,000 per year.

ACS currently provides the following benefits for this position: paid vacation leave, paid sick leave, paid holidays, health insurance, flexible spending account or health care savings account, dental insurance, life insurance, vision insurance, retirement benefits, short- and long-term disability, and 4-week work from anywhere; each benefit is subject to the terms of the applicable program. Additional benefits may apply based on skills, experience, and location.

Any actual offer of employment, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be made in the sole discretion of ACS. ACS reserves the right to amend or modify its employment benefits and compensation structure at any time.

Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD). 
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems. 
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda. 
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault. 
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams. 
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you. 

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services
  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $119,000-$154,000 in Kansas, $130,900-$169,400 in Chicago, and $148,750-$192,500 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

Castle Biosciences (Nasdaq: CSTL) is a leading diagnostics company improving health through innovative tests that guide patient care. The Company aims to transform disease management by keeping people first: patients, clinicians, employees and investors. 
 
The Company’s innovative portfolio of commercial and pipeline tests targets unmet clinical need along the patient care continuum. Castle currently markets six proprietary tests designed to answer clinical questions and address treatment plan challenges facing physicians in dermatologic cancers, Barrett’s esophagus, and uveal melanoma. 

DecisionDx®-Melanoma, Castle’s test for invasive cutaneous melanoma, is a proprietary gene expression profile (GEP) test that uses an individual patient’s tumor biology to predict the risk of metastasis or recurrence, as well as the risk of sentinel lymph node positivity, independent of traditional staging factors. 

DecisionDx®-SCC is the Company’s GEP test that predicts the risk of metastasis in patients with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, who have one or more risk factors. 

AdvanceAD-Tx™ is Castle's GEP test designed to guide systemic treatment decisions for patients aged 12 years and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (AD).

MyPath® Melanoma provides a highly accurate, objective result to aid dermatopathologists and dermatologists in characterizing suspicious pigmented lesions. 

TissueCypher® Barrett’s Esophagus is the world’s first precision medicine test designed to predict future development of esophageal cancer in patients with Barrett’s esophagus. 

DecisionDx®-UM, the standard of care in uveal melanoma staging, is Castle's GEP test that predicts the risk of metastasis for patients with uveal melanoma, a rare eye cancer. 

Castle Biosciences is based in Friendswood, TX, (a suburb of Houston) and has laboratory operations in Phoenix, AZ, and Pittsburgh, PA.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Zus Health is an AI-native healthcare data platform that brings fragmented patient information together to make it complete, current, and actionable. Through our nationwide data network, platform, and intelligent workflows, we help providers, value-based care organizations, payers, life sciences, and digital health companies drive business results, strengthen provider trust, and improve operational efficiency. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus is building the foundation for a more connected, precise, and effective healthcare system.

What We’re Looking For…

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Engineering organization and help build, maintain, and scale the cloud infrastructure that powers the Zus platform. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, modern deployment practices, and is excited to build and support systems that process and deliver health records for millions of patients.

Our core infrastructure is foundational to everything we do at Zus. You’ll work closely with our Platform, Data, and Product Engineering teams to ensure our systems are reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective. You’ll help improve our AWS environment, automate infrastructure processes, and build tools that enable our engineers to develop and deploy software efficiently.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving the systems that power our platform.

As part of our team, you will...

  • Build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure supporting the Zus platform and its applications.
  • Work with AWS services such as ECS, Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, RDS, and other cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with Platform, Data, and Product Engineering teams to support and standardize infrastructure needs, troubleshoot issues, and improve system performance.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Support, standardize, and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and developer tooling to help engineering teams ship software efficiently.
  • Monitor infrastructure performance and compliance, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to improvements in system reliability and availability.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, optimize cloud costs, and improve infrastructure efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering and Security teams to implement cloud security best practices and maintain a secure environment that meets our compliance needs.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and ongoing improvements to infrastructure operations.
  • Contribute to infrastructure documentation, technical discussions, and engineering best practices.

You’re a good fit because you...

  • Have 3+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Have hands-on experience working with AWS or another major cloud provider, with a strong interest in deepening your AWS expertise.
  • Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Are familiar with containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes.
  • Have experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, CircleCI, CodeDeploy, or similar technologies.
  • Are comfortable writing scripts and automating workflows using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Understand core cloud infrastructure concepts, including networking, IAM, security, monitoring, and system reliability.
  • Enjoy troubleshooting technical issues, learning new technologies, and finding practical solutions to complex problems.
  • Are a collaborative teammate who enjoys working across engineering teams and sharing knowledge.
  • Are scrappy, move fast, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a growing startup environment.
  • Are excited to help enable a true digital revolution in healthcare.
  • Are in the Boston metro and excited to collaborate in person on a hybrid schedule, or are remote (EST/CST) but willing to travel for in person collaboration occasionally.

It would be awesome if you were...

  • Experienced in supporting large-scale, highly available systems in AWS.
  • Familiar with Go and supporting backend services built in Go.
  • Experienced with ECS, container orchestration, or modern platform engineering practices.
  • Knowledgeable about cloud monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Familiar with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or other cloud-based database technologies.
  • Experienced with cloud cost optimization and infrastructure performance improvements.
  • Knowledgeable about application security, SOC 2, HIPAA, HITRUST or other compliance frameworks.
  • Interested in developer productivity, internal tooling, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experienced working with healthcare data, APIs, or interoperability platforms.
  • Familiar with FHIR, HL7, and/or TEFCA standards.

We will offer you…

  • Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team, and a combination of cash and equity
  • For full-time permanent roles, robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, and unlimited PTO.
  • Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)

Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.

descriptionHtml:
San Francisco, CA (On-site) | $140k–$240k base + pre-IPO stock options

Build and scale the cloud platform behind some of the world’s most advanced radar systems.

CHAOS Industries is a defense tech company founded in 2022 that has raised $1B from investors including 8VC, Accel and Valor Equity Partners. You’ll design, build and operate the infrastructure and backend services that move mission-critical sensor data from radars in the field to the operators who depend on it.

What you’ll do

  • Design and run Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform: networking, Azure Container Apps, managed databases and CI/CD pipelines
  • Build and own high-throughput Python (FastAPI) services and the data layer behind them (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, Cosmos DB) for real-time sensor data
  • Own security, reliability and observability: identity and access, secrets, network isolation, monitoring and alerting (Datadog), incident response
  • Scale a platform already in production as sensors, customers and deployments grow
  • Define the architecture of the next-generation platform with engineering teams across the company

You’re a fit if you have

  • Built and operated production infrastructure in a major cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP), defined in code with Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep or CloudFormation
  • Run containerized production workloads (Docker) on a managed platform such as Azure Container Apps, ECS/Fargate, Cloud Run or Kubernetes
  • Strong cloud networking fundamentals: virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancers, private endpoints, firewalls
  • Built and operated production backend services in Python, Go or similar, and understand what happens under load: concurrency, async I/O, connection pooling, resource limits
  • Fluency in distributed systems (consistency, replication, partitioning, caching, back-pressure, idempotency, graceful degradation), and have scaled a production system well beyond its original design and fixed what broke
  • A secure-by-default approach: least-privilege access, secrets kept out of code, hardened and patched systems

Nice to have

  • Azure Government, AWS GovCloud or other regulated environments (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171 or 800-53)
  • Real-time and streaming data systems: WebSockets, server-sent events, pub/sub, message queues
  • Identity and cloud security: Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, managed identities, service-to-service authentication, policy as code

What you get

  • Medical, dental and vision, 100% paid by the company
  • 401k with 50% company match up to 6% of pay, plus FSA, HSA and life insurance
  • Pre-IPO stock options, relocation assistance, and annual bonuses (coming soon)
  • Unlimited PTO and a casual dress code
  • Free daily lunch while you’re working on-site, plus a fully stocked kitchen

Pay range shown is base salary only and excludes equity, bonuses and benefits. Actual offers vary based on experience, skills and business needs.

Please note: Must be a U.S. Person as defined under U.S. export control regulations, as required for access to controlled technology, and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

  • Experience operating cloud platforms in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of hybrid identity, networking, security fundamentals, and cloud governance principles.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation tooling, and cloud platform engineering best practices.

  • 401(k) match + Age-Weighted Defined Contribution

companySlogan: Accelerating Drug, Biologic and Medical Device Clinical Development
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in information technology in the healthcare industry? Do you get excited about the opportunity to work with the newest medical applications and industry leading instrumentation? Are you passionate about critical problem solving and administrating IT solutions to make a difference for users and other health professionals in the field? If you said yes to any of the following, this could be the role for you!

Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based Systems Engineer to join our Information Technology team.

Responsibilities

As our team has several openings at different levels and in different skill areas, the list below are samples of some of the technologies that we work with. While we desire candidates with experience in these specific technologies, we also understand that each of them have market alternatives, so the most important skillset a candidate can have is a good attitude and have a strong work ethic. Top candidates will have an aptitude to learn new technology and have a “do what it takes” attitude.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will serve as a point of contact for Infrastructure related Cloud projects, questions and issues. You will participate in the design, implementation and administration of Cloud-based platform solutions working alongside our Application Architects and other teams (Software Development, Database, Storage, Networking & Security) to ensure that initial and anticipated future business requirements are presented. This position partners with Information Security to ensure that the proposed infrastructure solution complies with our Cloud security standards.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Monitors new developments in emerging Cloud technology trends. Identifies new products with potential benefit to Medpace and conducts in-depth research and analysis of these products.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Azure features, services, and industry trends.
  • Engages in the SDLC of new systems and technologies and/or major system improvements. Frequently handles or directs projects, from research to implementation.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of cloud solutions
  • Ensures the feasibility of proposed projects and evaluates new software packages as it relates to cost, resources, system capability, and other attributes.
  • Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Python
  • Demonstrates the applicability of tools in real-world applications. Investigates their use in the Medpace Infrastructure and recommends adoption of new technologies/methodologies when appropriate.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for cloud architecture, engineering, and governance
  • Executes on performance tuning, monitoring, and optimization of cloud environments
  • Engages with vendors and third parties to support platforms and implement improvements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and services.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or a related field;
  • 5+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure including 2+ years of focused support experience with Azure Cloud
  • Desire to learn and grow, with a solid foundation of experience;
  • Aptitude to manage many different servers, applications, and priorities effectively; and
  • Ability to communicate effectively with peers, end users, and management.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports
Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

companySlogan: Delivering Breakthrough Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About CFD Research: Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. CFD Research has earned multiple national awards for successful application and commercialization of innovative component/system technology prototypes, multi-physics simulation software, multi-disciplinary analyses, and expert support services. Based in Huntsville, Alabama where laboratory facilities and headquarters are located, CFD Research also has office and laboratory facilities in Dayton, Ohio, prototyping test and evaluation facilities in Hollywood, Alabama, and office facilities in Fort Walton Beach, Florida. CFD Research is an ISO9001:AS9100D registered company and is appraised at CMMI Level II for Services. CFD Research is a 100% ESOP (employee-owned company) recognized in Inc. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at www.cfd-research.com

CFD Research is seeking a Cloud Solutions Engineer. In this role, you will design and implement resilient cloud architecture-based solutions, leveraging AWS and modern cloud technologies to host, scale, and optimize performance for complex test infrastructure, test environments, and research applications. The selected engineer will work closely with cross-functional research and software teams, applying robust network engineering and modern cloud engineering methodologies to enhance test automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable cloud architecture-based solutions to support continuous testing and research initiatives.
  • Leverage AWS services and modern cloud tooling to build out infrastructure and optimize the performance of distributed cloud applications and data pipelines.
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to research and test development teams for onboarding and executing complex, high-throughput applications in the cloud.
  • Architect and configure robust cloud networking environments, secure VPC topologies, subnets, routing, and access control policies compliant with DoD security standards.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to integrate cloud-hosted resources with automated CI/CD build, testing, and telemetry frameworks.

Qualifications & Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing cloud architectures using Amazon Web Services (AWS) or equivalent cloud service providers.
  • Strong foundational background in network engineering, including IP routing, DNS, VPC configuration, firewalls, and secure network segmentation.
  • Proven understanding of cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles (e.g., Terraform or AWS CloudFormation), and software engineering methodologies.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary research or defense engineering teams in migrating, hosting, and optimizing complex software workloads.
  • Candidate must be a US Citizen
  • Candidate must possess an Active TS/SCI security clearance to be considered.

Location: This role is based in the Dayton, OH area, and is 100% onsite.

Benefits: CFD Research offers competitive salaries and excellent employee benefits, including an employer matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). CFD Research offers our Full-Time, permanent employee-owners a highly competitive insurance package, including medical, vision, and dental insurance. Additionally, we offer company paid leave, compensation time, parental leave, long-term and short-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment, and life insurance. Part-Time and Temporary employee-owners may receive partial or reduced benefits and leave time based on their employment status level. Performance appraisals occur twice a year and annual pay increases are based upon corporate goals, personal development, performance, and outstanding achievements. In addition, group and individual bonuses are awarded for exceptional performance.

CFD Research is an EO employer - Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories

descriptionHtml:
Help build the modern day cloud at a fast growth firm that's investing heavily in its platform.


Companies like this don't come along often. The business is growing quickly, and the focus is on creating what the cloud should look like today. You'll be working on innovative technology, with strong investment from the company behind everything you build.


As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that sits underneath the platform. That means working across multiple cloud providers, automating how environments get created and managed, and making sure everything runs smoothly as the business scales. It's a role where the work you do shapes what the company can offer.


The stack is modern, and you'll be working with tools you'll want on your resume. Kubernetes sits at the center of the platform, with Terraform handling infrastructure as code and Python used for automation and tooling. You'll be working across both AWS and Azure every day.


On the experience side, you'll need solid hands-on knowledge of AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Python and Terraform. This is a mid-senior level position, so if you've got a good grounding in these and you're ready to work on something bigger, this fits.


Starting salary will be $200,000- $225,000, plus bonus, along with PTO and medical coverage. It's a hybrid setup, so you'll split your time between the office and working from home.


Want to work on modern cloud technology at a company that's backing its platform with serious investment? Get in touch.


No up-to-date resume required.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251454

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a cloud computing infrastructure architect, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experienced professionals, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions. We’re looking for someone like you to help keep the warfighter safe, support national security, protect civilians, and change the face of healthcare.

You’ll closely collaborate with fellow cloud architects and engineers specializing in Office 365, Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, define, develop, test, and debug cloud solution components. You’ll have the chance to work within a DevOps framework to create and manage container apps and use products like Kubernetes to further the mission. With access to our internal Azure, AWS, and GCP labs, you’ll have the space and time to explore different ways of solving our clients’ problems, and you’ll partner with stakeholders and your team to deliver the right technical solutions. Whether modernizing legacy computing platforms and applications or creating new ones from scratch, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Grow your skills at the leading edge of innovation.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

  • 5+ years of experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration
  • Experience with scripting or development, including Python
  • Experience with cloud development, migration, or modernization efforts
  • Experience with containerization and CI/CD automation, including GitLab and GitHub Actions
  • Experience with DevOps or DevSecOps methods, including troubleshooting pipeline or deployment issues
  • Knowledge of AI/ML or agentic systems in cloud environments
  • Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) field


Nice If You Have: 

  • Experience with cloud identity protocols such as SSO, SAML, and OIDC
  • Experience with advanced cloud networking, including DNS, routing, subnets, and load balancing
  • Experience with GPU‑accelerated workloads or model‑serving platforms
  • Experience with multi‑cloud or hybrid architectures
  • Experience with automation, microservices, and cloud‑native enterprise solutions, including Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Description

TEKsystems is seeking a Cloud Engineer to support one of our partner companies in the financial services industry. This position is responsible for maintaining and supporting the company's infrastructure and participating in various projects to continually improve efficiency and security. The role requires a high level of technical expertise to identify and resolve hardware, software, network, and security issues. This position is 100% on-site in Honolulu, Hawaii.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, deploy, and support enterprise server, application, and cloud environments (Azure & AWS)
  • Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, and application hosting platforms
  • Manage Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 services
  • Configure and support SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, RBAC, and identity security solutions
  • Lead cloud migrations, upgrades, system implementations, and modernization initiatives
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM Templates) and automation using PowerShell and Python
  • Implement monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions
  • Troubleshoot complex server, application, cloud, identity, and performance issues
  • Support networking technologies, including VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, routing, DNS, and DHCP
  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on infrastructure and cloud initiatives
  • Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable platform operations across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments


Core Technologies

  • Azure & AWS
  • Windows Server & Linux
  • Microsoft 365
  • Intune
  • Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Active Directory
  • Terraform / CloudFormation
  • PowerShell & Python
  • IIS & Application Servers
  • DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Firewalls, and Load Balancers

  • Experience with enterprise application support, PKI, SSL/TLS certificates, and security best practices

Job Number: R0252608

AWS & Databricks Cloud Platform Engineer, Senior

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a cloud computing infrastructure architect, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experienced professionals, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions. We’re looking for someone like you to help support national security.

You’ll closely collaborate with fellow cloud architects and engineers specializing in AWS GovCloud to develop cloud solution components. You’ll have the chance to work within a DevOps framework to create and manage container apps and use products like Kubernetes to further the mission. With access to our internal AWS, you’ll have the space and time to explore different ways of solving our clients’ problems, and you’ll partner with stakeholders and your team to deliver the right technical solutions. Whether modernizing legacy computing platforms and applications or creating new ones from scratch, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Grow your skills at the leading edge of innovation.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

  • 5+ years of experience engineering and operating cloud infrastructure within AWS environments
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or Ansible
  • Experience deploying and supporting cloud networking solutions, including VPCs, routing, security groups, private connectivity, and network segmentation
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, testing, and release management
  • Experience implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls and cloud security best practices using least-privilege principles
  • Experience troubleshooting and optimizing cloud platform performance, availability, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Cloud technologies
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


 

Nice If You Have: 

  • Experience creating and improving continuous automation across infrastructure, platform, and application technology stacks
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized workloads using AWS EKS, Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, or Helm
  • Experience working with modern DevOps toolchains, including Git, GitLab, and Terraform
  • Knowledge of cloud-native architectures and modernization frameworks supporting enterprise platform transformation
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field
  • AWS DevOps Engineer, AWS SysOps Administrator, Azure DevOps Engineer, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), or similar industry certification


 

Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

WASH is a company that our customers depend on to keep them going so they can provide valuable services to their clients across USA and Canada (Coinamatic Inc. and ParkSmart Inc). We strive to build a sense of purpose and achievement in the work we do while staying true to the DNA of our core values. We value our people and encourage the development of talented and motivated employees to support the continued performance and growth of our diverse operations. We have been the foundation of many successful careers. At our core we are an innovation driven, fast-paced team environment with a high performance culture. If you are looking for a career that will challenge and engage you, is focused on customer care and quality service, then WE are the company for you. We invite you to bring your passion and experience to our team!

WASH is looking for a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer with hands-on DevOps experience to help design, automate, operate, and secure our AWS cloud environment. This role will support customer-facing and internal applications by building reliable cloud infrastructure, improving CI/CD pipelines, automating operational processes, strengthening security controls, and helping modernize our technology platforms.

The right candidate will have deep AWS experience, strong infrastructure automation skills, practical DevOps knowledge, and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues. This is a senior technical role for someone who enjoys building scalable cloud platforms, improving reliability, reducing manual effort, and partnering with application, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver business value.

What you'll be doing: 

  • Design, build, operate, and improve AWS cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing and internal applications.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or similar technologies.
  • Build, enhance, and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
  • Automate repeatable operational tasks using scripting and AWS-native services.
  • Support AWS account structure, IAM, networking, compute, storage, monitoring, backup, and security services.
  • Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver scalable and reliable cloud solutions.
  • Implement and support highly available, resilient, scalable, and self-healing cloud environments.
  • Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, security, cost, and operational health.
  • Configure and improve logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and incident response workflows.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across AWS infrastructure, applications, deployments, networking, and integrations.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
  • Improve cloud security posture through least privilege access, secure configuration, encryption, vulnerability remediation, logging, and governance controls.
  • Help define and implement AWS standards, patterns, documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Support cloud migrations, modernization initiatives, and ongoing platform improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve deployment quality, optimize costs, and increase platform reliability.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for AWS-related engineering, DevOps, automation, and operational questions.

What we'd like to see in you: 

  • 7+ years of Cloud engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or site reliability engineering experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on AWS experience in production environments.
  • Strong experience with AWS core services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Route 53, RDS, Lambda, EKS/ECS, ELB/ALB, Systems Manager, Secrets Manager, and AWS Backup.
  • Hands-on experience designing and supporting AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, VPNs, NAT gateways, private endpoints, and load balancers.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, or similar platforms.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Experience with Git-based source control and modern branching/release practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux systems administration; Windows/.NET environment experience is a plus.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, ELK/OpenSearch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure, application, deployment, performance, and networking issues.
  • Working knowledge of security best practices, including IAM, MFA, least privilege, encryption, patching, vulnerability remediation, logging, and audit readiness.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, backup/recovery, RTO/RPO, horizontal scaling, load balancing, and resilient architecture patterns.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and leadership.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join our enterprise IT department in Plano, TX. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud architecture, security, and best practices to ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of our cloud-based systems. 

They will work in a fast-paced environment and must be adaptable to the many changing processes and technologies related to the various IT systems.  

Responsibilities: 

  • Design, deploy, and manage GCP infrastructure and services. 

  • Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC Networks  

  • Thorough understanding of Google infrastructure and networking 

  • Thorough understanding of GKE, design, operations and troubleshooting 

  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with GKE. 

  • Collaborate on cloud security measures, including identity and access management, encryption, and network security. 

  • Monitor and optimize cloud performance, cost, and scalability. 

  • Automate cloud operations using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar. 

  • Troubleshoot and resolve cloud-related issues and incidents. 

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest GCP features, services, and best practices. 

  • Provide technical guidance and support to other IT team members. 

  • Develop and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure and processes. 



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

  • 5+ years of experience working with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • 5+ years of experience working with GKE 

  • Strong knowledge of GKE and integration with development teams 

  • Strong knowledge of GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud Functions. 

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or Ansible. 

  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 

  • Ability to use GitOps principles for all code-based infrastructure. 

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Bitbucket, Jenkins. 

  • Understanding cloud security best practices, compliance requirements and IAC practices. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Additional Technical Qualifications: 

  • Proficiency in managing and optimizing GCP networking components, such as VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, and Cloud CDN. 

  • Familiarity with serverless computing and event-driven architectures using GCP services like Cloud Run and Cloud Pub/Sub. 

  • Certification and hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tool DataDog 

  • Understanding of DevOps, DevSecOps practices and integrating security into CI/CD pipelines. 

  • Knowledge of Google Backup, disaster recovery and business continuity planning in a cloud environment. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification. 

  • Experience with GCP Cloud databases: Spanner, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, and Bigtable, BigQuery. 

**This job requires work to be done outside of normal working hours including occasionally weeknights and weekends. 



Additional Information

Workplace

  • One of our values pillars is to work as OneTeam and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.
