descriptionHtml:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess :

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure.
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO).
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment.
  • Reside a commutable distance to Deloitte office in Gilbert, AZ, Mechanicsburg, PA, or Lake Mary, FL
  • Able to travel up to 10%

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

As a Center Delivery Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess :

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure.
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO).
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment.
  • Reside a commutable distance to Deloitte office in Gilbert, AZ, Mechanicsburg, PA, or Lake Mary, FL
  • Able to travel up to 10%

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)

Department: Information Technology

Job Number: 100666

Offices: Boston; Chicago; Los Angeles; Washington, D.C.; Tampa

With eleven offices across the United States, 500+ professionals and 350+ business professionals, Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients. The firm's groundbreaking approach brings together legal services, advocacy and business strategy. This approach differentiates Manatt from its competitors and positions the firm to provide a distinct and compelling value proposition.

The Opportunity

Cloud Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineering role focused on deploying, automating, and operating Azure workloads within established firm standards, and keeping those environments scalable, resilient, and secure. The position works closely with IT leadership, Information Security, application teams, support teams, end users, and vendors to turn requirements and approved designs into working, supportable cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, configure, and maintain Azure infrastructure and platform services across identity, networking, security, storage, data, integration, and application-hosting workloads. 
  • Deploy and maintain Azure landing zone components, management group and subscription structures, resource organization standards, naming and tagging conventions, policy assignments, and role-based access controls in line with firm standards. 
  • Build and operate Azure compute and platform services, including virtual machines, scale sets, storage, backup, recovery, Azure App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and related PaaS capabilities. 
  • Partner with Information Security to implement cloud security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, managed identities, privileged access, Defender for Cloud, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability-remediation practices. 
  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation

The base annual pay range for this role is between $135,000-$155,000. The base pay to be offered will vary depending on skills and qualifications, experience, and location. A full range of medical, financial and/or other benefits dependent on the position will also be offered.

Manatt is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, physical or mental disability, religion, creed, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex or gender (including gender identity, gender expression, status as a transgender or transsexual individual, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), age (over 40), genetic information, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, sexual orientation, political activity or affiliation, genetic or and any other protected classes or characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the American Disabilities Act, applicants may request accommodations needed to participate in the application process.

This employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

IMPORTANT: If the Government cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to provide you written instructions and an opportunity to contact SSA and/or DHS before taking adverse action against you, including terminating your employment.

Employers may not use E-Verify to pre-screen job applicants or to re-verify current employees and may not limit or influence the choice of documents presented for use on the Form I-9. The candidate will work with senior architects, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, operators, and program stakeholders to help develop scalable, secure, and mission-ready cloud solutions while supporting documentation, troubleshooting, deployment, and compliance activities.

In this role, you’ll contribute to Naval Operational Architecture (NOA), working alongside engineers and operators to deliver resilient, forward-leaning solutions in support of national defense.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN SAN DIEGO, CA. WITH UP TO 5% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

Job Duties

  • Support the design, implementation, configuration, integration, and sustainment of secure cloud and hybrid cloud architectures aligned to warfighter needs and Navy mission objectives.
  • Assist with the development of hybrid edge-to-cloud architectures by supporting integration of edge nodes, tactical compute, on-platform systems, on-premises infrastructure, and cloud environments.
  • Support cloud architecture activities across multi-classification environments, while assisting with documentation of cross-domain and multi-level security considerations.
  • Support cloud deployments across AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, on-premises, tactical, and containerized environments by assisting with compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and monitoring configurations.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code and automation scripts to support repeatable provisioning, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and sustainment of cloud and platform resources.
  • Support DevSecOps pipeline implementation by assisting with CI/CD workflows, automated security scanning, configuration management, container deployment, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Assist with cybersecurity and compliance activities by supporting RMF documentation, Zero Trust alignment, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, patching, and audit-ready technical artifacts.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, developers, cybersecurity teams, operators, and program stakeholders to track tasks, document technical decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate status, risks, and dependencies.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret clearance to start.
  • Must be able to obtain a TS/SCI after start.
  • Experience supporting cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems administration, DevOps, infrastructure automation, or related technical roles.
  • Experience supporting enterprise, cloud, hybrid cloud, containerized, or application hosting environments.
  • Experience with cloud deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, monitoring, sustainment, or modernization activities.
  • Experience using scripting, automation, configuration management, or Infrastructure as Code concepts to support technical operations.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking, identity, compute, storage, security, monitoring, and infrastructure operations.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity, access control, secure configuration, system hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance support activities.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams of engineers, cybersecurity personnel, operators, program managers, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to engineering, cybersecurity, program, and operational stakeholders.

Desired Skills

  • Security + certification preferred.
  • Experience supporting AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or other government cloud environments.
  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, Security Groups, S3, EBS, EFS, Route 53, IAM policies and roles, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, Lambda, ELB, Availability Zones, VPCs, subnets, route tables, endpoints, NACLs, Transit Gateways, VPC peering, AWS Directory Services, AWS Workspaces, and AWS CLI.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools and formats such as Terraform, CloudFormation, YAML, JSON, Git-based workflows, and related automation practices.
  • Experience using scripting and programming languages such as Bash, Python, PowerShell, and JavaScript to automate cloud deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational tasks.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift Container Platform, Amazon EKS, and service mesh environments.
  • Experience with microservices architectures, data streaming, event-driven architectures, real-time analytics, or distributed data platforms.
  • Experience supporting DoW cloud standards, Impact Levels 4, 5, and 6+, Zero Trust, RMF, cybersecurity compliance, STIGs, vulnerability scanning, patching, and secure configuration management.
  • Familiarity with cross-domain solutions, multi-level security architectures, multi-classification environments, or cloud-based cross-domain considerations.
  • Experience supporting Navy, DoW, IC, tactical, shipboard, or operational cloud environments.
  • Experience with web application infrastructure, reverse proxies, APIs, databases, authentication services, Apache, NGINX, PostgreSQL, SQL, Node.js, React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.

Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).

  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

  • Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
  • Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;

  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0245212

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are building the next generation of cloud-native infrastructure to build a system that will have a positive impact on the intelligence community (IC). We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated senior Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to join our growing team. If you have a passion for automation, cloud infrastructure, and Kubernetes, and you're excited to use the latest open-source tools, this is the role for you.

As an experienced Infrastructure Cloud engineer on our team, you will use your development experience to build, deploy, and manage a cloud agnostic platform for a multi-tenant environment. You will collaborate with engineering teams to design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient infrastructure solutions, ensuring seamless operation and deployment of cloud-native applications. Join our team as we build tools to transform the future of the IC.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or infrastructure engineering
  • Experience in Kubernetes architecture, deployment, management, container orchestration, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting
  • Experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining Linux server systems in the Cloud
  • Experience with automation tools
  • Knowledge of AWS services and how to integrate them with Kubernetes
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with scripting or object-oriented programming in Bash, Python, Groovy, or Golang
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm for Kubernetes, or Terragrunt
  • Experience with Kubernetes Operators, Rancher, and RKE2
  • Experience using or managing ArgoCD, Grafana, ElasticSearch, and Prometheus
  • Experience with Pulumi or Crossplane
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer Certification
  • Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0253821

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the power of the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a Cloud Engineer, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experts, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions. We need you to help us develop cloud-based solutions for our customer’s toughest challenges.

You’ll closely collaborate with cloud architects and engineers to design, define, develop, test, and debug cloud solution components. You’ll have the chance to work within a DevOps framework to build and manage applications and use products like Kubernetes, to further the mission. With access to our internal Azure, AWS, and GCP labs, you’ll have the space and time to explore different ways of solving our clients’ challenges, and you’ll partner with stakeholders and your team to deliver the right technical solutions. Whether modernizing legacy computing platforms and applications or building new ones from scratch, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips. Are you ready to grow your skills at the leading edge of innovation? 

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience administering Windows and Linux operating systems
  • 1+ years of experience with cloud computing, including Amazon Web Services GovCloud or Commercial
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8570 IAT Level II Certification within 30 days of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with scripting tools and languages, including Ansible, Terraform, or Python
  • Experience standing up and configuring engineering tools on new and existing infrastructure
  • Experience developing and automating tools and infrastructure in the cloud
  • Knowledge of linking analytical and engineering tools in a digital thread
  • Knowledge of DoD security best practices and compliance requirements


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $69,400.00 to $158,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
MORSE Corp is an employee owned, small business based in Cambridge, MA, Arlington, VA, and Seattle, WA with a history of fielding cutting-edge technology. MORSE boasts a specially selected team of scientists, engineers, and software developers to deliver best-in-class technical solutions that solve difficult multidisciplinary problems faced by the US National Security Ecosystem.  

MORSE is seeking highly motivated and talented Software Engineers with cloud expertise to join our innovative team. You will support projects that provide critical AI, machine learning, simulation, situational awareness, and mission planning capabilities to a diverse range of Department of Defense (DoD) customers.

As a Cloud Software Engineer at MORSE, you will work on cutting-edge technology and directly contribute to the success of our applications and our customers’ missions. You will collaborate with teams of engineers and data scientists to design, develop, and deliver software products that meet high standards of scalability, reliability, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable, efficient, and reliable software applications using Python.

  • Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Oversee the deployment of cloud services and ensure compliance with security guidelines and best practices.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration with your team to ensure high-quality code and knowledge sharing.

  • Stay up to date with the latest software engineering trends, tools, and technologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products, ensuring seamless integration and deployment.

  • Contribute to new codebases that emphasize object orientation, modularity, and maintainability.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance (TS/SCI).

  • Strong proficiency in Python.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm charts.

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and microservice architectures.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, and deployment in cloud environments. 

  • Strong communication skills and self-motivation.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, and 1+ years of software engineering experience.

 

Nice to Have

  • AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification.

  • Security+ or equivalent security certification.

MORSE Corp’s salary range for this role carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to, prior experience, education, skills and expertise, location, internal equity, and other factors that are job related and consistent with business need. Therefore, final offer amounts may vary from the amount stated. Depending on role eligibility, total compensation may also include bonus, stock, 401(k) match, paid time off, medical, dental, vision and life insurance.Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year. MORSE maintains an “open” leave policy that does not restrict exempt, regular full-time employees to a specific number of paid sick or vacation days. However, this policy is not an “unlimited” paid leave policy. 

Compensation: $90,000 USD - $210,000 USD

The team at MORSE takes pride in being the smart team that is easy to work with. We focus on steady, long-term success with an emphasis on exceptionalism and delivering mission-critical impact to our customers. For more information, please visit www.morsecorp.com.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Summary

The Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer plays an integral role in defining and assessing the firm’s infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture and practices. This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.

  • Design, implement and manage hub-and-spoke network topology with hybrid connectivity and SD-WAN integration.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage Azure networking services including VNets, subnetting, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute, and security boundariesIntegrate on-prem and cloud systems with secure identity and network models.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

  • Implement, manage, and design monitoring capabilities for cloud architecture and cloud-hosted systems and applications to ensure optimal performance and compliance with VA/Federal policies
  • Provide customer-focused support for Product lines and Services, including setup, configuration, and provisioning of VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC) environments
  • Provide Cloud support services for systems and applications in the VAEC Azure (GovCloud) environments, ensuring compliance with Veterans Independence Program (VIP) development, release, and documentation requirements
  • Adopt a DevOps mindset with an understanding of CI/CD practices and tooling
  • Provide Cloud Security Provider Documentation
  • Design VAEC/cloud-hosted solutions and address cloud-readiness gaps

Required Skills and Experience

  • A proven track record of designing, deploying, and managing Azure infrastructure and services
  • Experience with large-scale, high-availability, and scalable cloud architecture
  • Expertise in core Azure services such as Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Structured Query Language (SQL) Database, Azure Virtual Network (VNet), Azure Functions, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Azure Monitor, and Azure Domain Name System (DNS)
  • Experience with Azure security practices and services including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Azure Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) Protection, and Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
  • Proficiency with Azure networking components such as VNet Peering, Azure ExpressRoute, Virtual Private Network (VPN) Gateway, Private Endpoints, and Azure Load Balancer
  • An ability to design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available Azure cloud infrastructures
  • Experience establishing and governing multi-subscription Azure environments using Management Groups, Azure Policy, and Azure Landing Zones
  • Knowledge of cloud cost management, FinOps practices, budgeting, tagging strategies, and resource optimization using Azure Cost Management
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/NodeJS for automation and cloud operations
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Azure Resource Manager (ARM) Templates, Ansible, and GitOps methodologies
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and observability tools including Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Activity Log, and third-party tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and New Relic
  • Experience optimizing performance, availability, and resiliency of Azure resources and services
  • A strong understanding of Azure security best practices and compliance frameworks including Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)
  • Experience implementing encryption, key management, secrets management, and identity solutions using Azure Key Vault, customer-managed keys, and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Knowledge of Azure database services including Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Cosmos Database (DB), Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and Azure Database for MySQL
  • Experience with database performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices including Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab CI
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, and Kubernetes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholder
  • Skilled in prioritizing tasks, managing competing priorities, and meeting project deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure system stability, security, operational excellence, and data integrity
  • A proven ability to mentor engineers, provide technical leadership, and contribute to cloud architecture governance
  • Experience leading complex cloud modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives while collaborating across cross-functional teams
  • A willingness to provide on-call support and participate in operational response activities when required
  • Strong documentation skills for architecture, operational procedures, security controls, and system configurations
  • An ability to manage and contribute to multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • A commitment to staying current with emerging Azure technologies, cloud-native architectures, and industry best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to troubleshoot complex cloud-related issues
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Skilled in prioritizing tasks, managing time effectively, and meeting deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure system stability, security, and data integrity
  • A capability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and team members
  • An ability to lead technical projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • A willingness to be on call for emergency support and maintenance when required
  • Strong documentation skills for creating and maintaining system configurations, processes, and procedures
  • An ability to manage and contribute to multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely completion and quality results
  • A commitment to staying current with emerging Azure technologies, tools, and industry trends

  • X.12 medical claims (837, 834, 835, 277, etc)
  • 270/271 and 278 transactions
  • 999 transactions

  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Administrator Associate

  • Automate provisioning and configuration by using infrastructure as code and scripting, including Bicep or Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Microsoft Graph, and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Implement observability through Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, alerting, dashboards, and actionable operational metrics. 
  • Analyze Azure consumption and recommend improvements for cost allocation, right-sizing, reservations or savings options, lifecycle management, and workload efficiency. 
  • Execute cloud migration and modernization work, including discovery, dependency analysis, build-out, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. 
  • Serve as a technical resource and escalation point for complex Azure and hybrid-cloud issues, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. 
  • Maintain configuration standards, build and as-built documentation, support procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. 
  • Follow established change management, security, risk, and incident-response processes while balancing project delivery with operational responsibilities. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum of seven to ten years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including at least three years of hands-on experience building, deploying, administering, and supporting production workloads in Microsoft Azure. 
  • Three or more years of experience working within Azure landing zones and applying Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework guidance to day-to-day builds and configurations. 
  • Three or more years of experience with Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and cloud security posture management. 
  • Proficiency with PowerShell, at least one infrastructure-as-code approach such as Bicep or Terraform, and source control and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or comparable tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DHCP, DNS, certificates, and hybrid identity technologies. 
  • Two or more years of experience recommended supporting Microsoft 365, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, or OneDrive, where these services integrate with Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain cloud configurations, issues, and risk to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with engineers, administrators, security teams, vendors, and support organizations. 
  • One or more years of experience with Microsoft Purview, including data classification, sensitivity labels, retention, eDiscovery, audit, and information protection capabilities a plus. 
  • Two or more years of experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment a plus. 
  • Microsoft certifications a plus; such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert. 

Compensation
