Summary

The Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer plays an integral role in defining and assessing the firm’s infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture and practices. This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.
  • Develop and maintain structured landing zone architecture and scalable cloud governance model.
  • Design, implement and manage hub-and-spoke network topology with hybrid connectivity and SD-WAN integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage Azure networking services including VNets, subnetting, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute, and security boundariesIntegrate on-prem and cloud systems with secure identity and network models.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

  • Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
  • Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
  • Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
  • Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
  • Foster positive work relationships;
  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $112,879 - $179,481 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

DLA Piper is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Job applicant poster viewing center.

AWS Cloud Operations Engineer

Manages, administers, supports and enhances cloud environments, ensuring continuous improvement and rapid problem resolution. Job Number: R0253835

Infrastructure Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Join the team shaping the future of the Intelligence Community (IC). We’re building the next generation of secure, cloud‑native infrastructure that powers the IC and we are looking for an experienced, forward‑thinking senior Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to help lead the way. If you're passionate about automation, Kubernetes, and designing resilient systems at scale, this is an opportunity to make real impact on mission‑critical technology.

As a senior engineer, you’ll be a cornerstone of our cloud platform team, architecting solutions, enabling development teams, and driving the adoption of modern infrastructure practices across a complex, multi‑tenant environment. Your work will directly support the delivery of secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities for the IC.

What You'll Work On:

  • Architect, deploy, and optimize cloud‑agnostic infrastructure using modern tools and cloud technologies.
  • Design Kubernetes‑based solutions to support scalable, containerized workloads across mission environments.
  • Drive automation initiatives to eliminate manual processes and accelerate delivery.
  • Implement strong security practices and respond to emerging threats to keep systems hardened and mission‑ready.
  • Partner closely with developers and cross‑functional teams to deliver seamless, cloud‑native capabilities.
  • Work independently, mentor peers, and bring innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.


Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience in systems engineering, cloud development, cloud engineering or infrastructure engineering
  • Experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining systems in the Cloud
  • Experience with automation tools and infrastructure‑as‑code
  • Knowledge of AWS services and how to integrate them with Kubernetes
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience scripting or programming, including Bash, Python, Golang, or Groovy
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or Terragrunt
  • Experience with Rancher, RKE2, or Kubernetes Operators
  • Experience with tools such as ArgoCD, Grafana, Prometheus, or ElasticSearch
  • AWS Solutions Architect or Developer Certification

Cloud Engineer, AzureRequisition ID: 5170

Country: United States

US Locations: Hermitage, Tampa, Cincinnati, Nashville, Indianapolis, Kansas City, San Antonio, Columbus, St. Louis, Dallas

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate and optimize secure, scalable cloud solutions within Microsoft Azure. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role focused on Azure infrastructure, automation, security, DevOps and the integration of cloud services across a complex enterprise environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong Azure engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, CI/CD, identity, networking, security and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, deploy and support secure, scalable and highly available Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual machines, App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, storage, databases and networking.

Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates and automate cloud operations using PowerShell, Azure CLI and Azure Automation.

Build and maintain Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.

Implement Azure identity, security and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault and related services; perform vulnerability assessments and remediate security or configuration issues.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights to manage infrastructure performance, security, reliability and cost.

Integrate Azure with applications and other cloud-based systems using secure enterprise integration patterns and ensure data consistency and availability.

Troubleshoot complex Azure infrastructure, application integration, performance, scalability and availability issues and ensure operational activities meet required SLAs.

Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver secure, scalable Azure solutions.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, operational procedures and reusable implementation patterns.

Use DevOps practices, including GitHub for version control, to manage cloud infrastructure and configuration.

Stay current with emerging Azure technologies and cloud engineering practices and integrate them where appropriate.

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

3+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure, including architecture, configuration and management.

Hands-on experience across core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Policy, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure databases and Azure networking.

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates.

Experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable technologies.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and Azure security and governance practices.

Experience With Azure Monitoring, Logging And Operational Support Capabilities.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Azure infrastructure, automation, integration and deployment environments.

Ability to collaborate effectively across application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams.

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies.

Preferred:

Experience with containers, Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service.

Full-stack development experience.

Experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions in enterprise cloud environments.

Experience building reusable or automated Azure infrastructure and provisioning capabilities.

Knowledge of Azure monitoring, observability, cost management and/or FinOps practices.

Experience working within a large, complex enterprise cloud environment.

Relevant active Microsoft Azure certifications, such as:

Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Our culture

At Deloitte Global people are valued and respected for who they are - with opportunities to bring their unique perspectives, talents and passions to business challenges. Our global workspace creates room for individuality and collaboration. Ours is an inclusive, supportive, connected culture with a focus on development, flexibility, and well-being. This culture makes Deloitte Global one of the most rewarding places to work, and to transform your career.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in investing in you, helping you identify and hone your unique strengths at every step of your career. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities, and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Our Total Rewards program reflects our continued commitment to lead from the front in everything we do-that's why we take pride in offering a comprehensive variety of programs and resources to support your health and well-being.

descriptionHtml:
MORSE Corp is an employee owned, small business based in Cambridge, MA, Arlington, VA, and Seattle, WA with a history of fielding cutting-edge technology. MORSE boasts a specially selected team of scientists, engineers, and software developers to deliver best-in-class technical solutions that solve difficult multidisciplinary problems faced by the US National Security Ecosystem.  

MORSE is looking for a Cloud Engineer to join one or more projects in big data, artificial intelligence, decision systems, and their accompanying cloud applications. Our applications provide cutting-edge, algorithmic-based simulation, situational awareness, and mission planning capabilities to a wide variety of DoD customers. You will join small interdisciplinary teams of scientists, engineers, and software developers. These teams follow Agile development processes and embrace DevSecOps to ensure fast and secure delivery of software services.

The Cloud Engineer will be focused on the development and maintenance of cloud infrastructure working very closely with developers and using IaC. A successful candidate will have the ability to work directly with others on the team, overseeing the deployment of cloud services and compliance to security guidelines. Creative candidates who want to make an immediate impact will thrive in the MORSE environment.

Additionally, the candidate must be eager to learn new technologies and stay on top of the latest cloud computing and software engineering trends. The candidate will work on a team developing new code bases that are heavily object-oriented, extensible, and maintainable.

Skills and Requirements

  • The ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance

  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS, Azure or GCP.

  • Expertise in working with Terraform or Cloud Formation

  • 5+ years of experience working with software development teams.

  • Proficiency in working with scalable cloud infrastructure

  • Experience managing Identity management systems for cloud services

  • Experience with compliance and monitoring systems.

  • Experience with Agile development (Scrum or Kanban)

  • Experience with microservice architecture

  • Strong communication skills

  • Self-starter and driven

  • BS or MS (preferred) in computer science or equivalent degree, or significant professional experience

Desired Skills

  • Experience with container orchestration services

  • IAT Level 2 Certification

 

 

MORSE Corp’s salary range for this role carefully considers a wide range of compensation factors, including but not limited to, prior experience, education, skills and expertise, location, internal equity, and other factors that are job related and consistent with business need. Therefore, final offer amounts may vary from the amount stated. Depending on role eligibility, total compensation may also include bonus, stock, 401(k) match, paid time off, medical, dental, vision and life insurance.Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year. MORSE maintains an “open” leave policy that does not restrict exempt, regular full-time employees to a specific number of paid sick or vacation days. However, this policy is not an “unlimited” paid leave policy. 

Compensation: $90,000 USD - $160,000 USD

The team at MORSE takes pride in being the smart team that is easy to work with. We focus on steady, long-term success with an emphasis on exceptionalism and delivering mission-critical impact to our customers. For more information, please visit www.morsecorp.com.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Number: R0245205

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

We are building the next generation of cloud-native infrastructure to build a system that will have a positive impact on the intelligence community (IC). We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Infrastructure Cloud Engineer to join our growing team. If you have a passion for automation, cloud infrastructure, and Kubernetes, and you're excited to use the latest open-source tools, this is the role for you.

As an Infrastructure Cloud Engineer on our team, you will use your development experience to build, deploy, and manage a cloud agnostic platform for a multi-tenant environment. You will collaborate with engineering teams to design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient infrastructure solutions, ensuring seamless operation and deployment of cloud-native applications. Join our team as we build tools to transform the future of the IC.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • Experience developing, deploying, and managing applications within AWS
  • Experience managing Kubernetes clusters, including deployments, management, container orchestration, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm for Kubernetes, or Terragrunt
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED
  • Ability to obtain a Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification within 6 months of start date


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with scripting or object-oriented programming in Bash, Python, Groovy, or Golang
  • Experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining Linux server systems in the cloud
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools
  • Experience with Kubernetes Operators, Rancher, and RKE2
  • Experience using or managing ArgoCD, Grafana, Elasticsearch, and Prometheus
  • Experience with Pulumi or Crossplane
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer Certification
  • Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA-Security, or GSEC Certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $69,400.00 to $158,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Description

Company Description

Citizant is a leading provider of professional IT services to the U.S. government. We seek to address some of our country’s most pressing challenges in Agile application development, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, and Program Management support services. We strive to hire only ethical, talented, passionate and committed “A Players” who already align with the company’s core values: Drive, Delivering Excellence, Reputation, Responsibility, and a Better Future. No matter how large we grow, Citizant will retain its collaborative, supportive, small-company culture, where successful team effort to address external and internal customer challenges is valued above all else.

This is for a near-term opportunity

Position Summary

Join our team as an Integrated Maintenance Data System / Maintenance Scheduling Module (IMDS / MSM) Cloud Engineer dedicated to supporting the Air Force’s critical maintenance and readiness operations. In this role, you will design, implement, secure, automate, and support cloud infrastructure and platform services that underpin the IMDS/MSM application. Your expertise will enable application modernization, enhance scalability and resiliency, and promote secure, efficient delivery through DevSecOps practices in a complex environment blending legacy and modern technologies.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure solutions supporting IMDS/MSM.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation capabilities.
  • Support containerized workloads and orchestration platforms.
  • Design, implement, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevSecOps tooling supporting IMDS/MSM.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployment, testing, and release processes.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, capacity, and operational health.
  • Implement and maintain cloud security controls and compliance requirements.
  • Support application modernization and system enhancement initiatives.
  • Support deployment and operational requirements for applications utilizing COBOL, C#, Python, SQL, TypeScript, Angular, and related technologies.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, platform, deployment, integration, and operational issues.
  • Collaborate with application developers, database engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and infrastructure teams.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational artifacts.
  • Support cybersecurity compliance and vulnerability remediation efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of infrastructure, platform, systems, or cloud engineering experience.
  • Experience deploying, managing, and supporting solutions within enterprise cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, Cloud One, or similar platforms).
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code and automation solutions.
  • Experience supporting containerized applications and orchestration platforms.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevSecOps processes within enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting enterprise application platforms, integrations, and deployment environments.
  • Experience supporting applications utilizing technologies such as COBOL, C#, Python, SQL, TypeScript, Angular, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts, secure system design, and cloud security principles.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Local to Montgomery, AL.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Experience supporting IMDS/MSM.

Country: United States

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate and optimize secure, scalable cloud solutions within Microsoft Azure. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role focused on Azure infrastructure, automation, security, DevOps and the integration of cloud services across a complex enterprise environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong Azure engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, CI/CD, identity, networking, security and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, deploy and support secure, scalable and highly available Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual machines, App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, storage, databases and networking.

Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates and automate cloud operations using PowerShell, Azure CLI and Azure Automation.

Build and maintain Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.

Implement Azure identity, security and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault and related services; perform vulnerability assessments and remediate security or configuration issues.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights to manage infrastructure performance, security, reliability and cost.

Integrate Azure with applications and other cloud-based systems using secure enterprise integration patterns and ensure data consistency and availability.

Troubleshoot complex Azure infrastructure, application integration, performance, scalability and availability issues and ensure operational activities meet required SLAs.

Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver secure, scalable Azure solutions.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, operational procedures and reusable implementation patterns.

Use DevOps practices, including GitHub for version control, to manage cloud infrastructure and configuration.

Stay current with emerging Azure technologies and cloud engineering practices and integrate them where appropriate.

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

3+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure, including architecture, configuration and management.

Hands-on experience across core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Policy, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure databases and Azure networking.

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates.

Experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable technologies.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and Azure security and governance practices.

Experience With Azure Monitoring, Logging And Operational Support Capabilities.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Azure infrastructure, automation, integration and deployment environments.

Ability to collaborate effectively across application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams.

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies.

Preferred:

Experience with containers, Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service.

Full-stack development experience.

Experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions in enterprise cloud environments.

Experience building reusable or automated Azure infrastructure and provisioning capabilities.

Knowledge of Azure monitoring, observability, cost management and/or FinOps practices.

Experience working within a large, complex enterprise cloud environment.

Relevant active Microsoft Azure certifications, such as:

Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Our culture

At Deloitte Global people are valued and respected for who they are - with opportunities to bring their unique perspectives, talents and passions to business challenges. Our global workspace creates room for individuality and collaboration. Ours is an inclusive, supportive, connected culture with a focus on development, flexibility, and well-being. This culture makes Deloitte Global one of the most rewarding places to work, and to transform your career.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in investing in you, helping you identify and hone your unique strengths at every step of your career. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities, and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Our Total Rewards program reflects our continued commitment to lead from the front in everything we do-that's why we take pride in offering a comprehensive variety of programs and resources to support your health and well-being.

  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

Job Description

Responsibilities

Multi-cloud platform engineering and operations (design and operate foundations) (25%)

  • Design, implement, and operate scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and other providers, with hands-on depth in at least two.
  • Engineer and improve foundational services and standard patterns (identity integration, networking, logging/monitoring, compute, storage, security controls).
  • Own lifecycle management for key services (upgrades, deprecation planning, operational readiness).

IaC ownership: reusable modules, standardized patterns, environment consistency (25%)

  • Develop and maintain IaC (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep) with focus on reusable modules, standardized patterns, and consistency.
  • Establish code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation) to improve repeatability and reduce risk.

Automation-first engineering for efficiency and improve reliability (15%)

  • Build automation workflows and scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate manual operational tasks and improve reliability.

Reliability ownership and operational standards (lead, don’t just participate) (15%)

  • Own reliability outcomes for cloud services.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis; implement preventative improvements.
  • Define and improve runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, and support models.

Security, compliance, resilience, and vulnerability management as engineered guardrails (12%)

  • Ensure deployments meet security and compliance expectations through guardrails, patterns, and technical controls with Security/Risk.
  • Support audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples) with evidence support and control implementation.
  • Design and validate backup, recovery, and resilience patterns; ensure objectives are tested and reliable.
  • Lead and automate patching and vulnerability management improvements.

Technical leadership: mentoring and cross-team influence (*8%)

  • Translate requirements into designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps aligned to cloud-first.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide technical guidance across teams, influencing patterns and decisions to reduce delivery friction

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or related roles.
  • Hands-on engineering depth in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Strong IaC (Terraform preferred and/or Ansible) including module development and pattern standardization.
  • Strong scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing or significantly improving CI/CD practices for infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong operational ownership: incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventative remediation.

Certifications / licenses (2 or more preferred)

  • AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional

Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of multi-cloud design and operations, with hands-on depth in at least two: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
  • Knowledge of building and improving foundational services and standard patterns: identity integration, networking, logging and monitoring, compute, storage, security controls.
  • Knowledge of operational excellence practices: runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, operational readiness, lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance implementation patterns and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples).

Skills

  • Engineer, automate, and operate cloud services end-to-end; drive ambiguous work to clarity.
  • IaC engineering with emphasis on reusable modules, pattern standardization, and environment consistency (Terraform preferred and or Ansible).
  • Build automation workflows and enforce code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation).
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements.
  • Optimize for performance and cost-efficiency, including enforcing tagging standards and cost allocation practices.

Abilities

  • Ability to own reliability outcomes and reduce operational toil through automation.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps.
  • Ability to mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing, and influence cross-team patterns.

Languages and tools

  • Scripting and automation: Python, PowerShell, Bash (or equivalent).
  • IaC: Terraform (preferred), Ansible, Bicep.
  • Containers and orchestration (preferred): container platforms and orchestration experience.
  • Governance and guardrails (preferred): Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, GCP org policies.

Preferred

  • Containers and orchestration.
  • Cloud governance and guardrails (Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, org policies).
  • Centralized logging and security monitoring integrations (SIEM examples).
  • Regulated environments and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC).
  • Multi-region patterns, shared services networking, private connectivity.

The pay rate range for this job position is $74,200 to $148,230. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Description

Are you looking to take the next steps in your career as an Azure Cloud Engineer? Let's chat and see if we are a good match!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy Azure resources such as Azure Virtual Machines, Key Vaults, and other core Azure resources using Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Monitor and maintain Azure infrastructure, addressing performance issues and optimizing cloud resources.
  • Implement and manage Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep.
  • Review, refine and troubleshoot new and existing IaC within the environment.
  • Design, implement, and manage secure enclave environments within Microsoft Azure.
  • Ensure the stability, performance, and security of Azure enclave systems.
  • Manage identity and access management (IAM) policies, ensuring least privilege access across enclave systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and enhance cloud solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues within Azure environments, providing escalation support as needed.
  • Document configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Azure AVD image building and rotation via automation.
  • Administer and maintain Windows infrastructure services, including Active Directory Domain Services, Active Directory Certificate Services, and Group Policy, ensuring secure account provisioning, certificate management, policy enforcement, and resolution of domain-related issues
  • Provide support in assisting customers installing software onto baseline desktops using an automation first mentality (DSC or Packer).


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud administration and development, with a focus on Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience working in secure enclave environments and familiarity with security compliance frameworks
  • Strong knowledge of Azure services, including Azure Virtual Desktop
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Azure DevOps, ARM templates, or Bicep.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and other scripting languages
  • Strong experience with automating the deployment of Azure resources via code
  • Strong knowledge of YAML, Json, Bicep and PowerShell
  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • Travel: Up to 10%
  • Clearance: Active Top Secret with SCI.


Requirements

  • Must be within driving distance of Lorton, VA OR willing to relocate there
  • Must be willing to work onsite
  • Must be willing and able to travel up to 10%
  • Must possess an active TS/ SCI clearance or above
  • Please note that pursuant to a government contract, this specific position requires U.S. citizenship status


What is Important to Us:

  • You are an excellent communicator in writing and speaking.
  • You have the ability to work independently but also value teamwork.
  • Your problem-solving skills are excellent.
  • You are looking for a job where performance appraisals occur regularly, and you look forward to advancing your career.
  • You seek a community of virtue-centered co-workers and clients.


What we offer you: As part of the VSO company, you will be part of a virtue-centered team who value their work and teammates. This is a no-jerk zone. We provide ongoing learning and development opportunities to foster continuous growth. We offer competitive salaries, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements.

More About VSO: VSO is a hybrid cloud and managed services consulting firm. Much of VSO’s success can be attributed to our deep partnerships with IT services industry leaders such as AWS, IBM, Microsoft and others. VSO leverages numerous other partner relationships so as to provide our customers with optimal support. Additionally, we take pride in taking care of our employees. We offer a wide variety of benefits for eligible employees related to health, retirement, professional development, and more! For more information, please visit our website at https://vso-inc.com/careers

Salary Description

$140,000.00 - $180,000.00

descriptionHtml:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer plays an integral role in defining and assessing the firm’s infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture and practices. This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.
  • Develop and maintain structured landing zone architecture and scalable cloud governance model.
  • Design, implement and manage hub-and-spoke network topology with hybrid connectivity and SD-WAN integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage Azure networking services including VNets, subnetting, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute, and security boundariesIntegrate on-prem and cloud systems with secure identity and network models.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

  • Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
  • Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
  • Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
  • Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
  • Foster positive work relationships;
  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $112,879 - $179,481 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Applicants who are not based in the jurisdiction in which this position is posted and who apply for this role are doing so voluntarily and are not eligible for relocation assistance. Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

descriptionHtml:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess :

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • 3+ years of experience building/operating production AWS infrastructure.
  • 3+ years of experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • 3+ years of experience working with AWS core services: VPC, IAM, EC2/ECS/Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch.
  • 3+ years of experience integrating with third-party or legacy government systems, such as federal security/compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, ATO).
  • 3+ years of experience with CI/CD tooling and automated deployment.
  • Reside a commutable distance to Deloitte office in Gilbert, AZ, Mechanicsburg, PA, or Lake Mary, FL
  • Able to travel up to 10%

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience with identity verification, biometric, or credentialing systems
  • 2+ years of experience with Salesforce integration patterns
  • 2+ years of experience with CBP, DHS, or other federal law-enforcement systems
  • 2+ years of experience supporting systems through an ATO process
  • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or Security Specialty)

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

companyDescription: Whether at the border, up in space, or on the battlefield, we build the advanced technology that makes America stronger, faster, and safer. It’s who we are and what we do. It’s in our code.
descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0252190

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a cloud computing infrastructure architect, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experienced professionals, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions. We’re looking for someone like you to help support national security.

You’ll closely collaborate with fellow cloud architects and engineers specializing in AWS to develop cloud solution components. You’ll have the chance to work within a DevOps framework to create and manage container apps and use products like Kubernetes to further the mission. With access to our internal AWS you’ll have the space and time to explore different ways of solving our clients’ problems, and you’ll partner with stakeholders and your team to deliver the right technical solutions. Whether modernizing legacy computing platforms and applications or creating new ones from scratch, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Grow your skills at the leading edge of innovation.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience with DevOps engineering
  • 5+ years of experience engineering and operating cloud infrastructure in AWS, including multi-account networking with VPCs, Transit Gateway, and centralized egress and inspection
  • Experience maintaining Git-based change control for infrastructure and system configuration
  • Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code, using technologies such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, testing, and release control
  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Cloud technologies
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience creating and improving continuous automation across multiple technical stacks
  • Experience operating AWS EKS
  • Experience working with applications, including Git, GitLab, Terraform, OpenTofu, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or Helm
  • Knowledge of Cloud‑native tooling
  • Knowledge of modernization frameworks used across mission programs
  • Possession of excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field
  • AWS DevOps Engineer, AWS SysOps Administrator, Azure DevOps Engineer, or Red Hat Certified Engineer Certification


Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
