descriptionHtml:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Sr Cloud Infrastructure Engineer plays an integral role in defining and assessing the firm’s infrastructure and operations strategy, architecture and practices. This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.
  • Develop and maintain structured landing zone architecture and scalable cloud governance model.
  • Design, implement and manage hub-and-spoke network topology with hybrid connectivity and SD-WAN integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage Azure networking services including VNets, subnetting, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute, and security boundariesIntegrate on-prem and cloud systems with secure identity and network models.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

  • Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
  • Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
  • Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
  • Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
  • Foster positive work relationships;
  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.    

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

The firm’s expected hiring range for this position is $112,879 - $179,481 depending on the candidate’s geographic market location.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Applicants who are not based in the jurisdiction in which this position is posted and who apply for this role are doing so voluntarily and are not eligible for relocation assistance. Any relocation benefits, if any, are provided only where a relocation is required at the firm’s direction and in accordance with applicable policy and law.

Job Description

This position is responsible for the completion of technical work on client engagements involving accounting and consulting matters while maintaining positive client relationships.

Responsibilities

Multi-cloud platform engineering and operations (design and operate foundations) (25%)

  • Design, implement, and operate scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and other providers, with hands-on depth in at least two.
  • Engineer and improve foundational services and standard patterns (identity integration, networking, logging/monitoring, compute, storage, security controls).
  • Own lifecycle management for key services (upgrades, deprecation planning, operational readiness).

IaC ownership: reusable modules, standardized patterns, environment consistency (25%)

  • Develop and maintain IaC (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep) with focus on reusable modules, standardized patterns, and consistency.
  • Establish code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation) to improve repeatability and reduce risk.

Automation-first engineering for efficiency and improve reliability (15%)

  • Build automation workflows and scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate manual operational tasks and improve reliability.

Reliability ownership and operational standards (lead, don’t just participate) (15%)

  • Own reliability outcomes for cloud services.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis; implement preventative improvements.
  • Define and improve runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, and support models.

Security, compliance, resilience, and vulnerability management as engineered guardrails (12%)

  • Ensure deployments meet security and compliance expectations through guardrails, patterns, and technical controls with Security/Risk.
  • Support audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples) with evidence support and control implementation.
  • Design and validate backup, recovery, and resilience patterns; ensure objectives are tested and reliable.
  • Lead and automate patching and vulnerability management improvements.

Technical leadership: mentoring and cross-team influence (*8%)

  • Translate requirements into designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps aligned to cloud-first.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide technical guidance across teams, influencing patterns and decisions to reduce delivery friction

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or related roles.
  • Hands-on engineering depth in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
  • Strong IaC (Terraform preferred and/or Ansible) including module development and pattern standardization.
  • Strong scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing or significantly improving CI/CD practices for infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong operational ownership: incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventative remediation.

Certifications / licenses (2 or more preferred)

  • AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional

Knowledge

  • Deep knowledge of multi-cloud design and operations, with hands-on depth in at least two: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
  • Knowledge of building and improving foundational services and standard patterns: identity integration, networking, logging and monitoring, compute, storage, security controls.
  • Knowledge of operational excellence practices: runbooks, monitoring standards, alerting practices, operational readiness, lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance implementation patterns and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC examples).

Skills

  • Engineer, automate, and operate cloud services end-to-end; drive ambiguous work to clarity.
  • IaC engineering with emphasis on reusable modules, pattern standardization, and environment consistency (Terraform preferred and or Ansible).
  • Build automation workflows and enforce code quality expectations (reviews, documentation, versioning, validation).
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis and implement preventative improvements.
  • Optimize for performance and cost-efficiency, including enforcing tagging standards and cost allocation practices.

Abilities

  • Ability to own reliability outcomes and reduce operational toil through automation.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and roadmaps.
  • Ability to mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing, and influence cross-team patterns.

Languages and tools

  • Scripting and automation: Python, PowerShell, Bash (or equivalent).
  • IaC: Terraform (preferred), Ansible, Bicep.
  • Containers and orchestration (preferred): container platforms and orchestration experience.
  • Governance and guardrails (preferred): Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, GCP org policies.

Preferred

  • Containers and orchestration.
  • Cloud governance and guardrails (Azure Policy, AWS Organizations controls, org policies).
  • Centralized logging and security monitoring integrations (SIEM examples).
  • Regulated environments and audit readiness (SOC, HIPAA, CMMC).
  • Multi-region patterns, shared services networking, private connectivity.

Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Overview

This role requires U.S. citizenship to meet federal contract requirements related to access to sensitive government data.

The DevOps Engineer III (Cloud Platform Engineer III) is a senior level technical contributor responsible for the development, automation, and maintenance of the organization’s multi-cloud ecosystem. This role focuses on refactoring legacy infrastructure into resilient, standardized Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to eliminate single points of failure and operational drag. The candidate participates in architectural and design decisions while contributing as a primary technical resource for Terraform, CloudFormation, and cloud-native services. Working closely with development, security, and networking teams, the DevOps Engineer III implements complex production environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The focus is on driving scalability through high-level automation—transitioning from manual intake to self-service orchestration—while ensuring strict adherence to global security, IAM governance, and compliance standards. This position follows agile workflows and delivery timelines. This position has no responsibility for providing care to patients.

As a patient-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of people through patient care, research and education. Success in this mission requires a culture of collaboration, excellence, leadership, and respect. University of Utah Health seeks staff that are committed to the values of compassion, collaboration, innovation, responsibility, integrity, quality and trust that are integral to our mission. EO/AA

Corporate Overview: The University of Utah is a Level 1 Trauma Center and is nationally ranked and recognized for our academic research, quality standards and overall patient experience. Our five hospitals and eleven clinics provide excellence in our comprehensive services, medical advancement, and overall patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Development: Contributes advanced development and refactoring of Terraform and CloudFormation codebases. Develops reusable modules and standardized network patterns to ensure infrastructure parity across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • REST API Development & Integration: Designs and develops custom code to interface with REST APIs for cloud service providers and internal platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, GitHub, BeyondTrust). This includes creating automated middleware or scripts to facilitate data exchange and trigger complex orchestration workflows.
  • Cloud Orchestration & Self-Service: Contributes to the design and implementation of automated cloud provisioning workflows by integrating ServiceNow, GitHub Actions, Ansible and Terraform Cloud via IaC and pipelines to replace manual processes.
  • Multi-Cloud Platform Stewardship: Implements logging, monitoring, and observability solutions in Azure and GCP to align with established AWS enterprise standards via IaC.
  • Configuration Management: Develops and maintains "configuration as code" using Ansible to automate system roles, patching, and the onboarding of development teams into cloud-native environments.
  • Modernization & POCs: Executes proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives for modernizing legacy infrastructure with modern cloud technologies and enterprise AI infrastructure.
  • Tooling Lifecycle Management: Manages the governance, maintenance, and updates for core cloud and IaC technologies. Investigates and recommends new technologies that modernize and increase the efficiency of the organization.
  • Team Enablement & Redundancy: Provides senior-level technical oversight and redundancy for critical cloud systems. Supports and mentors DevOps I and II engineers. Leads and contributes to internal Communities of Practice.
  • Security & Compliance Implementation: Implements IAM roles, security groups, and baseline security controls, supporting CIS hardening and compliance requirements through automated configuration and policy enforcement.
  • Observability & Operational Support: Develops, configures, and supports logging and monitoring solutions across “hybrid cloud” infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and GCP to maintain visibility into platform health, automation outcomes, and system performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate and consult with cross-functional teams and external service providers (e.g., AWS, Red Hat) on cloud-related initiatives, providing technical expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and efficient solutions while supporting outage resolution and service request management.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Expert Multi-Cloud Proficiency: Expert-level skill in administering and configuring a hybrid multi-cloud enterprise environment.
  • Terraform Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing, refactoring, and managing Terraform code at scale, including experience with Terraform Cloud and GitHub integration. Follows an IaC first approach.
  • AWS CloudFormation: Deep understanding and experience with AWS CloudFormation templates for infrastructure deployment is highly desirable.
  • Software Development Skills: Proficiency in Python with working knowledge of one or more of the following: JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash, and PowerShell for building automation, integrations, and platform tooling.
  • REST API Development: Strong knowledge of RESTful API principles and experience developing scripts or applications that consume and interact with web services to automate cross-platform tasks.
  • Cloud Networking Knowledge: Strong understanding and debugging of cloud networking, including virtual networks, VPN tunnels, routing tables, direct connect tunnels, network security groups.
  • Cloud Security & IAM: Deep understanding of cloud security principles, specifically IAM policy construction, secret management, automated compliance hardening (CIS), networking controls, and security best practices.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Proficiency in building and maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and integrating them with ITSM tools like ServiceNow.
  • Configuration Management: Experience with Ansible, specifically applying a "configuration as code" philosophy.
  • Enterprise Platform Integration: Experience integrating cloud platforms with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, CMDBs, databases, and internal automation systems.
  • AI & Automation Concepts: Working knowledge of AI concepts and prompt engineering, with the ability to incorporate AI-driven capabilities into cloud and automation workflows.
  • Workload & Priority Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions.

Required

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent.
  • Three years experience administering systems or equivalent.

Qualifications (Preferred)

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

Employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without an accommodation.

  • This is a sedentary position in an office setting that may exert up to 10 pounds and may lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. This position involves sitting most of the time and is not exposed to adverse environmental conditions.

Physical Requirements

Carrying, Climbing, Color Determination, Crawling, Far Vision, Lifting, Listening, Manual Dexterity, Near Vision, Non Indicated, Pulling and/or Pushing, Reaching, Sitting, Speaking, Standing, Stooping and Crouching, Tasting or Smelling, Walking

Cloud Engineer, AzureRequisition ID: 5170

Country: United States

US Locations: Hermitage, Tampa, Cincinnati, Nashville, Indianapolis, Kansas City, San Antonio, Columbus, St. Louis, Dallas

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

Work you'll do

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to design, build, integrate and optimize secure, scalable cloud solutions within Microsoft Azure. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role focused on Azure infrastructure, automation, security, DevOps and the integration of cloud services across a complex enterprise environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong Azure engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, CI/CD, identity, networking, security and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, deploy and support secure, scalable and highly available Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual machines, App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, storage, databases and networking.

Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates and automate cloud operations using PowerShell, Azure CLI and Azure Automation.

Build and maintain Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.

Implement Azure identity, security and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Key Vault and related services; perform vulnerability assessments and remediate security or configuration issues.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights to manage infrastructure performance, security, reliability and cost.

Integrate Azure with applications and other cloud-based systems using secure enterprise integration patterns and ensure data consistency and availability.

Troubleshoot complex Azure infrastructure, application integration, performance, scalability and availability issues and ensure operational activities meet required SLAs.

Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver secure, scalable Azure solutions.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, operational procedures and reusable implementation patterns.

Use DevOps practices, including GitHub for version control, to manage cloud infrastructure and configuration.

Stay current with emerging Azure technologies and cloud engineering practices and integrate them where appropriate.

The team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

3+ years of experience working with Microsoft Azure, including architecture, configuration and management.

Hands-on experience across core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Policy, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure databases and Azure networking.

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and/or ARM templates.

Experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable technologies.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and Azure security and governance practices.

Experience With Azure Monitoring, Logging And Operational Support Capabilities.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Azure infrastructure, automation, integration and deployment environments.

Ability to collaborate effectively across application, infrastructure, security and engineering teams.

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies.

Preferred:

Experience with containers, Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service.

Full-stack development experience.

Experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions in enterprise cloud environments.

Experience building reusable or automated Azure infrastructure and provisioning capabilities.

Knowledge of Azure monitoring, observability, cost management and/or FinOps practices.

Experience working within a large, complex enterprise cloud environment.

Relevant active Microsoft Azure certifications, such as:

Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Our culture

At Deloitte Global people are valued and respected for who they are - with opportunities to bring their unique perspectives, talents and passions to business challenges. Our global workspace creates room for individuality and collaboration. Ours is an inclusive, supportive, connected culture with a focus on development, flexibility, and well-being. This culture makes Deloitte Global one of the most rewarding places to work, and to transform your career.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in investing in you, helping you identify and hone your unique strengths at every step of your career. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities, and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Our Total Rewards program reflects our continued commitment to lead from the front in everything we do-that's why we take pride in offering a comprehensive variety of programs and resources to support your health and well-being.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251736

Cloud Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud”, but not everyone knows how. As a cloud computing infrastructure architect, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experienced professionals, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions. We’re looking for someone like you to help transform our managed platforms to support various missions.

You’ll closely collaborate with fellow cloud architects and engineers specializing in Amazon Commercial, GovCloud, and Azure to build, evolve, maintain, and secure out cloud solution components. You’ll have the chance to work within a DevOps framework to create and manage container apps and use products like Kubernetes to further the mission. With access to our internal tooling and processes, you’ll have the space and time to explore different ways of solving our clients’ problems, and you’ll partner with stakeholders and your team to deliver the right technical solutions. Whether modernizing legacy computing platforms and applications or creating new ones from scratch, you’ll have the latest tech and brightest teammates at your fingertips.

Grow your skills at the leading edge of innovation.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience engineering and operating cloud infrastructure in AWS, including multi-account networking with VPCs, Transit Gateway, and centralized egress and inspection
  • 3+ years of experience writing Infrastructure-as-Code with AWS CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation, and delivering it through pull request-based CI/CD pipelines with automated tests
  • 3+ years of experience automating infrastructure and cost controls, including schedules, lifecycle rules, tag enforcement, and budget alerts, with Terraform, AWS CDK, or Python delivered through pull request-based CI/CD pipelines
  • 2+ years of experience optimizing cloud costs, including rightsizing, Savings Plans or Reserved Instance coverage, storage lifecycle policies, and off-hours scheduling, with measured savings
  • Experience analyzing billing data in AWS and Azure, including AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports, and Azure Cost Management
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or agents in daily engineering work, and reviewing and validating AI-generated infrastructure code before it ships
  • Secret clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in a CS or Information Systems field
  • DoD 8140 IAT Level II Certification such as Security+ CE Certification


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with cloud management and cost platforms such as Kion, CloudHealth, or Apptio Cloudability, including project budgets and spend enforcement
  • Experience implementing showback or chargeback, including cost allocation tags, account hierarchies, and shared-cost splits for multi-tenant platforms
  • Experience optimizing AI and LLM spend, including Amazon Bedrock, prompt caching, model routing, and batch inference
  • Experience with Azure commercial levers, including reservations, savings plans, and Azure Hybrid Benefit
  • Experience optimizing network and logging costs, including Transit Gateway, NAT gateways, public IPv4, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch log retention
  • Experience supporting AWS GovCloud or DoD Impact Level 5 environments, including GovCloud billing through paired commercial accounts
  • Knowledge of the FinOps Foundation Framework, including unit economics and cost forecasting economics and cost forecasting


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,900.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

descriptionHtml:
Join our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the HCI team, you will join the infrastructure team supporting a new unified importer identity and onboarding platform - providing full visibility across every importer entity and individual applying on its behalf, all running on AWS.

You'll design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure for identity verification, biometric matching, and ACE Portal integration, working alongside developers, identity/policy specialists, and stakeholders through Release 1, Release 2, and ongoing O&M. You will work on core AWS infrastructure supporting a mobile identity-verification app, Salesforce orchestration, and ACE Portal integration, as well as biometric/identity services, including hosting and scaling Iprove (facial recognition/liveness) within AWS environment. In addition, integration infrastructure connecting to ATS/NVC (vetting), Salesforce, and ACE. Environments supporting Release 1 (Year 1 launch) and Release 2 running in parallel with steady-state O&M. Security infrastructure supporting the ATO process - access controls, audit logging, encryption for a system handling PII and biometric data. Scheduling/appointment infrastructure for background check and fingerprinting workflows, if in scope.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across two concurrent release tracks. Configure networking, IAM, and security groups per federal requirements
  • Stand up and scale compute for biometric/ML workloads under real onboarding volume
  • Implement monitoring/logging/alerting (CloudWatch) to support O&M
  • Support integration between AWS-hosted services, Salesforce, ATS/NVC, and ACE
  • Support ATO documentation and audits (access control evidence, data flow diagrams, encryption, vulnerability scanning)
  • Collaborate with identity/policy stakeholders on credentialing infrastructure. Support patching, tuning, and capacity planning as the platform scales

A successful candidate would possess :

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

This position may be required, based on the overall size and available competencies within the IT organization, to assume responsibility for security functions. This position will be required to effectively translate business objectives and risk management strategies into specific processes enabled by technologies and services.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain Azure-based infrastructure supporting global enterprise workloads.

  • Design, implement and manage hub-and-spoke network topology with hybrid connectivity and SD-WAN integration.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Manage Azure networking services including VNets, subnetting, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute, and security boundariesIntegrate on-prem and cloud systems with secure identity and network models.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security controls including RBAC, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Collaborate with security teams on threat detection, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives.
  • Utilize tools for cloud posture management, runtime protection, and IaC scanning where applicable.
  • Support secure DevOps practices and integrate security into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

  • Must have experience on Automation platforms and proven skills in scripting tools (PowerShell, Azure CLI).
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussion for solutions buy-in and consensus at various levels is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing “upward” among senior leadership.
  • Experience leading diverse teams. Must have a proven track record of leading large-scale projects, incorporating best practices.
  • Experience mentoring/training the engineering staff on complex technical issues.
  • Five plus years' experience in Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS). Strong technical, analytical and project management skills.
  • Experience leading and participating in large deployment projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Experience in articulating the business drives and architectural approach/trade-offs during discussions for solution buy-in at various levels and gain consensus.
  • Demonstrated data-driven mindset and decision-making skills.
  • Ability and willingness to multi-task and learn new technologies quickly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced agile environment. Ability to adapt to moving targets as requirements change.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills needed.

Minimum Education

  • High School or GED

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT business/industry which includes advanced experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with a focus on cloud networking principles, security, identity, automation & CI/CD. Experience scripting with PowerShell and/or Python and understanding of source control processes.

  • Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
  • Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
  • Foster positive work relationships;
  • Comply with all firm policies and practices;
  • Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
  • Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Applicants must apply directly online instead of sending application materials via email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to permit individuals with a disability to perform the essential functions and responsibilities of the position or to participate in the job selection process. If you have a request for an accommodation during the application process, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

You will collaborate with a talented team of cloud engineers and architects, championing operational excellence and delivering highly available, HIPAA- and SOC-compliant infrastructure. Working closely with security, application development, and business teams, you will help build robust, enterprise-grade platforms that empower innovation, agility, and growth.

Location: Hybrid - at least 3 days/wk in our Dallas, TX offices

On-Call: This position requires being on-call 1 week per month at the most

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available Azure cloud infrastructure to support Lantern’s healthcare solutions.
  • Collaborate with cloud architects, engineers, application developers, and InfoSec teams to deliver enterprise-grade cloud platforms that meet HIPAA, SOC 2, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of Azure resources.
  • Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions to support agile software development and rapid release cycles.
  • Ensure robust monitoring, observability, and alerting for production systems; proactively address incidents and contribute to incident response.
  • Participate in cost optimization efforts by monitoring resource usage and recommending efficiencies for cloud spend.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and uptime strategies for critical healthcare applications.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for infrastructure, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings with product, engineering, and compliance teams to ensure infrastructure aligns with business and regulatory goals.
  • Mentor junior engineers and support a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement within the team.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform is a plus).
  • Experience designing, deploying, and managing cloud-based infrastructure at scale.
  • Practical experience configuring and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
  • Proven experience in a regulated environment, ideally in the healthcare sector with HIPAA and/or SOC compliance requirements.
  • Hands-on exposure to security best practices for cloud environments, including identity and access management, encryption, and monitoring/logging.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • If you don’t meet every requirement listed, we still encourage you to apply.

Strong Candidates Will:

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), especially Terraform, to automate Azure resources.
  • Experience managing Azure App Services, networking, and storage solutions.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Azure Kubernetes Service) is a plus.
  • Relevant Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator) are a plus.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k with company match
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave

About You:

  • You use LOGIC in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
  • INCLUSION is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
  • You have the GRIT, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
  • You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep HUMANITY in all decisions. Your customers aren’t just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
  • Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the TRUTH vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
  • You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.

These pillars of LIGHT are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this LIGHT, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern.

Please apply to our role & someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

Job Description


BAE Systems, a top-ten prime contractor to the U.S. Department of Defense, enables the U.S. government to transform data into intelligence and provides engineering, integration and sustainment support for critical military platforms and systems. Intelligence & Security provides services and products to the Department of Defense, the government, federal law enforcement officials, and troops deployed around the world.

At BAE Systems, we promote a strong, collaborative culture and provide our employees with the tools, skills and training they need to succeed. We are all about trust, camaraderie and a shared ambition to lead the world in defense technologies and national security services. We offer flexible work environment to support the balance in your life and keep you performing at your best. Be a part of a company that is part of the community; driven to improve our future and protect our freedom.

We are looking for experienced System Engineers to join our technology-based program supporting a key government customer. This program will deliver engineering services for network infrastructure as well as sophisticated enterprise computing infrastructure including end-point devices, data center hosted servers, multi-Cloud services as well as virtualized applications, and storage systems. Enterprise Computing Engineering services include modern application technology including containerized solutions with orchestrated workflow that function both on customer premise, and via remote Cloud services. Network infrastructure engineering services are comprised of core infrastructure, voice and video engineering, field engineering, application management and development for networks, network analytics, firewalls, network access controls and bandwidth service delivery. This is a fast paced, challenging, and career rewarding experience to recruit and develop provide top talent and solutions on one of the most complex and high-profile programs within the government.

ABC



Required Education, Experience, & Skills


We are looking for an Senior Systems Engineer with a Bachelor's degree, 6 years of relevant work experience and a background utilizing the following:

  • AWS Services
    • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) services such as EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch and CloudTrail
    • Ability to manage and maintain AWS Cloud infrastructure, including resource provisioning, monitoring and cost optimization
  • Python Programming
    • Proficient in Python programming language (version 3.9 or later)
    • Ability to write Python scripts to automate tasks, such as data processing, file management and system administration
    • Familiarity with popular Python libraries, such as Boto3 (AWS SDK for Python), requests and Django
  • Automation
    • Experience with automation tools, such as Ansible, Terraform and/or CloudFormation
    • Ability to translate deployment practices into automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash scripts and/or other automation tools
  • Other
    • Familiarity with Version Control systems such as Git and specifically, GitHub
    • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools, such as Prometheus and CloudWatch
    • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Development, Operations and Security teams
    • Knowledge of Agency governance and compliance practices as they relate to AWS and other Cloud environments to include Government best practices and Government Enterprise services, processes and procedures
    • Architect background; ability to advise customer management on technical conversations within the team to support customer tools and operations; be the team technical rep. at technical meetings


Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills


  • AWS Cloud Certification(s)


Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $132962 - $226035

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems, Inc.


BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Job Number: R0253680

Kubernetes Infrastructure Engineer

The Opportunity:

Everyone is trying to “harness the cloud,” but not everyone knows how. As a cloud computing infrastructure architect, you know how to take advantage of cloud capabilities. On our team of experienced professionals, you’ll use cutting-edge enterprise cloud platforms to support your clients as they modernize their IT infrastructure and meet their most challenging missions.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience engineering core cloud infrastructure in AWS or Azure, including networking, identity, compute, and storage
  • 3+ years of experience building, securing, and operating production Kubernetes clusters, including EKS or AKS from the cloud layer up
  • Experience using Infrastructure-as-Code to provision cloud and Kubernetes environments
  • Experience integrating cloud identity and access controls
  • Experience configuring node autoscaling and persistent cloud storage
  • Knowledge of enterprise cloud networking and Kubernetes networking or overlays, such as Cilium or Istio
  • Knowledge of Node server administration, node bootstrapping, and troubleshooting underlying host or networking issues
  • Ability to plan and execute zero-downtime Kubernetes version upgrades
  • Secret clearance
  • HS diploma or GED


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience operating Kubernetes environments inside regulated or government cloud boundaries, including AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, FedRAMP, or DoD
  • Knowledge of GitOps workflows, modern container networking, or multi-cluster management tools
  • CKA or CKS certification


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,900.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

It's an exciting time to be a member of the Fisher Investments Technology Department. We're investing in the future of our firm's technology and are building our team to achieve global growth. We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to support our Cloud Platform team. If you are looking for an opportunity to make an impact as we develop scalable and strategic solutions to support our global growth, we want to hear from you!

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will report to the Cloud Platform Team Lead and will be responsible for supporting, implementing, and managing our Azure-based cloud infrastructure. The Azure Cloud Engineer will maintain the operational Azure cloud environment, perform infrastructure deployments and ensure the production environment is operating securely and efficiently using automation tools. You will work with Infrastructure Engineering to make sure all deployments follow standards, are compliant and secure. You will also be partnered with other cloud team members, application owners and business owners for faster delivery of resources.

The Day-to-Day:

  • Design and manage scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure and automation tooling for routine operation tasks
  • Deploy enterprise scaled cloud resources that can be used across technology organizations using code
  • Be the contact to business application owners and build bridge between them and cloud team
  • Develop, implement and maintain scalable, AI infrastructure on Cloud Platform
  • Follow security audit requirements and controls in every action
  • Implement and suggest strategies in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, develop tooling and associated processes for applying automated, faster, efficient, and consistent error-free deployments
  • Enhance existing deployment processes and Infrastructure as Code scripts to improve automation, efficiency, and consistency
  • Participate in team activities such as peer code reviews, design collaboration efforts and rotating on-call process
  • Use configuration management and automated deployment tools to provide cloud-based solutions and services ensuring best practices
  • Work with solution architects, tech leads and partners to confirm developed solutions align with existing standards, meet security controls and meet cloud computing best practices
  • Investigate and monitor current-state cloud usage, solutions in use, risks, gaps, limitations and recommend solutions, optimizations and remediation
  • Provide international and 24/7 support at on-call duties and working a flexible off-hours schedule for planned and unplanned maintenance

Your Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure cross platform technology areas, with implementing and maintaining expertise of Azure/AWS cloud services.
  • 5+ years of experience building, deploying and managing IaaS and PaaS services on Microsoft Azure/AWS platform.
  • 4+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, including building reusable modules, managing state, and promoting infrastructure changes through automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • 2 years of hands-on experience on Kubernetes and containerized workloads
  • Knowledge on AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI or similar cloud-based AI services
  • Hands-on experience implementing Cloud security and governance controls, including Cloud Platform Policy, Defender for Cloud, secure landing zones, identity governance, secret management and compliance enforcement.
  • Strong working networking knowledge (DNS, routing, firewalls, and private access)
  • Scripting and automation of builds, workflows, tasks and other integration aspects
  • Linux and Microsoft Windows server administration
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef
  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect Expert cloud certification or equivalent certification

Why Fisher Investments:

We work for a bigger purpose: bettering the investment universe. We take great pride in our inclusive culture, our learning and development framework customized for every employee, and our Great Place to Work Certification. It's the people that make the Fisher purpose possible, and we invest in them by offering exceptional benefits like:

  • 100% paid medical, dental and vision premiums for you and your qualifying dependents
  • A 50% 401(k) match, up to the IRS maximum
  • 20 days of PTO, plus 10 paid holidays
  • Family Support programs including 8 week Paid Primary Caregiver Leave, $10,000 fertility, family forming, and hormonal health assistance, and back-up child, adult, and elder care
  • This is an in-office role. Based on your role, tenure, and performance eligibility you may have the opportunity to participate in our hybrid work from home program. This program is subject to change.

We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people because technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions.

About The Role

At Makai, we build and run cloud platforms for clients in healthcare and other high-stakes industries. You take a platform from an empty Azure subscription to production, make the architecture calls and live with them, and own the infrastructure as code, the pipelines and the monitoring. Much of this runs inside our clients’ own Azure environments, so you work with their infrastructure teams daily: reviewing their designs, explaining what we need and why, and keeping work moving when it depends on them.

The ideal candidate will be able to

  • Design, build and maintain Azure environments with Terraform across multiple subscriptions, from networking and identity to a running application
  • Build and maintain CI/CD for applications and infrastructure in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and similar platforms: release promotion with approvals, secure deployment identities and repository synchronization
  • Operate the compute and runtime platforms, from virtual machines to containers and PaaS: base images, upgrades, patching, rolling deployments, autoscaling and capacity planning
  • Design and tune monitoring, logging and alerting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights
  • Design and operate the identity and access model: Entra ID, SSO, workload identities, role- and attribute-based access control, privileged and just-in-time access, and secrets in Key Vault
  • Design and maintain secure network architectures: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, private endpoints and DNS, Application Gateway and WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs and isolation between environments
  • Maintain security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, patching, Azure Policy, and audits against client policies and regulatory frameworks
  • Design and run backup, high availability and disaster recovery: recovery objectives, zone and region redundancy, restore testing, DR drills and failover
  • Own production changes and incidents: formal change management with verification and rollback, and troubleshooting through to root cause
  • Act as the technical counterpart to clients’ infrastructure and security teams: design reviews, proposals, change requests and runbooks

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and operating production Azure environments
  • Expert-level Terraform: you have owned large multi-environment, multi-subscription Azure codebases, designed their code and state structure, and carried out major refactors and state migrations on live infrastructure
  • Proven experience designing CI/CD systems for both applications and infrastructure on Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms, across many repositories and environments
  • Strong Linux systems administration background, with a deep understanding of how servers are provisioned, configured and run, and hands-on troubleshooting of services, containers, storage and networking at the OS level
  • Fluency in Bash and PowerShell; Python is a plus
  • Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and of identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, and of Azure’s control-plane and data-plane authorization models
  • Proven experience designing, implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for production systems, with a solid understanding of the SLAs and recovery limits of Azure services
  • Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as Virtual Machines and VM Scale Sets, App Service and Container Apps
  • Experience building observability on Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, and fluency in KQL
  • Solid working knowledge of Azure networking, particularly hub-and-spoke topologies, private connectivity and DNS
  • Experience operating Azure data services such as Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Redis, Cosmos DB and Azure Storage
  • Excellent technical writing and live communication: documentation others can act on without you, and a composed, precise manner on client calls and during incidents
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.

How We Work

Small senior teams, real ownership. We'd rather have one engineer who understands a platform top to bottom than several who each own a slice.

Core values for Makai employees

  • Be a flexible, innovative and creative thinker
  • Be congenial and a team player
  • Be self-sufficient
  • Be self-driven with an ownership mentality
  • Have a strong work ethic

About The Team

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers.

About The Role

We also offer “cloud solutions engineering”: we unblock teams across DoorDash with novel or complex cloud needs, from multi-cloud deployments and cross-cloud credential vending to multi-region sFTP. You will partner directly with teams across the company to take a need from an ambiguous request to production, and mature the most common ones into platform products that can be adopted widely.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, security, and developer experience. It includes designing, building, and operating systems that must be reliable, secure, easy-to-use, and cost-efficient.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the Cloud Infrastructure team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from our New York City engineering hub.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

  • Design and build the foundational cloud platform (account vending, IAM, cloud networking primitives, quotas, infrastructure as code) that every engineering team at DoorDash builds on top of
  • Own the paved path for cloud at DoorDash: make the secure, cost-efficient way the easy way through self-service tooling
  • Partner with product and platform teams to unblock complex or novel cloud use-cases, and turn the recurring ones into platform products
  • Drive cloud-wide initiatives such as multi-cloud, unifying cloud foundations across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, cost efficiency, and security posture
  • Set technical direction for the team, mentor engineers, and influence cloud architecture decisions across the company
  • Find ways to improve the team’s productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
  • Participate in a shared support rotation

We’re Excited About You Because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, cloud, or platform engineering
  • Deep, hands-on experience with AWS (IAM, Organizations, VPC, S3, ECR, etc.); GCP experience is a plus
  • Experience with cloud networking primitives like VPC, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway and VPC peering.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform and GitOps workflows such as Atlantis or ArgoCD
  • Experience with programming languages like Go and Python
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Track record of taking ambiguous problems from customer teams to well-paved solutions that can be adopted across multiple teams
  • You are curious, independent, ambitious, and can find solutions and make progress in an ambiguous and challenging environment
  • You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

Bonus points if you…

  • Have built an internal cloud platform, landing zones, or account vending at scale
  • Have multi-cloud experience, especially running workloads on GCP alongside AWS
  • Have experience with cloud cost management and vendor relationships

Compensation

The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See Below For Paid Time Off Details

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay ranges for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden-ai.com/metaview/application-review.
