descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Infra and DevOps Cloud Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for:

  • Consult with clients on the design of Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments
  • Install, configure, automate, and monitor cloud platform services
  • Maintain DevOps environments based on client requirements
  • Support system migrations and upgrades to build and deploy cloud environments
  • Mentor and support junior team members

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure offering provides specialized engineering capabilities to design, implement, manage, and operate hybrid cloud environments, modernize networks and AI infrastructure from the core to the edge, and incubate new infrastructure and device services to help clients stay ahead with the latest technology advances.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AWS DevOps, Terraform, and automation scripting with Python, Bash, or Ansible
  • Ability to work in a hybrid model while residing within a commutable distance of Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg, or GeoHub locations in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, or Philadelphia
  • Ability to spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office, approved site, or project location
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, Node.js, Python, or Go
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure services, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), Simple Storage Service (S3), Elastic Block Store (EBS), Elastic File System (EFS), Elastic Load Balancing (ELB), and Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Experience administering Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, or Windows Server 2012R2, 2016, 2019, or 2022
  • AWS Associate- or Professional-level certifications; Red Hat Linux system administration certification; or HashiCorp Terraform certification
  • Experience with cloud operations, including backup, patching, vulnerability management, and server hardening
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform, Chef, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS), or AWS Fargate

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $171,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Role Description

The Senior Cloud Engineer supports the Lead Engineer in executing migration and engineering activities across cloud infrastructure, application deployment, automation, and operational readiness workstreams. The role functions as a senior hands-on technical resource responsible for building, configuring, deploying, and supporting AWS-based solutions throughout the engagement.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Alpharetta, GA is $105k - $120k/year & benefits (see below).


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software, infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting cloud migration, application modernization, or infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, monitoring, and automation tools.
  • Experience supporting production systems in complex enterprise environments.
  • AWS certifications preferred.


Key Responsibilities

  • Implement cloud infrastructure and platform components within AWS.
  • Support application migration, deployment, and modernization activities.
  • Develop and maintain automation, deployment pipelines, and infrastructure templates.
  • Configure monitoring, logging, security, and operational tooling.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration-related technical issues.
  • Support testing, environment readiness, and production cutover activities.
  • Collaborate with architects and application teams to optimize performance, reliability, and operational supportability


We offer:

  • A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational organization with 58 offices in 22 countries and the possibility to work abroad.
  • 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).

  • A flat and approachable organization.

descriptionHtml:

Aretum is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to support a federal customer. Help deliver secure, managed cloud infrastructure for mission-critical DoD IT systems. Working across AWS, Microsoft Azure and private cloud environments, you will support application migrations, secure connectivity, automation and continuous delivery while partnering with technical teams on enterprise modernization. 

Responsibilities

  • Engineer and support public and private cloud infrastructure and services. 
  • Plan and execute migrations of on-premises applications to cloud environments. 
  • Implement secure connectivity using IPsec, VPN and BGP technologies. 
  • Automate infrastructure and administrative workflows using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools. 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and version-controlled engineering practices. 
  • Apply DoD security hardening and vulnerability management requirements. 
  • Coordinate network, storage, server and application integrations. 
  • Support technical delivery across multiple large-scale initiatives. 

Requirements

  • Experience in Computer Science or IT. 
  • CompTIA Security+. 
  • DoD Secret Security Clearance. 
  • Mid to senior level Cloud Engineer experience. 
  • Security+ (Or equivalent IA cert) and computing environment certification (i.e. MCSD Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, etc.). 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Experience effectively managing multiple large-scale projects. 
  • Strong experience with IPSEC/VPN, and other secure transport technologies as well as Border Gateway Protocol. 
  • Proven experience migrating on-premises applications to the cloud. 
  • Understanding of network, storage, server, and application technologies. 
  • Strong knowledge of automation concepts, tools, and scripting languages (Ansible, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Puppet, Chef, etc.). 
  • Working knowledge of code repositories tools such as Git. 
  • Working knowledge of DoD STIGs, and IA Vulnerability Management (IAVM). 
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipeline experience such as Jenkins, Travis CI, AWS CodeDeploy. 

  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior IT experience in networking or equivalent experience. 
  • Experience automating routine administrative tasks.

General Position Summary

The Cloud Platform Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, automating, and evolving cloud infrastructure and platform services. This position develops resilient infrastructure patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, disaster recovery capabilities, and platform modernization by partnering with Cloud Architecture, Cloud Operations, DevOps, Security, Support, and application teams, driving a more scalable, secure, automated, and operable cloud platform.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and improve Azure infrastructure and platform service patterns.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules, deployment patterns, and platform automation standards.
  • Design and implement networking, compute, storage, PaaS, resiliency, and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Support disaster recovery design, recovery readiness, failover planning, and resilience engineering activities.
  • Automate repeatable platform operations using scripting, pipelines, and cloud-native tooling.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Architecture on reference architecture implementation and platform standards.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on deployment orchestration, pipeline integration, and infrastructure delivery processes.
  • Mentor CloudOps team members and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, or operational handoffs.
  • Document design decisions, standards, implementation patterns, operational handoff requirements, and support considerations.
  • Lead complex technical remediation, modernization, and platform improvement efforts.

Job Required Knowledge And Skills

  • AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AZ-700 Azure Network Engineer Associate.
  • AZ-400 DevOps Engineer Expert, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or equivalent automation / IaC experience.
  • Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, CI/CD integration, and cloud platform modernization.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical workshops, or creating reusable platform standards.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement plan
  • 100% employer-paid benefits, including short-term and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Generous employee discount and exclusive perks
  • Ongoing career development, including discounted secondary education courses
  • A collaborative, innovative, and team-oriented work environment
  • Early Wage Access options
  • Bonus eligibility depending on position level

Physical Demands & Requirements

  • Ability to operate a computer and work with digital systems for extended periods

Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD). 
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems. 
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda. 
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault. 
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams. 
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you. 

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services
  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $119,000-$154,000 in Kansas, $130,900-$169,400 in Chicago, and $148,750-$192,500 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.

RTI International’s Platform Team serves as a strategic technology enablement group that helps RTI business units deliver secure, scalable, and cost-effective digital solutions. We provide reusable platform patterns through modern cloud & data engineering and operational support services for research computing, analytics, application development, and data-intensive work steams. We work collaboratively with project & software teams as well as infrastructure teams, compliance, and security partners across RTI to reduce one-off technology builds, improve delivery consistency, and help business units bring solutions to market more efficiently.

The Platform Team is currently expanding the shared environments, services, and operational capabilities it develops, operates, and maintains in support of RTI projects and strategic initiatives. These capabilities support a broad range of cloud, application, analytics, and research computing needs, including:

  • Research computing and analytics environments
  • Kubernetes-based application and platform services
  • Secure data enclave and lakehouse architectures
  • CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code automation
  • Cloud cost modeling, observability, and platform operations
  • Integrated tools such as JupyterHub, RStudio/Posit, Airflow, REDCap, Stata, Databricks, and custom web applications

We have an immediate opportunity for an Early-Career Platform Engineer to join our growing platform team. The successful candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams including platform engineers, software developers, data engineers, security and infrastructure teams, project leaders, and non-technical stakeholders to support, operate, maintain, and enhance existing platform capabilities as well as contribute to the development of new services that support RTI projects and initiatives.

This position is right for you if you:

  • Exhibit passion for technology, enjoy working across several projects and systems at the same time, and are energized by building, understanding, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex cloud and platform environments.
  • Want to continually learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and practices in cloud engineering, DevOps, research computing, data platforms, and secure application delivery.
  • Have experience designing, building, and operating in a cloud computing environment, including the use of Infrastructure-as-Code and automated deployment patterns.
  • Have a strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle using version control, continuous integration/continuous deployment, project tracking tools, automated testing, and operational release practices.
  • Are proactive and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders with varying degrees of technical knowledge.
  • Are interested in helping project teams adopt reusable platform patterns that improve delivery speed, compliance readiness, operational consistency, and cost transparency.

This position is based at RTI International’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park (RTP), North Carolina, with the potential for a hybrid work arrangement.

What You'll Do

The Platform Engineer assists with designs, implements, automates, and supports enterprise platform services that enable scalable, secure, and compliant delivery of research, analytics, and business applications. Supports development and maintenance of cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD pipelines, observability solutions, and platform automation capabilities supporting other strategic technology initiatives. Collaborates with application development teams, researchers, security teams, and infrastructure teams to improve platform reliability, operational efficiency, and service delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Supports design, implementation, and operationalization of multi-tenant cloud-native platform services across AWS and Azure.
  • Develops and modifies Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using OpenTofu, Terraform, or similar technologies with guidance.
  • Utilizes platform security controls, secrets management, identity integration, and policy enforcement capabilities.
  • Assists with platform performance, availability, scalability, resiliency, and cost optimization identification and implementation.
  • Follows and assists with writing platform engineering standards, reference architectures, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Participates with security operations, governance, and application teams to collaborate on platforms infrastructure and security requirements.
  • Uses continuous learning and on-hands training to develop skills and experience to perform job duties.

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience working with open-source frameworks, tools, and applications.
  • Foundational knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration, gained through education or hands-on experience.
  • Proficiency in managing software packages and dependencies.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-based storage solutions, such as Amazon S3, EFS, and/or RDS.
  • Understanding of Agile development methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate challenges and identify practical solutions.
  • Ability to understand and navigate complex technical systems and their interdependencies.
  • Ability to support troubleshooting and issue resolution across infrastructure, platform, networking, and application layers.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize responsibilities and manage competing demands in a dynamic environment.
  • Detail-oriented approach, commitment to quality and accuracy, and a willingness to continuously learn and develop new technical skills.
  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development and deployment practices, including GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, multi-environment deployments, and GitHub Actions or equivalent workflow automation tools.
  • Foundational understanding of Layer 4 and Layer 7 cloud networking concepts, including how they support application connectivity and traffic management.
  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and identity and access management systems, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Amazon Cognito, or Keycloak.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.

Equal Pay Act Minimum/Range

$70,000 - $87,000

Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Mission Enablement Center (MDEC) Cloud Engineering Team in Reston, Virginia. This is a hybrid position requiring regular on-site presence in Reston, with flexibility to work remotely based on program and mission requirements.

This is a customer facing role and selected candidates will be required to present and demo Leidos Cloud platforms, facilitate technical exchange meetings, and provide engineering updates directly to leadership and external customers.

The selected candidate will support multiple federal and Department of Defense (DoD) programs, including InSight Mission Cloud, by developing secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud solutions. The position requires strong technical experience in cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, DevSecOps, and cloud operations.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on engineering, can manage multiple technical priorities, troubleshoot complex issues, collaborate with customers and technical teams, and mentor junior engineers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Cloud Engineering: Design, deploy, configure, and sustain secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure, primarily across AWS and Azure, with additional support for OCI and GCP environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code and Automation: Develop and maintain reusable Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, and other automation solutions for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployments.
  • Containerization and Kubernetes: Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain containerized applications and orchestration platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Azure AKS.
  • DevSecOps and CI/CD: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot automated build and deployment pipelines using GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and related technologies.
  • Cloud Security and Compliance: Implement secure cloud configurations, identity and access controls, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and automated security scanning aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, DoD STIGs, and applicable federal requirements.
  • Cloud Operations and Sustainment: Support day-to-day operations, patching, monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across mission-critical cloud environments.
  • Cloud Modernization: Support application migrations, cloud landing zones, infrastructure modernization, virtualization, and hybrid cloud integration.
  • Monitoring and Logging: Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and related enterprise tools.
  • Technical Documentation: Develop architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, automation scripts, operational runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, participate in engineering reviews, support complex troubleshooting, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
  • Cross-Program Support: Collaborate with MDEC engineers, program teams, customers, and vendors to deliver technical solutions across multiple federal and DoD programs.
  • Candidates must facilitate communication between stakeholders and lead engineering discussions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 6+ years of experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, administering, and supporting cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including hands-on engineering in at least one platform and working knowledge of a second cloud platform.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-managed container platforms such as EKS or AKS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, including VPCs, VNets, subnets, routing, firewalls, security groups, load balancers, and VPN connectivity.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments.
  • Experience scripting and automating tasks using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, and monitoring.
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, and platform issues in operational environments.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and support multiple engineering efforts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with customers, engineers, and technical leadership.
  • Must reside within commuting distance of Reston, VA and be able to support a hybrid work schedule.

Clearance Requirements

  • Active DoD Top Secret (TS) clearance with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility prior to the start date, or an active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Ability to meet additional security and access requirements associated with assigned programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or federal government cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, OCI Government, or other regulated cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting DoD Impact Levels IL4, IL5, or IL6.
  • Experience with multi-cloud environments, shared cloud services, cloud landing zones, and managed cloud offerings.
  • Experience with cloud migration, application modernization, and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Familiarity with Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO), NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and DISA STIG requirements.
  • Experience with security and vulnerability management tools such as Tenable, Splunk, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent solutions.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code security scanning, configuration compliance, and automated remediation.
  • Relevant cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps Administrator, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
  • Security+ CE, CISSP, or other relevant DoD 8140-aligned certifications.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and serving as a technical lead on cloud engineering efforts.

Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Mission Enablement Center (MDEC) Cloud Engineering Team in Reston, Virginia. This is a hybrid position requiring regular on-site presence in Reston, with flexibility to work remotely based on program and mission requirements.

This is a customer facing role and selected candidates will be required to present and demo Leidos Cloud platforms, facilitate technical exchange meetings, and provide engineering updates directly to leadership and external customers.

The selected candidate will support multiple federal and Department of Defense (DoD) programs, including InSight Mission Cloud, by developing secure, scalable, and repeatable cloud solutions. The position requires strong technical experience in cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, DevSecOps, and cloud operations.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on engineering, can manage multiple technical priorities, troubleshoot complex issues, collaborate with customers and technical teams, and mentor junior engineers.

Primary Responsibilities



- Cloud Engineering: Design, deploy, configure, and sustain secure cloud and hybrid infrastructure, primarily across AWS and Azure, with additional support for OCI and GCP environments.
- Infrastructure as Code and Automation: Develop and maintain reusable Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, and other automation solutions for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployments.
- Containerization and Kubernetes: Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain containerized applications and orchestration platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Azure AKS.
- DevSecOps and CI/CD: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot automated build and deployment pipelines using GitLab, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and related technologies.
- Cloud Security and Compliance: Implement secure cloud configurations, identity and access controls, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and automated security scanning aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, DoD STIGs, and applicable federal requirements.
- Cloud Operations and Sustainment: Support day-to-day operations, patching, monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across mission-critical cloud environments.
- Cloud Modernization: Support application migrations, cloud landing zones, infrastructure modernization, virtualization, and hybrid cloud integration.
- Monitoring and Logging: Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and related enterprise tools.
- Technical Documentation: Develop architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, automation scripts, operational runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
- Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, participate in engineering reviews, support complex troubleshooting, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
- Cross-Program Support: Collaborate with MDEC engineers, program teams, customers, and vendors to deliver technical solutions across multiple federal and DoD programs.
- Candidates must facilitate communication between stakeholders and lead engineering discussions.

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 6+ years of experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
- 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, administering, and supporting cloud infrastructure.
- Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including hands-on engineering in at least one platform and working knowledge of a second cloud platform.
- Experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
- Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-managed container platforms such as EKS or AKS.
- Strong understanding of cloud networking, including VPCs, VNets, subnets, routing, firewalls, security groups, load balancers, and VPN connectivity.
- Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments.
- Experience scripting and automating tasks using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
- Understanding of cloud security, IAM, vulnerability management, encryption, logging, and monitoring.
- Experience troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, and platform issues in operational environments.
- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and support multiple engineering efforts.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with customers, engineers, and technical leadership.
- Must reside within commuting distance of Reston, VA and be able to support a hybrid work schedule.

Clearance Requirements



- Active DoD Top Secret (TS) clearance with the ability to obtain SCI eligibility prior to the start date, or an active TS/SCI clearance.
- Ability to meet additional security and access requirements associated with assigned programs.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or federal government cloud environments.
- Hands-on experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, OCI Government, or other regulated cloud environments.
- Experience supporting DoD Impact Levels IL4, IL5, or IL6.
- Experience with multi-cloud environments, shared cloud services, cloud landing zones, and managed cloud offerings.
- Experience with cloud migration, application modernization, and hybrid cloud architectures.
- Familiarity with Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO), NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and DISA STIG requirements.

companySlogan: Redefining modern defense.
descriptionHtml:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

The Role

You'll join a small, highly collaborative team in San Francisco building the cloud platform behind some of the world's most advanced radar systems. You'll design, build, and operate both the infrastructure and the backend services that move mission-critical sensor data from radars in the field to the operators who depend on it. The platform is in production and growing fast, and your job is to scale it as our fleet of sensors, customers, and deployments grows.

Responsibilities

  • Cloud Infrastructure - design and operate our Azure infrastructure as code with Terraform: networking, Azure Container Apps, managed databases, and the CI/CD pipelines that deploy to them.
  • Backend Platform Services - build and own high-throughput Python (FastAPI) services and the data layer behind them (PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis, Cosmos DB) that ingest and stream real-time sensor data.
  • Platform Architecture - work with engineering teams across the company to define the architecture of the next generation of the platform.
  • Operations - own security, reliability, and observability across the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network isolation, monitoring and alerting (Datadog), and incident response.

Minimum Requirements

  • Have built and operated production infrastructure in at least one major cloud - Azure, AWS, or GCP - defined in code with Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or CloudFormation.
  • Have run containerized production workloads (Docker) on a managed platform such as Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS or Fargate, Google Cloud Run, or Kubernetes.
  • Have strong cloud networking fundamentals: virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancers, private endpoints, and firewalls.
  • Have built and operated production backend services in Python, Go, or a similar language, and understand what happens under load - concurrency, async I/O, connection pooling, and resource limits.
  • Are fluent in distributed systems: consistency and replication, partitioning, caching, back-pressure, idempotency, and how systems fail - and how to design so that they degrade gracefully.
  • Have scaled a production system well beyond its original design, and fixed what broke on the way.
  • Build securely by default - least-privilege access, secrets kept out of code, and patched, hardened systems - and can explain the trade-offs behind those choices.

Preferred Requirements

  • Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or other regulated environments (FedRAMP, CMMC, NIST 800-171 or 800-53).
  • Real-time and streaming data systems: WebSockets, server-sent events, pub/sub, and message queues.
  • Identity and cloud security: Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, managed identities, service-to-service authentication, and policy as code.

Why CHAOS?

  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
  • Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
  • Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
  • Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
  • Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $140,000 - 240,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

descriptionHtml:
CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Engineer – Platform Engineering (Cloud Engineer) is responsible for building and managing Chipotle’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure, with a focus on automation and scalability. You will implement and maintain core platform services (such as cloud resources, servers, and CI/CD pipelines) that power our restaurants and enterprise systems. By utilizing Infrastructure-as-Code and robust monitoring, you’ll drive improvements in reliability, performance, and security. This role plays a key part in Chipotle’s modernization initiatives, contributing to cloud adoption and platform innovation in line with our Infrastructure Strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Configure, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS) and on-prem servers, ensuring systems are set up following best practices for security and performance.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code templates and CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Terraform scripts, Azure DevOps tasks) to automate provisioning and configuration of resources.
  • AI & Automation: Comfortable leveraging leading LLMs and hybrid AI models to accelerate engineering work, including generating and validating Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripts, automation, and troubleshooting workflows.
  • Implement and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for platform components to quickly detect issues and optimize system performance
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues (network, OS, or cloud service problems), working with cross-functional teams to restore service and identify root causes.
  • Research and introduce new technologies or tools (containers, configuration management, AIOps platforms) that can improve infrastructure efficiency, scalability, or cost-effectiveness.


What You’ll Bring To The Table

  • Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) from 4-year college or university.
  • 3-5 year’s experience
  • Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS), virtualization, and containerization, along with a strong grasp of core infrastructure components (servers, storage, networks, security).
  • Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g. Terraform, PowerShell, CI/CD pipelines) to build and manage infrastructure as code, driving consistency and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with leading LLMs and AI coding tools, including using AI to generate, review, and validate Infrastructure as Code and automation, plus an understanding of hybrid AI architectures.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for infrastructure issues – able to dissect complex problems under pressure and implement reliable solutions.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally (e.g. with developers, support teams) and clearly document technical processes.
  • A security-minded and detail-oriented approach – you follow best practices for cloud governance, identity/access management, and compliance in everything you build.


PAY TRANSPARENCY

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $87,000.00–$120,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. descriptionHtml:
Why AIS?

When you join AIS, you’re joining a mission-driven team that’s passionate about making a difference. You’ll work on projects that matter, alongside industry-leading experts, in an environment that fosters innovation, driving client success, and empowering our team to make a lasting impact. As an employee-owned company, we value collaboration, inclusivity, continuous growth, and shared success.

  • Employee Ownership: Your contributions directly impact the company’s success, and you share in its achievements.
  • Continuous Learning: Access to resources, training, and mentorship to support your professional growth.
  • Inclusive Culture: A workplace where diversity is celebrated, and everyone’s voice is valued.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Engage in projects that make a meaningful difference for our clients and communities.

What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

Working@AIS

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Infrastructure Architect.

  • Core Knowledge & Skills: Architects scalable, resilient solutions; authors roadmaps and blueprints; integrates diverse components; advances automation (PowerShell/Python/Ansible) and governance/policy.
  • Work & Complexity: Leads architectural initiatives, establishes performance benchmarks, integrates systems at scale, researches emerging tech, and mitigates enterprise risk.
  • Quality & Independence: Ensures integrity, scalability, and cost/performance optimization; produces comprehensive design artifacts; sets and enforces standards with broad autonomy.
  • Teamwork & Communication: Leads architectural teams, builds strategic partnerships, institutionalizes knowledge management, and communicates designs and executive‑ready reports.
  • Consulting & Engagement: Delivers architectural consulting aligned to business strategy, proposes enterprise technologies, nurtures vendor alliances, and seeds new project opportunities.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Senior AWS Cloud Systems Engineer.

Project Summary

AIS is seeking an AWS Cloud Systems Engineer for an exciting opportunity to apply your expertise in a large-scale, multi-cloud environment spanning AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, supporting a critical mission focused on improving system resiliency, security, and cost effectiveness. In this hands-on technical role, you will design, develop, deploy, and support scalable, cloud-native solutions while applying best practices across architecture, development, operations, and security. You will support solutions throughout the full lifecycle, from design, development, testing, and integration through production deployment, sustainment, and maintenance. You will work directly with cloud technologies to architect, build, troubleshoot, automate, and optimize solutions, while also providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide cloud operations and engineering support to enhance, sustain, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure AWS cloud environments.
  • Perform AWS cloud operations, sustainment, and maintenance activities to maintain optimum cloud performance, security, and user experience.
  • Develop cloud strategy and roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives and technical requirements.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging cloud technologies to maximize automation, and assess their potential impact on organizational and program goals.
  • Drive adoption of DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and automation frameworks.
  • Optimize application performance and reliability in cloud environments.
  • Support the design, implementation, and sustainment of secure cloud architectures implementing zero-trust principles and defense-in-depth strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, etc.) and regulatory requirements.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain cloud networking security controls, including STIG requirements.
  • Implement identity and access management solutions and security monitoring frameworks.
  • Facilitate customer onboarding and implement a consistent pathway to cloud adoption.
  • Assess legacy systems and design modernization strategies, including containerization and microservices.
  • Support development of migration methodologies and ensure minimal organizational disruption during transitions.
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments, networking, VPNs, IaaS, PaaS, and SQL systems.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD workflows and infrastructure-as-code development using Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Jira, Confluence, Artifactory, and Guacamole to support DevSecOps practices.
  • Containerize applications to enhance scalability and deployment efficiency.
  • Support the design and development of Shared Services.
  • Configure and troubleshoot cloud, virtual, and physical hardware and software.

Required For This Opportunity

  • Certifications: IAT-2 and one or more AWS cloud certifications.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience: 12 years of relevant experience, or 10 years of experience with a Master’s Degree.
  • Clearance: Active Secret Clearance
  • Experience working across multiple cloud platforms.

Nice To Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud in addition to AWS.
  • Experience with Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Artifactory, and Guacamole in DevSecOps environments.
  • Experience with containerization, microservices, and legacy system modernization.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and STIG compliance requirements.
  • Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

At AIS, we are committed to offering competitive and fair compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and contributions of each team member. The targeted base salary range for this role is $138,000-$209,000 per year. Please note that this range is provided as a guideline and the final offer will be based on several factors, including but not limited to, skillset and competencies, level of experience, education, certifications, and location. We value transparency in our hiring process and are happy to discuss how your unique qualifications align with our compensation structure during the interview process.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Senior AWS Cloud Systems Engineer.

Project Summary

AIS is seeking an AWS Cloud Systems Engineer for an exciting opportunity to apply your expertise in a large-scale, multi-cloud environment spanning AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, supporting a critical mission focused on improving system resiliency, security, and cost effectiveness. You will support solutions throughout the full lifecycle, from design, development, testing, and integration through production deployment, sustainment, and maintenance. You will work directly with cloud technologies to architect, build, troubleshoot, automate, and optimize solutions, while also providing technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

- Develop cloud strategy and roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives and technical requirements.
-  Continuously evaluate emerging cloud technologies to maximize automation, and assess their potential impact on organizational and program goals.
- Drive adoption of DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and automation frameworks.
- Optimize application performance and reliability in cloud environments.
- Support the design, implementation, and sustainment of secure cloud architectures implementing zero-trust principles and defense-in-depth strategies.

- Architect, implement, and maintain cloud networking security controls, including STIG requirements.
- Implement identity and access management solutions and security monitoring frameworks.
- Facilitate customer onboarding and implement a consistent pathway to cloud adoption.
- Assess legacy systems and design modernization strategies, including containerization and microservices.
- Support development of migration methodologies and ensure minimal organizational disruption during transitions.
- Manage and optimize AWS environments, networking, VPNs, IaaS, PaaS, and SQL systems.
- Implement and maintain CI/CD workflows and infrastructure-as-code development using Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Jira, Confluence, Artifactory, and Guacamole to support DevSecOps practices.
- Containerize applications to enhance scalability and deployment efficiency.
- Support the design and development of Shared Services.

Required For This Opportunity



- Certifications: IAT-2 and one or more AWS cloud certifications.

- Experience working across multiple cloud platforms.

Nice To Have Skills



- Hands-on experience with Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud in addition to AWS.
- Experience with Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Artifactory, and Guacamole in DevSecOps environments.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

The Integrated Solutions Business Unit is hiring a TMF Cloud Engineer to operate the cloud infrastructure layer of our Tactical Mission Fabric (TMF) program.

TMF is a multi-tenant network-as-a-service platform that delivers secure, globally interconnected managed networking to DoD mission owners. This is a hands-on cloud engineering role, not an architecture-only seat and not a generalist IT role. Working alongside the Lead Systems Engineer, you will build, deploy, and operate the AWS infrastructure that TMF tenants run on: landing zones, networking, identity, security telemetry, and tenant compute, all inside a continuous authorization boundary where every configuration maps to a FedRAMP and NIST control. We're looking for a cloud engineer who has operated production AWS in a regulated environment: someone fluent in Terraform-driven multi-account design who understands that in a FedRAMP boundary, the audit trail is as important as the uptime.

The day-to-day

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (Hands-On)

  • Multi-Account AWS Operations: Build and operate multi-account, multi-partition AWS architectures spanning GovCloud (IL4/IL5), Secret Region (IL6), and commercial partitions, with tenant isolation enforced by architecture, not by policy alone.
  • Landing Zones: Maintain and extend AWS landing zones for tenant and shared-service segmentation, including account vending, guardrails, service control policies, and CloudTrail/Config baselines, under the direction of the Lead Systems Engineer.
  • Cloud Networking: Engineer cloud networking: Transit Gateway, Direct Connect Gateway, Global Accelerator, VPC spoke topologies, PrivateLink, and AWS Network Firewall, integrated with the MPLS backbone and SD-WAN overlay at NNI boundary points.
  • IaC-First Delivery: Author and extend Terraform modules for cloud infrastructure. Every change flows through Terraform Enterprise and GitLab CI/CD with policy gates; no direct-to-production applies.
  • Tenant Compute: Deploy and operate tenant compute and workspace services, including AWS WorkSpaces VDI in STIG-hardened configurations and tenant account guardrails.


Security, Identity, and Compliance in the Cloud

  • Identity and Access: Operate the identity stack: AWS IAM Identity Center, AD Connector, self-managed Active Directory, and PrivacyIDEA RADIUS MFA.
  • Security Telemetry and SIEM: Engineer security telemetry into the centralized OpenSearch SIEM, integrating Security Hub, GuardDuty, and Nessus/Tenable findings to sustain continuous monitoring under the platform's C-ATO posture.
  • Hardening and Evidence: Apply and maintain KMS CMK encryption baselines, AWS Backup vaults, and STIG/CIS hardening across cloud workloads; produce configuration evidence that maps to NIST 800-53 Rev 5 and 800-171 controls.
  • Accreditation Support: Support FedRAMP Moderate and CMMC Level 2 assessments with cloud-layer artifacts, POA&M inputs, and continuous monitoring data.


Team and Platform Contribution

  • Integration Partnership: Work alongside the Lead Systems Engineer and network engineering team to keep cloud, network, and security layers integrated at every boundary.
  • Tenant Onboarding: Execute tenant onboarding runbooks for the cloud layer: account provisioning, boundary controls, telemetry enrollment, and operational handoff to GCC/CSOC.
  • Runbooks and Improvement: Contribute to the structured runbook catalog for security, platform, and recovery operations, and feed operational lessons back into Terraform modules and landing zone baselines.


What You'll Need

Required (Day-One Critical)

  • Hands-on production AWS experience: VPC, IAM, EC2, S3, CloudTrail, Config, and multi-account structures
  • Terraform module authoring and GitOps discipline in a production environment
  • AWS networking: Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPC topologies, route tables, security groups, and hybrid connectivity to carrier or MPLS backbones
  • Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-bound cloud environment (FedRAMP, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent), where configurations map to NIST 800-53 / 800-171 controls
  • Familiarity with cloud security tooling: SIEM integration, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation beyond Terraform
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or DevSecOps roles, with at least 2 years hands-on in AWS
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent operational experience
  • US Citizenship required
  • Active DoD Secret clearance required
  • Ability to travel up to 15%


Strongly Preferred (90-Day Ramp)

  • AWS GovCloud-specific experience, including partition constraints and IL4/IL5 boundary operations
  • AWS multi-account governance at scale: Organizations, SCPs, Control Tower or custom landing zone frameworks, account vending automation
  • Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud workflow experience with policy-as-code gates (Sentinel, OPA, or similar)
  • GitLab CI/CD pipeline development for infrastructure delivery
  • Identity stack experience: IAM Identity Center, Active Directory integration, RADIUS/MFA solutions (PrivacyIDEA or equivalent)
  • OpenSearch/Elasticsearch SIEM administration, plus Security Hub, GuardDuty, and Tenable/Nessus integration
  • AWS WorkSpaces or VDI deployment in hardened configurations
  • KMS, AWS Backup, and encryption baseline engineering


What Will Help You On The Job

  • AWS Secret Region (IL6) or Top Secret Region experience, or other classified cloud operations
  • AWS certifications: Solutions Architect Professional, Security Specialty, Advanced Networking Specialty, or SysOps
  • Experience integrating cloud infrastructure with SD-WAN overlays and NGFW boundary security (FortiGate, Palo Alto)
  • Cloud broker or multi-cloud service delivery experience
  • Container and edge compute platforms (EKS, AWS Outposts, or forward compute architectures)
  • DoD 8140/8570 baseline certification (Security+, CASP+, CISSP, or equivalent)
  • TS/SCI clearance currently held
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP or CMMC assessments with technical artifacts


Salary range

$120,500.00 - $190,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $149,500.00- $224,500.00/ annually

Why WWT?


At World Wide Technology, we work together to make a new world happen. Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. WWT is dedicated to achieving its mission of creating a profitable growth company that is also a Great Place to Work for All. We achieve this through our world-class culture, generous benefits and by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients.


Founded in 1990, WWT is a global technology solutions provider leading the AI and Digital Revolution. WWT combines the power of strategy, execution and partnership to accelerate digital transformational outcomes for organizations around the globe. Through its Advanced Technology Center, a collaborative ecosystem of the world's most advanced hardware and software solutions, WWT helps clients and partners conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology solutions for the best business outcomes and then deploys them at scale through its global warehousing, distribution and integration capabilities.


With over 12,000 employees across WWT and Softchoice and more than 60 locations around the world, WWT's culture, built on a set of core values and established leadership philosophies, has been recognized 14 years in a row by Fortune and Great Place to Work® for its unique blend of determination, innovation and creating a great place to work for all.


Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!


What is the Government Services Team and why join?

Our Government Services team provides cleared resources with a global reach to federal civilian, Department of Defense (DoD), and intelligence community markets. We excel at delivering innovative, operationally ready, and cost-effective IT solutions that accelerate the interoperability and resiliency of mission-critical systems.


What will you be doing?

WWT is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer (AI Integration) supports advanced AI/ML workloads by designing secure, scalable cloud environments across multi enclave and high security settings.

This role builds and optimizes cloud infrastructure for distributed model training, high performance compute, and low latency inference. The engineer enhances automation practices, standardizes processes across teams, and strengthens secure cloud operations.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement cloud architectures optimized for AI/ML compute, storage, and networking needs.
  • Automate cloud infrastructure using DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
  • Integrate public cloud platforms with on premises hyperconverged systems and accelerator hardware.
  • Support secure, high availability operations for classified or mission critical AI applications.
  • Manage container orchestration platforms and ensure efficient multi tenant operations.
  • Implement data and model governance practices to maintain secure AI pipelines.


Knowledge/Skill Description:

  • Extensive experience with modern frontend frameworks, backend technologies, APIs, and relational/non-relational databases.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, system integration, and scalable application design.
  • Experience with secure development practices, DevSecOps methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in database design, performance optimization, and application troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and establish development standards across teams.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • minimum Top Secret (TS) with eligibility to access SCI material
  • 8+ years of experience
  • Knowledge of cloud engineering, infrastructure, or related technical roles.
  • Hands on experience with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML compute environments, distributed systems, or HPC.
  • Skills in IaC (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation) and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and cloud networking/storage optimization.
  • Strong understanding of secure cloud practices and multi enclave operations.
  • Effective communication and cross team collaboration skills.
