Location Detail: 9 Farm Springs Rd Farmington (10566)

Work where every moment matters.

Every day, over 40,000 Hartford HealthCare colleagues come to work with one thing in common: Pride in what we do, knowing every moment matters here. We invite you to become part of Connecticut’s most comprehensive healthcare network.

The creation of the HHC System Support Office recognizes the work of a large and growing group of employees whose responsibilities are continually evolving so that we and our departments now work on behalf of the system as a whole, rather than a single member organization.

With the creation of our new umbrella organization we now have our own identity with a unique payroll, benefits, performance management system, service recognition programs and other common practices across the system.

Position Summary

Hartford Healthcare’s (HHC) cloud technology is an integral part of our digital transformation strategy. Our aim for cloud strategy is agility, efficiency, and a foundation that is integrated, scalable and sustainable.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for contributing to the design and management of HHC’s cloud systems, applications, policies, and strategy. You will develop and modify scalable architecture to support applications and infrastructure on IaaS and PaaS platforms. You will incorporate security management and privacy requirements into cloud hardware, software, and applications. Additionally, you will maintain up-to-date and extensive knowledge of cloud products and technology.

In this role, you may work with stakeholders across the organization to evaluate cloud systems and identify appropriate solutions. You will provide second- and third-level support across all server system platforms, ensuring SLA's and KPI's are met for service recovery and order fulfillment. You should have a deep understanding of cloud networking, storage, and compute; knowledgeable with both cloud-native and cloud-hosted services; and experience operating in dynamic and complex environments. Experience with High Performance Computing (HPC) is also required. As the Cloud Engineer, you will provide the required expertise to build and operate products with reliability and resiliency while iteratively improving service levels with automation, monitoring, and alerting tools using both cloud ecosystems and various enterprise applications.

This position reports to the Manager, Systems Engineering.

Position Responsibilities

Key Areas of Responsibility

Working independently and in collaboration with system engineers, developers, application, and security teams to architect, deploy, and maintain hybrid, multi-cloud environment (IaaS, PaaS, etc.) with consideration to application performance, uptime, security, scalability, cost optimization and business continuity.

Develop, deploy and maintain monitoring, orchestration, automation, and configuration management tools in alignment with DevSecOps strategy.

Responsible for day-to-day cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting, including Cloud to on-prem related system issues

Document infrastructure design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other best practice guidance and strategies.

Educate and mentor others on Cloud technologies and initiatives to jointly define, document, and enforce cloud architecture best practices; availability, redundancy schemes, performance, disaster recovery based on business unit requirements.

Working Relationships

This Job Reports To (Job Title): Manager, Systems Engineering

Qualifications

Requirements and Specifications:

Education

  • Minimum: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or Computer Science OR the equivalent of 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Experience

  • Minimum:
  • 3 years of experience in the field of cloud computing.
  • 5+ years of core systems engineering experience.
  • 3+ years working with API's/IaC/Scripting to interconnect various applications and build workflows to provide efficient user lifecycle management.
  • Windows and Linux operating systems in a server environment.
  • Experience with third-party tools, such as Docker, Kubernetes, Snowflake and Ansible.
  • Preferred:
  • 5+ years of experience in the field of cloud computing, specifically with Google Cloud Platform.
  • 6-10 years of core systems engineering experience.
  • 3+ years creating API's/IaC/Scripting to interconnect various applications and build workflows to provide efficient user lifecycle management.
  • Windows and Linux operating systems in a server environment.
  • Terraform
  • Experience with third-party tools, such as Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud, Snowflake and Ansible.

Licensure, Certification, Registration

  • Minimum: Professional Cloud Technical certification (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Preferred:
  • Professional Cloud Advanced Technical certification (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP)
  • Microsoft MCSE Server 2016

Language Skills

  • English

Knowledge, Skills And Ability Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills with emphasis on the ability to communicate effectively through clear, concise delivery coupled with listening attentively, valuing others’ perspectives, creating open dialogue in own areas of influence, and effectively conveying technical information to non-technical personnel.
  • Good writing skills with the ability to write with accuracy, simplicity, and completeness while providing an appropriate level of detail for the intended audience.
  • Ability to gain the confidence and trust of others through principled business ethics, high integrity, follow-through on commitments, and adherence to procedures.
  • Ability to establish relationships that enhance cooperation and collaboration.
  • Ability to work in a remote team environment. Self-driven, organized and motivated to deliver results.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively under minimal supervision.
  • Ability to organize and facilitate planning and demonstrations.
  • Ability to work under pressure and stressful situations.
  • Ability to trouble-shoot problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.
  • Exercises independent judgment and decision-making, trouble-shooting diverse and complex issues ranging from moderate to substantial.
  • Expert level knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems.
  • In-depth knowledge of various IT systems including email, identity, system monitoring, and device management
  • Experience with High Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Participates in on-call rotation
  • Possess a strong attention to detail.
  • Possess strong organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills as well as a drive for continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with recognizing, mitigating, and assessing probability of risks.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft productivity applications including: Outlook, Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint. You should be well-versed in performing data extracts, imports, exports, merges, lookups, graphing/charting, and formatting.
  • Working knowledge and Background in meeting security compliance such as HIPAA, HiTrust, ISO, and PCI
  • Ability to travel occasionally as required. Typical travel to Farmington, CT home office quarterly.
  • Work from home requirements:
  • Reliable internet. A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 25x10 (25mpbs download x 10mpbs upload) is required.
  • A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

We take great care of careers.

With locations around the state, Hartford HealthCare offers exciting opportunities for career development and growth. Here, you are part of an organization on the cutting edge – helping to bring new technologies, breakthrough treatments and community education to countless men, women and children. We know that a thriving organization starts with thriving employees-- we provide a competitive benefits program designed to ensure work/life balance. Every moment matters. And this is your moment.

descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

The Senior Cloud Engineer is a technical leader within the Cloud Engineering organization, responsible for designing, building, and evolving secure, scalable, and highly automated cloud platforms across a multi-cloud environment. This role plays a critical part in defining cloud standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices that enable product teams to deliver reliable, well‑architected solutions at scale.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands‑on cloud engineering expertise, strong Infrastructure as Code and automation skills, and the ability to influence platform direction through technical mentorship, and architectural contributions.

Role Responsibilities

Cloud Engineering & Architecture

Design, implement, and evolve cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, aligning with enterprise architecture principles and security standards.

Lead the development and maintenance of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar tools, ensuring consistency, scalability, and reusability.

Own and enhance reusable cloud modules, patterns, and reference architectures used across the organization.

Partner with architects and senior stakeholders to define secure, resilient, and cost‑efficient cloud designs.

Review and provide guidance on cloud designs and IaC contributions from other engineers.

Platform Automation & Tooling

Design and implement end‑to‑end automation for cloud provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.

Lead improvements to CI/CD and IaC automation pipelines using platforms such as Spacelift, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tooling.

Drive initiatives to improve deployment reliability, reduce configuration drift, and increase platform self‑service.

Evaluate and introduce new tooling or approaches that improve developer experience and platform maturity.

Security, Compliance & Operations

Define and enforce cloud guardrails, policies, and controls to ensure secure and compliant platforms.

Integrate security and compliance requirements into IaC and automation workflows (policy as code).

Establish and improve observability, monitoring, and alerting for cloud platforms.

Lead troubleshooting efforts for complex cloud infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis for incidents.

Collaborate with security, risk, and compliance teams to support audits, regulatory requirements, and governance initiatives.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Act as a technical mentor for Cloud Engineers, supporting skill development and engineering best practices.

Collaborate closely with application teams, SRE, security, and architecture to deliver end‑to‑end cloud solutions.

Drive platform modernization initiatives, identifying opportunities to automate, optimize, standardize, and simplify.

Contribute to technical documentation, standards, and knowledge sharing to uplift cloud engineering maturity.

Participate in architectural discussions and influence platform strategy through well‑reasoned technical proposals.

Basic Qualifications

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 4 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 2 years of experience; OR a PhD with 0+ years of experience; OR as associate's degree with 8 years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 10 years of relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of hands‑on cloud or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with production‑scale experience.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform strongly preferred).
  • Strong automation and scripting skills (Python strongly preferred).
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, security, and cloud‑native services.
  • Experience working in global, cross‑functional engineering environments.
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives and make architectural decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of hands on cloud or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with production scale experience.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform strongly preferred).
  • Strong automation and scripting skills (Python strongly preferred).
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, security, and cloud native services.
  • Experience working in global, cross functional engineering environments.
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives and make architectural decisions.
  • Technically curious, self driven, and committed to continuous improvement.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical mindset, especially for complex cloud systems.
  • Comfortable operating with high ownership and autonomy.
  • Able to influence technical direction and mentor others through collaboration and clear communication.
  • Customer focused mindset with the ability to balance engineering excellence and business outcomes.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $99,200.00 to $165,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 12.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

Sunshine Act

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

EEO & Employment Eligibility

Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Role Summary

The Senior Cloud Engineer is a technical leader within the Cloud Engineering organization, responsible for designing, building, and evolving secure, scalable, and highly automated cloud platforms across a multi-cloud environment. This role plays a critical part in defining cloud standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices that enable product teams to deliver reliable, well‑architected solutions at scale.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands‑on cloud engineering expertise, strong Infrastructure as Code and automation skills, and the ability to influence platform direction through technical mentorship, and architectural contributions.

Role Responsibilities

Cloud Engineering & Architecture

Design, implement, and evolve cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, aligning with enterprise architecture principles and security standards.

Lead the development and maintenance of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar tools, ensuring consistency, scalability, and reusability.

Own and enhance reusable cloud modules, patterns, and reference architectures used across the organization.

Partner with architects and senior stakeholders to define secure, resilient, and cost‑efficient cloud designs.

Review and provide guidance on cloud designs and IaC contributions from other engineers.

Platform Automation & Tooling

Design and implement end‑to‑end automation for cloud provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.

Lead improvements to CI/CD and IaC automation pipelines using platforms such as Spacelift, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tooling.

Drive initiatives to improve deployment reliability, reduce configuration drift, and increase platform self‑service.

Evaluate and introduce new tooling or approaches that improve developer experience and platform maturity.

Security, Compliance & Operations

Define and enforce cloud guardrails, policies, and controls to ensure secure and compliant platforms.

Integrate security and compliance requirements into IaC and automation workflows (policy as code).

Establish and improve observability, monitoring, and alerting for cloud platforms.

Lead troubleshooting efforts for complex cloud infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis for incidents.

Collaborate with security, risk, and compliance teams to support audits, regulatory requirements, and governance initiatives.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Act as a technical mentor for Cloud Engineers, supporting skill development and engineering best practices.

Collaborate closely with application teams, SRE, security, and architecture to deliver end‑to‑end cloud solutions.

Drive platform modernization initiatives, identifying opportunities to automate, optimize, standardize, and simplify.

Contribute to technical documentation, standards, and knowledge sharing to uplift cloud engineering maturity.

descriptionHtml:
Cloud Engineer

Location: Eglin Air Force Base, Florida (Onsite)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Security Clearance: Active Secret Required

Salary: $110,000–$180,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

About The Opportunity

The JAAW Group LLC, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), is seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer to support mission-critical Department of Defense cloud infrastructure onsite at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with cloud technologies, solving technical challenges, and keeping critical systems running smoothly. We're looking for someone with strong, hands-on Kubernetes experience who can confidently deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized environments. While experience with additional cloud and DevOps technologies is valuable, we're most interested in candidates who have practical experience working with Kubernetes and understand how to diagnose and resolve technical issues.

What You'll Do

  • Deploy, configure, manage, and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments and containerized workloads.
  • Diagnose and resolve Kubernetes issues involving Pods, deployments, networking, storage, and configurations.
  • Support cloud infrastructure and help maintain secure, reliable systems.
  • Work with automation tools, scripting, and CI/CD pipelines to support deployments and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with engineering and cybersecurity teams to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance or higher.
  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Professional, hands-on Kubernetes experience, including deploying, managing, and troubleshooting workloads in production or other operational environments.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals, including Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and configuration management.
  • Ability to independently investigate and troubleshoot Kubernetes deployment failures, Pod issues, and related technical problems.
  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, or DevOps practices.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite at Eglin Air Force Base.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • CompTIA Security+ or CISSP certification, or the ability and willingness to obtain the required certification after hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, or comparable Kubernetes platforms.
  • Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, GitLab CI, or similar automation and deployment tools.
  • Kubernetes cluster administration, security, monitoring, or lifecycle management.
  • Previous experience supporting Department of Defense or federal government environments.

The JAAW Group offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Paid time off and paid sick leave
  • Paid holidays
  • Employer-paid life insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Voluntary supplemental insurance options

descriptionHtml:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Sound like the place for you? Join us!

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for Cboe’s Cloud Operations team. The Cloud Operations team is responsible for building and operating Cboe’s cloud-based applications, including products supporting clearing, exchange, and data solutions platforms. This role is focused on designing, automating, and operating infrastructure solutions for cloud-native applications. Senior Cloud Engineers are expected to lead project delivery, shape team processes and technical standards, and raise the technical depth of the engineers around them. 

You bring breadth across infrastructure disciplines, including network design, system administration, storage management, security policy implementation, virtualization, and process automation. You apply it to build secure cloud infrastructure, support application runtime environments, and collaborate with engineers at all levels. You are proactive in diagnosing complex technical issues and own the automation the team depends on. 

Your responsibilities will be:

  • Build and maintain a globally distributed cloud infrastructure platform using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • Collaborate with Cloud Platform Engineering and business unit application teams to engineer infrastructure solutions for their cloud-based applications
  • Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and workloads (EKS, Cluster API), including GitOps workflows (e.g., Argo CD)
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
  • Perform system and database maintenance, including application deployment, backup and restoration, patching, and upgrades
  • Maintain cloud environments through incident response, troubleshooting, and performance tuning
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support operational readiness
  • Drive retrospectives to identify opportunities to improve platform scalability and supportability
  • Lead implementation of cloud infrastructure projects from design through delivery
  • Own complex workstreams end-to-end — scope, sequencing, and hand-off to operations
  • Communicate status, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Lead design discussions and reviews, and provide technical direction and feedback to other engineers
  • Define and evolve the patterns and standards that keep the platform consistent and maintainable
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are secure and compliant
  • Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation — infrastructure designs, standard operating procedures, and support runbooks — tailored to the target audience (e.g., engineers, support staff)

The ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of experience working with public cloud platforms (AWS and GCP preferred) in a professional setting. 
  • Deep, hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes (EKS, GKE) and GitOps (Argo CD). 
  • Deep, hands-on experience using Terraform, CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and scripting languages (Python) to deploy, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strong experience supporting containerized applications and Linux-based systems. 
  • Strong understanding of networking, IAM, cloud observability, and common cloud services such as AWS VPC, EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, and Lambda. 
  • Familiarity with managing secrets and sensitive configuration using tools such as HashiCorp Vault. 
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating fault-tolerant systems with on-call responsibilities. 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including working effectively with engineers, security, and operations teams. 
  • Interest in continuous learning and in developing the engineers around you. 

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days
  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services
  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire
  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office
  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities
  • Generous charitable giving company match
  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits
  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

More About Cboe

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed. We celebrate the diversity in our communities, inside and out, and welcome new perspectives with equity, inclusion and belonging.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our associates' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $119,000-$154,000 in Kansas, $130,900-$169,400 in Chicago, and $148,750-$192,500 in New York, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama, with additional offices in Ohio and Florida, the company delivers solutions through modeling and simulation, software development, and advanced testing. With decades of expertise in multiphysics simulations, engineering design, and applied research, CFD Research has translated ideas into patented technologies, real-world applications, and mission-focused results for government and industry partners. As a 100% employee-owned company, CFD Research combines technical excellence with a collaborative culture to drive innovation and impact.
companySlogan: Delivering Breakthrough Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About CFD Research: Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. CFD Research has earned multiple national awards for successful application and commercialization of innovative component/system technology prototypes, multi-physics simulation software, multi-disciplinary analyses, and expert support services. Based in Huntsville, Alabama where laboratory facilities and headquarters are located, CFD Research also has office and laboratory facilities in Dayton, Ohio, prototyping test and evaluation facilities in Hollywood, Alabama, and office facilities in Fort Walton Beach, Florida. CFD Research is an ISO9001:AS9100D registered company and is appraised at CMMI Level II for Services. CFD Research is a 100% ESOP (employee-owned company) recognized in Inc. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at www.cfd-research.com

CFD Research is seeking a Cloud Solutions Engineer. In this role, you will design and implement resilient cloud architecture-based solutions, leveraging AWS and modern cloud technologies to host, scale, and optimize performance for complex test infrastructure, test environments, and research applications. The selected engineer will work closely with cross-functional research and software teams, applying robust network engineering and modern cloud engineering methodologies to enhance test automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable cloud architecture-based solutions to support continuous testing and research initiatives.
  • Leverage AWS services and modern cloud tooling to build out infrastructure and optimize the performance of distributed cloud applications and data pipelines.
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to research and test development teams for onboarding and executing complex, high-throughput applications in the cloud.
  • Architect and configure robust cloud networking environments, secure VPC topologies, subnets, routing, and access control policies compliant with DoD security standards.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps engineers to integrate cloud-hosted resources with automated CI/CD build, testing, and telemetry frameworks.

Qualifications & Desired Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing cloud architectures using Amazon Web Services (AWS) or equivalent cloud service providers.
  • Strong foundational background in network engineering, including IP routing, DNS, VPC configuration, firewalls, and secure network segmentation.
  • Proven understanding of cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles (e.g., Terraform or AWS CloudFormation), and software engineering methodologies.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary research or defense engineering teams in migrating, hosting, and optimizing complex software workloads.
  • Candidate must be a US Citizen

SUMMARY/JOB PURPOSE (Basic Purpose Of The Job)

The Senior Staff Engineer – Cloud Platform will support the design and creation of cloud-based products and services to meet the technology needs of Exelixis. This position will help define and design our cloud platform, which includes cloud automation tools and standards, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling and AWS account provisioning automation. This position will also work with application support teams to re-define the interface between our cloud platform products and application installation and configuration processes.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Product Road Map:

  • Develop technical solutions to complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity.
  • Understands key business processes and business areas.

Product Development & Delivery

  • Guides the successful completion of major initiatives or programs and lead mid to large size complex projects.
  • Lead end-to-end development processes, from ideation through CI/CD, security scanning, and production monitoring.
  • Identify and implement improvements to overall processes and development procedures.
  • Develops and applies complex and often long-term strategies on specific projects.
  • Represents the department as the prime technical contact on contracts and projects.
  • Exhibits broad knowledge of state-of-the-art engineering principles and theories.

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Translates overall direction and strategy and communicates across organizational levels and functions.
  • Works on strategic initiatives.
  • Interacts with senior external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations.

Operational Excellence, Quality & Compliance

  • Document infrastructure and work instructions for systems and applications, including architecture diagrams, runbooks and code-level commits / READMEs.
  • Lead and own incident response and root cause analysis for high-impact issues.
  • Ensure that completed work delivers long-term value, including the aspects of maintainability, performance and observability.
  • Make decisions regarding access, permissions, and security controls across systems.

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the SME for assigned capabilities, providing technical leadership and guidance.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering technical growth and best practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No supervisory responsibilities.

Education

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Master's degree in a relevant field and 7 years of experience; or
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and 9 years of related experience; or
  • Associate degree and 11 years of experience; or
  • Equivalent combination of education or years of experience
  • Technical certification may be required

Experience

  • At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure in a highly available and production environment.
  • Experience working in a SOX and FDA regulated environment is a plus.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing and supporting AWS infrastructure, including EC2, VPC, S3, EBS, Route 53, IAM, KMS, load balancing, and Auto Scaling.
  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform.
  • Experience developing and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash, with the ability to develop operational automation.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Advanced level knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS), especially with services related to hosting: EC2, RDS, Systems Manager, IAM, etc.
  • Advanced level knowledge with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools, especially Terraform.
  • Intermediate level knowledge with cloud and infrastructure automation.

Location: Alameda, CA Range for this position: $190,000 - $239,500 The base pay offered will take into account job-related knowledge, skills, experience and internal equity, among other factors.

In addition to the base salary, as part of our Total Rewards program, Exelixis offers comprehensive employee benefits package, including a 401k plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts. Employees are also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus program, or if field sales staff, a sales-based incentive plan. Exelixis also offers employees the opportunity to purchase company stock, and receive long-term incentives, 15 accrued vacation days in their first year, 17 paid holidays including a company-wide winter shutdown in December, and up to 10 sick days throughout the calendar year.

Staff Infrastructure Engineer (AWS / Kubernetes / Terraform)

New York City, 4 - 5 days Onsite | $230,000 – $280,000 Base + Equity


Want to lead a production AWS platform through a major infrastructure upgrade and take ownership of how it scales, runs and recovers?


We’re looking for a Staff Infrastructure Engineer to join a fast-growing, VC-backed software company building AI products for enterprise finance teams. Its platform automates critical business workflows and needs to support a growing customer base, higher transaction volumes and increasingly complex security requirements.


This is a senior, hands-on engineering role combining infrastructure architecture with day-to-day ownership of production systems. You’ll lead the transition from managed container services to Kubernetes, define how the AWS environment is provisioned and operated, and build the tooling that makes deployments and infrastructure changes safer.


You’ll work directly with engineering leadership and a small platform team to set technical direction and deliver the work yourself. An early priority will be strengthening cloud security and building the infrastructure controls needed to support larger enterprise customers.


The role

  • Own the architecture and evolution of the company’s production AWS infrastructure
  • Lead the migration to Kubernetes and design the platform to handle increasing customer and workload demands
  • Build and operate Kubernetes environments using Terraform, Docker and Helm
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows and infrastructure automation
  • Implement practical cloud security controls to support enterprise and compliance requirements
  • Own production reliability and observability, including metrics, logs, tracing, service-level objectives and alerting
  • Lead incident response and postmortems, and follow through on changes that prevent repeat incidents
  • Work with engineering leadership on architecture, technical trade-offs and long-term scalability
  • Stay hands-on with production code, implementation and troubleshooting


Requirements

  • 7+ years in software engineering, infrastructure engineering or SRE
  • A software engineering background and experience designing and building production infrastructure. Hands-on SRE and DevOps backgrounds are welcome
  • Strong production experience with Terraform and Kubernetes, including Docker and Helm. AWS experience is strongly preferred
  • Experience owning multiple production Kubernetes clusters
  • A track record of building infrastructure from scratch or scaling it through significant growth
  • Experience at a high-growth startup
  • Working knowledge of information security and how to apply it in production


Hands-on coding experience in one of TypeScript, Python, Rust or Java would be particularly useful but not essential, as is experience building observability systems and defining SLIs and SLOs.


Compensation

  • $230,000 – $280,000 base salary
  • Competitive equity
  • Up to 100% coverage of healthcare premiums
  • Unlimited PTO (Paid Time Off)
  • 12 weeks of parental leave
  • Lunch provided daily
  • New York City, 4 - 5 days per week in-office
  • Visa transfers considered


This is an opportunity to take Staff-level ownership of the AWS platform at a growing software company. You’ll make the architecture decisions behind a major Kubernetes migration and stay close to the code, deployments and production systems as the business scales.


If you’re a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing systems and operating them in production, please send your resume to Jennifer Palmer at IT Recruitment Solutions.

In a world of technology, people make the difference. We believe if we invest in great people, then great things will happen. At AnaVation, we provide unmatched value to our customers and employees through innovative solutions and an engaging culture.

Description of Task to be Performed: AnaVation is seeking an experienced cloud engineer to join our high- performing team. This work is onsite in Quantico, VA. You’ll keep a complex hybrid environment running for a mission enterprise application that people depend on every day to do their jobs. That covers AWS commercial accounts, a GitLab CI/CD pipeline across dev, test, and prod, and on-prem hardware that you’ll maintain from the rack up. This is an on-site role, with hybrid options available once you’ve established yourself on the team.

What You’ll Do
  • Maintain and improve AWS commercial infrastructure using infrastructure as code
  • Run and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines in GitLab across dev, test, and prod environments
  • Keep multiple environments stable, consistent, and working as expected
  • Rack, swap, and maintain on-prem servers
  • Patch and update on-prem Debian-based Linux systems
  • Support monitoring and logging so issues are caught before users notice them


This position requires regular on-site presence in Quantico, VA. Applicants who do not currently reside within commuting distance to this location should describe how they would satisfy any onsite requirements.

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in cloud or relevant systems engineering
  • Active TS/SCI clearance, and willingness to complete a CI polygraph
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining AWS infrastructure with infrastructure as code
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments
  • Hands-on experience maintaining physical servers
  • Experience administering and patching Debian-based Linux and Windows systems

  • Terraform
  • ICAM experience
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate or higher
  • GitLab CI
  • Containers (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS)

  • Monitoring and logging tools
  • Ansible

  • 100% company paid dental insurance for employees and dependents
  • 100% company paid long-term and short-term disability insurance

Koniag Technology Solutions, Inc a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Cloud Engineer Architect with a Secret security clearance to support KTS and our government customer in Washington, DC. This position is for a Future New Business Opportunity.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Koniag Technology Solutions, Inc a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced, motivated, and customer-oriented Cloud Engineer/Architect to join our team supporting a large-scale federal enterprise cloud environment servicing more than 10,000 users. The ideal candidate is a skilled cloud professional passionate about technology, committed to continuous learning, and capable of applying deep technical expertise to design, engineer, and maintain secure, scalable cloud solutions.

The Cloud Engineer/Architect will play a key role in the engineering, development, administration, and continuous enhancement of a federal enterprise cloud environment. This individual will design and implement cloud infrastructure solutions, automate migrations, and ensure operational compliance with security and infrastructure standards.

Principal Responsibilities Will Include But Are Not Limited To

  • Participate in technical project review meetings to ensure technical designs meet the client's operational requirements and infrastructure/security standards.
  • Provision and maintain cloud resources for an enterprise cloud environment, including network, storage, and compute infrastructure.
  • Automate infrastructure migrations to cloud environments and identify on-premise technologies and their appropriate cloud counterparts.
  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to support repeatable, scalable deployments. Ensure compliance with incident, problem, and change management procedures, executing ticket-based requests with little or no additional oversight.
  • Support CI/CD pipeline design, automation, and code promotion processes across development environments. Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance, cost, and capacity across the enterprise environment. Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams to translate operational requirements into scalable, secure cloud architectures.
  • Maintain and enhance system documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks. Focus on results and be delivery-oriented, with a keen interest in quality and the ability to consistently meet deadlines.

Required

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • 4+ years of progressive experience administering, designing, and engineering cloud solutions.
  • Valid Driver's License required.

Clearance Requirement

  • Secret DoD Clearance required.

Required Skills And Competencies

  • Sound fundamental knowledge of cloud technology and enterprise IT systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to exercise mature, independent judgment.
  • Experience deploying resources into and running workloads in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Ability to clearly translate technical requirements and concepts in a manner that appeals to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working independently with minimal supervision and guidance.
  • Experience with operating systems and software upgrade planning and implementation.
  • Fundamental knowledge of and experience working in a DevOps-centric environment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, code promotion processes, and related methodologies.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, JSON, YAML, or others.
  • Experience deploying infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation templates, Azure ARM templates, Chef, Terraform, or other automation tools.
  • Ability to maintain a valid Top Secret DoD Clearance throughout employment.
  • Desired Skills and Competencies:
  • Amazon Web Services Associate or Professional Level certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect, Developer, DevOps Engineer, or similar certifications.
  • Experience supporting federal government or DoD cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) and Zero Trust architecture principles.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with security hardening, STIG compliance, and vulnerability remediation in cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting hybrid on-premises and cloud environments with a focus on cost and capacity optimization.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.

The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at accommodations@koniag-gs.com or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Koniag, we apply our proven commercial solutions to a deep knowledge of Defense and Civilian missions to provide forward leaning technical, professional, and operational solutions. KGS enables successful mission outcomes for our customers through solution-oriented business partnerships and a commitment to exceptional service delivery. We ensure long-term success with a continuous improvement approach while balancing the collective interests of our customers, employees, and native communities. For more information, please visit www.koniag-gs.com.

descriptionHtml:
Fluxx is looking for a highly motivated Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Engineering team.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure and pipelines behind the leading grants management software for philanthropy—the platform that connects Donors and Doers. Collaborating closely with Engineering, you'll build, deploy, and secure our infrastructure while playing a key role in setting technical direction. You'll lead projects across CI/CD, our delivery and orchestration platform, and monitoring and logging. You'll also be responsible for infrastructure resilience and cloud costs as part of the team.

We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, intellectually honest, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team—even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

This is a full-time, exempt, and remote position. Candidates must be located in the United States.

Who we are looking for:

  • You debug systems and the processes around them. You are capable of resolving an incident and fixing the conditions that allowed it
  • You work in both software engineering and operations, understanding what runs where and how to configure the infrastructure to smoothly deliver great service to our clients
  • You're pragmatic. You know the vision, and deliver in steady increments toward that vision rather than waiting for perfect
  • You teach and guide teams to better practices. You understand Rome wasn't built in a day
  • You love resolving issues related to latency, scalability, and performance of core infrastructure
  • The thing that really floats your boat is making systems better, not just building new stuff
  • You bring a collaborative educational mindset
  • You want to work with others, learn from them, and teach your experiences
  • You own outcomes, not just tickets. A task is finished when the system is more reliable, not when the PR merges
  • You are a curious, proactive learner who explores emerging technologies and evaluates their practical application within our infrastructure

What you'll do:

  • Automate our infrastructure and operational processes with infrastructure as code and standard tooling
  • Own our CI/CD pipelines, image builds, and GitOps deployments with ArgoCD
  • Keep our fleet patched and current, from OS updates to Kubernetes and managed-service upgrades
  • Build monitoring and alerting that catches problems before customers do
  • Partner with our security team to protect our systems and customer data, support SOC 2 compliance, and work security findings through to their remediation
  • Build self-serve tools for Engineering to reduce bottlenecks and dependencies
  • Work with engineering teams to make our services reliable, secure, and scalable
  • Take part in our on-call rotation for production systems as needed

What you will bring to the team:

  • 4+ years of professional software development and infrastructure operations experience
  • Deep professional experience managing Kubernetes in production, including creating manifest templates for services, deployments, and other application components
  • Significant experience writing and using Terraform code to deploy production infrastructure on AWS
  • Significant experience managing the full lifecycle of AWS services such as EKS, RDS, Elasticsearch, and WAF, including version upgrades, scaling, and failover
  • Familiarity with Azure and cross-cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to streamline development workflows and use them as a force multiplier

Salary:

Fluxx is committed to fair, transparent, and equitable compensation practices. We use a market-based approach that considers cost of labor by geographic region, along with company size and industry benchmarks.

San Francisco Bay Area, New York City

$185,000 - $200,000 (SF/NY)

All other locations

$165,000 - $180,000

The successful candidate's starting salary will be determined based on, but not limited to, (a) location; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

Fluxx is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We take a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. Locations are categorized into one of three zones based on a cost-of-labor index for that geographic location and our compensation philosophy.

Benefits:

Fluxx offers the following benefits for the position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; Flexible time off; Paid sick leave; 12 weeks of fully-paid parental leave; Annual learning and development stipend; Internet stipend; One-time home office set-up stipend; 401(k) retirement plan with company match. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Fluxx's applicable stock plans.

More About Fluxx:

We are a people-first and inclusive workplace committed to continuous learning. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce, and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity, and gender expression of our applicants and employees. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

descriptionHtml:
Premise Health is Different on Purpose

Premise Health serves large organizations and their people with exceptional healthcare. The result? Better experiences, better health, and better value, all while helping organizations lower their healthcare costs.

Premise's mission is to help people get, stay, and be well. Come join us and see for yourself why amazing health starts with amazing healthcare. For more information, visit www.premisehealth.com.

This is a full time, remote, Senior Cloud Services Engineer role.

What You'll Do

  • Provide leadership and oversight with strong understanding of cloud services, DevOps toolsets and platforms including compute, storage, networking, as well as security, governance, monitoring and logging technologies.
  • Drive automation of cloud infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management.
  • Develop and document operational standards that promote DevOps practices such Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD).
  • Provide expertise and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for cloud services.
  • Work with application teams with their digital transformation goals and provide cloud resource deployment orchestration, automation, security, and configuration expertise.
  • Implement and institutionalize cloud security standards, reference architecture’s, patterns, and guidelines for cloud services.
  • Participate in continuous improvement planning for cloud operations, including technology reviews, root cause analysis, action reports analysis, and cloud portfolio review to ensure adequate infrastructure to provide a suitable operating environment(s) for critical applications.
  • Work alongside architects, developers, and engineering team members to provide infrastructure solutions for products and services.
  • Establish and maintain working relationships across disciplines within the organization.
  • Participate in system design planning, review, and implementation to create enterprise solutions built on cloud services.
  • Provide general and routine maintenance support including installation, patching, configuration, backups, and updates.
  • Recommend modifications to systems to improve efficiency, reliability, and performance for delivering application and infrastructure in the cloud.
  • Responsible for participating in IT change management and asset management processes.
  • Work with the IT Security Team, Cloud Services Architect, and the rest of IT concerning any security-related issues.
  • Contribute to research and evaluation and build out of new enterprise technologies.
  • Provides expert guidance and leadership to less-experienced cloud services personnel.
  • May serve as a task or project leader. May consult with executives and customers to deliver complex cloud-based solutions.
  • Stay up to date with technology. Adapt and quickly advance your technical skill sets.
  • Requires occasional work during non-business hours and on weekends.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information-technology, engineering, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • Public cloud certifications preferred, not required.
  • Minimum of (7) seven year of experience in overall IT, with at least five in public cloud management for large organizations.
  • Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments.
  • Experience developing engineering diagrams, strategies, and roadmaps.
  • Experience presenting to senior-level technical executives and technical audiences.
  • Experience securely connecting public cloud resources with on-premises resources.
  • Healthcare industry work experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Detailed understanding of Azure cloud service offerings.
  • Detailed understanding of public cloud engineering principles and strategies, as well as design, implementation, and operational support.
  • Strong understanding across cloud and infrastructure components (compute, storage, network, security, data, and applications) to deliver end-to-end cloud designs and implementations.
  • Detailed understanding of either Windows and/or Linux operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop cloud operating frameworks and documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly motivated and self-directed.
  • Excellent analytical, planning, organizational, and technical skills.
  • Understanding of emerging technology trends/disruptions and their practical application to new and existing technologies.
  • Excellent understanding of application support and development methodologies, infrastructure, and network.
  • Good understanding of product management, agile principles and development methodologies and capability of supporting agile teams by providing guidance on opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
  • Understanding and knowledge of IT standards and controls.
  • Understanding and knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) and Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL).

Work-life balance is at the foundation of how decisions are made and where Premise is headed. We can only help people get, stay, and be well if we do the same for ourselves. In addition to competitive pay, Premise offers full-time team members benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) program with company match, paid holidays and vacation time, a company-sponsored wellness program, EAP, access to virtual primary care and virtual behavioral health at no cost for team members and their dependents. Additional benefits can be viewed here: https://jobs.premisehealth.com/benefits.

Premise is an equal opportunity employer; we value inclusion and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, past, current or prospective service in the uniformed services, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Premise provides its reasonable and genuinely expected range of compensation for this job of $135,000.00 - $150,000.00 annually. A number of factors will influence the rate offered for this position, including your experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other factors.

For individuals living in Washington or Colorado: Premise offers the following paid time off benefits. Employees will earn 0.0692 hours of paid time off per actual hours worked or based on standard schedule, per pay period, and will receive 10 paid holidays or an equivalent bank of hours aligned to schedule throughout the calendar year. Paid sick leave is satisfied by the paid time off accrual, detailed above.

This posting is anticipated to close within 90 days of 10/26/2026.

Should you have questions regarding this job posting, please contact askhr@premisehealth.com.

Bering Straits Native Corporation (BSNC) is an Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA) regional corporation for the Bering Strait and Norton Sound region and is owned by more than 8,000 Alaska Native shareholders. The BSNC region is located in Northwest Alaska and is home to three culturally distinct people: Inupiat, Siberian Yupik and Central Yup'ik. 

BSNC actively pursues responsible development of resources and other business opportunities. Through its subsidiaries, BSNC serves the federal government and commercial customers.   • Seven years of experience in all aspects of cloud computing (compute, storage, platforms, data, and security).

  • Must be a US Citizen.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

  • Strong knowledge of Cloud cost optimization techniques.
  • Experience in one or more automation languages (CLI, Python, Ruby, PowerShell).
  • Strong knowledge of Direct Connect, Private Link, VPN and other Public Cloud connectivity solutions.
  • Thorough understanding of infrastructure automation, CI/CD, networking, storage, and cloud-based delivery models.
  • Strong knowledge in networking and web standards such as DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, HTTP, web security & firewalls.
  • Highly experienced in autoscaling, load balancing and DR cloud computing models.
  • Experience in SSO/Federation.
  • Working knowledge of configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet & Ansible).
  • Thorough understanding of Cloud native, vendor agnostic & cloud ready app development.
  • Thorough understanding of Cloud Governance.
  • Strong working knowledge in cloud monitoring tools, application performance monitoring tools and operational dashboarding.

Preferred

  • Agile development experience.
  • Active SECRET security clearance.

  • This position will not have supervisory responsibilities.

descriptionHtml:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Who you are:

The Senior Cloud Engineer (AI Integration) supports advanced AI/ML workloads by designing secure, scalable cloud environments across multi enclave and high security settings. This role builds and optimizes cloud infrastructure for distributed model training, high performance compute, and low latency inference. The engineer enhances automation practices, standardizes processes across teams, and strengthens secure cloud operations.

What you'll do:

  • Design and implement cloud architectures optimized for AI/ML compute, storage, and networking needs.
  • Automate cloud infrastructure using DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
  • Integrate public cloud platforms with on-premises hyperconverged systems and accelerator hardware.
  • Support secure, high availability operations for classified or mission critical AI applications.
  • Manage container orchestration platforms and ensure efficient multi-tenant operations.
  • Implement data and model governance practices to maintain secure AI pipelines.

What you need:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or related technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML compute environments, distributed systems, or HPC.
  • Skills in IaC (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation) and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and cloud networking/storage optimization.
  • Strong understanding of secure cloud practices and multi enclave operations.
  • Effective communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
  • Active Top Secret clearance required

Nice to have:

  • Experience with hybrid or multi-cloud integrations.
  • Familiarity with GPU/accelerator hardware and AI optimized cloud patterns.
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Architect).
  • Experience working in high security or classified environments.

Unique Skills:

  • Air-gapped hybrid cloud and on-premises operational environments, including complex multi-enclave ecosystems.
  • AWS GovCloud/SC2S/C2S and GCP cloud platforms Nutanix host and cluster configuration, management with Prism Central, and NDFS configuration/management.
  • Cisco switching, routing, firewalling, and site-to-site functionality (such as IPSEC, DMVPN, and SD-WAN).
  • Locally hosted GPU servers.
  • Multi-tenant Cross-Domain Solutions (CDS).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Cloud-native security implementation and security accreditation processes.
  • Advanced GitLab CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
  • Enterprise database services (RDS, RDS Aurora, DynamoDB).
  • Serverless architectures (Lambda).
  • Cloud networking and VPC configuration.
  • Monitoring, logging, and data platforms (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk).
  • Microservices architecture and API Gateway implementation.
  • Development experience with Python, .NET/C#, and related languages.
  • Identity and access services (Microsoft Active Directory, LDAP / OpenLDAP, Entra ID, Keycloak).
  • High assurance cross-domain and encryption solutions (TACLANE, NCAP).
  • Cloud cost optimization techniques.
  • Operating Systems: Linux (e.g., Rocky, RedHat, Amazon, Ubuntu), Windows, and Mac OS.

descriptionHtml:
Koniag Technology Solutions, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a motivated Junior Cloud Engineer to join a focused, dynamic team supporting cloud service offerings for a government agency undergoing cloud modernization and migration. The ideal candidate is an eager team-player with foundational knowledge of cloud services and computing across one or more major cloud platforms, a passion for automation and continuous learning, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a fast-paced, agile environment. This position requires an active Secret Clearance to support our government customer. This is for a future new business opportunity.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

Responsibilities

The Junior Cloud Engineer will serve as a contributing member of a focused, small team responsible for supporting cloud service offerings used by a federal agency to modernize and migrate systems to the cloud. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and the team lead, the Junior Cloud Engineer will assist in the design, implementation, and day-to-day support of cloud solutions across one or more major cloud platforms, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role provides an excellent opportunity to grow technical skills in a collaborative, mission-driven environment. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Assist in the support and maintenance of cloud service offerings operating at FISMA Moderate and FISMA High security levels.
  • Work collaboratively with senior engineers, the Scrum Master, and security engineers to contribute to the build and ongoing improvement of cloud service offerings.
  • Assist in the implementation of proof of concepts and pilots for various cloud solutions under the direction of senior team members.
  • Support the development of operational plans, documentation, and implementation plans for solutions used to access and leverage cloud platforms.
  • Assist in building and maintaining YAML-based CI/CD pipelines leveraging tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar.
  • Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) efforts using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible, or similar under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Develop and maintain basic scripting solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar languages to support operational and automation tasks.
  • Partner with senior engineers and operations teams to troubleshoot automation issues and contribute to practical solutions that move projects forward.
  • Support Change and Configuration Management processes in accordance with team best practices.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to a team culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Research and evaluate emerging cloud technologies and solutions across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP, presenting findings to the team as directed.

Required

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of one entry-level cloud certification from a major cloud provider, including but not limited to:
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
    • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
    • Google Cloud Certified: Cloud Digital Leader or Associate Cloud Engineer
    • Or an equivalent entry-level certification from a recognized cloud provider
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a cloud computing or cloud engineering role, utilizing one or more of the following platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Active Secret Clearance or higher.
Desired

  • Associate-level or higher cloud certification from a major cloud provider, including but not limited to:

Job Category
