Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Our Public Cloud engineering teams are responsible for maintaining and building out a large-scale distributed systems engineering platform that supports hundreds of features for high-compliance environments. As a software engineer on the GovCloud Developer Platform team, you will work within team-defined designs and architecture to help deliver robust product onboarding experiences, cloud-native services, and resilient infrastructure. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers to implement microservices, participate in on-call rotations, and ensure high availability and security compliance.

Your Impact

  • Deliver feature components supporting our portfolio into high-compliance environments under guidance from senior team members.
  • Build and maintain microservices and cloud infrastructure using tools such as Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Author substrate-aware configurations, modules, and templates based on established team patterns.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve standard system issues and support feature delivery with high test coverage.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, handling common alerts and utilizing team telemetry to troubleshoot operational problems.
  • Write clean, maintainable code, leaving the codebase in better shape than you found it.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2 - 4 years of experience in a software development role building and managing cloud infrastructure or distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern language such as Python, Go, or Java.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native tooling and orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working within Agile development methodologies, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and writing well-tested code.
  • Strong willingness to ask questions, learn system architectures, and collaborate effectively with a team.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $117,200 - $223,900 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $141,200 - $246,000 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

Description

﻿SAIC is a premier technology integrator driving our nation’s technology transformation, and we are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team in Charleston, SC or New Orleans, LA. In this role, you will support the day-to-day operations of AWS cloud environments that host mission-critical applications in a Navy/DoD cloud hosting environment. You will perform foundational system administration and operational tasks, such as monitoring, security hardening, backup and recovery, automation, and ticket resolution, so that mission owners have reliable, secure, and consistently managed platforms. You will work as part of a cloud operations team, and you will have room to build your technical skills and certifications as you grow.

Note Candidates must reside in either Charleston, SC or New Orleans, LA for this onsite role.

Job Duties

  • Manage and maintain existing AWS infrastructure, including EC2 instances, S3 buckets, VPCs, RDS instances, and related AWS services.
  • Configure and manage security groups, network access control lists (ACLs), and other security controls that protect cloud infrastructure and data.
  • Monitor system performance and health using Amazon CloudWatch, dashboards, and other monitoring tools, and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and system errors.
  • Implement and manage backup and disaster recovery solutions, such as AWS Backup, snapshots, and Data Lifecycle Manager.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools that streamline operational tasks and improve efficiency.
  • Manage and resolve support tickets within established Service Level Agreement (SLA) priority levels.
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with customers and teammates by providing exceptional customer service.
  • Stay current on new AWS services, features, and best practices.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure system availability and respond to incidents outside of normal business hours.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical documentation.

Qualifications

Required Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree and five (5) or more years of work experience.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in cloud engineering, with a focus on AWS.
  • Systems AWS services (EC2, S3, VPC, RDS, and CloudWatch).
  • DoD 8570/8140 Must meet IAT Level II requirements, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, CASP+, or CISSP.

Required Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance at start, with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance.

Required Certifications

  • Vendor/platform certification Must have a vendor or platform certification, such as AWS Cloud Practitioner.
  • Agile certification Must obtain an Agile Developer certification or a Certified Scrum Developer certification.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with both Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Knowledge of DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs).
  • An advanced AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator.

Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Essential services power the real economy. Every one of us interacts with these industries repeatedly throughout our lives.

But these large businesses face real-world constraints—human labor, external volatility, compliance, logistics, and physical infrastructure. Their operations are complex and often rely on outdated systems and manual workflows, and they can’t access the frontier technologies that drive digital-first businesses.

In a world where startups mostly build for startups, we serve the large enterprises in real industries and end users that keep America running. We're a small team of relentless builders, ex-founders, and immigrants from top CS schools and tech companies who thrive on solving hard problems and making a tangible impact.

We are backed by the best investors and founders of our generation.
companySlogan: The AI revenue engine for essential service industries that keep America running.
descriptionHtml:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll architect and scale the backbone supporting our autonomous AI agents—tackling real-world challenges with immediate, tangible impact. You’ll collaborate with a driven team of builders to shape infrastructure and processes from the ground up, leveraging cutting-edge cloud and orchestration technologies. If you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are excited to set new standards in the agentic space, this is your opportunity to build and leave your mark.

What You'll Do

  • Build cloud infrastructure: Design and operate the backbone that hosts our AI agents and supports our platform.
  • Automate operations: Create infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines for reliable releases.
  • Enable scale: Implement systems that handle usage spikes gracefully through autoscaling and multi-region support.
  • Create observability: Build monitoring, logging, and dashboards that provide real-time visibility into system health.
  • Maintain security: Implement security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, and audit trails.

What You'll Bring

  • Infrastructure experience: Seasoned in running distributed systems at scale with major cloud platforms (we use GCP but AWS and Azure is great, too).
  • Automation skills: Proven record of owning infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines (Terraform, Git Actions, etc).
  • Performance expertise: Experience optimizing systems and databases to meet latency and cost targets under multi-modal workloads. For example, experience with pgBouncer, Kubernetes-based autoscaling, and similar tools.
  • Observability knowledge: Fluent with modern monitoring and tracing tooling (we use Datadog) and built-in tools in Vercel or GCP.
  • Security awareness: Understanding of enterprise security requirements and compliance needs like authentication and service proxies.
  • Product mindset: Treat infrastructure as a product and prioritize ambiguous requirements to see around the corner for 1-2 years ahead of our current systems—measure impact and iterate continuously.

Our values

  • Obsess over the customer
  • Every second counts
  • Sweat the details
  • There are no blockers
  • Be self-directed
  • Seek and speak the truth
  • Enjoy the ride

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Job Description:


Who We Are

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory and on-demand talent solutions, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration, culture shaping and on-demand, independent talent solutions. Heidrick & Struggles pioneered the profession of executive search more than 70 years ago. Today, the firm provides integrated talent and human capital solutions to help our clients change the world, one leadership team at a time.®

Additional information on the firm can be found at www.heidrick.com.


The Role

The Cloud Engineer will have practical, hands-on experience with all aspects of cloud infrastructure design and management in an enterprise environment. This role is expected to provide strong technical leadership and relevant recommendations regarding the design, implementation and support of the enterprise cloud environment including migration to the cloud suitable internal infrastructure and will be responsible for maintaining and expanding a secure, scalable, and efficient cloud infrastructure. This environment includes approximately 2400 staff members located in more than 60 offices across the globe.


Heidrick & Struggles currently utilizes several third-party organizations to provide Helpdesk and Level 1-3 support. The candidate will be expected to interact with these organizations on an on-going basis to ensure that as-implemented technology is aligned and does not negatively impact the business. The candidate will also be required to provide a high level of technical expertise and leadership on an as-needed basis for the rest of the team.


The Cloud Engineer will have primary responsibility for all cloud and on-prem infrastructure (including one colocation facility) management, process design, implementation, maintenance, and support throughout the Heidrick & Struggles environment. Additional responsibilities include overall project management, technical and architecture design, cost effectiveness, quality of solution, knowledge transfer, documentation, and mentoring of technical team members.


Responsibilities

  • Microsoft Technologies (Active Directory, Windows Servers, Exchange, etc.)
  • Lead cross-functional cloud and platform initiatives while providing clear, timely communication to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Design, implement, and maintain standardized cloud platform services that enable secure, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure operations.
  • Manage and maintain on-prem and cloud infrastructure along with currency of documentation.
  • Coordinate closely with our global Information Security team to ensure infrastructure meets data protection standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, NIST)
  • Collaborate across engineering, operations, security, and business teams to align platform solutions with organizational objectives and operational requirements.
  • Implement APIs to enhance integration across cloud environments as well as on premise.
  • Collaborate to define and implement platform engineering standards, cloud operational best practices, and service resilience strategies that improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Design and implement observability and telemetry solutions that provide actionable insights into platform health, performance, and service reliability.
  • Prioritize engineering and operational initiatives based on risk, business impact, service reliability, and platform sustainability.
  • Develop and maintain automated cloud monitoring, alerting, and reporting capabilities to enhance operational visibility and reduce manual effort.
  • Act as a mentor to junior engineers, promoting best practices in system design, operations, and documentation.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals.
  • Ability to contribute to the development and refinement of Heidrick & Struggles technology roadmaps by proactively assessing current technology capabilities against current and emerging business needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.
  • Attention to detail, strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent Interpersonal skills.
  • Energetic team player who works well across boundaries and readily adapts to change and enjoys rapid development.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience designing, implementing, and managing complex cloud environments.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience of full-stack IT: *nix, Windows, GPO, hardware, network/firewall concepts, public and private cloud services, LDAP/Active Directory, automation tools, virtualization.
  • Hands on practical experience working with AWS and Microsoft Azure components and tools.
  • Experience with Network Security Hardware & Software Management; Patch Management and Vulnerability.
  • Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP networking and network services such as DNS, SMTP, DHCP, etc.
  • Understanding links and impact between networks, applications, and systems
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements, such as SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, etc.
  • Working knowledge of various project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile)


Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

  • Securing Cloud-based servers & applications.
  • Linux.
  • Certification on AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience creating documentation and diagrams
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and securing cloud applications, environments, and servers.
  • Experience with shell scripting and one or more programming languages is strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing & implementing global cloud solutions with a focus on performance & accessibility


Pay Range Guidelines for this Position:

The salary range for this position is 120000 USD to 140000 USD. Compensation is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience and skills. In addition to your salary, Heidrick & Struggles offers discretionary bonuses (subject to eligibility requirements) and a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental, vision, disability leave, parental leave, paid time off and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Note: we have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in other locations.


Heidrick & Struggles is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, veteran or military status, or citizenship status.

companyDescription: Created by researchers from UC Berkeley, Arena (formerly LMArena) is a community-powered platform to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use. Tens of millions of builders, researchers, and creative professionals come to Arena to use frontier models and give feedback on their responses, shaping a public leaderboard grounded in real-world use.
companySlogan: Where AI meets the real world.
descriptionHtml:
About Arena Intelligence

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus.

About The Role

Arena Intelligence is seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to drive the strategy and execution of the platform that runs Arena. You'll own the infra to enable our apps, API and AI agents, also how the compute, and data pipelines are hosted, connected, and secured across multiple clouds and managed platforms. You'll make the key decisions: where our applications should run, how long-running agent workflows should be executed, and when managed services are worth it versus running our own. Then you'll build it with the team.

As our cloud infrastructure engineer, you'll partner closely with product, research, data, and security to make our platform fast to build on, reliable at scale, and secure by default. You'll set the standards for identity, secrets, networking, and infrastructure-as-code, and you'll help grow the infrastructure team as we scale.

YOU'LL

  • Own Arena's cloud architecture end to end: hosting, compute, networking, and the infra our products are built on.
  • Decide and execute on our hosting and workload strategy, including serverless and edge platforms, containers and Kubernetes, and durable execution for long-running AI agent workflows.
  • Build identity and access the right way: workload identity, least-privilege IAM, short-lived credentials, and centralized, audited secrets management.
  • Design network boundaries, private connectivity, and egress controls for our databases and services.
  • Manage all infrastructure as code with clear ownership, CI/CD, and review practices.
  • Establish reliability practices: SLOs, monitoring and alerting, on-call, incident response, and post-incident follow-through.
  • Keep infrastructure cost and risk visible, and improve them continuously.
  • Help hire and mentor the infrastructure team as we grow.

YOU'LL HAVE

  • 6+ years of experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure, including owning architecture decisions at a fast-growing company.
  • Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform (or a similar infrastructure-as-code tool).
  • Strong experience with cloud identity and secrets at scale: OIDC and workload identity federation, IAM design, secret managers, and key rotation.
  • Experience running serverless or edge platforms (e.g. Vercel, Cloud Run, Lambda, Cloudflare Workers) and the judgment to know when to use them.
  • Experience with queues, workflow engines, or durable execution systems for long-running and asynchronous workloads.
  • A track record of leading infrastructure through incidents and turning lessons into lasting improvements.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to explain trade-offs to engineers and leadership.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI products, such as sandboxed code execution, model serving, or GPU clusters.
  • Experience with data platforms (Databricks or similar) and Postgres at scale.
  • Background in cloud security, detection engineering, or security posture tooling.
  • Experience as the first infrastructure hire at a fast-growing startup.

What we offer

  • We offer competitive compensation aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The compensation range for each role is listed on its posting and will depend on the candidate's experience and work location.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI with a small, mission-driven team
  • A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact

Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI.

Arena Intelligence provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

companyDescription:
Quva is a national, industry-leading provider of health-system pharmacy services and solutions, including 503B sterile injectable outsourcing and data software solutions that generate insights to help power the business of pharmacy. 

Quva Pharma’s FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities provide hospitals with essential medications in ready-to-administer formats that are demanded by health care providers and critical to effective patient care. Quva’s unmatched cGMP expertise and pharmaceutical manufacturing background, broad sterile-to-sterile product portfolio, expansive capacity across multiple production facilities that leverage automation and integrated technologies, industry-first dedicated forward distribution capabilities, transparent and accountable customer service, and a patient-first safety orientation combine to help hospitals better meet their patient care and operational needs while reducing compliance risk.

Quva BrightStream’s predictive analytics and data insights software solutions partners with health systems to aggregate, normalize, and analyze large amounts of complex data across all sites of care, and through our proprietary machine learning and AI platform, transforms complex data into actionable insights supporting revenue optimization, script capture, inventory management, drug shortage control, and more so health-system pharmacy can have total clarity to make better decisions.

Quva’s overall progressive and integrated platform helps health-systems transform pharmacy management to achieve greater value by operating more efficiently and effectively in delivering high-quality patient care.
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer serves as a senior technical leader supporting Quva's hybrid cloud environment spanning private cloud, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and managed-service provider (MSP) delivered cloud services. This role combines hands-on cloud and infrastructure engineering with leadership in architecture, governance, automation, security integration, operational escalation, cost optimization, and technical oversight. The position leads complex initiatives, establishes scalable standards, mentors technical team members, and strengthens internal cloud capability across providers while continuing to leverage external partners for operational scale, specialist capabilities, and after-hours support. At Quva, you will be an essential part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to expanding critical access to quality, affordable medication and data insights while promoting a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What The Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer Does Each Day

  • Lead the technical architecture, engineering standards, roadmap, and lifecycle direction for Quva's private cloud, Azure, and AWS environments
  • Provide direct engineering support for existing private-cloud tenants, including compute, storage, networking, identity integration, monitoring, backup, recovery, and infrastructure troubleshooting
  • Design, implement, and govern Azure and AWS infrastructure using scalable, secure, repeatable patterns aligned with business and application requirements
  • Serve as an internal Azure/AWS technical resource and escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents, complex changes, migrations, integrations, and performance issues
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automation practices using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, AWS CloudFormation, PowerShell, Python, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions, as appropriate to Quva standards
  • Partner with Cybersecurity to integrate cloud identity, privileged access, network security, logging, vulnerability management, endpoint/workload protections, and security monitoring into cloud architecture
  • Architect and maintain cloud connectivity and network services, including virtual networks/VPCs, routing, DNS, VPN/private connectivity, load balancing, firewalls/security groups, and hybrid-cloud integration
  • Implement and maintain standards for cloud observability, monitoring, alerting, log collection, backup, disaster recovery, resilience, and capacity/performance management
  • Contribute technical expertise to workload migration planning, landing-zone design, cloud adoption, tenant/account/subscription structure, and application infrastructure modernization
  • Implement cloud governance controls covering access, resource organization, tagging, configuration standards, policy enforcement, change control, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Monitor and optimize cloud utilization and spend through rightsizing, lifecycle management, reservations/savings approaches where appropriate, resource cleanup, and cost visibility; partner with IT leadership on cloud cost governance

descriptionHtml:
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking a Cloud Engineer. This job is located in Washington D.C. and will be Hybrid. The Cloud Engineer will be responsible for developing cloud solutions, implementing automation, and supporting cloud service delivery models across enterprise environments. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cloud-native technologies, DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code, and containerized environments in Washington D.C. supporting a DOJ Program

Top Secret Clearance Required

Responsibilities of the Cloud Engineer include:

  • Develop cloud-native applications and migrate existing on-premises applications into cloud environments.
  • Analyze applications and recommend cloud migration, optimization, deployment, and modernization strategies.
  • Implement cloud automation, DevSecOps processes, Infrastructure as Code solutions, and containerized deployments.
  • Design secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments while supporting cost optimization and disaster recovery initiatives.
  • Debug cloud services, manage cloud infrastructure, and support enterprise cloud operations.

Qualifications for the Cloud Engineer include:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years of relevant experience.
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and supporting cloud architecture and cloud service delivery models including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and DaaS.
  • Strong experience implementing DevSecOps practices, cloud automation, and GitLab-based development workflows.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies and automated cloud resource provisioning.
  • Experience with containerization, container orchestration, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to analyze applications and develop migration, deployment, cost optimization, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Experience managing cloud policies, governance frameworks, and highly available cloud environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and independent decision-making skills.

Compensation for the Cloud Engineer:

  • Salary range: $130,000 - $180,000 *depending on experience*
  • Comprehensive Benefits: health insurance, dental, vision, and life insurance, as well as a 401(k)/retirement plan, paid time off, and maternity/paternity leave.

This job opens for applications on 10/26/2026. Applications for this job will be accepted for at least 30 days from the posting date.﻿
